Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updated (5/2/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measurement errors of the Vaisala RS 80 radiosonde (Wang et al 2002). Please see the README for details.

dataset.title: Chemiluminescence Instruments for NO, NO2, and O3 Data
dataset.description: Measurements of NO, NO2, and O3 obtained by the 2-channel (NO/NO2) and the fast O3 chemiluminescence instruments onboard the NSF/NCAR GV aircraft during the ACCLIP campaign in August 2022.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Riverton
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Riverton, Wyoming during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2007-10-24 12:00:00 to 2008-01-03 12:00:00.

dataset.title: INDOEX: NCAR/NSF C-130 High Rate (25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Indian Ocean Experiment (INDOEX) . This dataset contains the High Rate (HRT, 25sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: Vandenberg AFB High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Vandenberg Air Force Base High Resolution Radiosonde Data is one of several upper air data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are pressure, temperature, relative humidity, U and V wind components, and altitude taken during radiosonde flights from the United States Air Force Base at Vandenberg, California. The data set covers the period from 7 - 31 July 2001. The soundings are typically available twice per day at 00 and 12 UTC. NCAR/EOL has performed automated quality control on these data. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Radar Reflectivity Forecast Imagery (Craig to Greeley)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of radar reflectivity from Craig, CO to Greeley, CO. The imagery was generated during the ICE-L project and is in PNG format. It covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Radar Reflectivity Forecast Imagery (Monument to Cheyenne)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of radar reflectivity from Monument, CO to Cheyenne, WY. The imagery was generated during the ICE-L project and is in PNG format. It covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: NCEP RUC Model Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 1,2,3,6,9, ans 12-hour NCEP RUC model forecast imagery of integrated liquid and frozen hydrometeors valid between 12 and 18 kft (kilofeet) MSL during the ICE-L project. The data is in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2007-11-15 03:00:00 to 2008-01-03 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Thermal IR Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains data measured with the IR screen setup which is described in the readme file. To facilitate an overview of the captured situations, this dataset contains multiple short videos. The file names correspond to time in local time (Mountain Standard Time). On 2023-01-24 and 2023-02-27, local time is UTC-7h, while LT corresponds to UTC-6h for the measurements in May. Alongside with the videos, the original data is contained in a proprietary format. To open the *.irb-files, the InfraTec IRBIS 3 software is necessary. Furthermore, the file "SOS_IR_times.txt" contains a list of start and end times of all IR screen setup measurement sequences during the project. The original data is contained in a Proprietary Format which requires InfraTec IRBIS 3 software. The data have been packaged into zip files for ordering. This dataset and the individual day files are very large and only one file at a time can be ordered in an order.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data (EOL Format) [NCAR-EOL]
dataset.description: The National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes at 00 and 12 UTC with occasional special releases at sites throughout the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled Tropical Cyclone Intensity (TCI) NWS soundings released at sites near the locations of TCI flown tropical cyclones. TCI flew two storms in the Atlantic (Erika and Joaquin) and two storms in the eastern Pacific basin (Marty and Patricia). For Erika, this data set includes soundings from 25-30 August 2015 from Key West, Miami, Tampa Bay, and San Juan. For Joaquin, the included soundings are from 25 September to 6 October 2015 from Albuquerque, Albany, Birmingham, Amarillo, Brownsville, Buffalo, Caribou, Chatham, Corpus Christi, Del Rio, Greensboro, Fort Worth, Gray, Sterling, Lake Charles, Wilmington, Lincoln, Jackson, Slidell, Little Rock, Midland, Nashville, Norman, Pittsburgh, Blacksburg, Shreveport, Key West, Miami, Jacksonville, Charleston, Tampa Bay, Tallahassee, Newport, Upton, and San Juan. For Patricia, the included soundings are from 19-24 October 2015 from Brownsville and Corpus Christi. Marty was not near any NWS sounding locations. A total of 1059 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final TCI data set.

dataset.title: Chemistry Ozone (O3) [Campos, T. (NCAR/RAF)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains ozone measurements at 1hz collected during the PREDICT project. The data is in columnar ascii format.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Nauru
dataset.description: This dataset consists of Integrated Sounding System (ISS) sounding data from Nauru Island (WMO 91530) which was operated by Taiwan under agreement with Nauru. Soundings were taken twice daily (00 and 12 UTC) during EMP and four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) during the IOP. UCAR/JOSS conducted no quality control on these data. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updated (4/23/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measurement errors of the Vaisala RS80 radiosonde (Wang et al 2002). Please see the README for additional information.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ARISTO2015, the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number C130_N130AR) flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: FO3 (Fast Ozone) Low Rate Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains ozone (O3) by chemiluminescent reaction with excess nitric oxide (NO) collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) during the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades) project. This dataset is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments. Note: Data from 07/14/2015 added 09/24/2018.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Vertical Velocity Forecast Imagery (Craig to Greeley)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer cross-sections of vertical velocity. The imagery was generated from Craig, CO to Greeley, CO to during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Giant Nuclei Impactor (GNI) NaCl-equivalent Sea-Salt Size Distributions
dataset.description: This dataset contains Giant Nuclei Impactor (GNI) NaCl-equivalent Sea-Salt Size Distributions collected by the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ORCAS (O2/N2 Ratio and CO2 Airborne Southern Ocean Study) campaign. The size distributions are given as spherical dry radius in 97 bins each of 0.2 μm width starting from 0.8 μm (center of bin) and extending to 20 μm (center of bin). The data were obtained by exposing polycarbonate in the free air streak outside the NSF/NCAR GV aircraft. Slides are available for ORCAS research flights RF08, RF15 and RF17. The slides were analyzed in the NCAR/EOL/RAF GNI slide chamber, using a dual-optical microscope. Slides were inserted into a humidified chamber with a relative humidity of 90%. The images were analyzed using an automated edge detection algorithm, and using spherical cap geometry to determine the solution drop volume. Subsequently, the equivalent dry NaCl (Sodium Chloride) equivalent radius was determined using the Kohler equation for concentrated solutions. The size distributions are intended to be used as aerosol size distributions (Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei, GCCN) for cloud modeling studies, as aerosol size distributions for atmospheric radiation studies, and as aerosol size distributions for atmospheric chemistry studies.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the MIC-78 project. This dataset contains high rate (primarily 10sps) navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Upper Air - Leon High Resolution Soundings
dataset.description: This data set consists of CLASS soundings taken at Leon, Kansas for the CASES-99 program. The site was operated by the National Center for Atmospheric Research/Atmospheric Technology Division (NCAR/ATD). UCAR/JOSS has not changed these soundings in any way. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the README file for details.

dataset.title: CEDRIC Cartesian files (realtime, experimental, in ced format)
dataset.description: This data set consists of PECAN CEDRIC (Custom Editing and Display of Reduced Information in Cartesian Space) Cartesian data files for individual NEXRAD radars. They can be used to create Multi Doppler analysis prducts (realtime, experimental, in ced format), collected continuously during the PECAN (Plains Elevated Convection at Night) project.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Surface Radar Reflectivity Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather and Research Forecast Model (WRF) 1 kilometer surface radar reflectivity forecast imagery generated during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: EPTA (Expanded Precipitation Type Algorithm) ICICLE Data
dataset.description: The EPTA (Expanded Precipitation Type Algorithm) ICICLE Data Set contains EPTA output for 'PWD' freezing drizzle algorithms. At the conclusion of ICICLE, the EPTA was run on data collected from 26 January - 8 March 2019 at each of five surface sites as part of the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field experiement. The EPTA output for each site has been archived to include one-minute reports of ice accretion, ice accretion rate, EPTA present weather type, and PWD-22 present weather type.

dataset.title: NCAS Manchester Radar Wind Profiler 1290MHz Alvaiade Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains the wind profile, signal-to-noise ratio, and spectral width data from the 1290 MHz radar wind profiler operated by the National Centre for Atmospheric Science (NCAS) Atmospheric Measurement Facility (AMF) and located at the Perdigao operations center in Alvaiade, Portugal during the Perdigao field project in 2017. The profiler is a Degreane Horizon 3-beam UHF radar boundary layer wind profiler operating at 1290 MHz. This dataset includes 1 minute and 15 minute wind data for both the low and high range in NetCDF format as well as browse imagery.

dataset.title: MDB: Murrumbidgee Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) Murray-Darling Basin (MDB) Murrumbidgee 30 Minute Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the 10 stations in the Murrumbidgee river basin for the CEOP EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period. This data set contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004) and the updated data 1 January 2005 through 30 November 2007 data. Prior to December 2006 the Cootmundra stations wind data came from hand held instrumentation at 2m height. Startin in December 2006 the wind data come from a 10 m wind sensor on a Young AWS located about 35 km away. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Radar Reflectivity Forecast Imagery (Jackson to Douglas)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of radar reflectivity from Jackson, WY to Douglas, WY. The imagery was generated during the ICE-L project and is in PNG format. It covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: HIAPER Atmospheric Radiation Package (HARP) Spectral Irradiance (SI)
dataset.description: During PACDEX, the GV collected spectral irradiance measurements in the zenith and nadir directions. This data is stored in IDL SAVE file format, one file per day. To access this data, start idl and use the restore command to ingest the data. Data are available for days there were flights. See the missions page within the PACDEX field catalog for a list of flights made. Please contact Bruce Kindel (kindel@ucar.edu) before using the nadir spectral irradiance data acquired during PACDEX. An aircraft vibration problem related to the mounting of the instrument degraded the stability of the measurements. Some flights are of good quality (i.e. stable to 1-5%) while others are of rather poor quality (30-40% changes). This pertains only to the nadir data. The zenith data was stable to 1-2% over the entire experiment.

dataset.title: GAPP: Ft. Peck Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) Global Energy and Water Cycle Experiment (GEWEX) Americas Prediction Project (GAPP) Ft. Peck 30 Minute Flux Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the single Ft. Peck station from the Ft. Peck reference site for the CEOP EOP-3 time period. This dataset only contains the first half of the EOP-3 time period (i.e. 1 October 2002 through 31 March 2003). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Coplanar Lidar Analysis Data
dataset.description: Coplanar lidar analysis data derived from two German Aerospace Center (DLR) scanning lidars deployed during the Perdigão field project.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Equivalent Potential Temperature Forecast Imagery (Kremmling to Cheyenne)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of Theta-E (Equivalent Potential Temperature). The imagery was generated from Kremmling, CO to Cheyenne, WY during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: AeroLaser Vacuum Ultra Violet (VUV) Fluorescence In Situ Carbon monoxide (CO) mixing ratio [Campos (NCAR/RAF)]
dataset.description: The AeroLaser Vacuum Ultra Violet (VUV) resonance fluorescence instrument measured carbon monoxide concentrations from the NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-4. This dataset contains RAF CO data in NASA Ames format collected during HIPPO-4

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ARISTO2015, the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number C130_N130AR) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) netCDF format files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Mexico: Megacities Impact on Regional and Global Environment (MIRAGE) This experiment is a sub-program of the Megacity Initiative: Local and Global Research Observations (MILAGRO4. There are no IR data available for RF03 thru RF05 inclusive (2006-03-10 16:21 - 2006-03-17 00:18) due to equipment problems.

dataset.title: GAPP: Bondville Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) Global Energy and Water Cycle Experiment (GEWEX) Americas Prediction Project (GAPP) Bondville 30 Minute Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the single station at the Bondville reference site for the CEOP EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: LBA: Santarem Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) Large Scale Biosphere-Atmosphere Experiment in Amazonia (LBA) Santarem Flux Data Set. This data set contains half-hourly data from a single station for the complete CEOP EOP-3 time period (01 October 2002 to 30 September 2003). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: University of Innsbruck Weather Station on Wheels (WOW) QCF Data
dataset.description: This data set contains surface meteorological data from the Weather Station on Wheels (WOW), an instrumented vehicle deployed during the T-REX project. WOW measured horizontal wind direction and speed, pressure, temperature and dew point, radiation and position while driving along different road legs in Owens Valley. There is one mobile WOW station included in this data set. The WOW station was not included in the Horizontal Quality Control process because it is a mobile station.

dataset.title: In Situ Chemiluminescence NO, NOy, O3 Data
dataset.description: This data set contains In Situ Chemiluminescence nitric oxide (NO), total reactive nitrogen (NOy), and ozone (O3) mixing ratio data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft during the Wintertime Investigation of Transport, Emission, and Reactivity (WINTER) project. This dataset contains data in NASA ICARTT format.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: High vertical resolution radiosonde data from National Weather Service radiosonde stations within and near the TORUS-LItE (Targeted Observation by Radars and UAS of Supercells - Left-flank Intensive Experiment) domain. High resolution (1 second vertical levels) are included from 20 stations.

dataset.title: CEOP_AP: Western Pacific Ocean Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) CEOP_AP 30 minute Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from two stations (Aimeliik and Peleliu). Data from Aimeliik are available from 1 April 2003 to 31 December 2004 and data from Peleliu are available from 29 November 2002 through 31 December 2004 and 1 January 2007 to 31 December 2007. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: ACCLIP NSF/NCAR GV Instrument Data Merges - GTCIMS-based
dataset.description: The GTCIMS-based merger of the data from the instrumentation that was onboard the NSF/NCAR GV aircraft for the ACCLIP campaign. The GTCIMS (Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer) data are the base data for this dataset leading to a data point about once every three seconds along the flight path.

dataset.title: ISFS High Rate Surface Meteorology and Flux Products, non-tilt-corrected 3D sonic anemometers
dataset.description: This dataset contains non-tilt-corrected high-rate ISFS data collected from 20 September to 1 December 2012 as part of the Shallow Cold Pool (SCP) Experiment.

dataset.title: SPEC Learjet Flight Videos
dataset.description: Flight videos collected on board the SPEC Learjet during the Experiment of Sea Breeze Convection, Aerosols, Precipitation and Environment (ESCAPE) field campaign from 2 June through 17 June 2021. These videos are in AVI format.

dataset.title: CEOP_AP Eastern Siberia Taiga Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) CEOP_AP Siberia Taiga Half Hourly Surface Data Set. This data set contains data from seven stations in the CEOP_AP Eastern Siberia Taiga reference site.This dataset contains data from the time period 1 October 2002 through 17 December 2004 and all of 2007. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Atmospheric Tunable Laser Absorption Spectroscopy - 1982 (ATLAS-82) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: In Situ Carbon monoxide (CO) mixing ratio [Campos (NCAR/RAF)]
dataset.description: This data set contains carbon monoxide concentrations from the NSF/NCAR C-130. The NSF/NCAR C-130 platform measured carbon monoxide using a modified TECO Model 48 gas filter correlation analyzer. The data cover the INDOEX C-130 research flights occurring between 24 February, 1999 and 24 March, 1999.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Padang
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Padang, Indonesia (WMO 96163) which was operated bythe Indonesian Meteorological Service. Soundings were taken twice daily (00 and 12 UTC) during the IOP. The data were processed through the automated, visual, and spatial quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Data were taken at 30/60 second vertical intervals prior to late January 1993, after late January 1993 data were taken at six second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) [Haggerty, NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains NGV Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) data measure aboard the NSF/NCAR GV during the MPEX project. The data is in NASA AMES format.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Mixing Ratio Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) 1 kilometer mixing ratio forecast imagery generated in 5 Colorado cities and 3 Wyoming cities during the ICE-L project. Data for Colorado is available to order below from the following cities: Craig, Denver, Eagle, Greeley, and Monument. Wyoming forecast data is available for Cheyenne, Laramie, and Rawlins. The imagery contains cloud water, rain water, snow, Graupel, and cloud-ice mixing ratios The imagery is in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: CTW: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) - sweep file format
dataset.description: This data set includes SABL lidar sweep files obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Coastally Trapped Waves (CTW) project.

dataset.title: AeroLaser Vacuum Ultra Violet (VUV) Fluorescence In Situ Carbon monoxide (CO) mixing ratio [Campos (NCAR/RAF)]
dataset.description: The AeroLaser Vacuum Ultra Violet (VUV) resonance fluorescence instrument measured carbon monoxide concentrations from the NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-5. This dataset contains RAF CO data in NASA Ames format collected during HIPPO-5.

dataset.title: UAH Mobile Alabama Sounding Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) 2012 project. This data set includes 22 high vertical resolution (1-sec) soundings from the UAH Mobile site taken in locations around northern Alabama and southern Tennessee from 15 May to 15 June 2012. These data were provided by the University of Alabama-Huntsville. NCAR/EOL converted the soundings to ESC format and passed them through a QC process.

dataset.title: HIAPER Airborne Radiation Package (HARP) Actinic Flux Data
dataset.description: Photolysis frequencies and actinic flux data from the HIAPER Airborne Radiation Package (HARP) that flew aboard the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft for 14 research flights during the ACCLIP campaign. The flights were over the western Pacific Ocean.

dataset.title: LSC-NCAR Photogrammetry and Damage Surveys - CAMB
dataset.description: This data set contains the VORTEX2 LSC-NCAR Photogrammetry data collected by team CAMB during the two VORTEX2 field phases (i.e., 10 May 2009 to 13 June 2009 and 1 May 2010 to 15 June 2010). The objective was to photo document the evolution and structure of the hook region within the supercell. Data were collected by two teams, CAMA and CAMB, during 2009 and three teams, CAMA, CAMB and CAMC, during 2010. Each team was comprised of a photographer and videographer. The teams attempted to collocate with the mobile X-band Doppler radars. For most missions, CAMA, CAMB and CAMC collocated with DOW7, DOW6 and DOW5, respectively. This data set contains only the data collected by team CAMB. Several types of data are contained in this data set including: data digital still imagery (DSLR), HD video, QuickTime movies, panoramas, damage surveys, Google Earth KMZ files, and mission summaries. Both photo and video times are in Central Daylight Time (CDT), unless otherwise noted. Not every type of data was collected for each day. This is a very large data set. Note that much of this data set is available for quick review at: http://meteorology.lyndonstate.edu/vortex2. For more information about instrumentation and when data were collected by each team, please see the readme file. Imagery and video collected by the NSF sponsored Lyndon State College/National Center for Atmospheric Research (LSC/NCAR) photography teams are available for all to use and modify. When publishing original or modified imagery/video electronically or in print, please include an acknowledgment that the data was collected by NSF-supported photography teams under the direction of PIs Nolan Atkins (LSC), Roger Wakimoto (NCAR), and Wen-Chau Lee (NCAR).

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes at 00 and 12 UTC with occasional special releases at sites throughout the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled VORTEX-SE_2016 NWS soundings released at 10 sites throughout the southeastern United States during the VORTEX-SE_2016 field phase (1 March to 2 May 2016). A total of 1280 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final VORTEX-SE_2016 data set.

dataset.title: ARM-CART Soundings
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air soundings taken at the DOE Atmospheric Radiation Measurement - Clouds and Radiation Testbed (ARM-CART) site in Oklahoma. Data from four ARM-CART sites have been included. These data include pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. See the Readme file for more details.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during ICE-T. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: Stossel Box Weight Data
dataset.description: Stossel Box Weight measurements, from two manual lysimeters, collected during the Sublimation of Snow (SOS) field project from 31 January to 2 March 2023. These measurements are available in CSV format. See the readme file for more detail.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During the Front Range Air Pollution and Photochemistry Experiment (FRAPPE), the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number C130_N130AR) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo images (JPEG format) were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the OCFS project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: WRF 12KM Surface 3-hour Precipitation Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather and Research Forecast Model (WRF) 12 kilometer precipitation forecast imagery generated during the ICE-L project. Surface precipitation for 3 hours previous to forecast time is shown. The imagery are in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV flight track in real-time during the ICEBRIDGE project.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Surface 3-hour Precipitation Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather and Research Forecast Model (WRF) 1 kilometer precipitation forecast imagery generated during the ICE-L project. Surface precipitation for 3 hours previous to forecast time is shown. The imagery are in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: START-08 Multiple Enclosure Device for Unfractionated Sampling of Air (MEDUSA) Kernel Data
dataset.description: The Multiple Enclosure Device for Unfractionated Sampling of Air (MEDUSA) Kernel data from the START-08: Stratosphere-Troposphere Analyses of Regional Transport project are contained in this dataset. This dataset includes measurements made by the Scripps Institution of Oceanography (SIO) O2 Program on kernels collected by the NCAR/SIO Medusa Whole Air Sampler. These data were collected on the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream V (GV).

dataset.title: CAMP: Tibet Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Tibet Hourly Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. There are 12 stations included in this dataset. This dataset contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (ISS1 Homestead Site)
dataset.description: 1-minute surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Homestead site during the SAVANT field campaign. These data have been checked for quality and are available in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: CAMP: Siberia Taiga Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Siberia Taiga Half Hourly Tower Data Set. This dataset contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 17 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Council Climate NCAR ISS RASS Virtual Temperatures for Tundra Site (C2) (ASCII)
dataset.description: This dataset contains vertical profiles of virtual temperature collected at the Tundra Site (C2) on the Council, Seward Peninsula during the Arctic Transitions in the Land-Atmosphere System (ATLAS) project, 2000 summer field campaign. These data were collected by the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) using the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS). These data are available in ASCII text format and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NO-NOy-O3 [Weinheimer, NCAR/ACD]
dataset.description: This data set contains data collected during START08 research flights. Each txt file contains concentration data of NO, NOy, and O3.

dataset.title: SUNY Albany Ceilometer Data - Gaviota Site
dataset.description: CT12K ceilometer data reports aerosol backscatter intensity and cloud base, up to 12000 feet, collected at the Gaviota Site by the Atmospheric Sciences Research Center (ASRC) at SUNY Albany during SWEX (Sundowner Winds Experiment) field campaign from 20 April through 16 May 2022.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Cooperative Convective Precipitation Experiment (CCOPE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research (NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER) during the CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics experiment (CONTRAST). These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL 2D Display Software (xpms2d) download page.

dataset.title: Main Tower High-Rate Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains high-rate ISFF data for CASES 99.

dataset.title: DOHGS Merged Data Files containing all C-130 Observations
dataset.description: This dataset consists of DOHGS merged data from the 19 research flights with the C-130 over the Southeast U.S. between June 1 and July 15, 2013, as part of the Southeast Atmosphere Study (SAS). Merged data files have been created, combining all observations on the C-130 to a common time base for each flight. Version R5 (created Jan 21, 2015) of the merges includes all data available as of Jan 12. Start and stop times taken from the DOHGS file, midtime calculated from them. Averaging and missing value treatment as in 1-min merge.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Skew-T Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) 1 kilometer Skew-T forecast plots available for various locations across the United States. The imagery was generated during the ICE-L project and is in PNG format. The imagery covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Multiple Project 2008-2016 Medusa Flask Sampler Data
dataset.description: Multiple Enclosure Device for Unfractionated Sampling of Air (MEDUSA) flask and kernel data collected by the NCAR GV can be access through this dataset. This dataset does not contain data. Users can access data via the Companion Datasets listed in the Related Links section. Use the DOI for this multiple project MEDUSA dataset to refer to all linked Companion MEDUSA Datasets.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science Phase 2 (IDEAS-2) project which took place from 3 October 2002 to 1 November 2002. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 Sample Per Second) production data set. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: LBA: Pantanal Hourly Surface Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) Large Scale Biosphere-Atmosphere Experiment in Amazonia (LBA) Pantanal Hourly Surface Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains hourly data from a single station for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: Cordoba Sounding Data
dataset.description: This data set contains atmospheric profiles derived from rawinsondes released from Cordoba, Argentina during the South American Low-Level Jet Experiment (SALLJEX) from 06 December 2002 thru 14 February 2003. Rawinsondes were generally released once per day at 12 UTC. Consult the README for more information. SALLJEX was funded by NOAA/OGP, NSF(ATM0106776) and funding agencies from Brazil FAPESP Grant 01/13816-1) and Argentina (ANPCYT PICT 07-06671, UBACyT 055).

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Relative Humidity Forecast Imagery (Rawlins to Cheyenne)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of relative humidity. The imagery was generated from Rawlins, WY to Cheyenne, WY during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation data subset (ICARTT format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V HIAPER (NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) project from 18 May 2012 to 30 June 2012. This data set is a subset of the low rate aircraft data that contains a select set of the navigation parameters. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Kota Kinabalu
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Kota Kinabalu in Malaysia (WMO 96471). Soundings were taken four time per (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) during the IOP, however the 06 and 18 UTC releases contain only wind information. UCAR/JOSS conducted no quality control on these data. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at a variable vertical resolution. Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updates (5/2/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measurement errors of the Vaisala RS 80 radiosonde(Wang et al 2002). Please see the README for details.

dataset.title: ACE-ASIA Aircraft: C-130 Chemistry O3 and Fast O3 (Campos/Faloona)
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements using two instruments (slow and fast ozone) during 19 research flights made by the NCAR C-130 during the ACE-Asia field project. All data is in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER Energy and Momentum Flux Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Flight Level Analysis from the 2014 DEEPWAVE campaign from June 6, 2014 to July 20, 2014. This data set is in an excel spreadsheet format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data (NetCDF) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V HIAPER (NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format. Concentrations were NOT converted to STP.

dataset.title: HIAPER Atmospheric Radiation Package (HARP) Data
dataset.description: This data set contains HIAPER Atmospheric Radiation Package (HARP) data collected during the CSET (Cloud Systems Evolution in the Trades) project from 1 July to 8 August 2015. These data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [Jensen, J. (NCAR-EOL-RAF)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR G-V during IDEAS-4 GV. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: NASA DC-8 Photolysis Frequencies calculated from measured Actinic Flux
dataset.description: This data set contains NASA DC-8 Photolysis Frequencies calculated from NCAR CAFS (CCD Actinic Flux Spectroradiometers) collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 4 May 2012 through 22 June 2012. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Equivalent Potential Temperature Forecast Imagery (Rawlins to Goodland)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of Theta-E (Equivalent Potential Temperature). The imagery was generated from Rawlins, WY to Goodland, KS during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) [Haggerty, J. and M. J. Mahoney (NCAR/EOL, JPL)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains NGV Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) data measure aboard the NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-1. The data are in NASA AMES format.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Mulitchannel Cloud Radiometer [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The MCR is a seven-channel radiometer that scans between ±45° about the NSF/NCAR C-130 track. This dataset contains MCR data collected during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science Phase 1 (IDEAS-1) project which took place from 5 April 2002 to 14 May 2002. This data can be viewed using MCRVIEW available for download below.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 ELDORA Radar Data
dataset.description: The Electra Doppler Radar (ELDORA) is an airborne, dual beam, meteorological research radar developed jointly by NCAR and France's Centre de Recherches en Physique de L'Environnement Terrestre et Planetaire (CRPE). The ELDORA radar operated during T-PARC/TCS08 on the NRL-P3 aircraft for 23 research flights from 12 August to 4 October 2008. The data are in DORADE (Doppler Radar Exchange) sweep files tarred into 10 minute chunks.

dataset.title: ARM-CART 915 Mhz Profiler and RASS Data Set
dataset.description: This dataset contains vertical profiles of virtual temperature and wind speed and direction taken from the Department of Energy (DOE) Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Southern Great Plains (SGP) Clouds and Radiation Testbed (CART) Central Facility 915 Mhz Profiler and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) in Lamont, Oklahoma. Profiles are generated every hour. The vertical resolution of RASS virtual temperature is 100 m. The vertical resolution of the high mode wind profiles is 200 m and for the low mode wind profiles it is 60 m. See the Readme file for more details.

dataset.title: Lake-ICE Surface: MAPS Analysis (T,dew point,P,P tendency) (GIF)
dataset.description: US MAPS surface analysis provided every 3 hours. 4-Panel plot includes temperature, dew point, pressure and pressure tendency. Images taken from NCAR/RAP site generated at NMC.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Kavieng
dataset.description: This dataset consists of Integrated Sounding System (ISS) sounding data from Kavieng (WMO 94076) which was operated by the Papua New Guinea Meteorological Service. Soundings were taken four times daily (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC) during the IOP. UCAR/JOSS conducted no quality control on these data. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updated (4/18/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measurement errors of the Vaisala RS80 radiosonde (Wang et al 2002). Please see the README file for additional information.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science Phase 1 (IDEAS-1) project which took place from 5 April 2002 to 14 May 2002. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Equivalent Potential Temperature Forecast Imagery (Rifle to Greeley)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of Theta-E (Equivalent Potential Temperature). The imagery was generated from Rifle, CO to Greeley, CO during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Equivalent Potential Temperature Forecast Imagery (Rock Springs to Ogallala)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of Theta-E (Equivalent Potential Temperature). The imagery was generated from Rock Springs, WY to Ogallala, NE during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: HIPPO-4 Airborne Oxygen Instrument (AO2)
dataset.description: The NCAR Airborne Oxygen Instrument (AO2) was mounted on the NCAR GV during the HIPPO-4 project. The submitted AO2 data are in 1 flat ascii text file per flight. Each file contains running 10-second medians (of the original ~ 2.5-second data) at 1 Hz matching the times in the RAF data files. The files are in NASA Ames 1001 format, with a final comment line of variable names (UT CO2_AO2orig O2_AO2orig APO_AO2orig CO2_AO2 O2_AO2 APO_AO2), spaces separating columns, and 9999.99 for missing data. The reported times correspond to when the air entered the inlet. This instrument measures O2/N2 ratio as well as CO2 concentration.

dataset.title: SPEC Learjet Instrument Data
dataset.description: State and Cloud microphysics data collected on board the SPEC Learjet 35 during the ESCAPE (Experiment of Sea Breeze Convection, Aerosols, Precipitation, and Environment) field project, collected from 2 June to 17 June 2022. This data set is in ICARTT format, available as one zipped file per research flight. Please see the ReadMe file and the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information and data set comments.

dataset.title: ACCLIP NSF/NCAR GV Instrument Data Merges - 10 Second
dataset.description: The 10 second resolution merger of the data from the instrumentation that was onboard the NSF/NCAR GV aircraft for the ACCLIP campaign.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Relative Humidity Forecast Imagery (Rock Springs to Ogallala)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of relative humidity. The imagery was generated from Rock Springs, WY to Ogallala, NE during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: GTS PACS Region Land Meteorological Data
dataset.description: This data set contains all land-based surface meteorological observations available from GTS over the region from 30 N to 60 S latitude and 30 to 150 W longitude as collected by NCAR/SCD. It includes site identifier information, wind speed and direction, surface and sea level pressure, air temperature, and dew point depression. These data have undergone no quality control. See the README for more details. NOTE: Starting with the data in February 2001 and continuing through sometime in July of 2002 the wind observations at many of the stations are incorrect (about twice what they should be).

dataset.title: Constant Pressure Level Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains 12-hourly constant pressure level maps over the continental US. The levels included are 200, 250, 300, 500, 700 and 850 mb. During PLOWS 2009-2010 the 925 mb level was also included. The maps were generated by NCAR/RAL and contain actual station observations and the RUC initial analysis. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 7 January to 30 March 2009 and 16 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: ARM-CART 50 Mhz Profiler and RASS Data Set
dataset.description: This dataset contains vertical profiles of virtual temperature and wind speed and direction taken from the Department of Energy (DOE) Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Southern Great Plains (SGP) Clouds and Radiation Testbed (CART) Central Facility 50 Mhz Profiler and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) in Lamont, Oklahoma. Profiles are generated every hour. The vertical resolution of RASS virtual temperature is ~150 m. The vertical resolution of the high mode wind profiles is ~1000 m and for the low mode wind profiles it is ~300 m. See the Readme file for more details.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the CONS project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Mixing Ratio Forecast Imagery (Rawlins to Goodland)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of four different mixing ratios, ice number concentration, and temperature. The imagery contains cloud water, rain water, snow, and Graupel mixing ratios. The imagery was generated from Rawlins, WY to Goodland, KS during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: NSF C-130 Radiation Actinic Flux Spectroradiometer [Campos]
dataset.description: This data set contains the Radiation Actinic Flux Spectroradiometer data taken aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft during the Indian Ocean Experiment (INDOEX). The NCAR C-130 platform measured spectrally resolved solar flux. Two spectroradiometers were integrated in zenith and nadir locations to provide upwelling, downwelling and total actinic flux spectra. The data are available as space delimited ASCII files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the CZWEP project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Eta MOLTS Derived Soundings for GCIP Region
dataset.description: The Upper Missouri River Basin Pilot Project (UMRBPP) Eta MOLTS Derived Soundings data set contains NCEP Eta Model Location Time Series (MOLTS) derived soundings for locations within the UMRBPP domain. These output are only for the initial analysis time (i.e. no forecast derived soundings) and only the state parameters (pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, and wind direction). The complete output (including hourly forecast derived soundings with all surface and upper level parameters) in the original BUFR format are available from NCAR/SCD. This data set consists of output from 05 April 1999 to 05 May 1999. See the README file for more details.

dataset.title: FRAPPE Trace Organic Gas Analyzer (TOGA) VOC Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains trace organic gas analyzer (TOGA) data taken aboard the NCAR C130 during the FRAPPE project. VOCs measured include hydrocarbons, oxygenates, halocarbons, nitrogen and sulfur compounds, isoprene, methacrolein, MVK, and acetone. Dataset added July, 2021 to aid in consistent access to instrument datasets collected onboard the NSF/NCAR C-130. The NASA Archive linked below contains the same data files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the CCOPE project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Vertical Velocity Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical velocity forecast imagery generated during the ICE-L project. The data is available at the following heights: 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4.5, 5.5, 6.5, and 7.5 km. The imagery is in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: COAGMET Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Colorado Agricultural Meteorological Network (COAGMET) Hourly Surface Data in QC Format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Eta MOLTS Derived Soundings
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-97 Eta MOLTS Derived Soundings data set contains NCEP Eta Model Location Time Series (MOLTS) derived soundings for locations within the ESOP-97 domain. These output are only for the initial analysis time (i.e. no forecast derived soundings) and only the state parameters (pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, and wind direction). The complete output (including hourly forecast derived soundings with all surface and upper level parameters) in the original BUFR format are available from NCAR/SCD. This data set consists of output from 01 October 1996 to 31 May 1997. See the README file for more details.

dataset.title: Picarro G2401-m WS-CRDS CO2, CH4, CO and H2O in situ mixing ratio observations - ICARTT format
dataset.description: This dataset contains carbon dioxide (CO2), methane (CH4), carbon monoxide (CO) and water vapor (H2O) in situ mixing ratio observations collected by the PICARRO G2401-m aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the WE-CAN project.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from R/V Moana Wave
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from aboard the Research Vessel (R/V) Moana Wave which was operated by members of the science team. Soundings were taken four times daily (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC) during participation in the IOP. UCAR/JOSS conducted no quality control on these data. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updated (4/23/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measuerment errors of the Vaisala RS80 radiosonde (Wang et al 2002). Please see the README for additional information.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) [Haggerty, EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset contains NGV Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) data measure aboard the NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-5. The data are in NASA AMES format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Aerosol data subset (ICARTT format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V HIAPER (NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) project from 18 May 2012 to 30 June 2012. This data set is a subset of the low rate aircraft data that contains a select set of the aerosol parameters. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: WRF 12KM Surface Air Temperature Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 12 kilometer surface air temperature imagery generated during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the IDEAS-4 C130 project. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps, mixed) production data. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the C130 flight track in real-time during the NOMADSS project. Both LRT and HRT files are included in this dataset

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER VCSEL Hygrometer Data
dataset.description: This data set contains NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER VCSEL Hygrometer Data collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 18 May 2012 through 30 June 2012. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Mixing Ratio Forecast Imagery (Cheyenne to Chadron)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of four different mixing ratios, ice number concentration, and temperature. The imagery contains cloud water, rain water, snow, and Graupel mixing ratios. The imagery was generated from Cheyenne, WY to Chadron, NE during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: HIPPO-2 Merged 1-second Meteorology, Atmospheric Chemistry, and Aerosol Data [Wofsy, et. al.]
dataset.description: This data set provides merged 1-second data products from Mission 2 of the HIAPER Pole-to-Pole Observations (HIPPO) of the Carbon Cycle and Greenhouse Gases Study. Mission 2 took place during October, November, and December of 2009. These merged data products were derived by combining the NSF/NCAR G-V aircraft state parameters for position, time, temperature, pressure, and wind speed with meteorological, atmospheric chemistry and aerosol measurements made by several teams of investigators. Investigators reported most data at a 1-second interval. The data files are in space delimited format. The NCAR/EOL Research Aviation Facility has recently completed a review and upgrade of its existing algorithms for data processing to incorporate recent improvements that have become available for specific instruments. HIPPO-2 LRT data have been reprocessed and rereleased with these new upgrades. For more info see the Appendix to HIPPO-II Project Manager's Report: Reprocessing

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Vertical Velocity Forecast Imagery (Craig to Denver)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer cross-sections of vertical velocity. The imagery was generated from Craig, CO to Denver, CO to during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: NCEP RUC Model Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains RUC imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: 200mb_wnd, 300mb_wnd, 500mb_wnd, 700mb_wnd, 850mb_wnd, sfc_precip.

dataset.title: SUNY Albany Infrasound and Seismometer Data - Gaviota Site
dataset.description: Infrasound and Seismometer data collected from three infrasound station locations at the Gaviota Site by the Atmospheric Sciences Research Center (ASRC) at SUNY Albany during SWEX (Sundowner Winds Experiment) field campaign from 20 April through 16 May 2022.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Lindenberg Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture, and Temperature Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Lindenberg Observatory Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture, and Temperature Data Set. This data set contains hourly soil temperature (5cm, 10cm, 20cm, 50cm, 100cm, and 150cm depth), soil moisture (8cm, 15cm, 30cm, 45cm, and 60cm depth), and soil heat flux (5cm depth) data from one station for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001).

dataset.title: SPICULE Chatlogs
dataset.description: Flight Chatlogs from the SPICULE (Secondary Production of Ice in Cumulus Experiment) field project, collected from 03 May to 25 June 2021 onboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream V). These scrubbed chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the SPICULE project and are available in a text format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER TOGA VOC Analyzer Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) Trace Organic Gas Analyzer (TOGA) Volatile Organic Compounds (VOC) Analyzer Data collected during the CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics experiment (CONTRAST) from 11 January through 28 February 2014. This dataset is in ICARTT format. Please see the readme files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and dataset comments.

dataset.title: WRF 12KM Horizontal Winds Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting 12KM wind imagery generated in real-time during the ICE-L project. Horizontal winds are modeled at the following hPa levels: 250, 300, 500, 700, 850, and 925. The imagery is in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Santa Cruz
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Santa Cruz Island in the Solomon Islands (WMO 91541) which was operated by the Australian Bureau of Meteorology for the Solomon Islands Meteorological Service. Soundings were taken twice per day (00 and 12 UTC) during the IOP. UCAR/JOSS conducted no quality control on these data. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updated (5/2/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measurement errors of the Vaisala RS 80 radiosonde (Wang et al 2002). Please see the README for details.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Vertical Velocity Forecast Imagery (Rawlins to Goodland)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer cross-sections of vertical velocity. The imagery was generated from Rawlins, WY to Goodland, KS during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Thermistor Harp Data
dataset.description: Thermistor measurements from 8 thermistors vertically spaced 5mm apart on two faces of a "thermistor harp," collected on four different days (3-4 February and 6-7 March 2023) during the Sublimation of Snow (SOS) field project. These data are available in one CSV file with an accompanying PNG image. See the readme file for more detail.

dataset.title: START-08 Multiple Enclosure Device for Unfractionated Sampling of Air (MEDUSA) Flask Data
dataset.description: The Multiple Enclosure Device for Unfractionated Sampling of Air (MEDUSA) flask data from the START-08: Stratosphere-Troposphere Analyses of Regional Transport project are contained in this dataset. This dataset includes measurements made by the Scripps Institution of Oceanography (SIO) O2 Program on flasks collected by the NCAR/SIO Medusa Whole Air Sampler. These data were collected on the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream V (GV).

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Vertical Velocity Forecast Imagery (Broomfield to Sidney)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer cross-sections of vertical velocity. The imagery was generated from Broomfield, CO to Sidney, NE during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Trace Organic Gas Analyzer-Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometer (TOGA-TOF) Data
dataset.description: Trace organic gas measurements obtained by the Trace Organic Gas Analyzer with Time-of-Flight Mass Spectrometer (TOGA-TOF) onboard the NSF/NCAR GV aircraft during the ACCLIP campaign in August 2022.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ARISTO2016, the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number N130AR) flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from R/V Shiyan 3
dataset.description: This dataset consists of Integrated Sounding System (ISS) sounding data from aboard the People's Republic of China Research Vessel (R/V) Shiyan 3 which was operated by U.S. personnel. Soundings were taken four times daily (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) during participation in the IOP. UCAR/JOSS conducted no quality control on these data. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details. NOTE: This dataset has been updated (4/23/2002) with corrected data for the humidity measurement errors of the Vaisala RS80 radiosonde (Wang et al 2002). Please see the README for additional information.

dataset.title: GV Navigation Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains location data of the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV during the MAIR-E project for the PICARRO and Aerodyne datasets.

dataset.title: ACCLIP NSF/NCAR GV Instrument Data Merges - 1 Second
dataset.description: The one second resolution merger of the data from the instrumentation that was onboard the NSF/NCAR GV aircraft for the ACCLIP campaign.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the G-V during HIPPO-4. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the G-V during HIPPO-5. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: NASA DC-8 Solar Spectral Flux Radiometer (SSFR) Upwelling and Downwelling Solar Spectral Irradiance Data
dataset.description: This data set contains NASA DC-8 Solar Spectral Flux Radiometer (SSFR) Upwelling and Downwelling Solar Spectral Irradiance data collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 11 May 2012 through 22 June 2012. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments. The data reported are only selected wavelengths, as well as integrated solar irradiance in two ranges (SSFR). Use of these data requires PRIOR OK from the PI. For full SSFR spectra from 350-2150 nm, please contact the PI.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Mixing Ratio Forecast Imagery (Craig to Denver)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of four different mixing ratios, ice number concentration, and temperature. The imagery contains cloud water, rain water, snow, and Graupel mixing ratios. The imagery was generated from Craig, CO to Denver, CO to during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) derived aircraft-relative tropopose height [Haggerty, EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: These files indicate the position of the aircraft relative to the estimates of tropopause height taken from MTP data measured aboard the NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-3. The 1st column contains time in seconds past midnight UTC. The 2nd column gives the position of the aircraft relative to the tropopause: 1 = > 1 km below trop; 2 = < 1 km below trop; 3 = < 1 km above trop; 4 = > 1 km above trop; 5 = trop not determined. For complete MTP profiles, see the companion dataset Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) [Haggerty, NCAR/EOL].

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the USAF C-130 dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset consists of dropsonde data from the USAF C-130. Dropsondes were taken as requested. These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. These data include pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Mixing Ratio Forecast Imagery (Winter Park to Platteville)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 1 kilometer vertical cross-sections of four different mixing ratios, ice number concentration, and temperature. The imagery contains cloud water, rain water, snow, and Graupel mixing ratios. The imagery was generated from Winter Park, CO to Platteville, CO during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC 2) [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of cloud particle size distributions collected during the HEFT10 project using an airborne holographic instrument (HOLODEC 2) mounted on the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream V (N677F). The data are recorded in a raw video stream that is processed using a MATLAB script to a series of lossless 8-bit grayscale .png files with the filenames serving as the time stamps. Each image file is about 11 or 12 MB from the 4872x3248 8-bit pixels or compressed to about 2/3 of the raw. Images are combined into 1-minute log tarfiles. To help analyze the data, movies (800x600, mpeg4) of each image series are also available.

dataset.title: GEM MOLTS Derived Soundings
dataset.description: CGIP/ESOP-98 GEM MOLTS Derived Soundings data set contains AES/CMC GEM Model Location Time Series (MOLTS) derived soundings for locations within the ESOP-98 domain. These output are only for the initial analysis time (i.e. no forecast derived soundings) and only the state parameters (pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, and wind direction). The complete output (including hourly forecast derived soundings with all surface and upper level parameters) in the original BUFR format are available from NCAR/SCD. This data set consists of output from 01 October 1997 to 31 May 1998.See the README file for more details.

dataset.title: GTS Mandatory/Significant Level Sounding Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled GTS mandatory and significant level soundings for the Davenport, Iowa NWS radiosonde site for the SAVANT (Stable Atmospheric Variability and Transport) period (15 September to 15 November 2018). The high vertical resolution data was unavailable for this station. The other NWS stations in the SAVANT region had the high vertical resolution data available and are available in a companion data set. A total of 126 quality-controlled, mandatory and significant level resolution soundings are contained in the final data set.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Equivalent Potential Temperature Forecast Imagery (Big Piney to Gillette)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of Theta-E (Equivalent Potential Temperature). The imagery was generated from Big Piney, WY to Gillette, WY during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser Hygrometer (VCSEL) [Paige, M. E., Mark A. Zondlo]
dataset.description: The Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Laser Hygrometer (VCSEL) flew aboard the NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-2. The data are in NASA AMES format.

dataset.title: GTS Station Plot Alabama Regional Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GTS Station Plot Alabama regional imagery produced during the DC3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 24:59:59.

dataset.title: WRF 1KM Cumulative Surface Precipitation Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather and Research Forecast Model (WRF) 1 kilometer surface precipitation imagery generated during the ICE-L project. Precipitation reported is cumulative from the beginning of the model run to the forecast hour. The imagery are in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: WRF 4KM Equivalent Potential Temperature Forecast Imagery (Broomfield to Sidney)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Weather Research and Forecasting Model (WRF) 4 kilometer vertical cross-sections of Theta-E (Equivalent Potential Temperature). The imagery was generated from Broomfield, CO to Sidney, NE during the ICE-L project. It is available in PNG format and covers the time span from 2007-11-19 00:00:00 to 2007-12-21 23:59:59.

dataset.title: ISFS Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description:
ISFS towered surface meteorology and flux data collected during the Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study (M2HATS). 5-minute averages and high rate 1s quality controlled netCDF datasets are available for download. Refer to the data report for details on these datasets. Downloadable data files
