NCAR users may access the data from Glade; path(s) listed in the 'Additional Information' section.

dataset.title: CMIP6 CESM2 AMIP hindcast (1950-2014) with high-top atmosphere (WACCM6) with interactive chemistry (TSMLT1), interactive land (CLM5), data ocean, prescribed sea ice, and non-evolving land ice (CISM2.1).
dataset.description:
An atmosphere only climate simulation using prescribed sea surface temperature and sea ice concentrations but with other conditions as in the Historical simulation. (CMIP6 Experiment).
Users can access the data from the Earth System Grid Federation or Climate Data Gateway as registered users; see the 'Related links' section.
Diagnostic plots are also available from the 'Related links'.
NCAR users may access the data from Glade; path(s) listed in the 'Additional Information' section.

dataset.title: CMIP6 SSP2-4.5 experiments (2015-2100) with CAM6, interactive land (CLM5), coupled ocean (POP2) with biogeochemistry (MARBL), interactive sea ice (CICE5.1), and non-evolving land ice (CISM2.1).
dataset.description:
SSP-based RCP scenario with medium radiative forcing by the end of the century. Following approximately RCP4.5 global forcing pathway with SSP2 socioeconomic conditions. Radiative forcing reaches a level of 4.5 W/m2 in 2100. Concentration-driven. (CMIP6 Experiment).
Users can access the data from the Earth System Grid Federation or Climate Data Gateway as registered users; see the 'Related links' section.
Diagnostic plots are also available from the 'Related links'.
NCAR users may access the data from Glade; path(s) listed in the 'Additional Information' section.

dataset.title: CAM6 Data Assimilation Research Testbed (DART) Reanalysis: Cloud-Optimized Dataset
dataset.description: This is a cloud-hosted subset of the CAM6+DART (Community Atmosphere Model version 6 Data Assimilation Research Testbed) Reanalysis dataset. These data products are designed to facilitate a broad variety of research using the NCAR CESM 2.1 (National Center for Atmospheric Research's Community Earth System Model version 2.1), including model evaluation, ensemble hindcasting, data assimilation experiments, and sensitivity studies. They come from an 80 member ensemble reanalysis of the global troposphere and stratosphere using DART and CAM6. The data products represent states of the atmosphere consistent with observations from 2011 through 2019 at 1 degree horizontal resolution and weekly frequency. Each ensemble member is an equally likely description of the atmosphere, and is also consistent with dynamics and physics of CAM6. The dataset also contains corresponding land surface values at 6-hourly frequency. This dataset is a reformatting, with no change to numerical values, of data from the "CAM6 Data Assimilation Research Testbed (DART) Reanalysis", [DOI:10.5065/JG1E-8525](https://doi.org/10.5065/JG1E-8525).

dataset.title: NA-CORDEX Cloud-Optimized Dataset
dataset.description:
The NA-CORDEX dataset contains output from high-resolution regional climate models run over North America using boundary conditions from global simulations in the CMIP5 archive.
The subset of the NA-CORDEX data on AWS (data volume ~15 TB) includes daily data from 1950-2100 for impacts-relevant variables on a 0.25 degree or 0.50 degree common lat-lon grid. This data is freely available on AWS S3 thanks to the AWS Open Data Sponsorship Program and the Amazon Sustainability Data Initiative, which provide free storage and egress.
The data on AWS is stored in Zarr format. This format supports the same data model as netCDF and is well suited to object storage and distributed computing in the cloud using the Pangeo libraries in Python.
An Intake-ESM Catalog listing all available data can be found at: [https://ncar-na-cordex.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/catalogs/aws-na-cordex.json]
The full dataset (data volume ~35 TB) can be accessed for download or via web services on the NCAR Climate Data Gateway. [https://www.earthsystemgrid.org/search/cordexsearch.html]

dataset.title: NA-CORDEX Visualization Collection
dataset.description: 2000+ color maps of seasonal and annual temperature and precipitation climatology and change for regional climate simulations over North America in the NA-CORDEX Data Archive.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) moments data collected during the CSET (Cloud Systems Evolution in the Trades) project from 18 June 2015 through 12 August 2012. These are 10Hz data in cfradial format and are available as daily tar files.

dataset.title: Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data is a composite upper-air sounding data set which contains all upper-air sounding data collected from 39 platforms used during BAMEX. The data in the composite is at the highest possible resolution (i.e. the 'native' resolution). For more information about this data set please consult the Readme. Some of the release times for the MIPS soundings included in this data set were corrected. See the documentation (bamex_mips_correction_record.doc) for more details.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 11:07:00 to 2010-04-20 14:45:00.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Barrow
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Barrow, Alaska during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Satellite Ch2-4 Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains Ch2-4 satellite images taken at 30 minute intervals at 4 km from November 5, 2004 through Febrary 1, 2005.

dataset.title: Four Corners High Resolution Rawinsonde Data Set
dataset.description: This is one of the sounding datasets developed for the Upper Missouri River Basin Pilot Project (UMRBPP). The dataset consists of research soundings form the Four Corners site and contains vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, dew point, humidity, U and V wind components, total wind speed and direction, and latitude and longitude taken every 10 seconds after the sonde's release time. The soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC, but there were occassional releases at 06 and 18 UTC. Note: since the files are loaded in the database using the actual release time, use the hour just before or a couple hours before the UTC release time when attempting to browse the dataset. UCAR/JOSS performed automated quality control on this data. See the README for further information.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NEXRAD OAX (Omaha, NE) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Omaha, NE. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Airborne Lidar and Observations of the Hawaiian Airglow (ALOHA94) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol data from theTropical Rainfall Measuring Mission, Large-scale Biosphere-Atmosphere (TRMM-LBA) . These data are in dorade format and are available as 4 hourly tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS SODAR Data
dataset.description: Sonic Detection And Ranging (SODAR) data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Advection Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (AHATS). This dataset contains raw SODAR data files (*.SDR) in ASCII format that have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Wyoming&#39;s Remote Weather Information System (RWIS) &quot;Specials&quot; Data QC format
dataset.description: The Wyoming's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) "Specials" data in QC format dataset is one of several datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. Data from this source has been converted to Quality Control format, but no Quality Control has been performed by UCAR/JOSS. See the README for additional information.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ICE-T, the C-130 flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during ICE-T flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 59 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains forward-looking images.

dataset.title: GIDS-1 Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: This composite contains daily precipitation totals from observing sites in the GCIP/GIDS-1 domain (the central United States). Data included in the composite are from National Weather Service observing stations, research instrumentation, and various regional and state observing stations. Data have been converted to a common format, standard units, and uniform quality control of the data has been performed.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the ALPEX project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: AIRS-II: C130 Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of hourly mpg files from video tapes (VHS) from each flight of the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft during the Alliance Icing Research Study - II (AIRS-II). Each hourly file is about 1.3 Gb in size.

dataset.title: Mobile GPS Radiosonde Data from TAMU
dataset.description: Texas A&M University (TAMU) operated a mobile radiosonde system during the Mesoscale Predictability Experiment (MPEX) during the period from 21 May to 31 May 2013. Soundings were taken intermittently as determined by the weather situation, with a focus on the pre-convective and convectively disturbed environments near deep convective storms in the central United States. This final MPEX data set includes a total of 23 quality controlled, high vertical resolution (1 second) soundings.

dataset.title: 5-min and 30-min ISFS Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: 5 minute and 30 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Systen (ISFS) data collected during the International H2O Project of 2002 (IHOP_2002). These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected and rotated to a geographic coordinate system.

dataset.title: ISFS 5-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: Final version of the ISFS 5-minute statistics collected during the Advanced Technology Solar Telescope Site Survey (ATST) project are available in NetCDF. The wind data are in instrument coordinates; they have not been corrected for anemometer tilt or mean wind flow. Refer to the project report (under Related Links below) for the anemometer azimuth directions. The ISFS ATST 5-minute NetCDF files contain statistics (means, variances and covariances) of all sampled variables. Each file contains one day's data from 00:00 to 23:59 GMT.

dataset.title: GOES-13 4km Channel 4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GOES-13 4km channel 4 thermal-IR satellite imagery for the DC3 project. The imagery are in JPEG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During DC-3 TEST, the GV_N677F flew a left-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-7 IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 IR imagery collected during the GCIP/GIST period via PC-McIDAS and then converted to GIF image format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the NOAA P-3 dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset consists of dropsondes from the NOAA P-3. Dropsondes were taken as requested. These data were processed through an interpolation that included the removal of bad data from the higher resolution data, automated, and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: MICROFRONTS-95 10-sec CLASS Soundings
dataset.description: The MICROFRONTS-95 10-second Class Soundings dataset contains the high resolution sounding data collected by NCAR Fixed CLASS systems in the MICROFRONTS project domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 10 seconds. These data have been extensively quality- controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: DC3 Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the DC3 project from May 15 - June 30, 2012. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the DC3 project.

dataset.title: CAMP: Northeast Thailand Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Periods 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and 4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Northeast Thailand Hourly Surface Data Set. This dataset contains the complete EOP-3 and EOP-4 time periods (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT (XRUN) Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Convective Initiation Downburst Experiment (CINDE). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: SUNY-Oswego Mobile Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The State University of New York at Oswego (SUNY-Oswego) operated a mobile radiosonde system during lake-effect systems on Lake Ontario. SUNY-Oswego operations were on the east and southeast end of Lake Ontario. This data set includes the quality controlled SUNY-Oswego soundings released for the Ontario Winter Lake-effect Systems (OWLeS) field phase (7 December 2013 to 28 January 2014). A total of 51 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final OWLeS data set.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Impact of Typhoons on the Ocean in the Pacific (ITOP) 2010. This data set includes 976 high vertical resolution (6-second) MicroArt soundings from the six (6) National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the ITOP 2010 region (Yap, WCI; Ponape, ECI; Koror, Palau WCI; Chuuk, ECI; Majuro, Marshall Island; Guam, Marianna Island). The data cover the period from 1 August 2010 to 31 October 2010. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC). This data set currently does not contain soundings from Majuro for the month of September nor Yap for the month of October. The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the Lake Effect Snow Storms - 1980 (LESS-80) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPROI format.

dataset.title: Composite 5-mb Level Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper-air sounding data interpolated to a constant vertical resolution of 5 hPa in the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) Sounding Composite Format. Data for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) 2006 domain (25°N to 37°N latitude and 118°W to 114°W are contained within this dataset. The dataset covers the time period 1 March 2006 through 30 April 2006. This T-REX 2006 Sounding Composite 5-mb Resolution Upper-Air Dataset contains 1299 soundings from 13 platforms.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During PREDICT, the GV_N677F flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. The images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Satellite Visible Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains channel 1 visible images from the GOES - 12 satellite taken at 1 , 4 and 8 km every 30 minutes from October 27th, 2004 through February 1st, 2005.

dataset.title: NEXRAD DMX (Des Moines, IA) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. Both the 2009 and 2010 field phases cover approximately May through June for those years. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Des Moines, IA. The files are in .gif format. See the catalog links in the related links section below to access the field catalogs.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR C-130 flight track in real-time during the ARISTO2016 project.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:52:00.

dataset.title: MICROFRONTS-95 6-sec NWS Soundings
dataset.description: The MICROFRONTS-95 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 11 sites in the MICROFRONTS-95 project domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality- controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: WISP90: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This sounding data is from the 1990 Winter Icing and Storms Project (WISP90). NCAR's Cross Chain Loran Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) rawinsonde data consist of vertical profiles in three versions: "i" data interpolated to every 5mb, "m" with 1-second raw dat with data flogs collected during the sonde ascent, and "x" 10 second interval data. There are 4 stations. Data from each CLASS station is in raw ascii format in a single g-zip tar file. Data is ordered by station.

dataset.title: CSU RAMS Initialization Files
dataset.description: This dataset contains input data that can be used to re-create RAMS model runs for cases of interest during the CASES-99 field experiment. See the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the WE-CAN project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the Profiling of Winter Storms (PLOWS) project. The data are in NetCDF format and are available for 18 flights. These files do NOT currently contain TDL data. That data will be merged at a later date and users who have ordered this dataset will be notified.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia ISS Surface Meteorological Data: DYNAMO Legacy Collection
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1 minute surface meteorological data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) weather station that was located on Diego Garcia during DYNAMO. The data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: ACE-1: Discoverer ISS 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) aboard the R/V Discoverer during the Southern Hemisphere Marine Aerosol Characterization Experiment (ACE-1) of 1995. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:22:00 to 2011-07-14 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Standard Sea Ice Observation Reports Healy Cruises HLY-09-01 and HLY-09-02
dataset.description: A link to the BEST Field Catalog for the HLY-09-01 and HLY-09-02 Cruise Ice Observations reports

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS All-sky Camera Imagery (ISS2 Farm Field Site)
dataset.description: 5-minute all-sky camera images collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Farm Field site SAVANT field campaign. These images are jpeg files tarred into daily archives.

dataset.title: GOES-East 3-hourly 1km Visible Imagery SE Pacific
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-8 Satellite Imagery at 1 kilometer resolution for 5 days during the period from 3 Sept - 27 Sept 2001(2001d246-270).

dataset.title: NWS Cooperative Observer Daily Observations
dataset.description: This dataset contains the National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the BAMEX domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by EOL on this dataset.

dataset.title: NDTE: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: The North Dakota Tunderstorm Experiment (NDTE) sounding data is in both binary files and ascii tar files. Data is

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the PRECIP98 project, in support of NASA's TEFLUN-B study near Melborne, Florida. These data are in dorade format and are available in 3-hourly tar files.

dataset.title: PCAPS ISFS 30 Minute Surface Fluxes
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 minute time series surface flux data including sensible and latent heat fluxes, friction velocity, total radiation and surface heat flux, as measured by the seven NCAR Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) stations in the Salt Lake Valley during PCAPS. These data are in NetCDF format, with each file containing data for one month.

dataset.title: NOAA Wind Profiler Network Hourly Surface Meteorological Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) 405 MHZ Wind Profiler Network (NPN) hourly surface data in JOSS Quality Control format from 2 sites within the SGP 1997 area of interest. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Humans and Hydrology at High Latitudes: Community Information
dataset.description: This data set contains detailed community information for regions of Canada and Alaska. These data are utilized in the Arctic Rapid Integrated Monitoring System (ArcticRIMS) project to improve the development of the water stress model. This water stress model shows the effects of water resources, humans and climate change in the Arctic. Recent studies suggest that climate change will have a significant impact on Arctic hydrology. However, it is currently unknown which regions of the pan-Arctic are most vulnerable to future changes. In order to begin to address the future change to freshwater availability on a pan-Arctic scale, a system of Arctic typologies were used to enable the integration of biophysical data with socio-cultural data produced regionally, such as demographics and water values. Those mature data sets were used to study the strategic transformations of the high latitude water cycle. The overall objective of this research is to use a wide array of existing data sets in a synthesis effort to describe the vital role of freshwater in the lives of people in the pan-Arctic, how it has changed in the recent past, and how it is likely to change in the future.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Meteosat-9 Products
dataset.description: This dataset consists of GOES-13 Meteosat-9 jpeg images from the PRE-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. This data covers July through October of 2010. This data set is password protected.

dataset.title: VALI: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is 3 tar files of data from a single PAM station from the VALI experiment at Elk Mountain, approximately 80 miles Northwest of Laramie, Wyoming. This station was operated from 1987-11-08 through 1989-09-09.

dataset.title: GOES-8 4-km IR CONUS Sector Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 4-km resolution Infrared (11 micron) imagery collected for the SGP99 in McIDAS AREA file format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Other: ARM NSA Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) CEOP_AP 3 Global Energy and Water Cycle Experiment (GEWEX) North Slope Alaska (NSA) 30 Minute Meteorological Tower Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from two stations in the NSA reference site, the Barrow and Atqasuk stations. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: GOES-East 1km Visible Channel TDF Data
dataset.description: The GOES-8 Satellite data is at 1 kilometer. The data cover the period from 1 September2001 to 15 October 2001. That data are in tdf format.

dataset.title: NIDS KUDX Velocity Azimuth Display (VAD) Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Nexrad Information Dissemination Service (NIDS) Velocity Azimuth Display (VAD) product. The VAD products are generated in either clear air or precipitation mode. It contains the current vertical wind profile and up to ten profiles from previous time periods. The profiles are in a time vs. height format. The range is up to 70,000 feet in height. It is updated once every volume scan (typically every 5-10 min). The wind speeds are in knots, the wind direction in degrees, and the height in feet above mean sea level. Data are available for most periods during the UMRBPP (5 April to 5 May 1999) from the Rapid City, SD (KUDX) radar site. These data are in the (KUDX) radar site. These data are in the original NIDS original NIDS format. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). This data set is quite large both in terms of size (32 Mb) and the number of files (4500). Please take this into consideration when placing your data order.

dataset.title: ICE88/89: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from 6 PAM stations from the Intercomparison Experiment (ICE). No data was taken between 88/06/19 until 89/08/31 at which only PAM station was used. The data was taken at the Marshall Field Site near Boulder, Colorado.

dataset.title: Wyoming&#39;s Remote Weather Information System (RWIS) &quot;Specials&quot; Data QC format
dataset.description: The Wyoming's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) "Specials" data in QC format dataset is one of several datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. Data from this source has been converted to Quality Control format, but no Quality Control has been performed by UCAR/JOSS. See the README for additional information.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery [Rogers/NCAR-RAF]
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 µm. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR G-V N677F during the PREDICT project. The 2DS puts all flight data into 3 files, and the size of these files depends on the amount of time in clouds.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) during the PPP project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking east
dataset.description: East-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) experiment from 26 May 2015 through 20 July 2015. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm (LCFA) Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm (LFCA) during the period of RELAMPAGO operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV flight track in real-time during the START08 project.

dataset.title: ISS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Inhibition of Snowfall by Pollution Aerosols (ISPA) was the third phase of a field campaign performed to better quantify the amount of water in snow pack lost due to pollution aerosols. The first and second phases of ISPA took place in 2002 and 2007. The third phase was conducted during January and February 2010. ISPA was organized by the Desert Research Institute (DRI) and each phase took place near Steamboat Springs, Colorado. The primary site was located on Mount Werner at the Storm Peaks Laboratory (SPL), and a GPS Advanced Upper Air Sounding System (GAUS), operated by the NCAR Integrated sounding System, was located near the base of the Steamboat ski resort. A total of 32 radiosonde launches were made from the GAUS site. In addition to the radiosonde sounding system, there were a suite of surface meteorology instruments, a microwave radiometer, microwave rain radar and a laser distrometer.

dataset.title: GOES-10 4km Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 satellite imagery for the VOCALS study area and time of interest. The images are JPEG files.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Channel 5 (Split Window) Imagery
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Channel 5 (Split Window) Sectored Imagery (GIF) is one of several satellite products collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase-II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project field catalog operated by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL: http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 4-km imagery from Channel 5 (split-window; 12.0um) of the GOES-10 satellite. the products cover the period from 1-30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). The products are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). All images are in gif format.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) CONUS Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of PERiLS_2022 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: STORM-WAVE: Upper Air 5mb Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This dataset consists of a composite of all STORM-WAVE sounding data interpolated to 5-millibar vertical levels collected from the sounding sites in the experiment domain. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the README file for details.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 &amp; 5 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains legs 4 & 5 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 07:52:00 to 2009-02-01 19:22:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Ice in Clouds Experiment -L" (ICE-L) project. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) production, CO, DGPS, and TDL data. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Research Profiles - PDFs
dataset.description: This data set consists of PDF files containing DMG Profiles, Fast FSSP qk, and SO2 Profiles for the period and area of the VOCALS project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFS data, non tilt corrected sonic array
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) data collected during the Ocean Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (OHATS) field project in 2004. These data are available in NetCDF format and have been quality controlled, however data from the sonic anemometers have not been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: PACS Region GTS Sounding Data
dataset.description: This data set contains all land- and ship-based upper air sounding data available from GTS over the region from 30 N to 60 S latitude and 30 to 180 W longitude as collected by NCAR/SCD. It includes only mandatory and significant level data. It includes site identifier information, wind speed and direction, surface and sea level pressure, air temperature, and dew point depression. These data have undergone no quality control. A new version of these data was released on 27 January 2005 to correct significant problems. See the readme for details. NOTE: Each file contains soundings based on release time rather than nominal time. Be aware that if you are looking for soundings with a nominal time of 00:00:00, it may be contained within the previous day's files, so order both days.

dataset.title: PCAPS ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) ceilometer during the Persistent Cold-Air Pool Study (PCAPS) between 01 December 2010 and 17 February 2011. These data are in daily tar files containing raw ASCII format ceilometer data and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Koror
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Koror Island in the Palau Islands (WMO 91408) which was operated by the U.S. National Weather Service. Soundings were taken twice per day (00 and 12 UTC) during the IOP. The data were processed through the automated, visual, and spatial quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at six second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the GOTHAAM project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Anchorage
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Anchorage, Alaska during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S- and Ka-band, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-PolKa data from the Rain in Cumulus Over the Ocean (RICO) project . This data set contains both S-band and Ka-band data. These data are in cfRadial format and are available as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ARISTO2017 project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Trace Gas Profiles II (TGP-II) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, AVHRR Channel 5 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12, 14, 15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 5 Imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-11 06:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Stable Isotopes in Cloud Tops project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Fort Royal
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the French ASAP ship the Fort Royal. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Howard University High Resolution Soundings - Barbados
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Pre-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. This data set includes 99 high vertical resolution (4 second) soundings from Barbados taken by Howard University from 14 August through 25 September 2010.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, DMSP OLS 1 KM Visible Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains imagery of the visible channel from the F12, F13 and F14 DMSP satellites observed during the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy 2002 spring cruise (HLY-02-01). All files are in .gif formatand are at 1KM resolution.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TI3GER, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Time Series Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains time series imagery from the NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS). NOTE: These images were developed based on real-time preliminary data. These soundings contained a daytime dry bias (see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFS data, tilt corrected sonic array
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) data collected during the Ocean Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (OHATS) field project in 2004. These data are available in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and data from the sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Forward-Facing Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During INTEX-B2, the C-130 flew a forward looking digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Images were captured once per second during INTEX-B2 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into movies, one mp4 file per flight.

dataset.title: Indian Ocean Region GTS Surface Weather Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains surface weather plots based on GTS METAR, SYNOP, ship and buoy observations. Plots are available twice per hour. These plots were developed by NCAR/EOL and are in gif format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains the NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 Field Catalog for the entire United States. This is a very large dataset, so the user should be careful to limit the number of days and hours ordered. Please use the preview function to determine which dates, times, and stations to order. The user may also use the NEXRAD imagery data sets by station ID and name listed for VORTEX2 to order a series of images for a particular station.

dataset.title: FABLE 1998 NCAR/ATD 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the WLEF-TV tower in Park Falls, Wisconsin during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 1998. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data files have been tarred into montly files for RASS and each of the profiler's operation modes (high and low). These data have not been quality controlled. Note: The latitude in the data files is indicated as being negative, while the actual location of the ISS was in Wisconsin. In addition, the latitudes and longitudes may be off slightly in general.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 21:00:00.

dataset.title: FP4 NCAR/EOL ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains webcam imagery from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Web Camera. These images were collected at the Fixed PECAN Integrated Sounding Array 4 (FP4) in Minden, NE during the PECAN field campaign. These data have been compiled into daily tar files.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4KM Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 4KM satellite imagery from the GOES-12 satellite collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Richness Graph
dataset.description: This dataset contains the richness summary graph from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS 5-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: Surface meteorology and flux products collected by the EOL/Integrated Surface Flux System team during the MLO_CN2: Mauna Loa Seeing Study (Cn-squared study) (MLO_CN2) project in Hawaii.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TI3GER, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a right looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP)
dataset.description: This dataset contains NGV Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) data measured aboard the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the TI3GER project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the First ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Regional Experiment (FIRE-II). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, AVHRR Channel 1 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12,14,15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 1 imagery. Observations are from the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .gif format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 18:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (GTCIMS) Trace Gases In Situ Measurements
dataset.description: This data set contains NASA DC-8 In Situ Measurements by the Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (CIMS) of nitric acid (HNO3), and sulfur dioxide (SO2) collected during the Front Range Air Pollution and Photochemistry Experiment (FRAPPE). This data set is in the International Consortium for Atmospheric Research on Transport and Transformation (ICARTT) format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Convection Waves project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MAPR Wind Profiler and RASS Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located at the "Homestead Profiling Site" near Elmwood, OK during the International H2O Project (IHOP_2002). This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data (.windsnc_30) and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.nc.tar). These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: OLYMPEX NCAR/EOL AVAPS Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsondes were deployed on the NASA DC-8 during the Olympic Mountain Experiment (OLYMPEX) field campaign. 17 research flights were conducted, during which 53 dropsondes were launched between November 12 and December 19, 2015.

dataset.title: HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler (AWAS) [Atlas (U.Miami)]
dataset.description: The HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler measured trace gases from whole air samples collected by NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-2. In addition to tracers, the AWAS measured a full suite of halocarbon species. This dataset contains AWAS data in NASA Ames format collected during HIPPO-2

dataset.title: UV Hygrometer Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains low rate (1sps) UVH observations collected aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the WE-CAN project. Columns are Time (UTC seconds), Water Vapor mixing ratio (ppmv). Mixing ratio determined by fit of UVH signals to Aerodyne and Picarro (RF10 only) mixing ratios. No UVH data for flight RF14 and RF17.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the Le Suroit (French ship)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Le Suroit, a French ship (ID FZVN). Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to 16 times per day (90 min intervals). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe Data (Sabreliner) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the First ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Regional Experiment (FIRE-II).

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 micrometers. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR C130 during the IDEAS-4 C130 project. These data have been converted to a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Denver
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Denver during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Dropsonde Mandatory and Significant Level Data - GTS Format
dataset.description: This data set contains NSF/NCAR G-V Dropsonde Mandatory and Significant Level Data in the GTS TEMP DROP Format. These data are based off the QC'd data collected from 15 May to 15 June 2013 as part of the Mesoscale Predictability Experiment (MPEX).

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Sheboygan, Wisconsin
dataset.description: This dataset contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data for Sheboygan, Wisconsin. This site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). This dataset has undergone ATD and The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of rawinsonde release times for Sheboygan.

dataset.title: ARM 5-Minute Surface Meteorological Dataset
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 ARM 5-Minute Surface Dataset contains data from the Department Of Energy (DOE) Atmospheric Radiation Measurement Surface Network in the NESOB 96 domain and time of interest. These data were not Quality Controlled by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:00:00 to 2011-07-14 22:16:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Aircraft instrumentation TRAINing program (ATRAIN). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Hobart Aero (94975), AU, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During SOCRATES, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: ISS Radar Wind Profiler Products
dataset.description:
449 MHz and 915 MHz Profiler winds and moments collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Sundowner Wind Experiment (SWEX) field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. 915 MHz Profilers operated at the Rancho Alegra and Sedgwick Preserve sites within Santa Barbara county. Moments and winds at 30 minute resolution are provided. RASS virtual temperature and their moments at 30 minute resolution operated at the Sedgwick site. The 449 MHz profiler operated on the grounds of the Santa Barbara Fire Dept. 5 min and 30 averages are orderable. The following datasets are available for download: 915 MHz profiler datasets (30 min averages):
* swex_iss2-ranchoalegre_prof915_moments_v1.tar.gz
* swex_iss2-ranchoalegre_prof915_winds_v1.tar.gz
* swex_iss3-sedgwick_prof915_moments_v1.tar.gz
* swex_iss3-sedgwick_prof915_rass_v1.tar.gz
* swex_iss3-sedgwick_prof915_winds_v1.tar.gz 449 MHz profiler datasets:
* swex_iss1-sbfiredept_prof449_moments_v1.tar.gz
* swex_iss1-sbfiredept_prof449_winds_30min_v1.tar.gz
* swex_iss1-sbfiredept_prof449_winds_5min_v1.tar.gz

dataset.title: Constant Pressure Level Maps
dataset.description: This data set contains constant pressure level imagery for the T-PARC region and time period. The following pressure levels are included: 300, 500, 700, 850 and 925 mb.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Barrow
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Barrow, Alaska during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: DLR Falcon Flight Track Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains DLR Falcon flight track imagery produced during the DC3 project. The imagery are in PNG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-30 00:00:00 to 2012-06-14 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Lake-ICE upper air: NCAR/EOL Montague 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Montague, MI (ISS1) during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (LAKE-ICE), which occurred simultaneously with the SNOWBAND project. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: LDM Surface METAR Hourly Data
dataset.description: The Surface METAR Data set is one of several surface data sets collected by the National Center for Atmospheric Research/ Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL). Included in the data set are the global hourly surface meteorological observations in NCAR/EOL columnar ascii surface QC format. These data are contained in daily files which are compressed in gzip format (.gz). The data were aquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: During the second field phase of PLOWS (November 2009 to 10 March 2010) the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft released dropsondes over the north-central United States. Dropsondes were deployed ny NCAR/EOL during six research flights, of which 41 are included in this final quality controlled data set. These data are in a columnar ASCII format, the EOL sounding format.

dataset.title: Model MRF 200mb analysis Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) MRF model data from IGES and is daily 0000 UTC 200mb analysis for the northern hemisphere including the SHEBA domain.

dataset.title: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) [NCAR/EOL/RSF]
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Beaufort Arctic Storms Experiment (BASE) in 1994.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Sydney
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Sydney, Australia during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-15 18:00:00 to 2011-06-21 00:00:00.

dataset.title: FIFE: KingAir Photography Video Camera
dataset.description: This dataset contains hourly mpg movies from videos taken on the KingAir during the FIFE project. Each hour of mpg movie file is about 1.3 Gb in size.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Winter MONEX project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: GOES-8 WV Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (6.7 micron) satellite imagery collected for the STORM-WAVE experiment via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 8 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Iowa AWOS Network Data
dataset.description: The Iowa DOT collected 1 min resolution data for the Iowa AWOS stations. Data has undergone QC. The data consists oftemperature, dewpoint, altimeter, barometric pressure, wind speed/direction, sky conditions, visibility, density altitude and precipitation.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL High-Rate ISFS surface flux data, tilt corrected, geographic coordinate winds
dataset.description: High-rate surface flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. These data have been quality controlled and are available in netCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and corrected for the orientation of the instrument. The tilt corrections applied were determined by the use of laser multi-station scans of the position and orientation of the sonic anemometers with respect to gravity. Disclaimer: GPS positions of stations are not included in this dataset, but can be found at the ISFS Operations at CHEESEHEAD page linked below and are included in the Data QC report attached to the dataset.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV flight track in real-time during the TORERO project.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL Dropsonde sounding profiles from on the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream-V HAIPER aircraft in the region around New Zealand as part of the DEEPWAVE field project. Dropsondes were released as requested during the field phase. A total of 282 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (0.25-second wind and 0.5 second pressure/temperature/humidity) soundings are contained in the final DEEPWAVE data set.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 18:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-8 WV Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Water Vapor (6.7 micron) imagery collected for the 5-year GCIP Enhanced Observing Period (EOP) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: ISFS 5 minute surface data, geographic and tilt corrected sonic winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the 2009 ASP summer colloquium, which ran from 31 May to 12 Jun 2009. These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia ISS RASS Virtual Temperature and Moment Data
dataset.description: This data set contains virtual temperature profiles and moments data every 30 minutes from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) station that was located on Diego Garcia for the DYNAMO project. These data were collected and processed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the SMEX2002 (Soil Moisture Experiments in 2002) project. This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: PACS QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set consists of soundings from Santa Cruz, Bolivia.These data were processed through automated quality control. The dataset includes pressure, temperature, humidity, winds and altitude taken at 5 seconds vertical resolution.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the University of Michigan Biological Station (UMBS) in Pellston, MI during the Program for Research on Oxidants: Photochemistry, Emmissions, and Transport (PROPHET) intensive observing period that occurred in the summer of 2001. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled. All of these data files contain original data, none of which has been checked for quality or in any way reprocessed since recording. The files with both date and time components in the name, e.g. surface_met.20010713.000003.cdf, are original data files. Those with only the date have been concatenated from multiple files for that same day. Usually, multiple files are created on a single day because of system restarts. For this dataset a daily file has been reconstructed for those days from the separate files. Note that the first few days of surface data files here were recorded while the instruments were being setup and adjusted, before the field project officially began.

dataset.title: AVAPS Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: Quality controlled dropsonde profiles onboard the NSF NCAR C-130 were collected by the EOL Dropsonde team during the Cold Air Outbreak Experiment in the Sub-Arctic Region (CAESAR) field campaign.

dataset.title: FP3 FP4 FP5 Raw 5 minute Surface Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute surface data collected from NCAR Integrated Sounding Systems located at FP3, FP4 and FP5 between 23 April to 25 July 2015 as part the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format and have not been quality controlled or tilt corrected.

dataset.title: FAAM BAe-146 Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 47 high vertical resolution (0.5-sec) soundings collected from 31 October 2008 to 13 November 2008 aboard the FAAM BAe-146 aircraft, which was based in Arica, in the most northern part of Chile close to the Peruvian border. The data are in the NCAR/EOL Sounding Composite format. Users are strongly encouraged to contact FAAM BAe for guidance on using their dropsonde data. Please contact Grant Allen at grant dot allen at manchester.ac.uk.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data (Monticello)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Monticello site (ISS3) in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1995. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) operated by NCAR from 1973-1977. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the MONEX-77 project.

dataset.title: ARM Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) 2012 project. This data set includes 238 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Southern Great Plains (SGP) Central Facility (C1) near Lamont, Oklahoma collected during the DC3 field campaign. There are typically four soundings per day at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC. These data were provided by DOE ARM.

dataset.title: CPPA: Bondville High Resolution Radiosonde Data (NWS Site Central Illinois, IL)
dataset.description: This data set contains the Climate Prediction Program for the Americas (CPPA) Bondville high resolution radiosondes for the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP). The data was collected from the Central Illinois, IL National Weather Service (NWS) upper air station and consists of six second vertical resolution profiles of pressure, temperature, wind speed, wind direction, relative humidity,and altitude from 01 October 2002 through 20 July 2007 and two second vertical resolution profiles from 30 July 2007 to 31 December 2009. The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did perform quality control processing on this data set. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data in NetCDF format which were collected during the Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study (M2HATS). Two MPDs (MPD 2 and 3) were deployed to Nevada, USA, for this field project. Denoised data from MPD 3 is linked as a companion dataset in the "Related Links" section below.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Cabauw Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Cabauw 30 minute Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the single station in the BALTEX reference site for the Cabauw station. This dataset contains the complete time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 to 31 December 2009). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: GOES 12 4KM Multi-channel Imagery - NetCDF
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF 4km resolution images from the GOES-12 satellite. Images are for the period and area of the START08 project.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 3 Imagery
dataset.description: This is the channel 3 imagery collected from the GOES-8 satellite during the EPIC time period.

dataset.title: NCEP/CPC Mexico Unified Daily Precipitation Data (1989-1999)
dataset.description: This data set contains combined daily precipitation data from across Mexico from the CPC and JOSS datasets. Data for both the CPC and JOSS datasets were kindly provided by Art Douglas (Creighton Univ.) The data cover the time period January 1991 to April 1999.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Hourly Observation Data (GEMPAK)
dataset.description: The GTS Surface Hourly Observation Data is one of several surface data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are the global hourly (and special) surface observations. These data are contained in daily files which are in GEMPAK format. It may not contain data which was removed from the US GTS feed. variable. The data cover the period from 7 - 28 July 2001. The data were acquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: METCRAX-II Lidar Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Doppler LIDAR moment data collected by the EOL Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) during the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II) from 30 September 2013 to 30 October 2013. The data are gzipped ascii text files and are available as separate tar files per the lidar's scanning scenarios (LOS, DBS, RHI, PPI) for each day.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
ISFS 5-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the Hudson Valley Ambient Meteorology Study (HVAMS) project of 2003. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected and rotated to a geographic coordinate system.

dataset.title: NOAA/NSSL MGAUS Radiosonde Data - EOL Sounding Composite Format
dataset.description: The Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment (VORTEX) is a project aimed at investigating tornado genesis and examining tornado structure and evolution using a suite of atmostpheric instruments. The VORTEX2 field campaign included the use of four mobile GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) systems. This dataset contains 117 radiosonde soundings collected during the 2009 field campaign (May 11 - June 14, 2009) and 186 radiosonde soundings collected during the 2010 field campaign (May 6 - June 15, 2010) from two of the systems that were operated by the NOAA National Severe Storm Laboratory (NSSL).

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Pontianak Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 57 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from Pontianak, Indonesia. The soundings were typically released two times per day at 00, and 12 UTC from 3 December 2011 to 31 December 2011. These data were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3 version of the data set has had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU.

dataset.title: GOES-13 1km Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery - Colorado
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 1km Channel 1 visible satellite f- Colorado imagery taken during the DC3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 21:00:00.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
