dataset.description: This data set includes 1726 quality controlled NWS (National Weather Service) soundings released at 14 sites throughout the western United States during the WE-CAN (Western Wildfire Experiment for Cloud Chemistry, Aerosol Absorption and Nitrogen) field phase (20 July to 19 September 2018). Thirteen of the stations are available at 1-second vertical resolution (1608 soundings) and one station is available at mandatory and significant level resolution (118 soundings).

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC-II) IOP2
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of cloud particle size distributions collected during the ACE-ENA project (IOP2) using an airborne holographic instrument mounted on the DOE G1. The HOLODEC-II is a second-generation version of a holographic detecter designed to determine the size, two-dimensional shape, and three-dimensional position of hydrometeors via digital in-line holography. Advantages vs other hydrometeor detectors are that the sample volume is not size dependent, relative positions of hydrometeors in the sample volume can be determined in three dimensions, and effects produced by shattering from the aperture edges can be identified and eliminated. Automated analysis programs have been developed to process the holograms collected and produce size distributions. HOLODEC-II has sufficient resolution to determine the sizes and locations of cloud droplets as well as ice crystals. A separate dataset (562.002) has been created for IOP1. Please see the link below to access the ACE-ENA IOP1 dataset page.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Aerosol Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) Data
dataset.description: The Cloud Particle Imager captures high-resolution images (pixel size 2.3 microns) using a CCD camera. The CPI has two Particle Detector Sensor lasers that instruct the camera to capture an image. This dataset contains region of interest (roi) binary image files of cloud particles which can be viewed using the IDL software linked to below For all of the flights, the CPI makes as many *.roi files as it needs; each file can be maximum 92Mb size and then a new file is opened.

dataset.title: NWS and ARM 5 hPa Vertical Resolution Sounding Data Set
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 5 hPa ARM and NWS Soundings dataset contains 5 hPa interpolated sounding data extracted from 12 NWS sounding sites and five ARM sounding sites in the ESOP-96 domain. Only data from the surface to 3000 m have been retained in this data set. The high resolution data were extensively quality controlled, with every sounding subjected to both automated consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. See the readme for futher information.

dataset.title: Pre-INDOEX: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: Radiosondes launched during the Pre-Indian Ocean Experiment (pre-INDOEX). Datasets are provided in ascii and binary format, each format contained in a single tar file. Soundings were done aboard the ship Sagar Kanya.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During WE-CAN, the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number N130AR) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Shortwave and Longwave Radiation Composite
dataset.description: ARM SGP SIROS data, ARM SGP BSRN data, and ARM SGP 25m MFR data have been composited together into one data set. This data set is composed of 30-minute averages of observations taken either at 20 seconds (SIROS and MFR) or 60 seconds (BSRN). The SIROS data contains observations of Upwelling and Downwelling Longwave and Shortwave Irradiance. The BSRN data has Downwelling Longwave and Shortwave; and the MFR network contains Upwelling Longwave and Shortwave Irradiance. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: GOES-13 Channel 3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery - Galapagos
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Channel 3 Water Vapor Satellite imagery of Galapagos taken during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project from 14 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-96 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., Arkansas-Red Basin River Forecast Center, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers Precipitation data, and the precipitation data extracted from the ESOP-96 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: NWS San Diego,CA High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The NWS High Resolution San Diego, CA Sounding Data is one of several upper air data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are pressure, temperature, relative humidity, U and V wind components, and altitude taken during rawinsonde flights from the National Weather Service upper air sounding site in San Diego , California. The data set covers the period from 7 - 28 July 2001. The soundings are typically available twice per day at 00 and 12 UTC. NCAR/EOL has performed automated quality control on this data set. See the README for more details.

dataset.title: GOES 12 NorthWest 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 NorthWest 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Digital Camera Movie files
dataset.description: During VOCALS, the C-130 flew forward and downward looking digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Images were captured once per second during VOCALS flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into movies, one mp4 file per flight.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected at 3 locations near Walden, CO during the Fluxes Over Snow Surfaces (FLOSS) project that took place in 2001-02. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected, but remain in a corrdinate system relative to the sensor.

dataset.title: NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Dataset
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Climatic Database (DATSAV3) Dataset reports for 7 stations in the CASES-99 time period (25 September 1999 thru 5 November 1999) and domain (approximately 95.7438W to 97.7438W longitude and 36.6501N to 38.6501N latitude). This dataset contains only the "nominal" records for the DATSAV3 dataset. The special records are located in the CASES-99: Surface NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Specials Dataset. This dataset is provided as is and was not quality controlled by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: MAYPOLE84: King-Air Photography Cloud Videos [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from each flight of the NCAR King-Air aircraft during the May Polarization Experiment 1984 (MAYPOLE84). This dataset contains forward-looking videos that have radar inset within the video. Only videos for flights RF13 and RF14 are available and are divided into hour-long segments.

dataset.title: NDTP: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the North Dakota Thunderstorm Project (NDTP).

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - png images
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) images obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Mexico: Megacities Impact on Regional and Global Environment (MIRAGE) This experiment is a sub-program of the Megacity Initiative: Local and Global Research Observations (MILAGRO). The images are png images compressed into tar files.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R Leg3 PHKO-NCRG Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-11-05 17:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data - 1 Hz [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project. This dataset contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) production data. CN Inlet Concentration, CVI, FSSP, and SID2H data have been merged with these files. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: POPE: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from one PAM station from the Pacific Ocean Photochemistry Experiment (POPE).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the MAF project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Meteor All-Sky Camera
dataset.description: These 16 mm films include footage of the sky from the US ship Meteor for Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: BALTEX: Cabauw Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Cabauw 30 minute Meteorological Tower Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the single station in the BALTEX reference site, which is the Cabauw station. This dataset contains data from 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2008. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: HIAPER Atmospheric Radiation Package (HARP) Cloud Retrievals [Schmidt (CU-LASP)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains cloud retrievals derived from the irradiance measurements of HIAPER Atmospheric Radiation Package (HARP) during the TORERO project. The following parameters are derived at one-minute intervals: cloud phase, cloud optical thickness and effective radius, max/min/standard deviation of cloud optical thickness and effective radius within the one-minute interval.

dataset.title: GOES-13 4 km Channel 3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains jpg images from the GOES-13 4km Channel 3 water vapor satellite for the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) study area and time of interest.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Dropsonde SkewT Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains dropsonde SkewT Plots from the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The missions were completed between 7 Dec 2004 - 20 Dec 2004, and 12 Jan 2005 - 24 Jan 2004.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Contrail Studies Airborne Exhaust (CSAE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD FTG (Denver/Boulder, CO) Reflectivity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NEXRAD Reflectivity Imagery from the ICE-L Field Catalog. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Denver, CO. The files are in .GIF format and cover the time span from 2007-11-14 02:26:00 to 2008-01-03 15:46:00.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Fort Desaix
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the French ASAP ship the Fort Desaix. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NCAR S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains S-band polarimetric (S-Pol) imagery from NCAR.

dataset.title: NCAR CP3, C-Band Radar data set, DORADE Format
dataset.description: This dataset contains C-band radar data collected by the NCAR CP3 radar during the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP) from 11 July 1990 to 23 August 1990. The data are in DORADE format and are available as tar files (~500 MB per file).

dataset.title: NCAR MCASS QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde profile soundings from the Multi-Channel Atmospheric Sounding System (MCASS), an AVAPS dropsonde system adapted for ballooon launches, during the Thunderstorm Electrification and Lightning EXperiment (TELEX). During TELEX, dropsondes were launched from various locations around Oklahoma between May 13 and June 29, 2004. For detailed information on the data format and the quality control process, please see the attached readme file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Spontaneous Ice Nucleation II (SPIN) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD FWS (Fort Worth/Spinks, TX) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes reflectivity and velocity imagery from the NEXRAD radar at Fort Worth/Spinks TX, taken from the VORTEX2 field catalog for 2009 and 2010. The files are gif images. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Meteogram Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains Meteorogram imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: Blyth_CA, Casa_Grande_AZ, Deming_NM, Douglas_AZ, El_Paso_TX, Imperial_CA, Kingman_AZ, Las_Vegas_NV, Nogales_AZ, Palm_Springs_CA, Phoenix_AZ, Tucson_AZ, Yuma_MCAS_AZ.

dataset.title: VORTEX-95 6-sec NWS Soundings
dataset.description: The VORTEX-95 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the VORTEX project domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 Navigation and State Parameter Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes imagery from the P-3 Aircraft taken during the IHOP_2002 field project. Images include altitude plots of each flight, 3-D flight tracks, flight tracks plotted with wind vectors, and temperature and dew point plots from each flight.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Chemical Layering in the Lower Stratosphere (CLLS) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: UK BAE-146 Dropsonde Profile Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). It includes 72 high vertical resolution (0.5 second) dropsondes from the UK FAAM BAE-146 aircraft. Soundings were released from 17 Mar to 8 Apr 2006.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the ARISTO2015 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:45:00.

dataset.title: GCIP/LSA-NW 00 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, North Dakota Atmospheric Resource Board (NDARB) daily precipitation data, Natural Resource Conservation Service (NRCS) National Water and Climate Center SNOpack TELemetry (SNOTEL) daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: HaRP: Electra Photography Right-looking Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP). This dataset contains right-looking videos.

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The SGP99 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the SGP99 domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Please see the README for more details.

dataset.title: NIDS KUDX Vertically Integrated Liquid (VIL) Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Nexrad Information Dissemination Service (NIDS) Vertically Integrated Liquid (VIL) product. The VIL products are generated whenever precipitation echoes are detected. It displays VIL values summed for all elevation angles within the volume scan. It covers a range 230 km with a resolution of 2.2 by 2.2 nmi. It is updated once every volume scan (typically every 5-10 min) and includes 16 data levels. The units are kg/m^2. Data are available for most periods during the UMRBPP (5 April to 5 May 1999). Data are available from the Rapid City, SD (KUDX) radar site. These data are in the original NIDS format. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). This data set is quite large in terms of the number of files (4500). Please take this into consideration when placing your data order.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Cabauw Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture, and Temperature Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Cabauw Mast Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture, and Temperature Data Set. This data set contains hourly soil heat flux (5cm, 10cm depth) data from one station for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg9 NZCH-YMHB Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg9 NZCH-YMHB Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 16:01:00 to 2011-07-14 16:01:00.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Aerosol Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) Data
dataset.description: The Cloud Particle Imager captures high-resolution images (pixel size 2.3 microns) using a CCD camera. The CPI has two Particle Detector Sensor lasers that instruct the camera to capture an image. This dataset contains binary image files of cloud particles which can be viewed using the IDL software linked to below. The data were collected during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science Phase 3 (IDEAS-3) project which took place from 15 August 2003 to 22 September 2003.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Flight HRT Data (MSS) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains the HRT data from the NSF/NCAR C-130 flights during MILAGRO.

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: Data from five MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidars (MPDs) collected during MPD-NetDemo field campaign. The data was collected at the US Department of Energy’s Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) facility Southern Great Plains (SGP) field site. This is an engineering dataset. Several problems remain in the data and it should be used with caution and in collaboration with the NCAR lidar group for scientific analysis (see contact below).

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) operated by NCAR from 1973-1977. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the GAMETAG-76 project.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/EAOP-99 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the Enhanced Annual Observing Period - 1999 (EAOP-99) in a Large Scale Area - East (LSA-E) domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: CAMP: Chao Phraya River Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Chao Phraya River Hourly Flux Data Set. This dataset contains data from 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 Visible (Channel 1) Data in AREA Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 2.5 km resolution Meteosat-7 visible (channel 1) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the McIDAS AREA file format.

dataset.title: GOES-East 3-hourly 1km Visible Channel NetCDF Data SE Pacific
dataset.description: This dataset contains NetCDF-formatted GOES-8 Satellite data at 1 kilometer resolution. The data contain all 1KM channels (Visible, lat/lon fields). The data cover the period from 1 Sept - 23 Oct 2001 (2001d244-296).

dataset.title: Lake-ICE Surface: Specials Composite
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the Lake-ICE Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) and National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) DATSAV2 "Special" observation surface data for the Lake-ICE domain and time period. These are observations that are reported at off-hour times. The ASOS and DATSAV2 "Nominal" hourly surface data for the Lake-ICE domain and time period are included in the Lake-ICE Hourly Surface Composite.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) - netCDF format
dataset.description: This dataset contains Lidar SABL Data from the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The data covers December 07, 2004 to January 05, 2005, is rdb data and is in netCDF format.

dataset.title: ISS SODAR Wind Profiler Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains Sound Detection and Ranging (SODAR) data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the CHATS campaign and is available in raw ASCII format. These data have not been quality-controlled. The objective of CHATS was to make spatial measurements of the velocity and scalar turbulence fields in a uniformly vegetated canopy, using arrays of sonic anemometer/thermometers augmented with fast response water vapor and carbon dioxide sensors. With this spatial information, the three-dimensional fields of velocity and scalar fluctuations can be studied to quantify turbulence transport processes and coherent structures throughout the canopy layer. An ancillary goal was to characterize the turbulent structure of the fields of wind, temperature, humidity, and trace chemical species within and above the orchard canopy.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: These are the final, merged HIAPER flight level data files for the Pacific Dust Experiment (PACDEX). Cloud Condensation Nuclei (CCN) [Roberts], Continuous Flow Diffusion Chamber (CFDC) [Demott], Carbon monoxide mixing ratio (CO) [Campos], Counterflow Virtual Impactor (CVI) [Twohy], Ozone Dual-Beam UV Photometer (O3) [Gao] - RF07-RF14 only, PMS2D [NCAR], and Single Particle Soot Photometer (SP2) [Kok] data have been merged wiith the netCDF-formatted low rate flight-level data files. PMS2D and CFDC were updated as of the July 14, 2009 release of this data.

dataset.title: GOES-12 1KM Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 1KM satellite imagery from the GOES-12 satellite collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS Surface Meteorology and Flux Products, 5-minute
dataset.description: 5 minute averages of surface meteorology and flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) at 15 sites during the RELAMPAGO field campaign. These data have been quality-controlled and are available in NetCDF format. Winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected and rotated into geographic coordinates.

dataset.title: NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Specials Dataset
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Climatic Database (DATSAV3) Specials Dataset reports for 7 stations in the CASES-99 time period (25 September 1999 thru 5 November 1999) and domain (approximately 95.7438W to 97.7438W longitude and 36.6501N to 38.6501N latitude). This dataset contains only the "special" records for the DATSAV3 dataset. The nominal records are located in the CASES-99: Surface NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Dataset. This dataset is provided as is and was not quality controlled by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: Canister sampling during OASIS Barrow field intensive Spring 2009
dataset.description:
Several Volatile Organic Compound (VOC) were measured using the whole air gas canisters. One-minute data is reported, although canisters were filled only three times per day, on average. Sample times are reported in Alaska Standard Time (AKST). The measurement sample height for all canisters was at the 18-foot tower location, through the same inlet and silcosteel line as the Trace Organic Gas Analyzer (TOGA) samples for that tower height. Mixing ratios of VOCs in the canisters were determined by later laboratory analysis using Gas Chromatography with Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS) and Gas Chromatography with Flame Ionization Detection (GC-FID). VOC mixing ratios: All mixing ratios are in pptv. Below detection limit -8888
Data not available -9999
Detection limits are < 25 pptv.
PI: Eric Apel, apel@ucar.edu. The data are formatted as an Excel document.

dataset.title: GAUS Quality Controlled Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 52 quality controlled radiosonde soundings collected from October 6-27, 2011 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX II), conducted east of Flagstaff, Arizona, at the Arizona Meteor Crater.

dataset.title: NEXRAD ICT (Wichita/Municipal, KS) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Wichita/Municipal, KS. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately April - June 2009 and April - June 2010. See the related links section below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set..

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the BOReal Ecosystem Atmosphere Study (BOREAS). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MTSAT Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains 30 minute visible channel imagery over the Western Pacific Ocean from MTSAT-2 up to 7 October and then MTSAT-1R. MTSAT-2 operation was stopped during this time due to image data processing failure at JMA. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL. The files are in jpg format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, AVHRR 1KM Channel 1 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12,14,15 and 16 AVHRR Channel 1 imagery. Observations are from the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Images are at a 1KM resolution and in .jpg and .gif formats.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Imager Visible Channel data (AREA files)
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 Imager Visible Channel AREA files, provided in gzip format. This dataset covers the area and timespan of the VOCALS project.

dataset.title: POES Arctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains composite Arctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-17 18:00:00 to 2009-02-01 15:00:00.

dataset.title: Raw 2D-S Imagery
dataset.description: A 2D-S instrument contains two 2D probes which image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected aboard the NCAR GV during the ARISTO 2017 project.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Channel 4 - Channel 2 Difference Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-12 Channel 4 - Channel 2 difference imagery from the time period of the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project. From 13 January to 16 February 2012, the imagery covers Antofagasta, Chile, where the NSF/NCAR GV was forward deployed, and the imagery from 17 February to 1 April 2012 centers on the Galapagos Islands, and the GV was based in San Jose, Costa Rica.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the SAVE-79 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 Carbon Dioxide Concentration (Kok)
dataset.description: This dataset contains carbon dioxide measurements taken aboard the NCAR C-130 aircraft during ACE-1 by Greg Kok (NCAR/RAF). The data consists of time (UTC), location, carbon dioxide (infrared absorption). These data were processed and quality controlled by NCAR/RAF following the field phase of ACE-1.

dataset.title: NEXRAD DDC (Dodge City, KS) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Dodge City, KS. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: GOES 13 SouthWest 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 13 Southwest 1 km channel 1 visible imagery from the 2010 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the Energy Balance Experiment of 2000. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected, but remain in an instrument relative coordinate system. Note that the documentation for this dataset is limited and will be updated in the future. If you plan on using this dataset please contact us for more information.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Hong Kong Air Quality Study (HKAQS). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: ISS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: Radiosonde launches deployed by the EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Cloud and Precipitation Study (CPS) project. Data are in eol ascii format. 73 radiosonde are included in the final archive. The average horizontal distance traveled by the radiosondes during this project was 31.5 km (19.6 miles) from surface to 20.3 km.

dataset.title: Seastar SeaWIFS Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the SeaWIFS Imagery collected by the Seastar Satellite for the East Pacific Investigation of Climate Processes in the Coupled Ocean-Atmosphere System (EPIC 2001).

dataset.title: Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data is a composite upper-air sounding data set which contains all upper-air sounding data collected from 25 platforms (excluding the reference sonde) during IHOP_2002. The data in the composite is at the highest possible resolution (i.e. the 'native' resolution). For more information about this data set please consult the Readme. Note: as of May 12th,2003, this dataset contains reprocessed dropsonde profiles from the Lear and Falcon. ATD released the new dropsonde dataset May 1st,2003.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Winter MONEX project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Ship Underway Data - Seabeam Centerbeam Depth (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of Seabeam Centerbeam Depth plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding profiles collected between June 1 and Aug 12, 2015 during the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades) campaign. These data are provided in the EOL format and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Ship Underway Data - Temperature/Dew Point (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of temperature and dew point plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the Investigation of Sulfur Chemistry in the Antarctic Troposphere (ISCAT) project that ocurred in 2000. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected, but remain in an instrument relative coordinate system.

dataset.title: FP3 NCAR/EOL 449MHz Profiler 30 minute Consensus Winds Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the PRELIMINARY 30 minute consensus wind data measured by the NCAR/EOL 449 MHz profiler located at the PECAN Fixed PISA 3 site in Ellis, Kansas. These data are in netCDF format and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and Moments Data (Black Butte)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Black Butte, OR (ISS3) site during the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment II (IMPROVE-II). This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds and Doppler moments data in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NASA DC-8 NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains dropsonde data from the NASA DC-8 medium altitude research aircraft. A total of 328 quality-controlled dropsonde soundings were released during 16 research flights, and are contained in the final dropsonde data set.

dataset.title: CaPE CLASS Sounding Data
dataset.description: NCAR's Cross Chain Loran Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) rawinsonde data consist of vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, relative humidity and wind speed/direction from a network of seven stations (6 fixed, 1 mobile). No set schedule was used but often 3-hourly soundings from 1100- 2300 UTC. Final datasets include 10 sec and interpolated 5 mb resolutions. Data is ordered by the last 3 letters of the station location. Station tco data is in individual raw ascii files from data taken during soundings. Most other stations have two or three ascii files of comments, README or dailty data recovery rate information, plus tar files of data.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of the highest resolution (i.e. the "native" resolution) upper air sounding data from all sources for the Southeast Atmosphere Study (SAS). Sounding data is included from two sources: the National Weather Service (16 sites and 1438 soundings) and the NCAR/EOL ISS GAUS radiosonde site near the SOAS Centreville site in central Alabama (1 site and 105 soundings). Included are soundings from 30 May to 15 July 2013.

dataset.title: CINDE: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the Convective Initiation Downburst Experiment (CINDE).

dataset.title: Costa Rican Monthly Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This data set contains monthly precipitation data from Costa Rica. Data are from 14 sites within Costa Rica covering the time period January 1950 to December 1997.

dataset.title: WSR-88D NIDS Individual Radar Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NEXRAD imagery for cities in NM, KS, OK, an TX. This dataset contains over 22,000 images. The observing frequency is inconsistent but in some cases there is an image for every minute of the day.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) - png images
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL relative backscatter imagery from the NSF/NCAR C-130 flights during MILAGRO.

dataset.title: Net Radiation and PAR Composite
dataset.description: NOAA/ATDD Little Washita Flux data and derived values from ARM SGP SIROS and SIRS data have been composited together into one data set. This data set is composed of 30-minute observations of Incoming PAR, Outgoing PAR, and Net Radiation from the NOAA/ATDD site, and a Net Radiation value derived from 20-second observations from the SIROS and SIRS networks. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Stornoway (United Kingdom)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Stornoway in the United Kingdom (WMO 03026) which was operated by the UK Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight times per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Surface Meteorology Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: Surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located at the "Homestead Profiling Site" near Elmwood, OK during the International H2O Project (IHOP_2002). These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies - final
dataset.description: During HIPPO-4, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: NCAR Mobile GAUS (MGAUS) Rawinsonde Data (EOL Format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The Terrain Induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) was conducted during March and April 2006, during which time 87 radiosondes were launched using a mobile sounding system at three locations (Visalia (71), Madera (9) and Delano (7)) in the California Central Valley. TREX is the second phase of a coordinated effort to explore the structure and evolution of atmospheric rotors, which typically occur parallel to, and downstream from, mountain ridge crests. The first phase was a project conducted in 2004 called the Sierra Rotors Project. Both phases included downwind radiosonde launches from the central valley, used to help predict the onset of events likely to produce rotors on the West side of the Sierra Nevada Mountain Range. In order to capture the structure of the rotors, additional instruments were set up in California's Owens Valley.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-97 6 second NWS soundings data set contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART sounding systems at nine sites over the GCIP LSA-North Central region. The data set contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality controlled, with every sounding subject to automated consistency checks. No visual examination was conducted on these soundings. Refer to the README file for more details.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) - field DORADE format
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Mexico: Megacities Impact on Regional and Global Environment (MIRAGE) This experiment is a sub-program of the Megacity Initiative: Local and Global Research Observations (MILAGRO4. The files are in field DORADE format.

dataset.title: Vandenberg AFB Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The United States Air Force (USAF) routinely releases radiosondes once per day at 12 UTC from its site at Vandenberg Air Force Base (AFB) in Southern California (WMO ID 72393). This data set includes the soundings released during the MPEX field phase (15 May to 15 June 2013). A total of 31 quality controlled, high resolution (~30 m) soundings are contained in the final MPEX data set.

dataset.title: ASOS Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) Hourly Surface data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, AVHRR 1KM Channel 2 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of NOAA-12, 14, 15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 2 Imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are at a 1KM resolution and in .gif format.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ECLIPSE2019, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: OTREC Chatlogs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the OTREC (Organization of Tropical East Pacific Convection) field project, collected from 17 April to 03 October 2019 onboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER aircraft. These scrubbed chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the OTREC project and are available in a txt format.

dataset.title: GOES 12 4KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 4km Channel Visible Imagery from the 2009 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Small Cumulus Microphysics Study (SCMS).

dataset.title: MODIS Terra Satellite Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains images from the Terra MODIS NASA satellite--650 channel 1, 850 channel 2, and color channel 143 images--taken between December 12, 2004 and January 24, 2005. Not all days have images.

dataset.title: ISFS High Rate Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains high-rate surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the Crop/Wind-energy Experiment (CWEX). These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: ISS PurpleAir Aerosol Products
dataset.description: PurpleAir aerosol measurements collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. Three PurpleAir sensors were mounted at three sites (1) North Pivot, (2) Provo River, and (3) Railway Service Pad site near the Deer Creek Sounding site. Data could not be collected directly for the Railway Service Pad sensor. These data are available as a single csv file downloaded from the purpleair.com website.

dataset.title: NASA DC-8 NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding profile data from the NASA DC-8 medium altitude research aircraft. A total of 95 dropsonde soundings were collected during 11 research flights primarily off the west coast of Central and South America. All 95 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final dropsonde data set.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 12:00:00 to 2011-06-07 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 Visible (Channel 1) Raw Uncalibrated Data in NetCDF Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 2.5 km resolution Meteosat-7 visible (channel 1) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the NetCDF file format. These data are the raw uncalibrated units and are provided if you would like to generate your own calibration versus that in the provided calibrated data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Western Atmospheric Mercury Observations (WAMO). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: BEACHON 5 minute ISFS data, not tilt corrected
dataset.description: The Bio-hydro-atmosphere interactions of Energy, Aerosols, Carbon, H2O, Organics and Nitrogen (BEACHON) is a project aimed at examining the evolution of thermodynamic structures in the boundary layer above the Manitou Experimental Forest located Colorado. BEACHON included the use of an ISFS turbulence flux tower which was 45 meters tall and instrumented at 5 levels. This dataset contains 5 minute ISFS data. These data are in NetCDF format, and have not been tilt corrected. Minimal QC has been done on the files, as described on the Flux Tower Logbook Wiki Page linked below.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR C-130 during ARISTO2016. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Sipora Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 215 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from Sipora, Indonesia. The soundings were typically released eight times per day at 00, 03, 06, 09, 12, 15, 18 and 21 UTC from 29 November 2011 to 1 January 2012. These data were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3 version of the data set has had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Synoptic Observations
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Surface: GTS Surface Synoptic Observations are online data. Data is in GEMPAK format.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm (LCFA) data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of ICICLE operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: GTS Caribbean Station Plot Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains gif images from the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) Caribbean Station collected during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project time period.

dataset.title: HLY-04-03 NCAR EOl Service Group Cruise CD [NCAR EOL Service Group]
dataset.description: This CD ROM was created 25 August 2004 at the end of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer Cruise. It is a subset of the NCAR EOL HLY-04-03 field catalog and contains the data in the state they were in as of the end of the cruise. At that time, the Conductivity Temperature Depth (CTD) and bottle data were in their final form. The state (preliminary or final) of all other data sets on this CD was unknown at that time.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Ship Underway Data - Relative Humidity (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of Relative Humidity plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: REFRACTT06 QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The goal of the Refractivity Experiment For H2O Research And Collaborative operational Technology Transfer (REFRACTT) was to obtain high resolution measurements of water vapor variability and transport in the convective boundary layer, in order to assess the improvements these enhanced measurements have in numerical model forecasts of quantitative precipitation. An additional goal of this project was to demonstrate the usefulness of using the NEXRAD radar network to collect refractivity measurements for forecasting purposes. For this experiment, NCAR/EOL deployed one mobile sounding system to various locations along the front range of Central and Northern Colorado. Seventy-six radiosonde launches were performed between June 5, 2006 and Sept 2, 2006. For more information on the REFRACTT project please visit: http://www.eol.ucar.edu/projects/refractt/

dataset.title: NCAR S-Band Polarimetric (S-Pol) Catalog Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains NCAR S-Band Polarimetric (S-Pol) Catalog Plots for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. Data was acquired continuously at 30 minute intervals, 24 hours per day from November 24th, 2004 through January 24th, 2005. There are images for reflectivity, velocity, and polarization for each time period.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Ship Underway Data - Relative Humidity (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of Relative Humidity plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: Gan MMS Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description:
This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 184 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Addu Atoll, Gan Island, Maldives site, collected before and towards the end of the DYNAMO field campaign by the Maldives Meteorological Service (MMS). MMS conducted the releases from this site before the field phase daily at 12 UTC nominal time from 15 June to 30 September 2011. Also after the Maldivian political crisis the MMS conducted the soundings after ARM personnel departed from the site. Releases were daily at the 12 UTC nominal time from 12 February to 5 March 2012 and twice daily (00 and 12 UTC) from 6-30 March and then back to daily at 12 UTC from 1-8 April 2012. The soundings taken by ARM personnel from 22 September 2011 to 9 February 2012 are included in a separate data set.
This station used Vaisala RS92-SGP radiosondes with GPS windfinding.

dataset.title: BOREAS: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data consists of two tar files containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the BOReal Ecosystem Atmosphere Study (BOREAS). One file contains 1 minute data. The other contains 5 minute data.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the NOAA Gulfstream IV (G-IV) dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset consists of dropsonde data from the NOAA Gulfstream IV (G-IV). Dropsondes were taken as requested. These data were processed through an interpolation that included the removal of bad data from the higher resolution data, as well as automated, and visual quality control. These data include pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 2 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: SGP99: C-130 Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR C-130 aircraft during the Southern Great Plains Experiment (SGP99). This dataset contains downward-looking video of FF01.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR uncorrected radar moments data, 10 Hz
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar 10Hz, field version data collected during the HCR-Test experiment from 20 November 2014 to 1 December 2014. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as ten minute tar files. Note: The data is not quality controlled. Please contact us before using this data.

dataset.title: KOFSE: Electra Photography Cloud Video (fse, left, dwn)
dataset.description: This dataset contains hourly mpg movies from VHS videos taken from the Electra during KOFSE (Kuwait Oil-FIre Smoke Experiment) project. Each hour of mpg movie file is about 1.3 Gb in size.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: Webcam imagery every 5 minutes during daylight hours from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Web Camera collected during the CHEESEHEAD field project in Park Falls, Wisconsin. These data are organized by date and available tarred in JPEG format.

dataset.title: GTS Hourly Marine Observation Data (GEMPAK)
dataset.description: The GTS Hourly Marine Observation Data is one of several surface data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are the global hourly surface marine observations from buoys and ships of opportunity. These data are contained in daily files which are in GEMPAK format. The data cover the period from 7 - 28 July 2001. The data were acquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg9 NZCH-YMHB Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg9 NZCH-YMHB Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 16:01:00 to 2011-07-14 16:01:00.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Pago Pago
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Pago Pago during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Electra Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the Electra aircraft during Phases I, II, and III as well as the Pre Phase. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During HEFT10, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during HEFT10 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been sharpened, reduced from 1024x768 to 512x384 resolution, and combined into movies at 15 frames per second. The movies are H.264 encoded MPEG-4 files and can be played by Quicktime 6.5 or later (Mac and Windows), xine (linux), or RealPlayer 10.5 and later. By PI request, movies were only made for the flights to and from Hawaii on January 28-30, 2010.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data - 25 Hz [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Airborne Carbon in the Mountains Experiment" project which took place from 14 May 2004 to 2 August 2004. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps, mixed) production data set. The HRT Bitfile log lists times and dates of individual flights.

dataset.title: High-Priority Days All-Sky Camera
dataset.description: These 16 mm films include footage of the sky from Discovery, Fay, and Hecla for High Priority Days during Phase III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Vessel is specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: NOAA 405Mhz Profiler Dataset
dataset.description: The NESOB-97 National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) 405 MHZ Wind Profiler Network Dataset consists of hourly winds from sixteen NOAA Profiler Network (NPN) sites. The profiles contain total wind speed, wind direction, U and V wind components, and altitude. No additional quality control was performed. When attempting to preview a profile, use altitude and either wind direction or speed since pressure is always missing. Please see the README for more details.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg7 YWOL-YPDN Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 YWOL-YPDN Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 21:32:00 to 2011-07-14 15:32:00.

dataset.title: NCEP/CPC Daily Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This dataset contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction/Climate Prediction Center (NCEP/CPC) Daily Precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. This dataset was formed by extracting precipitation values with NCEP/CPC element codes of PC and PP that fall on the hour. All raw precipitation data, including data that do not fall on the hour, can be found in the GCIP/EOP Surface: Precipitation NCEP/CPC Gage Only Daily Dataset.

dataset.title: Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei (CCN) Impactor Data
dataset.description: The NCAR/EOL/RAF Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei Impactor (GNI) samples giant aerosol particles. This data set was acquired during the SPICULE project. Slides were exposed in the free air stream onto uncoated polycarbonate microscope slides. The slides were analyzed in the NCAR/EOL/RAF GNI slide chamber, using a dual-optical microscope. Slides were inserted into the humidified chamber with a relative humidity of 89.8 %. The images were analyzed using an automated edge detection algorithm, and using spherical cap geometry to determine the solution drop volume. Subsequently, the equivalent dry NaCl equivalent radius was determined using the Kohler equation for concentrated solutions, specifically Pruppacher and Klett, 1978, eq. 6.26b, using a full chemical potential calculation.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Irena Arctica
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Danish ASAP ship the Irena Arctica which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: STORM-FEST 10mb Sounding Composite
dataset.description: A composite upper air data set consisting of STORM-FEST data collected from all surface and aircraft based sites (NWS, AES, CLASS, US Military, Picket Fence, L2D2 and USAF). All data sets were converted to the NCAR CLASS format and interpolated to 10 mb pressure levels. Data were then quality controlled. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V (HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the HIAPER Pole-to-Pole Observations (HIPPO) of Carbon Cycle and Greenhouse Gases Study Phase 5 (HIPPO-5) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Forward-Looking Digital Camera Photography [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains images from the forward looking camera of the C130 during the VOCALS project. The C130 flew a forward looking digital camera and a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during VOCALS flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains the forward-looking camera images.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol radar moments data collected during the Mesoscale Alpine Programme (MAP) from September 4 to November 6, 1999. The data are available as hourly tar files in CfRadial format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 4km Channel4 - Channel 2 Difference Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 satellite imagery for the VOCALS study area and time of interest. The images are JPEGS.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings derived from NCAR Electra flight level data
dataset.description: This dataset consists of soundings derived from National Center for Atmospheric Research Electra flight level data. Data were taken during events of opportunity. The data were processed through the visual quality control process. The automated and spatial quality control processes were not conducted on this dataset. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at five second intervals along the flight path. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 1290MHz Wind Profiler NIMA Winds and RASS Data (West Profiler Site)
dataset.description: This dataset contains quality-controlled 1290 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located west of the double ridge at the West Wind Profiler Site during the Perdigao field project in 2017. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have been quality controlled by the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA).

dataset.title: NEXRAD TWX (Topeka/Alma, KS) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Topeka/Alma, KS. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: ISU Supplemental Sounding Data and Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains sounding data and images collected by Iowa State University during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 26 January - 8 March 2019. Data were collected with the Qinetic Tactical Atmospheric Sounding Kit (TASK). See the TASK data sheet for instrument accuracies/uncertainties. Also contains skewT/LogP images for quick reference.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler, 5 and 30 Minute Winds
dataset.description: 449 MHz radar wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Park Falls site during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. This dataset includes both 5 and 30 minute averaged winds data in netCDF format. Moments data from the profiler can be found in the companion dataset, 592.073 NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Moments.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Aerosol Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) Data
dataset.description: The Cloud Particle Imager captures high-resolution images (pixel size 2.3 microns) using a CCD camera. The CPI has two Particle Detector Sensor lasers that instruct the camera to capture an image. This dataset contains binary image files of cloud particles which can be viewed using the IDL software linked to below. The data were collected during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science Phase 1 (IDEAS-1) project which took place from 5 April 2002 to 14 May 2002.

dataset.title: GTS Upper-Air Constant Level Plots
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Upper Air: GTS Upper-Air Constant Level Plots (JOSS) are online data. All data is in GIF format.

dataset.title: R/V Sagar Kanya Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This preliminary data set includes 71 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from the R/V Sagar Kanya. The soundings were typically released four times per day at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC from 25 September to 10 October 2011 and less frequent releases continuing through 19 October 2011. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3 version of the data set has had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU. An L3.1 version of this data set will be available later with an additional correction applied for deck heating effects.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Low-rate Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains low-rate variables from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the Energy Balance Experiment of 2000. These data are in NetCDF format, have had some quality control performed, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected, but remain in an instrument relative coordinate system. Note that the documentation for this dataset is limited and will be updated in the future. If you plan on using this dataset please contact us for more information.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR Electra (N308D) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Hawaiian Rainband Experiment (HARP). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Mobile MGLASS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains rawinsonde profiles collected during the Bow Echo and Mesoscale Convective Vortex Experiment (BAMEX 2003) from May 24th thru July 6th,2003 . Rawinsondes were released from two Atmospheric Technology Division Mobile Glass systems and the Mobile Integrated Profiling System (MIPS) operated and owned by the University of Alabama, Huntsville . The data set underwent ATD and the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office of Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) quality control procedures. Consult the README for more information. Some of the release times for the MIPS soundings included in this data set were corrected. See the documentation (bamex_mips_correction_record.doc) for more details.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NCAR GV during the SAANGRIA Test. The data is in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II high-rate ISFS data, not tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains high rate (5 second) ISFS data collected from 27 September to 2 November 2013 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in NetCDF format, and have not been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S- and Ka-band, DORADE
dataset.description: S-PolKa data from the Refractivity Experiment for H2O Research and Collaborative operational Technology Transfer '06 (REFRACTT06) project . This data set contains both S-band and Ka-band data. These data are in dorade format and are available as tar files.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:52:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT20 Data (Sabreliner) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Experiment on Rapidly-Intensifying Cyclones over the Atlantic (ERICA) project. This dataset contains 20hz state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format. Note that these data files do NOT contain lat/lon information. Please refer to the companion dataset "Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Sabreliner)" for that information.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ASPIRE-TEST project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-13 4km Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GOES-13 4KM Channel 1 visible satellite imagery for the DC3 project. The imagery are in JPEG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: VORTEX-95 GOES IR Satellite Images (GIF)
dataset.description: GOES-8 IR imagery collected during the VORTEX-95 period via PC-McIDAS and then converted to GIF image format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Palu Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 365 high vertical resolution soundings from Palu, Indonesia (WMO 97072) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscater Lidar (SABL) - Field Dorade format [Morley, B. (NCAR/RSF)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the DYCOMS-II (Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II) project. The data are in DORADE format.

dataset.title: ZEBRA GOES-E 4KM N42 N43 NRL Dual-doppler radar composite imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains composite imagery of the dual doppler radar aboard the N42, N42 and NRL aircraft overlaid on satellite imagery. This dataset has two images on Aug 28, and 21 images on September 11.

dataset.title: PILS-IC Aerosol Fast anions
dataset.description: This dataset contains anion data collected by a particles-into-liquid-sampler (PILS) instrument aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the Wintertime Investigation of Transport, Emission, and Reactivity (WINTER) project. Please see the header portion of the data files for a list of parameters measured.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Barrow
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Barrow, Alaska during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.
