dataset.title: Chat logs START-08
dataset.description: These files contain the chat logs during flights for the Stratosphere-Troposphere Analyses of Regional Transport (START08) project.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the ASPIRE-TEST project.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the Winter Icing and Storms Project (WISP-04). These data are in cfRadial format and are available as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Ship Underway Data - Temperature/Dew Point (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of Temperature and Dew Point plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ASPIRE project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: Ship Radar
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of various radar footage (including, but not limited to Hybrid and Compacted) from ships for Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE) Title, vessel(s), and phase(s) are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: MISS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The first phase of the PLOWS 2008-2009 project, during February and March of 2009, and the later phase during November 2009 through early March 2010, included the use of one Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS), which is a suite of instruments that includes a GPS Advanced Upper-air Sounding System (GAUS). During PLOWS, the GAUS was used to launch 14 radiosondes during the first field season and 105 radiosondes during the second field season . This dataset contains those 119 Mobile ISS Radiosonde soundings in EOL format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-12-21 22:15:00.

dataset.title: Gilliss All-Sky Camera
dataset.description: These 16 mm films include footage of the sky from the US ship Gilliss for Phases I and II of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the North Dakota Thunderstorm Project (NDTP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) - field DORADE format
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field dorade format files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Rain in Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The data are in DORADE format.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Dropsonde Wind Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains dropsonde Wind Plots from the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The missions were completed between 7 Dec 2004 - 20 Dec 2004, and 11 Jan 2005 - 24 Jan 2004.

dataset.title: METCRAX ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: The Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX) is a 3-year meteorological research program supported by the Mesoscale Dynamics Division of the U. S. National Science Foundation (NSF). The program is investigating the structure and evolution of temperature inversions or cold-air pools that form on a daily basis in topographic basins and valleys. As part of this research a one-month-long field experiment will be conducted in October 2006 in Arizona's Meteor Crater, a simple near-ideal topographic basin formed by the impact of a meteor. In this basin, the physical processes leading to the buildup and breakdown of temperature inversions and the formation of atmospheric seiches (atmospheric oscillations in the basin caused by wind disturbances at the basin crest) can be studied without the complications introduced by more complex topography. This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during METCRAX. This data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the MAIR-E project.

dataset.title: Sounding data from San Cristobal (Galapagos)
dataset.description: This dataset contains high resolution upper air sounding data from San Cristobal in the Galapagos Islands. The dataset contains vertical profiles of pressure, wind speed and direction, air temperature, dew point temperature, relative humidity, and altitude. This data has undergone some quality control. See the README for more details.

dataset.title: NCAR MAPR RASS Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set was collected in the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS). It includes Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) data taken in hourly and 30-minute intervals. This data set was collected from February 26,2006 to May 1st, 2006 and is in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the SAVE-78 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Aircraft Vertical Separation Standards Project (AVSSP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During ACCLIP, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR Electra during ACLAIM. The data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Soundings Multi-Network Composite 5-mb Level Upper Air Data
dataset.description: The upper air 5-mb level sounding data for the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME) 2004 Tier 3 domain (5°N to 50°N latitude and 125°W to 75°W longitude) are contained within this dataset. The dataset covers the time period 1 June through 30 September 2004. This NAME 2004 Sounding Composite Highest Resolution Upper-Air Dataset contains 21254 soundings from 91 sites. NOTE: As of 25 March 2010 many of the soundings in this data set have had a correction applied to account for a significant dry bias. See the documentation file for details on the correction(s) applied to this data set. Also see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH.

dataset.title: GOES-13 1 km Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains jpg images from the GOES-13 1km channel 1 visible satellite, taken during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project.

dataset.title: ORCAS Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the O2/N2 Ratio and CO2 Airborne Southern Ocean (ORCAS) Study from January 15, 2016 to February 28, 2016. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the ORCAS project.

dataset.title: NEXRAD Flight Track Movies
dataset.description: This dataset contains NEXRAD flight track movies produced during the DC3 project. The movies are in MOV format. The movies cover the time span from 2012-05-18 00:00:00 to 2012-06-28 23:59:59.

dataset.title: St. Maarten Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). This data set includes 39 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from St Maarten. (WMO 78866). Soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC) from 12 August to 31 August 2005.

dataset.title: Reference Radiosonde Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: During the International H20 Project 2002 (IHOP 2002), Reference Radiosondes were released sixteen times. Either a Vaisala RS80 radiosonde released from the Homestead site or a National Weather Service (NWS) VIZ radiosonde released from Dodge City, KS accompanied the Reference Radiosondes during their flights. Consult the README for dates and times when the Reference Sondes were released and from which site sondes were released simultaneously. There are some issues with the Reference Radiosonde data. The following is just a summary. For a more detailed explanation please see the "Important Notes to Users" section in the readme file. Pressure Errors: The Reference Sonde (RS) uses a hypsometer to measure pressure, and this sensor hasbeen found to be unreliable. We suggest not using the RS pressure data. Time difference: The time difference in the launch time between the RS sounding files and the VIZ/Vaisala soundings is due to the RS recording data on the ground, while the other sondes began recording closer to, or at, the actual launch time. Wind data: The RS wind data were not corrected for balloon pendulum swing because the effects of the balloon swing are large, they vary from sounding to sounding, and because the focus of the RS for IHOP was on the humidity measurements.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Cumulonimbus Mass Flux (CBMF) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Laverton Aero (94865), AU, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These images consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily. in these plots are PRELIMINARY and could change significantly following final procificant level data(temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Hawiian Rainband Experiment (HaRP). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD AMA (Amarillo, TX) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 2009 and 2010 Field Catalogs. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Amarillo TX. The files are in gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - ICARTT format
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the WE-CAN project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in ICARTT format.

dataset.title: NCEP Eta model 500 mb Maps
dataset.description: NCEP Eta Model 500 mb Analysis map images for the SGP97 period.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released at five sites throughout the Midwestern United States during the SAVANT (Stable Atmospheric Variability and Transport) field phase (15 September to 15 November 2018). One station in the region was only available at mandatory/significant level resolution (KDVN - Davenport, IA) and is available in a separate data set. A total of 648 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final SAVANT data set.

dataset.title: Chat Logs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the MAIRE24 (Methane Emissions Quantification at scale using the MethaneAIR Imaging Spectrometer on the NSF Gulfstream-V 2024) field project, collected from 28 June to 22 July 2024 onboard the GV (Gulfstream V). These data are available in a txt format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD Radar with NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER, NASA DC-8, DLR Falcon Flight Track Movies
dataset.description: This dataset contains movies of the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER, NASA DC-8, and DLR Falcon flight tracks combined with the NEXRAD radar data from the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) field campaign for flights on 18-19 May, 21 May, 25 May, 29-30 May, 1-2 June, 5-6 June, 11-12 June, 15-16 June, 21-22 June, and 27-28 June 2012 in the DC3 area of interest.

dataset.title: EOL MGAUS Colorado Sounding Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) 2012 project. This data set includes 31 high vertical resolution (1-sec) soundings from the NCAR/EOL Mobile GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding System (MGAUS). They were released from locations around northeastern Colorado from 3 May to 18 July 2012 as part of the DC3 field campaign. This data set is the same as the EOL MGAUS Colorado Sounding Data but with the format converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 SABL IR Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the SABL IR imagery from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: University of Utah Halo Photonics Stream Line Scanning Doppler LiDAR Data Captured During Spring Campaign (LID-UOU-SPRING)
dataset.description: This data set contains the University of Utah's Halo Photonics Stream Line Scanning Doppler LiDAR Data. Data was collected during intense observation periods between 1 May and 31 May 2013 during the Mountain Terrain Atmospheric Modeling and Observations (MATERHORN-X) Spring field campaign. Files are the original data and have not been quality controlled. The format is ASCII tab separated and different scanning strategies have different file naming conventions. The time stamps are based off of UTC time for all the instruments for the MATERHORN-X data, unless it was stated otherwise. Please refer to the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Winter MONEX project.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Texas 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Texas 4km Channel 4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-03 14:00:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Frontal Air-Sea INteraction EXperiment (FASINEX) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Particulate matter Airborne Sampling INlet experiment (PASIN). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Camborne (United Kingdom)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Camborne in the United Kingdom (WMO 03808) which was operated by the UK Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight times per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NWS and ARM 5 hPa Vertical Resolution Sounding Data Set
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-97 5 hPa ARM and NWS Soundings dataset contains 5 hPa interpolated sounding data extracted from 12 NWS sounding sites and five ARM sounding sites in the NESOB-97 domain. Only the data from the surface to 3000 m have been retained in this data set. The high resolution data were quality controlled with every sounding subjected to automated consistency checks. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.See the readme for further information.

dataset.title: VORTEX-94 6-sec NWS Soundings
dataset.description: The Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment (VORTEX) 6-second National Weather Service (NWS) Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the VORTEX project domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: MRMS 3DZdr Products
dataset.description: MRMS 3DZdr Products collected during the Winter Precipitation Type Research Multi-scale Experiment (WINTRE-MIX) time and area of interest are included in this dataset. The data are in GRIB2 format. This is a large dataset. Please order only the time period that is required.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol radar data taken during the Severe Thunderstorm Electrification and Precipitation Study (STEPS). The data is available in dorade format as half hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR C-130 flight track in real-time during the WE-CAN project.

dataset.title: Redstone Arsenal Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) 2012 project. This data set includes 10 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the US Army Redstone Arsenal site in Alabama. Redstone releases soundings at 12 UTC from Monday through Friday. This data set includes only those soundings taken on days of DC3 operations from 15 May to 15 June 2012. These soundings were taken by personnel at the Redstone Arsenal and the data provided by the University of Alabama-Huntsville. NCAR/EOL converted the soundings to ESC format and passed them through a QC process.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - ICARTT format (subset of NetCDF files) [(NCAR-EOL-RAF)]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the NOMADSS project. These data are in ICARTT format. NOTE: This ICARTT data set contains a SUBSET of the low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data found in the netCDF form of this data set (373.005).

dataset.title: Wyoming&#39;s Remote Weather Information System (RWIS) Hourly Data in QC format
dataset.description: The Wyoming's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) Hourly data in QC format dataset is one of several datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. Data from this source has been converted to Quality Control format, but no Quality Control has been performed by UCAR/JOSS. See the README for additional information.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled GTS soundings for two High Ice Water Content (HIWC) Radar 2018 observational periods and regions. The first was the southeastern United States for the period of 29 July to 13 August 2018 and the second was across the Pacific Ocean for the period 10-31 August 2018. This data set includes only those stations in the regions for which high vertical resolution data were available. Those stations with the GTS mandatory and significant level data are available in a separate data set. A total of 375 quality-controlled, mandatory and significant level resolution soundings are contained in the final data set.

dataset.title: PIBAL Wind Only Sounding data from PACS-SONET
dataset.description: This data set contains PIBAL wind only sounding data from the Pan American Climate Study Program - Sounding Network (PACS-SONET) collected from twelve sites (the network was later expanded to seventeen sites) over the region from 30 N to 30 S latitude and 60 to 180 W longitude. It also contains PIBAL soundings collected during the South American Low-Level Jet Experiment (SALLJEX) which had field operations from 15 November 2002 thru 15 February 2003. The PIBAL files include site identifier information, the total wind speed and direction, and the u and v wind components. The soundings cover the period starting 07 Apr 1997 thru 09 Sep 2003. However, not all sites collected data during the entire period (Some sites were only operational during SALLJEX). This data set has undergone no quality control. See the README for more details.

dataset.title: CABL 5 minute ISFS data, QC&#39;d, geographic and tilt corrected sonic winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the Characterizing the Atmospheric Boundary Layer (CABL) field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 1 Imagery
dataset.description: This is the channel 1 imagery collected from the GOES-8 satellite during the EPIC time period.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during START08. Summary data have been merged with the "NCAR C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT (1-sps) Data" These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available. The instrument was being repaired during RF15 and RF16 so there are no PMS2D data for those flights.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 15:00:00 to 2011-06-07 21:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 12:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: Japan Minami-daito-Jima High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC). It includes 145 High Resolution (2 second) Radiosonde soundings from Minami Daito Jima, Okinawa, Japan. The soundings were typically released twice daily between 1 August and 30 September 2008. During periods of tropical activity there were more frequent releases. The raw data were provided by the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). NCAR/EOL converted the data to EOL Sounding Composite Format and conducted automated and visual quality control checks.

dataset.title: Grawmet Radiosonde System Playa Launch site Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the University of Utah's Grawmet Radiosonde System data from the Playa launch site. Data was collected during intense observation periods for the Mountain Terrain Atmospheric Modeling and Observations (MATERHORN-X) field campaign. Files are the original data and have not been quality controlled. The format is ASCII tab separated and consists of separate files for each radiosonde release. The time stamps are based off of UTC time for all the instruments for the MATERHORN-X data, unless it was stated otherwise. Please refer to the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: MRMS 2D Low Level Composite Reflectivity Products
dataset.description: MRMS 2D LowLevelCompositeReflectivity Products collected during the Winter Precipitation Type Research Multi-scale Experiment (WINTRE-MIX) time and area of interest are included in this dataset. The data are in GRIB2 format. This is a large dataset. Please order only the time period that is required.

dataset.title: NEXRAD SRX (Slatington Mtn, AR) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Slatington Mtn, AR. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Japan Ishigaki-Jima High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC 2008). The data set includes 179 high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings from Ishigakijima, Japan (WMO - 47918). The data cover August and September 2008 and soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC with some special releases during periods of nearby tropical storms. The data are in the EOL Sounding Composite format which is columnar ASCII. The data were provided by JMA.

dataset.title: Howard University High Resolution Soundings - Barbados (UWyo ASCII Format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Pre-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. This data set includes 99 high vertical resolution (4 second) soundings from Barbados taken by Howard University from 14 August through 25 September 2010. The files in this dataset are in the University of Wyoming ASCII format.

dataset.title: CAMP: Tongyu (Inner Mongolia) Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Tongyu (Inner Mongolia) 30-Minute Soil Data Set for the cropland and grassland sites. This data set contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Stratospheric Aerosol Validation Experiment (SAVE) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) RASS Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains RASS imagery from the NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS).

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Tahiti
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken in Tahiti during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2009-12-28 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Beaufort Arctic Storms Experiment (BASE). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Photography Forward/Side Looking Video [EOL]
dataset.description: The PACIFIC ATMOSPHERIC SULFUR EXPERIMENT is a comprehensive study of the chemistry of sulfur in the remote marine troposphere. Aircraft were based on Christmas Island in the Pacific Ocean from 3 August through 09 September 2007. The NSF/NCAR C-130 was used to carry the chemistry paylod. This dataset consists of MPEG movie files made from jpg images taken from a forward looking camera mounted on the C-130. The flight movies are made from the one frame per second images, but they play back at 15 frames per second. The aircraft position, attitude, and a number of other parameters are included as a sidebar in the movie.

dataset.title: FABLE 1998 NCAR/ATD ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the WLEF-TV transmitter near Park Falls, Wisconsin during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 1998. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES 12 4KM Channel 3 Water Vapor Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 4km Channel 3 Water Vapor Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: NEXRAD TLX (Oklahoma City/Twin Lakes, OK) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Oklahoma City/Twin Lakes, OK. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: SAO Special Observations
dataset.description: This dataset contains "special" (manual and automatic) observations from the GCIP/GIST domain, including the following parameters: wind direction/speed, ceiling height, visibility, dry bulb temperature, wet bulb temperature, dew point temperature, sea level and station pressure, cloud data, and present weather.

dataset.title: INDOEX-98: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This data set from the Indian Ocean Experiment 1998 (INDOEX-98] was collected on the ship Sagar Kanya and the Hululu Station, from Cross-Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding Systems (CLASS). Data from each station is in a single tar file.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, DMSP OLS Infrared Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of F-12, F-13, F-14 and F-15 DMSP visible infrared imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME). These data are in cfRadial format and are available as 3 hour tar files.

dataset.title: VORTEX-94 GOES Satellite Imagery (GIF)
dataset.description: GOES-7 IR imagery collected during the VORTEX period via PC-McIDAS and then converted to GIF image format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: GOES-7 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 VIS imagery collected during the ACE-1 Transect period via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of full-disk, 32 km resolution images collected every 6 hours. Digital McIDAS Area format data files were collected hourly at OFPS from NOAA/NSSFC from which these 6-hourly GIF images were created. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: GOES-East Imager Near IR CH2 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Imager CH2 Near IR Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 15 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: R/V Roger Revelle ISS 915 MHz Wind Profiler Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located on the R/V Roger Revelle during the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) field campaign. This dataset includes doppler moments data (.mom.nc) and consensus winds data (.winds*.nc) in NetCDF format. These data are tarred into daily files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NOAA/NOHRSC Central US Snow Depth Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains daily snow depth maps over the central US. The maps were generated by NOAA/NOHRSC and its National Snow Analysis. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 6 February to 30 March 2009 and 13 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg7 YWOL-YPDN Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 YWOL-YPDN Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 22:32:00 to 2011-07-14 15:32:00.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Medan Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 364 high vertical resolution soundings from Medan, Indonesia (WMO 96035) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: CAMP: Korean Peninsula Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Korean Peninsula Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture data set. This dataset contains the first half of the EOP-3 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 March 2003). There is only one station in this dataset. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (Electra) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Experiment on Rapidly-Intensifying Cyclones over the Atlantic (ERICA) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-97 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the ESOP-97 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Quality Controlled Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: 109 quality controlled dropsonde soundings collected over the Southern Ocean during the SOCRATES field campaign. The dropsondes were deployed from the NCAR GV aircraft during twelve research flights conducted between Jan 19 and Feb 24, 2018.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler Products
dataset.description: 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. Moments and winds in 5 minute and 30 minute resolution are provided.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Imager 4 km All Channel Data - netCDF
dataset.description: This data set contains the 4-km all channel GOES-13 satellite data over the contiguous United States during the PECAN project. The GOES-13 channels are visible (channel 1), near-IR (2), water vapor (3), thermal IR (4), and 13 micron (6). During PECAN GOES-13 was stationed at 75W. These data are in netCDF format and in daily tar files that contain all channels. These data were generated by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Driftsonde Data
dataset.description: Quality-controlled driftsonde sounding data for the African Monsoon Multidisciplinary Analysis (AMMA) project. A total of 124 soundings are contained in the quality final archive.

dataset.title: ZEBRA GOES-E NOAA LF N42 N43 NRL P-3 Track Composite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains composite imagery of the GOES-E satellite, LF radar, and the flight tracks for the NRL P-3, NOAA-42, and NOAA-43 aircraft. Imagery are for storm-specific areas within the RAINEX area of interest, available at 15 minute intervals during the flights.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Palu Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 365 high vertical resolution soundings from Palu, Indonesia (WMO 97072) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Downward-Facing Digital Camera Images [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains images from the downward looking camera of the C130 during the Airborne Carbon in the Mountains Experiment (ACME) project. The C130 flew a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during ACME flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains the downward-looking camera images.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV during SOCRATES. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: CAMP: N. South China Sea - S. Japan Hourly Surface Meteorology Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) CEOP Asian-Australia Monsoon Experiment (CAMP) Northern South China Sea - Southern Japan Hourly Surface Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains hourly data from 25 stations for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: GOES 12 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery, NetCDF
dataset.description: This dataset contains NetCDF format 1km resolution images from the GOES-12 satellite. Images are for the period and area of the START08 project.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Extended Area Effects (EAE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Climatology of Upslope Stratocumulus (Upslope) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: CEOP_AP Tsukuba Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) CEOP_AP 30 minute Flux Data Set. This data set contains averaged 30 minute data from the Tsukuba reference site. This TERC-UT station covers 1 January 2007 through 31 December 2009. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Cirrus - King Air) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the First ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Regional Experiment (FIRE). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MICROFRONTS GOES-8 VIS Images
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible satellite imagery collected for the 1995 MICROFRONTS experiment via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains data collected aboard the NCAR GV (HIAPER) by the onboard Airborne Data System (ADS) during the PACDEX field campaign. These files contain HRT (25 samples per second) flight-level data, including navigation and state parameters, and selected scientific instrumentation fed to the ADS system during the flight. These are netcdf files.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R NZCH Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NZCH Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-16 20:30:00 to 2009-02-01 18:30:00.

dataset.title: ACE-1: Southern Surveyor ISS High Vertical Resolution Balloon Data
dataset.description: Data from the NCAR/Integrated Sounding System (ISS) upper air data collected aboard the Southern Surveyor during the ACE-1 transect and intensive operations, via the NCAR/Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD). Data consist of 10-sec vertical resolution data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily with up to 6-hr frequency during intensive operations.

dataset.title: West Texas Mesonet Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes high vertical resolution (2 sec) soundings from the West Texas Mesonet Reese Center, TX site collected during the VORTEX2 field campaigns for 2009 and 2010. There are 2 soundings for the 2009 season (15 May 18:16 and 13 June 17:44, 2009) and 3 soundings for the 2010 season (18 May 18:39, 6 June 19:24, and 14 June 17:32, 2010) . These data were provided by Texas Tech University and converted to the EOL Composite (ESC) format. The station used Vaisala radiosondes with LORAN-C windfinding.

dataset.title: Mobile ISS Surface Met Imagery [EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains surface meteorology imagery from the Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS) sites during T-REX. The MISS is a self contained meteorological observing system contained within a vehicle. This data set contains real-time imagery files taken from the T-REX Field Catalog.

dataset.title: Model 24 hour forecast sfc temps,winds, 500mb heights (GIF)
dataset.description: This data set contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) 24 hour forecast of surface winds and temperature and 500 mb heights for the SHEBA domain from SSEC at University of Wisconsin.

dataset.title: NEXRAD SJT (San Angelo/Mathis, TX) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in San Angelo, TX. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set..

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Airborne Lidar and Observations of Hawaiian Airglow/Arctic NoctiLucent Cloud Campaign (ALOHA-93). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R NZCH Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NZCH Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-16 20:30:00 to 2009-02-01 18:30:00.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale sectors during the period of TORUS_2019 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The actual sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the TORUS_2019 region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: METCRAX 30 second ISFS data, QC&#39;d, geographic, not tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 second ISFS data from the Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX), from 24 September 2006 to 4 November 2006. These data are in NetCDF format, are not tilt corrected, and are in geographic coordinates. More information about the data source and processing can be found at the Project Documentation webpage in the related links. The Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC)
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of cloud particle size distributions collected during the ICE-T project using an airborne holographic instrument mounted on the NSF/NCAR C-130. The HOLODEC is a holographic detector designed to determine the size, two-dimensional shape, and three dimensional position of hydrometeors via digital in-line holography.

dataset.title: CSET Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the CSET (Cloud Systems Evolution in the Trades) study from 1 July 2015 to 15 August 2015. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the CSET project.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar time series data
dataset.description: S-Pol radar full time series data in IWRF format collected continuously during the LATTE (Lower Atmospheric Thermodynamics & Turbulence Experiment) project. Each file covers about 15 minutes of S-Pol operation. See the FRONT S-Pol Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the ALPEX project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 1343 quality controlled NWS (National Weather Service) soundings released at eighteen sites throughout the plains region of the central United States during the Targeted Observation by Radars and UAS of Supercells 2019 (TORUS_2019) field phase (15 May to 20 June 2019). Fifteen of the stations are available at 1-second vertical resolution (1128 soundings) and three stations are available at mandatory and significant level resolution (215 soundings).

dataset.title: AgriMet &quot;Specials&quot; Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Great Plains Region AgriMet data Network (AgriMet) "Specials" Surface Data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: ASOS Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) Hourly Surface data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: AWOS Data with QC, 20-Minute
dataset.description: 32 AWOS sites in the GCIP/GIST domain measured 20 min. averages of temperature, dewpoint, altimeter, visibility, wind speed/direction, barometric pressure, sky conditions, density altitude and precipitation. Winds averaged using 2-5 min running mean, cloud heights using a 30 min running mean. This data has undergone quality control.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Channel 4 - Channel 2 Difference Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Channel 4 - Channel 2 Difference Satellite imagery taken over the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project study area from 14 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: NCEP/CPC Hourly Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This dataset contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction/Climate Prediction Center (NCEP/CPC) Hourly Precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. This dataset was formed by extracting incremental precipitation values that fell on the hour. All raw precipitation data, including data that do not fall on the hour, can be found in the GCIP/EOP Surface: Precipitation NCEP/CPC Gage Only Hourly Dataset.

dataset.title: GOES-EAST Imager 13.3 Micron CH6 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Imager CH6 13.3 Micron Channel Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 15 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: Data for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) 2006 domain (25°N to 37°N latitude and 118°W to 114°W are contained within this dataset. The dataset covers the time period 1 March 2006 through 30 April 2006. This T-REX 2006 Sounding Composite Highest Resolution Upper-Air Dataset contains 1299 soundings from 13 platforms.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 866 quality controlled NWS (National Weather Service) soundings released at ten sites throughout the western Great Lakes region during the ICICLE (In-Cloud Icing and Large-Drop Experiment) field phase (26 January to 9 March 2019). Eight of the stations are available at 1-second vertical resolution (703 soundings) and two stations are available at mandatory and significant level resolution (163 soundings).

dataset.title: NWS Guam Radar Reflectivity Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains radar reflectivity imagery from the Guam NWS WSR-88D radar. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL and are in gif format.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R Leg6 AGGH-PHKO Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-11-05 17:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: FABLE 1999 NCAR/ATD Tennessee Site ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Walker Branch Watershead in Oak Ridge, Tennessee during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 1999. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 21:00:00.

dataset.title: National Weather Service (NWS) High Resolution Soundings
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC 2008). This data set includes 2590 high vertical resolution (6-second) MicroArt soundings from the eight National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the T-PARC region (Yap, WCI; Ponape, ECI; Koror, Palau WCI; Chuuk, ECI; Majuro, Marshall Island; Guam, Marianna Island; Hilo, HI; Lihue, HI). The data cover the period from 31 May 2008 to 31 October 2008. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC). The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: GOES-East 7 KM Atlantic Basin Water Vapor Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 minute satellite water vapor imagery from the GOES-12 satellite over the RAINEX area of interest.

dataset.title: NOAA Wind Profiler Network Hourly Winds (Merriman, NE)
dataset.description: This data set contains the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) 405 MHZ Wind Profiler Network (WPN) hourly data from the Merriman, NE site. Data are available for the periods from 5-19 and 22-25 April 1999. The profiler was not operational from 1200 UTC 19 April to 0200 UTC 22 April and from 2300 UTC 25 April to the end of the UMRBPP period of interest and no data are available during these time periods. This data consists of a series of hourly observations, each containing approximately 64 levels of wind speed and direction data. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NOAA N42 P-3 Dropsonde Skew-T plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains Skew-T plots of dropsondes from the NOAA N42 P-3. Images exists for hurricanes Ophelia on September 7, 9, 11, 12, 16, and 17, and Rita on September 22-23.

dataset.title: ABLE-2B: PAM-II Data
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from 4 PAM stations from the Amazon Boundary Layer Experiment (ABLE-2B). The data files are in common mesonet format.

dataset.title: Photography Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: The PACIFIC ATMOSPHERIC SULFUR EXPERIMENT is a comprehensive study of the chemistry of sulfur in the romote marine troposphere. Aircraft were based on Christmas Island in the Pacific Ocean from 3 August through 09 September 2007. The NSF/NCAR C-130 was used to carry the chemistry payload. This dataset consists of jpg images taken from a forward looking camera mounted on the C-130. The jpg images are compressed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies - Final
dataset.description: During PREDICT, the GV N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The aircraft flight track is plotted in the upper right quadrant with dropsonde locations shown in yellow. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer CL51 Data Products
dataset.description: Vaisala C51 ceilometer products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System group during Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. The CL51 instrument was operated at the North Pivot site. Two types of files are available: netCDF or raw DAT ascii files. The DAT files are orderable as a single tarred file.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite DMSP and HRPT Overpass Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains the satellite DMSP and HRPT overpass data. During the 2002 Spring and Summer Cruises of SBI all HRPT and DMSP overpasses of the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy were archived to tape. These files were collected with a Terascan receiving system aboard the Healy as it cruised the Bering and Chukchi Seas. These data are archived as pass files on 4mm DDS-3 tapes using the Terascan archive function. Please see the accompanying documentation files for the spring cruise and summer cruise for a complete catalog of overpasses on each tape.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:15:00 to 2011-07-14 22:16:00.

dataset.title: ISS Surface Meteorology Products
dataset.description: Surface meteorology products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Sundowner Wind Experiment field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. Data were collected at three sites: ISS1=Santa Barbara County Fire Department, ISS2=Rancho Alegre, and ISS3=Sedgwick Reserve. Final meteorology products are in netCDF format. PurpleAir aerosol data are in ascii format archived here as tar.gz files by site. Refer to the data report for details.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/ESOP-97 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the ESOP-97 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: GOES-East 7 KM Atlantic Basin Infrared Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-East 7 KM Atlantic Basin infrared thermal imagery at 30 minute intervals during the RAINEX field campaign.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V (HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the Winter Icing and Storms Project (WISP-04). These data are in DORADE format and are available as tar files.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - ICARTT format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ACCLIP project. The files contain low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in ICARTT format.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 MASP Statistical Cloud Pass Data (Baumgardner)
dataset.description: Multiangle Aerosol Spectrometer Probe (MASP) statistical cloud pass data collected by Baumgardner.

dataset.title: Mobile GPS Radiosonde Data from CSU
dataset.description: Colorado State University (CSU) operated a mobile radiosonde system during the Mesoscale Predictability Experiment (MPEX) during the period from 10 May to 14 June 2013. Soundings were taken intermittently as determined by the weather situation, with a focus on the pre-convective and convectively disturbed environments near deep convective storms in the central United States. Soundings were coordinated with releases from the mobile teams from Purdue University and the National Severe Storms Laboratory (NSSL). This data set includes a total of 55 quality controlled, high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings are contained in the final MPEX data set.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This data set includes flight-level airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Kuwait Oil-Fire Smoke Experiment (KOFSE).

dataset.title: US Precision Lightning Network (USPLN) Midwest Lightning Strike Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 minute maps of lightning strikes over the north central United States from the USPLN (United States Precision Lightning Network) operated by WSI. The imagery were developed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: 5-minute ISFS Surface Met and Flux from AABC site
dataset.description: These data contain surface meteorology measurements of the Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS), at the Alabama Aquatic Biodiversity Center (AABC), from 22 May through 16 July 2013. The ISFS five minute dataset contains first moments and some second moments of variables measured by the NCAR ISFS during the SOAS portion of the Southeast Atmosphere Study (SAS). The data are stored in NetCDF files.

dataset.title: NCAR Electra Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains aircraft data from the Kuwait Oil-Fire Smoke Experiment (KOFSE) from the NCAR Electra. Data were collected from 19 May 1991 to 04 June 1991 (14 flights). Data files are in GNU Zip format.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) 2011 project. This data set includes 60 high vertical resolution (1-second) Radiosonde Replacement System (RRS) soundings from National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations. This ICE-T data set includes data from 1 July 2011 through 31 July 2011 for the NWS station in San Juan, Puerto Rico. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC). The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) Dataset
dataset.description: The Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) Surface Dataset is one of several surface datasets provided for the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study October 1999 (CASES 1999) project. This ASOS dataset contains data from three stations within the CASES 1999 time period (25 September 1999 through 5 November 1999) and in the CASES 1999 domain (approximately 95.7438W to 97.7438W longitude and 36.6501N to 38.6501N latitude).

dataset.title: FP5 NCAR/EOL QC Radiosonde Skew-T Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains skew-T plots of quality-controlled radiosonde data from the PECAN field campaign. These data were collected at the fixed Integrated Souning System (ISS) site in Brewster, KS. This site was known as Fixed PECAN Integrated Sounding Array 5 (FP5) during the project. These plots were generated by a script based off of a plotting script developed by Russ Schumacher of Colorado State University.

dataset.title: Model MRF Surface analysis 0000 UTC Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains MRF model surface analysis 0000 UTC for the northern hemisphere including the SHEBA domain from IGES.

dataset.title: POES Antarctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Antarctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-03 12:00:00 to 2011-09-21 12:00:00.

dataset.title: METCRAXII ISS WXT Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: METCRAX-II was the second experiment studying the atmospheric boundary layer of the Arizona Meteor Crater. METCRAX-II investigated downslope-windstorm-type flows that develop when thermally-driven drainage flows cascade over the rim of the Arizona Meteor Crater on clear, undisturbed nights. These flows are ubiquitous in mountains throughout the world, but occur on a regular basis at this location and on scale that is uniquely amenable to observation with surface-based instrumentation. The goals of the project were to determine the characteristic atmospheric structure and evolution associated with these flows and the controlling parameters in the katabatic winds that drive them. The field observations will also be used to develop and validate LES models that can extend the findings to basins and ridges of different sizes and shapes. The data was collected between 03 October 2013 and 01 November 2013. This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) WXT sensor located on the crater rim during the METCRAX-II. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: ASTEX: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: The Atlantic Stratocumulus Transition Experiment (ASTEX) sounding data were collected from the Cross-chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) system. This data set contains "x" 10-second data, "i" data interpolated to 5mb, and "m" approximately 1-sec raw data and data flags collected during the sonde ascent.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Ambon Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 363 high vertical resolution soundings from Ambon, Indonesia (WMO 97724) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: R/V Vickers and Christmas Island Frostpoint/Ozone Soundings
dataset.description: This dataset contains the 10-sec high resolution Frostpoint and Ozone sounding data taken aboard the R/V Vickers and Christmas Island by NOAA/CMDL during CEPEX. This dataset includes pressure, altitude, temperature, potential temperature, relative humidity, frost point (from Vaisala and Hygrometer), ozone partial pressure, ozone mixing ratio, and water vapor mixing ratio.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Lake Effect Snow Storms - 1980 (LESS-80) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: PCAPS ISFS 1 second data
dataset.description: This dataset contains one second values for variables measured by the 7 NCAR ISFS stations during PCAPS. Variables that were recorded at rates faster than 1 Hz, namely u, v and spd from sonic anemometers, have been averaged to 1 second. Radiation and soil variables that were recorded at approximately 1/5 Hz will have missing values interspersed with measured values. The data was collected from November 10, 2010 to February 2, 2011.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Narssarssuaq (Greenland)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Narssarssuaq in Greenland (WMO 04270) which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight times per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Standard Sea Ice Observation Reports Healy Cruises HLY-07-01 and HLY-07-02
dataset.description: A link to the BEST Field Catalog for the HLY-07-01 and HLY-07-02 Cruise Ice Observations reports

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, NetCDF
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) radar data in netCDF format from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX). Due to the size of the dataset, it is recommended that the user restrict data orders to a few hours at a time per order (~1.5 GB per hour of data).

dataset.title: ASOS 5-Minute Data
dataset.description: 5-minute resolution surface meteorological observations from the Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) network of ~890 stations in the United States and select locations elsewhere. These data were collected by the National Centers for Environmental Information.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 Water Vapor (Channel 10) Data in AREA Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 km resolution Meteosat-7 Water Vapor (channel 10) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the McIDAS AREA file format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD MAF (Midland/Odessa, TX) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Midland/Odessa, TX. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Charleston (USA)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Charleston, South Carolina in the USA (WMO 72208) which was operated by the US National Weather Service. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to four times per day (also 06 and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 6 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 18:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler (AWAS) [Atlas (U. Miami)]
dataset.description: The HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler measured trace gases from whole air samples collected by NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-1. In addition to tracers, the AWAS measured a full suite of halocarbon species. This dataset contains AWAS data in NASA Ames format collected during HIPPO-1

dataset.title: NOAA P-3 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data - NetCDF Format
