dataset.description: The BAMEX Aircraft: NOAA P-3 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics dataset in network common data form (netCDF) is one of several datasets provided by the National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) in support of the Bow Echo and Mesoscale Convective Vortex Experiment (BAMEX) project. The data were collected by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Aircraft Operations Center (NOAA/AOC) P-3 aircraft and converted to netCDF format by NCAR/EOL. Only the final QC'd data (Type 5) and associated metadata have been converted. The raw (Type 4) data are not included in this dataset. See the README for details.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Constant Pressure Level Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Rawinsonde NWS Constant Pressure Plot imagery. Each day contains images for 500 MB, 700 MB, and 850 MB analysis at 00:00 and 12:00.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR G-V QC Dropsonde Data (EOL)
dataset.description: This data set contains dropsonde data collected by the NCAR Airborne Vertical Atmospheric Profiling System (AVAPS) on board the NSF/NCAR HIAPER G-V aircraft. A total of 17 quality-controlled soundings, collected during 4 missions, are contained in the final dropsonde data set. These data files are in NCAR CLASS format.

dataset.title: CLIVAR-KESS QC Radiosonde Dataset
dataset.description: The Climate Variability and Predictability (CLIVAR) Project is an international, multi-agency campaign aimed at understanding the physical processes responsible for climate variability and predictability. The Kuroshio Extension Sytem Study (KESS) is a subset of the CLIVAR program and is a collaborative effort between the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution, the University of Rhode Island, and the University of Hawaii. The purpose of KESS is to understand the processes that govern the variability of, and the interaction between the warm, northward-flowing waters that leave the Japanese coast to flow eastward into the North Pacific, also known as the Kuroshio Extension, and its recirculation gyre, the large oval current system to the south of the extension. For this study NCAR/EOL deployed a sounding system on a ship off of the coast of Japan, east of the Yokohama port. One hundred and forty-eight radiosonde launches were made from the ship's deck between May 29 and July 4, 2006. For more information in the CLIVAR project please visit: http://www.clivar.org/index.php or for additional information on KESS please visit: http://www.po.gso.uri.edu/dynamics/KESS/

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data in NetCDF format which were collected during the Prediction of Rainfall Extremes Campaign In the Pacific (PRECIP). Three MPDs were deployed to Taiwan for this field project.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) CONUS Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of TORUS_2019 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: MIT: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file from 15 PAM-II stations set at various locations on the NE US coast.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the SOCRATES project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler at Hokitika
dataset.description: 30 min and 5 min wind data collected by the NCAR/EOL 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler at Hokitika for the DEEPWAVE project.

dataset.title: WSR-88D Level 2 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains WSR-88D data collected during the BAMEX field project. The data comes from 7 sites.

dataset.title: ISFS 5-min Surface Meteorology and Flux Products.
dataset.description: 5 minute surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the Advection Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (AHATS). These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. NOTE: sonic anemometere winds are in instrument coordinates and have NOT been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: GOES-8 4-km VIS CONUS Sector Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible 4-km resolution continental US sector imagery during the SGP99 period in McIDAS AREA file format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Miscellaneous Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes miscellaneous microfilm from aircrafts during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Title, vessel(s), and phase(s) are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) CONUS Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of SAVANT operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Hokitika Quality Controlled ISS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) released special radiosondes from its Integrated Sounding System (ISS) site on the west coast of the South Island of New Zealand at Hokitika. During the DEEPWAVE field phase, soundings were released from Hokitika at 00 UTC every day and additional soundings were released at 3 hourly intervals during particular Intensive Observing Periods. This data set includes the quality controlled Hokitika soundings released for the DEEPWAVE field phase (25 May to 28 July 2014). A total of 145 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final DEEPWAVE data set.

dataset.title: Mexican Navy SEMAR R/V Altair Rawinsondes
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME). This data set includes vertical high resolution (2 second) rawindsonde data from the Secretaria de Armada de Mexico (SEMAR) Research Vessel (R/V) Altair. During NAME the R/V Altair was located near 23.5 N and 108.0 W for two cruises (7-22 July and 27 July to 12 August 2004). Soundings were typically released four times per day but there were more frequent releases during Intensive Observing Periods (IOPs). These data were provided by the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration/Environmental Technology Laboratory (NOAA/ESRL/PSD). NOTE: These data have been corrected as of 16 February 2010 for a significant dry bias. See the documentation file for details on the correction(s) applied to this data set. Also see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH.

dataset.title: GCIP/LSA-NW 99 Surface: Special Surface Observations Composite
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Great Plains Region Cooperative Agricultural Weather Network (AgriMet), Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS), National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Climatic Database (DATSAV3), Montana Department of Transportation (MDT of MTDOT) Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS), and Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) Roadway Weather Informational System (RWIS) "Special" observation surface data in QC format. Data for the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999 domain and time periods are contained within this dataset. The AgriMet, ASOS, DATSAV3, MTDOT_RWIS, and WYDOT_RWIS "Nominal" hourly surface data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP 1999 domain and time period are included in the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP 1999 Hourly Surface Composite. No additional QC was performed by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: GOES-10 4km Water Vapor (CH 3) Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 satellite imagery for the VOCALS study area and time of interest. The images are JPEGS.

dataset.title: Howard University High Resolution Soundings - Cape Verde
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Pre-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. This data set includes 20 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from Cape Verde taken by Howard University from 27 August through 15 September 2010.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) moments data collected during the MEOW (Make Everything Operate Well) project. During MEOW HCR was operated on the ground in the GV pod. It was located in the parking lot of the Foothills Lab 1 building of the NCAR campus in Boulder, Colorado, USA. The testing took place from May 10 to June 27, 2024 and consisted of 11 Intensive Operation Periods (IOPs).

dataset.title: 2000 STEPS Mobile Glass Sounding Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains the final sounding data sets from GLASS mobile1 and mobile2, collected during the Severe Thunderstorm Electrification and Precipitation Study (STEPS) in 2000. Data is available in two tar files, one each for mobile1 and mobile2

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 22:16:00 to 2011-06-07 22:16:00.

dataset.title: VTMX: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format (Morley, B. [NCAR/EOL])
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained from a ground based platform during the Vertical Transport and Mixing (VTMX) experiment.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 &amp; 5 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains legs 4 and 5 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 07:52:00 to 2009-02-01 19:22:00.

dataset.title: Montana&#39;s RWIS Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: Montana's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) Hourly Surface Data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Small Ice Detector Version 2 (SID-2H) [Rogers, NCAR/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SID2H data collected during the ICE-T project. The Small Ice Detector, Version 2 (SID2H) is a particle light-scattering instrument for measuring size distributions of particles in the 1 to 70 micrometer size range and for discriminating between ice crystals and supercooled water droplets in mixed phase clouds. SID2H measures the intensity of light scattered by cloud particles in the forward direction. Measurements are recorded for each particle that crosses the instrument's laser beam. The SID2H data files are binary and come in 10-minute blocks; a new file is created every 10 minutes. Data records include timing events, light scattering intensity, and housekeeping (temperatures, laser power, etc.). The file structure has a header, data, and a footer.

dataset.title: Synchronous Meteorological Satellite
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm and 16 mm film of satellite footage for Inter Phases as well as Phases I, II, and III. Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 micrometers. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the ARISTO2016 project. These data have been converted to a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the FORMATION project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NCAR OTIHS (hot film) Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains data collected during the T-REX experiment from an outdoor, three-dimensional, in-situ calibrated hot-film anemometry system (OTIHS). The system was deployed for EOP-2, 3, 4 and 5 (which occurred on 30 Mar, 19 Apr, 28 Apr, 29 Apr, and 30 Apr) at the ISFF Central site: on a 5 m tower adjacent to a 30 m tower. There were three systems at 1.4 m, 2.0 m, and 3.0 m above ground and above brush of 0.8m average height. Each OTIHS was embedded within a Campbell CSAT3 sonic anemometer operated at 60Hz providing u, v, w, and Tc (here in 1 second averages).

dataset.title: ISFS 5-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the Crop/Wind-energy Experiment (CWEX). These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: R/V Le Suroit 915MHz Wind Profiler Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) aboard the French ship R/V Le Suroit during the Fronts and Atlantic Storm Track Experiment that took place in 1997. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data with two range-gate extents (wHHMMa.JD files are 98 meter range-gate, while wHHMMb.JD files are 56 meter range-gateHH is hour, MM is minute, JD is Julian day). These data are in ASCII format and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Lisbon (Portugal)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Lisbon in Portugal (WMO 08579) which was operated by the INMG. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Sea_Salinity project. This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT,1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: GOES-8 WV Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (6.7 micron) satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1996 (ESOP-96) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 8 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 Water Vapor (Channel 10) Raw Uncalibrated Data in NetCDF Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 km resolution Meteosat-7 Water Vapor (channel 10) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the NetCDF file format. These data are the raw uncalibrated units and are provided if you would like to generate your own calibration versus that in the provided calibrated data set.

dataset.title: NCAR Ceilometer Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains Ceilometer data taken during the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). It contains ceilometer data taken from Feb 21, 2006 to May 1st, 2006. The ceilometer was located at the MAPR site. The data is in ascii format.

dataset.title: NCAR ISS GAUS (MAPR Site) Rawinsonde Data (EOL Format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The Terrain Induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) was conducted during March and April 2006, during which time 102 radiosondes were launched using a fix sounding system located near Independence, California. TREX is the second phase of a coordinated effort to explore the structure and evolution of atmospheric rotors, which typically occur parallel to, and downstream from, mountain ridge crests. The first phase was a project conducted in 2004 called the Sierra Rotors Project. Both phases included downwind radiosonde launches, from the California Central Valley, used to help predict the onset of events likely to produce rotors on the lee side of the Sierra Nevada Mountain Range. Soundings were also launched in the Owens Valley from an Integrated Sounding System (ISS).

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol radar data taken during the Severe Thunderstorm Electrification and Precipitation Study (STEPS). The data is available in cfRadial format as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR GV-HSRL lidar data
dataset.description: High Spectral Resolution LIDAR (HSRL) data collected aboard the HIAPER NSF/NCAR GV aircraft during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive Halogen Species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) field project from 19 January 2012 to 26 February 2012. The data are available in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Winds, Moments, and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 449 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the METCRAX-II field campaign. This dataset includes doppler moments data (mom.nc), 5 and 30 minute consensus winds data (.winds.*.nc), Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rass.nc), and an intermediate product generated every 15 minutes from which the previous winds and moments are generated (*.mapr.nc). The winds and moments, RASS, and mapr.nc data are each bundled into daily tar files. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: METCRAX 5 minute ISFS data, QC&#39;d, geographic and tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute ISFS data from the Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX), from 24 September 2006 to 4 November 2006. These data are in NetCDF format, have been tilt corrected, and are in geographic coordinates. More information about the data source and processing can be found at the Project Documentation webpage in the related links. The Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Queimadas '80 (Q80) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Shelf MIxed Layer Experiment (SMILE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:45:00.

dataset.title: CAMP: Chao Phraya River Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Moonsoon Project (CAMP) Chao Phraya River 60 minute Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data. This dataset contains data from 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Kupang Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 349 high vertical resolution soundings from Kupang, Indonesia (WMO 97372) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Pre-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) 2010 project. This data set includes 841 high vertical resolution (1-second) Radiosonde Replacement System (RRS) soundings from National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations. For PREDICT this data set includes data from 1 August 2010 through 30 September 2010 for six (6) NWS stations (Key West, FL, Miami, FL, Tampa Bay, FL, Brownsville, TX, Corpus Christi, TX, and San Juan, Puerto Rico). At the request of GRIP investigators this data set also includes data from 1 September 2010 through 5 September 2010 for seven (7) stations along the east coast of the United States (Jacksonville, FL, Charleston, SC, Newport, NC, Sterling, VA, Upton, NY, Chatham, MA, and Gray, ME) for Hurricane Earl. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC) and any special releases are also included. The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: PAM/ASTER 5-Minute Surface Flux Data
dataset.description: Surface flux data collected by NCAR/EOL (formerly ATD) during the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study 1997 (CASES-97) project from 22 April to 22 May 1997. These data are in netCDF format at 5 minute resolution.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During HIPPO-1, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NEXRAD FSD (Sioux Falls, SD) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes reflectivity and velocity imagery from the NEXRAD radar at Sioux Falls, SD, from the VORTEX2 field catalog for 2009 and 2010. The files are gif images. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale sectors during the period of VORTEX-SE Meso18-19 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The actual sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the VORTEX-SE region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Low Turbulence Inlet (LTI) Test. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the PRocessing of Emissions by Clouds and Precipitation-V (PRECP-V) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL MAPR Wind Profiler Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Inhibition of Snowfall by Pollution Aerosols in 2007 (ISPA-2007). This dataset includes 5 minute and 30 minute consensus winds data (*.winds_05.nc and *.winds_30.nc), and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (*.rass.nc) organized into daily tar files.

dataset.title: GOES-8 WV Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (6.7 micron) satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1995 (ESOP-95) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 8 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes, and should not be used for detailed scientific analyses.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II high-rate ISFS data, tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains high rate, 5 second, ISFS data collected from 27 September to 2 November 2013 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in NetCDF format, and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscater Lidar (SABL) - Field Dorade format [Morley, B. (NCAR/EOL)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Gulf Of Tehuantepec Experiment (GOTEX), Coupled Development of Ocean Waves and Boundary Layers (aka OceanWaves) project. The data are in DORADE format.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Biak Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 347 high vertical resolution soundings from Biak, Indonesia (WMO 97560) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the Mountain Airflow (MAF) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-7 Infrared Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: Various geostationary satellite imagery was collected during the CEPEX period. These images contain composites of the imagery, converted to GIF image format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS MISS Surface Meteorology Products
dataset.description: Surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS) during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3). These data are available in tarred, daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: ISS MAPR Surface Meteorology Data Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located in the Owens Valley, 5 miles south of Independence, CA during the Sierra Rotors Project in 2004 (SRP2004). These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the WINTER project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Mobile CLASS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains rawinsonde profiles collected during the International H20 Project (IHOP 2002) from May 13th to June 25th, 2002 . Rawinsondes were released from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration National Severe Storms Lab (NOAA/NSSL) Mobile Class system. The data set underwent University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office of Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) quality control procedures. This dataset was reprocessed in May 2003 to correct near surface boundary temperatures. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: US-C130 Radar Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft radar from US-C130 data during Phases I, II, and III. Phase is specified in the "Description" section on the order page. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During HIPPO-4, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: CAMP: Northeast Thailand Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Periods 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and 4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Northeast Thailand Hourly Soil Data Set. This dataset contains all of the EOP-3 and EOP-4 time periods (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II 30 second ISFS data, tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 second ISFS data collected from 27 September to 2 November 2013 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in NetCDF format. This is the "final" release of the 30 second, tilt corrected ISFS dataset.

dataset.title: WISP90: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from 19 PAM stations near Laramie, Wyoming.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Summer MONEX project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NCEP/CPC Hourly Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This dataset contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction/Climate Prediction Center (NCEP/CPC) Hourly Precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. This dataset was formed by extracting incremental precipitation values that fell on the hour. All raw precipitation data, including data that do not fall on the hour, can be found in the GCIP/EOP Surface: Precipitation NCEP/CPC Gage Only Hourly Dataset.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/EAOP-98 6 second NWS soundings data set contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART sounding systems at fourteen sites over the GCIP LSA-East region. The data set contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality controlled, with every sounding subject to automated consistency checks. No visual examination was conducted on these soundings. Refer to the README file for more details.

dataset.title: USCGC Healy Cruise HLY-02-01 NCAR EOL Service Data
dataset.description: This CD ROM was created 14 June 2002 at the end of the SBI Spring Cruise aboard the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy. It contains data in the state they were in as of the end of the cruise. At that time, the Conductivity Temperature Depth (CTD) and bottle data were thought to be in their final form (although the bottle data was updated after this date. Please see the archive for the latest version of this data.). The state (preliminary or final) of all other datasets on this CD were unknown at that time. This CD contains the following types of information: Acoustic Doppler Current Profiler (ADCP), ice observations, expendable conductivity, temperature, depth (XCTD), station documentation and CTD / bottle data, preliminary hydrographic plots, digital photos taken by various project participants aboard the ship including shots of wildlife seen during the cruise.

dataset.title: GCIP/LSA-NW 00 Surface: Special Surface Observations Composite
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS), Unidata Local Data Manager (LDM) World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Surface METAR (LDMSFCMETR), Montana Department of Transportation (MDT of MTDOT) Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS), and Wyoming Department of Transportation (WYDOT) Roadway Weather Informational System (RWIS) "Special" observation surface data in QC format. Data for the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000 domain and time periods are contained within this dataset. The ASOS, LDMSFCMETR, MTDOT_RWIS, and WYDOT_RWIS "Nominal" hourly surface data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP 2000 domain and time period are included in the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP 2000 Hourly Surface Composite. No additional QC was performed by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: BOREAS-91: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from two PAM-II stations located in Manitoba and Saskatchewan, CA. The stations were significantly modified to work in the cold climate.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:30:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Fires in Brazil (FIB) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT-FSSP Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Hawiian Rainband Experiment (HaRP). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Imager Channels 2-5 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Imager Channels 2-5 data collected from the GOES-10 satellite during the VOCALS project. The files are in netCDF format and cover the time period from September 30, 2008 to December 08, 2008.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Hilo
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Hilo, Hawaii during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde
dataset.description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) and does occasional special releases at other times of day (usually 18 UTC) from sites across the Pacific Ocean. This dataset includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released from 8 stations located within the CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics (CONTRAST) domain for the field phase (1 January to 28 February 2014). A total of 926 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final CONTRAST dataset.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Surabaya Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 365 high vertical resolution soundings from Surabaya, Indonesia (WMO 96935) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well as a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 Visible (Channel 1) Calibrated Data in NetCDF Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 2.5 km resolution Meteosat-7 visible (channel 1) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the NetCDF file format. These data are the calibrated brightness values.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 High Rate (25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Eastern Pacific Investigation of Climate" project which took place from 1 September 2001 to 15 October 2001. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps, mixed) production data set. The HRT Bitfile log lists times and dates of individual flights.

dataset.title: Beaumont 10-second CLASS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: CLASS radiosonde profiles taken at Beaumont, Kansas for the CASES-97 program. The site was operated by NCAR/Earth Observing Laboratory (formerly Atmospheric Technology Division). These soundings have been interpolated to 10 second vertical intervals. The quality control information is that provided by NCAR/EOL. UCAR/JOSS has not altered these soundings in any way. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the readme file for details.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Winds and Meteorological Imagery
dataset.description: ISS surface winds and meteorological imagery produced during the DC3 project. The imagery are in PNG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-03 00:00:00 to 2012-06-29 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) during the GRAVE-I project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Convection Waves project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: ESCAPE Chat Logs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the ESCAPE (Experiment of Sea Breeze Convection, Aerosols, Precipitation, and Environment) field project, collected from 31 May to 17 June 2022 onboard the NRC (National Research Council of Canada) Convair 580. These data are available in a CSV format.

dataset.title: R/V Roger Revelle ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected between 29 August 2011 and 12 February 2012 by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located on the R/V Revelle during the DYNAMO campaign. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar and GV-HSRL lidar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) and High Spectral Resolution Lidar (HSRL) moments data collected during the SOCRATES (Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study) project from 15 January 2018 to 24 February 2018. The data have a 2Hz time and 19m range resolution and are available in CfRadial format. This data set contains only the HCR and HSRL variables considered most useful for the general scientific user. Note that data is only provided when the two instruments were pointing roughly in the same direction. Data sets containing more variables and higher resolution data are available at the links provided in the "Related links" section below.

dataset.title: PECAN Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) study from 22 May 2015 - 16 July 2015. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the PECAN project. Included are the discussions from the NASA DC-8, University of Wyoming King Air, and NOAA P-3 aircraft channels as well as the mobile radar and radiosonde channels.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S-band, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-PolKa data from the Rain in Cumulus Over the Ocean (RICO) project . This data set contains data when only S-band data were collected. These data are in cfRadial format and are available as hourly tar files. This is a companion data set with S-band/Ka-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) Data cfRadial Format [NCAR/EOL] which contains the data when both S-band and Ka-band were collected.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT (1-sps) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the VAMOS Ocean Cloud Atmosphere Land Study (VOCALS). This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) Flight Level production data merged with the CVI, DMS, O3, PMS-2D, SO2, and TSURF data. Final CO data were added Oct, 2011.

dataset.title: Pan-Arctic Land Surface (PALS) model drivers and outputs
dataset.description: This data set includes forcing data and output fields for multimodel simulations of pan-Arctic hydrology. All models were forced with European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF) 40 Year Re-analysis (ERA-40) data for the period 1979-2002. The forcing fields comprise precipitation, 2-m air temperature, incoming solar and longwave radiation at the surface, 10-m winds and specific humidity at the lowest model level, the latter calculated from dewpoint, temperature and pressure. These are available every 6 h on a grid with an approximate 125 km spacing (the so-called N80 reduced Gaussian grid). Precipitation and radiation fluxes are provided as 6-h accumulations from 6-hr forecasts. Temperature, 10-m winds, pressure and dewpoint represent instantaneous values at the 6-h analysis time. The ERA-40 data on the N-80 grid were interpolated to the 100 km Equal-Area Scalable Earth grid (EASE grid) array.

dataset.title: ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: Webcam photos collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Sundowner Wind Experiment field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. Data were collected at three sites: (1) Santa Barbara County Fire Department, (2) Rancho Alegre, and (3) Sedgwick Reserve. All photos are compressed into weekly or monthly tar.gz files gathered by site and camera type to keep the file size manageable. Refer to the data report for details.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Availability) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the SO2 Oxidant (SO2OX) Availability Test Program. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MP4 NCAR/EOL MISS 915 MHz Profiler 30 Minute Consensus Winds and Moments and Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 minute NIMA consensus wind and moments data measured by the NCAR/EOL 915 MHz profiler located on the PECAN Mobile PISA 4 (MP4) NCAR/EOL MISS that moved throughout the central United States. These data are in netcdf format. This dataset also includes 30 second surface meteorology observations from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Vaisala WXT 520 weather sensor that was also located on MP4. These surface data have not been quality controlled and are provided in daily tar files.

dataset.title: UIUC Supplemental Sounding Data and Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains sounding data and images collected by University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 26 January - 8 March 2019. Data were collected with the Intermet iMet-4 Radiosonde. See the iMet-4 data sheet for instrument accuracies/uncertainties. Also contains skewT/LogP images for quick reference.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Bridger Range Study (BRS) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: BAJA: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This Data set is a single tar file of data from 6 PAM stations located in Baja, Mexico

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale sectors during the period of RELAMPAGO operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The actual sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the RELAMPAGO region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR 100-hz Mixing Ratio Lyman-Alpha (MRLA) - netCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes data obtained from the CIRPAS Twin Otter aircraft during the "Physics of Stratocumulus Tops"(POST) project off the coast of Monterey, CA. This data set contains 100-Hz Mixing Ratio Lyman-Alpha data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 1KM Imager Data (netCDF)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of satellite GOES-11 gzipped 30 minute netCDF files from the period of the PASE (Pacific Atmospheric Sulfur Experiment) from Christmas Island.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Imager 1 km Channel 1 (Visible) Data - netCDF
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1-km visible channel GOES-13 satellite data over the central United States during the PECAN project. During PECAN GOES-13 was stationed at 75W. These data are in netCDF format and in daily tar files. These data were generated by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During OTREC, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR 100-hz Mixing Ratio Lyman-Alpha (MRLA) Data in ASCII format
dataset.description: This data set includes data obtained from the CIRPAS Twin Otter aircraft during the "Physics of Stratocumulus Tops"(POST) project off the coast of Monterey, CA. This data set contains 100-Hz Mixing Ratio Lyman-Alpha data in ASCII format.

dataset.title: GOES-16 GLM LCFA Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of VORTEX-SE 2018 operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: Standard Sea Ice Observation Reports Healy Cruises HLY-08-01 and HLY-08-02
dataset.description: A link to the BEST Field Catalog for the HLY-08-01 and HLY-08-02 Cruise Ice Observations reports

dataset.title: CP4 Doppler RADAR cfradial format data
dataset.description: This data set from the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE) 1986 contains cfradial format data from the NCAR CP4 Doppler radar.

dataset.title: ACE-1: Cape Grim ISS Final High Vertical Resolution Balloon Data
dataset.description: Data from the NCAR/Integrated Sounding System (ISS) upper air data collected at Cape Grim during the ACE-1 operation, via the NCAR/Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD). Data consist of 10-sec vertical resolution data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily with up to 6-hr frequency during intensive operations.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, AVHRR Channel 2 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12, 14, 15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 2 Imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: MICROFRONTS Nowrad Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains images of a sector of the WSI Nowrad composite for the 1995 MICROFRONTS period. The sector was generally centered over the MICROFRONTS domain, but was occasionally moved. These data are provided for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset includes sounding data from dropsonde releases during the IOP from the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) P-3 and the National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) DC-8 aircraft. Dropsonde releases were conducted during events of opportunity. Data were processed only through the automated and visual quality control processes. No spatial quality control was performed on this dataset. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Macquarie Island
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken on Macquarie Island during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-09 23:00:00 to 2011-07-13 11:00:00.

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Greenville, Michigan
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data for Greenville, Michigan. This site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). This data set has undergone ATD and The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of rawinsonde release times for Greenville.

dataset.title: GTS Mandatory/Significant Level Sounding 2016 Hurricane Matthew Data (EOL Format)
dataset.description: National weather agencies around the world routinely release radiosondes at 00 and/or 12 UTC with occasional special releases. This data set includes the quality controlled Global Telecommunication System (GTS) soundings released at sites near tropical cyclones of interest to the Tropical Cyclone Intensity (TCI) field project. For the 2016 season, this included soundings from 28 September to 9 October 2016 from Bermuda, Wallops Island, Cape Canaveral, Nassau, Kingston, Grand Cayman, Saint Maarten, and Guadeloupe. A total of 183 quality-controlled, mandatory and significant level resolution soundings are contained in the final TCI 2016 Hurricane Matthew data set.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Global Atmospheric Measurements Experiment on Tropospheric Aerosols and Gases (GAMETAG) project.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Channel 4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: CAMP: Chao Phraya River Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Chao Phraya River Hourly Meteorological Tower Data Set. This dataset contains data from 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Central Equatorial Pacific Experiment (CEPEX) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Small Ice Detector Version 2 (SID-2H) [Rogers, NCAR/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SID2H data collected during the PREDICT project. The Small Ice Detector, Version 2 (SID2H) is a particle light-scattering instrument for measuring size distributions of particles in the 1 to 70 micrometer size range and for discriminating between ice crystals and supercooled water droplets in mixed phase clouds. SID2H measures the intensity of light scattered by cloud particles in the forward direction. Measurements are recorded for each particle that crosses the instrument's laser beam. The SID2H data files are binary and come in 10-minute blocks; a new file is created every 10 minutes. Data records include timing events, light scattering intensity, and housekeeping (temperatures, laser power, etc.). The file structure has a header, data, and a footer.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NOAA N43 P-3 Dropsonde Skew-T plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains Skew-T plots of dropsondes from the NOAA N43 P-3. Images exist for hurricanes Katrina on August 25, 27-30, Ophelia on September 7-9, and 11, and Rita on September 19-23.

dataset.title: VORTEX-95 GOES-8 2-km Vis Imagery (GIF)
dataset.description: Digital GOES-8 2-km visible imagery for selected case days during VORTEX-95. These data are in GIF format for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ECLIPSE project. Files contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II 5 minute ISFS data, tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute ISFS data collected from 27 September to 2 November 2013 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in NetCDF format, and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: METCRAX QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX) is a 3-year meteorological research program whose purpose is to investigate the structure and evolution of temperature inversions or cold-air pools that form on a daily basis in topographic basins and valleys. For this study NCAR/EOL deployed one Integrated Sounding System (ISS) approximately 35 miles East of Flagstaff AZ and 3 miles North East of an impact crater known as Meteor Crater. EOL also set up four surface towers in the base of the crater. For more information on these towers please visit, http://www.eol.ucar.edu/rtf/projects/metcrax/isff/. Forty-nine radiosonde launches were performed from the ISS site between October 7 and October 31, 2006. For more information on the METCRAX project please visit: http://www.met.utah.edu/whiteman/METCRAX/

dataset.title: GOES-13 4 km Channel 4 Thermal Infrared Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains jpg images from the GOES-13 4km Channel 4 Thermal Infrared satellite, taken during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, AVHRR Channel 5 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12,14,15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 5 imagery. Observations are from the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .gif format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Irish Bend)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Irish Bend, OR (ISS2) site during the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment II (IMPROVE-II). These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: MRMS 3DRhoHV Products
dataset.description: MRMS 3DRhoHV Products collected during the Winter Precipitation Type Research Multi-scale Experiment (WINTRE-MIX) time and area of interest are included in this dataset. The data are in GRIB2 format. This is a large dataset. Please order only the time period that is required.

dataset.title: NEXRAD National Composite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD National Reflectivity Composite Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. The files are in .gif format. For 2010 there is radar images for National 0.5 degree Reflectivity Mosaic (N0R) and National Max Column Reflectivity Mosaic (NCR). For each type of radar there are composite, east, and west images. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 micrometers. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the ICE-T project. These data have been converted to a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: High Rate Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files)
dataset.description: Keyhole Markup Language (KML) is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR C-130 flight track during the Front Range Air Pollution and Photochemistry Experiment (FRAPPE) project.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5mb Vertical Resolution Radiosonde Composite
dataset.description: Five millibar (5mb) resolution radiosonde data from research and operational sources during the Winter Precipitation Type Research Multi-scale Experiment (WINTRE-MIX) campaign converted into a common format (EOL Sounding Composite format which is a columnar ASCII format) are included in this composte. The composite includes data from radiosondes from locations around Quebec, Canada and the northeastern United States. The radiosondes were released by the University at Albany (three sites), University of Colorado Boulder (four sites), Université du Québec à Montréal (three sites), McGill University (three sites), and the National Weather Service (four sites).

dataset.title: Lake-ICE surface: NCAR/EOL Sheboygen ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Sheboygen, WI (ISS2) during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (LAKE-ICE), which occurred simultaneously with the SNOWBAND project. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located on Diego Garcia during the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) field campaign. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 4 Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES-8 imagery from the SALLJEX field project time of interest and area of interest. Images include channel 4 infrared imaging over Argentina. SALLJEX was funded by NOAA/OGP, NSF(ATM0106776) and funding agencies from Brazil FAPESP Grant 01/13816-1) and Argentina (ANPCYT PICT 07-06671, UBACyT 055).

dataset.title: NCAR HCR uncorrected radar moments data, 100 Hz
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar 100Hz, field version data collected during the HCR-Test experiment from 14 November 2014 to 1 December 2014. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as ten minute tar files. Note: This dataset is not quality controlled. Please contact us before using this dataset.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Tropospheric Ozone Production about the Spring Equinox) TOPSE project. This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data - 1 Hz
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the "HEFT Experimental Flight Test 2008" (HEFT08) project. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) production data. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/NESOB-97 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the NESOB-97 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR C-130 Aircraft during WE-CAN. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: TCI Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Tropical Cyclone Intensity (TCI) project from 24 June 2015 - 23 October 2015. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the TCI project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (King Air) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the Convective Waves over Ocean (Wave) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: CINDE: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: Sounding data from the Convection Initiation and Downburst Experiment (CINDE), conducted in the Denver, Colorado area were from a Cross-chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the CODE-I project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4km Channel 6 (12-micron Infrared) Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-12 4km resolution 12 micron IR (Channel 6) satellite imagery over the PLOWS region. The routine 15-minute imagery as well as any rapid scan imagery are included. The images were created by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 12 January to 31 March 2009 and 1 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S-band, 9 variables, DORADE
dataset.description: S-band S-PolKa moments data. This data set is limited to 9 S-Pol variables, and does not include any of the Ka-band data. Parameters available are: DBZ, DM, DX, LDR, NCP, PHIDP, SW, VR and ZDR. The data set incorporates two substantial changes to the original data set: a 1.4 dB adjustment to S-band DBZ, and a .35 dB adjustment to S-band Zdr.

dataset.title: NOAA N43 P-3 Flight Level Data - NetCDF format
dataset.description: This dataset contains the NOAA P-3 State and Navigation parameters from missions flown during RAINEX. These are the AOC derived (Type 5) data converted to NetCDF by NCAR/EOL. The binary (.std Standard Tape Format) form of this data can be ordered below.

dataset.title: COAGMET Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Colorado Agricultural Meteorological Network (COAGMET) Hourly Surface Data in QC Format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Sadorus)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Sadorus site in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1996. These data are in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER CIMS HCl and HNO4 In Situ Measurements
dataset.description: This data set contains NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER In Situ Measurements by the Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (CIMS) of hydrogen chloride (HCI) and peroxynitric acid (HNO4) collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 14 May 2012 through 30 June 2012. This data set contains both second and 20-second data collected by the CIMS. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: METCRAXII ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: METCRAX-II was the second experiment studying the atmospheric boundary layer of the Arizona Meteor Crater. METCRAX-II investigated downslope-windstorm-type flows that develop when thermally-driven drainage flows cascade over the rim of the Arizona Meteor Crater on clear, undisturbed nights. These flows are ubiquitous in mountains throughout the world, but occur on a regular basis at this location and on scale that is uniquely amenable to observation with surface-based instrumentation. The goals of the project were to determine the characteristic atmospheric structure and evolution associated with these flows and the controlling parameters in the katabatic winds that drive them. The field observations will also be used to develop and validate LES models that can extend the findings to basins and ridges of different sizes and shapes. This project took place between 27 September 2013 and 01 November 2013. This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during METCRAX-II. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia ISS 915MHz Profiler Wind and Moment Data
dataset.description: This data set contains wind profile and moments data every 30 minutes from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) 915 MHz profiler station that was located on Diego Garcia for the DYNAMO project. These data were collected and processed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, A-80 aircraft (Tail Number N304D) during the First COastal Dynamics Experiment (CODE I) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: ACE-ASIA Aircraft: C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the ACE-Asia project. This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw CPI ROI Imagery [Reeves (NCAR-RAF)]
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 µm. This dataset contains CPI roi images collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NCAR GV (HIAPER) during the IDEAS-4 GV project. For all of the flights, the CPI makes as many *.roi files as it needs; each file can be maximum 92Mb size and then a new file is opened.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/ESOP-98 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the ESOP-98 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: ISS Ceilometer CL51 Data Products
dataset.description: Vaisala C51 ceilometer data products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System group during the Sundowner Wind EXperiment (SWEX) field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. The instrument was mounted on the ISS2 trailer located at the Rancho Alegre site. Data are available in raw ASCII DAT format and in netCDF format. DAT files are ordered as a single compressed tar.gz file. netCDf files were created by the Vaisala BLView software. Preview plots are available.

dataset.title: NCAR GAUS Rawinsonde SkewT Plots [EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains NCAR GAUS Rawinsonde SkewT plots for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project taken daily at Spanish Point from from December 8th, 2004 through February 2nd, 2005.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4km Channel 2 (Near-Infrared) Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-12 4km resolution near-IR (Channel 2) satellite imagery over the PLOWS region. The routine 15-minute imagery as well as any rapid scan imagery are included. The images were created by NCAR/EOL.
