This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 21 January to 31 March 2009 and 1 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ADELE/SPRITE/HEFT09, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Flight RF02, 3, 5, and 9 were night flights, so all images were dark. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCEP ETA Model 500mb Initial Analysis Maps
dataset.description: NCEP ETA model 500mb initial analysis map images for the GAPP period.

dataset.title: ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: Webcam imagery provided every minute from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Web Camera. These data are in daily tarred files and were collected and processed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the International H2O Project (IHOP_2002). These data are in cfRadial format and are available as 3 hour tar files.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR C-130 during AIRS-II. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available.

dataset.title: METCRAX ISS SODAR Data
dataset.description: The Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX) is a 3-year meteorological research program supported by the Mesoscale Dynamics Division of the U. S. National Science Foundation (NSF). The program is investigating the structure and evolution of temperature inversions or cold-air pools that form on a daily basis in topographic basins and valleys. As part of this research a one-month-long field experiment was conducted from 01 October 2006 to 30 October 2006 in Arizona's Meteor Crater, a simple near-ideal topographic basin formed by the impact of a meteor. In this basin, the physical processes leading to the buildup and breakdown of temperature inversions and the formation of atmospheric seiches (atmospheric oscillations in the basin caused by wind disturbances at the basin crest) can be studied without the complications introduced by more complex topography. This dataset comtains Sound Detection and Ranging (SODAR) data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the METCRAX campaign and is available in raw ASCII format. These data have not been quality-controlled.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL R/V Investigator 915 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Products
dataset.description: Quality-controlled 915 MHz profiler winds and vertical beam moments data operated by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) for the SOCRATES / CAPRICORN field campaign. ISS operated a radar wind profiler on board the CSIRO RV Investigator. The primary voyage (CSIRO designation: IN2018_V01) for this deployment set sail from Hobart, TAS, Australia on 11 Jan 2018 into the Southern Ocean and concluded back in Hobart on 22 Feb 2018. A shakedown, test and training cruise (IN2017_E04) took place off the east coast of Tasmania Dec 7 - 11, 2017. The LapXM moment data were processed by EOL software (IDL lapxm_ship_prelim.pro) to generate wind estimates corrected for ship motion, course and heading, partly based on the methods of Johnston (2014). These data were then quality-controlled through the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA). Some gaps in the NIMA-processed data have been filled in with the original LapXM-processed data. This dataset currently includes a Preliminary Data Report that does not reference the NIMA quality-control.

dataset.title: NCAR ISFF Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of quality controlled data collected during the T-REX field project. These 5-minute average statistics have been derived from the TREX/ISFF merged dataset, in which the locally-stored data from the 3 stations has been merged to fill in gaps in the data that were collected through the wireless network. The Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: PHOENIX84: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the PHOENIX 1984 experiment.

dataset.title: NDARB Daily Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: The North Dakota Atmospheric Resource Board (NDARB) daily precipitation data in QC format is one of several precipitation datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. Data from this source was quality controlled, please see the README for additional information. This dataset contains the available data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period (01 April 2000 through 31 March 2001). The GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain is approximately 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude.

dataset.title: NCAR ADi-HSRL data
dataset.description: ADi-HSRL starting in May 2025. The instrument is deployed in several locations. It is an engineering dataset which contains a mix of testing and field campaign data and should only be used in collaboration with the NCAR lidar group for scientific analysis. The data is organized in separate daily tar files and can be ordered.

dataset.title: Quality Controlled Radiosonde Data (EOL/ISF)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 112 quality controlled radiosonde soundings collected from November 14, 2010 through February 5, 2011 during the Persistent Cold-Air Pool Study (PCAPS). PCAPS took place between December 1, 2010 and February 7, 2011 in Salt Lake City, Utah.

dataset.title: CAMP: Korean Haenam Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Korean Haenam Half-Hourly Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This dataset only contains the entire EOP-3 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 30 September 2003). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NCAR ISS GAUS (MAPR Site) Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: The Terrain Induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) was conducted during March and April 2006, during which time 102 radiosondes were launched using a fix sounding system located near Independence, California. T-REX is the second phase of a coordinated effort to explore the structure and evolution of atmospheric rotors, which typically occur parallel to, and downstream from, mountain ridge crests. The first phase was a project conducted in 2004 called the Sierra Rotors Project. Both phases included upwind radiosonde launches, from the California Central Valley, used to help predict the onset of events likely to produce rotors on the lee side of the Sierra Nevada Mountain Range. Soundings were also launched in the Owens Valley from an Integrated Sounding System (ISS).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the ROSE-Air project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TI3GER, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NRC Convair-580 Aircraft Data, Flight Tracks and Flight Notes
dataset.description: This dataset includes the National Research Council of Canada's (NRC) Convair-580 research aircraft Data, flight tracks and flight notes for the Storm Studies in the Arctic (STAR) project. This aircraft was used to collect internal storm measurements of cloud microphyusics, thermodynamics, wind and the 4-D dynamic and precipitation structures of storms within a 500 km radius of Iqaluit from November 5-30, 2007. The aircraft enabled STAR to probe storm events as they approached the area, during their passage and departure over the study area. The aircraft also provided the only sensor validation flights for CloudSat overpasses in the Arctic. The aircraft was equipped with meteorological instruments that measured temperature, humidity, 3-Dimensional wind fields, cloud and microphysics (liquid water probes, icing probes, dropsondes), Ka band upward/downward looking radar and a dual wavelength (W and X-band) polarimetric up/down/sideways Doppler radar. The NRC aircraft flew approximately 48 hours during the project. This time was divided over 14 missions, with variable objectives. The first flight was into the remnants of Hurricane Noel, which was the most severe hurricane of 2007 in terms of casualties (> 150) (NOAA, 2007). While in contrast, the final flight had a very local focus, sampling the cloud system directly over Iqaluit for remote sensing validation purposes. Additional flights took the research aircraft into Foxe Basin, Hudson Strait, Ungava Bay, Davis Strait, Cumberland Sound Peninsula and locally in Frobisher Bay. During these missions, a total of 55 dropsondes were deployed.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Channel 3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-12 Channel 3 water vapor satellite imagery from the time period of the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project. From 13 January to 16 February 2012, the imagery covers Antofagasta, Chile, where the NSF/NCAR GV was forward deployed, and the imagery from 17 February to 1 April 2012 centers on the Galapagos Islands, and the GV was based in San Jose, Costa Rica.

dataset.title: CP3 Doppler RADAR cfradial format data
dataset.description: This data set from the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE) 1986 contains cfradial format data from the NCAR CP3 Doppler radar.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Berlinor Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Berlinor data from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During OTREC, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II 30 minute ISFS surface fluxes
dataset.description: These are 30 minute flux files for METCRAXII. They are week-long files, with a starting date (UTC) indicated in the file name.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute ISFS surface flux data, tilt corrected, geographic coordinate winds
dataset.description: Tilt corrected 5 minute averages of surface flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign using the Leica theodolite survey measurements. These data have been quality controlled and are available in NetCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and corrected for the orientation of the sonic anemometers. The tilt corrections applied were determined by the use of laser multi-station scans of the position and orientation of the sonic anemometers with respect to gravity. Note: A companion dataset is available that corrects for sonic orientation with respect to flow through the sensor using the planarfit method: https://doi.org/10.26023/J7FD-1ME6-H70T Disclaimer: GPS positions of stations are not included in this dataset, but can be found at the ISFS Operations at CHEESEHEAD page linked below.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the JASIN project.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Channel 4 Thermal Infrared Satellite Imagery - Galapagos
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Channel 4 Thermal Infrared Satellite imagery over Galapagos taken during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project from 14 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Imager 1 km Channel 1 (Visible) Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1km resolution visible channel data over the southeastern United States from the GOES-13 satellite during the VORTEX-SE_2016 field campaign. The data are in daily tar files that contain the data files in NetCDF format. This is a large data set, consisting of approximately 6 GB daily tar files. Please consider the size of the data set when making your order. You can order 4 days in a single order.

dataset.title: Radarsat Quick Look Imagery
dataset.description: This is a link to Radarsat Quick-look imagery for SHEBA.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Chatham (USA)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Chatham, Massachusetts in the USA (WMO 74494) which was operated by the US National Weather Service. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to four times per day (also 06 and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 6 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Merauke Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 364 high vertical resolution soundings from Merauke, Indonesia (WMO 97980) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Medan Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 364 high vertical resolution soundings from Medan, Indonesia (WMO 96035) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Convective Waves (CONV_WAVES) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During the ICE-T project, the C130 flew a forward looking and a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during ICE-T flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains downward-looking images.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS Disdrometer histograms
dataset.description: Particle size and fall speed histograms measured by the OTT optical disdrometers collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the RELAMPAGO field campaign. The distrometers were deployed at 10 sites. Size distribution data (available every minute) are not part of standard ISFS data processing, but have been created as separate data files and will be available as a companion dataset. Data are made available as monthly ASCII files. Refer to ISFS operations during Relampago documentation for a readme information.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Storm Transfer and Response Experiment (STREX).

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Continental-scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the Enhanced Annual Observing Period - 1999 (EAOP-99) domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, AVHRR 1KM Channel 5 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12,14,15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 5 imagery. Observations are from the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Images are at a 1KM resolution and in .gif format.

dataset.title: TOGA-COARE: Electra Photography Cloud Videos [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from each flight of the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Tropical Ocean Global Atmosphere (TOGA) Coupled Ocean-Atmosphere Response Experiment (COARE). This dataset contains forward-looking and downward-looking videos.

dataset.title: NCAR C-130 Quality Controlled Dropsonde Data (NCAR/EOL)
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding data from the NCAR C-130 research aircraft, collected using the NCAR Airborne Vertical Atmospheric Profiling System (AVAPS) during the Gulf Of Tehuantepec Experiment, Coupled Development of Ocean Waves and Boundary Layers (GOTEX aka OceanWaves). Soundings are quality-controlled in the NCAR CLASS format.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Dropsonde Profile Data
dataset.description: The Terrain Induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) was conducted during March and April 2006, during which time 306 dropsondes were launched from the NCAR G-V aircraft during eleven research flights. T-REX marks the first project where dropsondes were deployed from NCAR's newest aircraft. T-REX is the second phase of a coordinated effort to explore the structure and evolution of atmospheric rotors, which typically occur parallel to, and downstream from, mountain ridge crests. The first phase was a project conducted in 2004 called the Sierra Rotors Project. Both phases included radiosonde launches from the California Central Valley and Owens Valley, however only the second phase included the use of dropsondes.

dataset.title: R/V Mirai Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes 518 high vertical resolution (2 sec) soundings from the R/V Mirai collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011. Soundings were typically released every three hours during the two cruises (26 September through 26 October and 29 October through 1 December 2011) and four times daily from 5-10 December 2011. For most of these soundings R/V Mirai was on station near 80.5E and 8.00S Latitude. These data were converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format. The station used Vaisala RS92-SGPD radiosondes. The ground station software was Digicora III/MW31/ver3.64.1. These data were provided by JAMSTEC and had quality control by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: Central American National Lightning 30 Minute Lightning IR Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains lightning_ir imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: Vaisala_30min.

dataset.title: MRMS 2D Merged Base Reflectivity Products
dataset.description: MRMS 2D Merged Base Reflectivity Products collected during the Winter Precipitation Type Research Multi-scale Experiment (WINTRE-MIX) time and area of interest are included in this dataset. The data are in GRIB2 format. This is a large dataset. Please order only the time period that is required.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Queen Air aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the Marine Radon (M-RADON) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Precipitation Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains daily precipitation data extracted from the Continental-scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the Enhanced Annual Observing Period - 1999 (EAOP-99) domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Five Channel 4KM Sectored Data in Hierarchical Data Format
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Five Channel 4KM Sectored Data in Hierarchical Data Format (HDF) is one of several satellite data sets collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 4-km data from Channel 1 (visible; 0.55-0.75 um), Channel 2 (Shortwave IR;3.8-4.0um), Channel 3 (Water vapor;6.5-7.0 um), Channel 4 (IR1; 10.2-11.2 um), and Channel 5 (IR2;11.5-12.5 um) of the GOES-10 satellite. The data cover the period from 1 - 30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). During the times the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft was in flight (see the web page http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms/missions/ for flight times) the data are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). For the times that the NSF/NCAR C-130 was not in flight data are available every three hours (00, 03, 06, ... UTC). All images are in HDF format. A brief description of HDF is given in Section 3.1 of the readme.

dataset.title: ASOS Surface &quot;Specials&quot; Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) Surface "special" data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Marine Stratus Cloud Tops project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) Airborne Lidar and Observations of Hawaiian Airglow (ALOHA-90) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-13 4 km Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains jpg images from the GOES-13 4km Channel 1 visible satellite, taken during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project.

dataset.title: GMS-5 IR Imagery
dataset.description: GMS-5 Infrared (IR) imagery collected during the ACE-1 intensive operations in Hobart, Tasmania, from the Australian Bureau of Meteorology. These images consist of the Southern Ocean (image center 30 deg S, 140 deg E), 8 km resolution, collected every hour. Digital McIDAS area format data files were collected hourly by OFPS from which these GIF images were created.

dataset.title: ACE-1: Discoverer ISS High Vertical Resolution Balloon Data
dataset.description: Data from the NCAR/Integrated Sounding System (ISS) upper air data collected aboard the ship R/V Discoverer during the ACE-1 transect and intensive operations, via the NCAR/Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD). Data consist of 10-sec vertical resolution data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily with up to 6-hr frequency during intensive operations.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During IDEAS-4 C130, the NCAR C-130 flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data (Special Processing) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the In-Cloud Temperature (SPICE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-East 3-hourly 4km Multi-Spectral Channel Area Files Eastern Pacific
dataset.description: This dataset contains MCIDAS area files of GOES-8 Satellite data at 4 kilometer resolution. The data are tarred into dayfile. The data cover the period from 1 Sept - 31 Oct 2001 (2001d244-304)

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:00:00 to 2011-07-14 22:16:00.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Ship Track Close-up View (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of .png images plotting a close-up view of the United States Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy ship location and track during the SBI Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03).

dataset.title: SPACE: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of PAM station data from the SPACE experiment near Huntsville, Alabama.

dataset.title: VINN: PAM Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single ascii text file of data from 28 PAM stations.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, DMSP OLS 1KM Visible Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of F-12, F-13, F-14 and F-15 DMSP visible channel imagery. Observations are at a 1KM resolution and cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: USAF C-130 NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Constant Level Winds KML Data
dataset.description: ITOP Google Earth KML files that contain constant level wind observations derived from the dropsondes released from the USAF C-130 aircraft. These files were produced by NCAR/EOL from the real time GTS TEMPDROP messages and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Satellite IR Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains channel 4 thermal-IR images from the GOES - 12 satellite taken every thirty minutes, at 4 and 8 km from October 27th, 2004 through February 1st, 2005.

dataset.title: Galapagos Rawinsondes (hi-res)
dataset.description: This Dataset consists of rawinsonde data collected from Galapagos during EPIC. Each datafile contains the sonde's UTC release time, and a vertical profile of pressure, temperature, humidity, latitude and longitude, total wind speed and direction, and U and V wind components, every 10 seconds during the sonde's ascent.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the First ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Field Experiment (FIFE). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Hilo
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data taken at Hilo, Hawaii during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 12:00:00 to 2011-07-13 12:00:00.

dataset.title: FIREII: CLASS Soundings
dataset.description: Sounding data from the second First ISCCP Regional Experiment (FIRE) II-Cirrus includes data from 4 fixed Cross-chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) instruments. Data is ordered by CLASS location: Arkansas Cith KS, Coffeyville KS, Iola KS, Muskogee OK.

dataset.title: NIU Supplemental Sounding Data and Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains sounding data and images collected by Northern Illinois University during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 26 January - 8 March 2019. Data were collected with the Intermet iMet-4 Radiosonde. See the iMet-4 data sheet for instrument accuracies / uncertainties. Also contains skewT/LogP images for quick reference.

dataset.title: AHATS QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: Radiosonde soundings were collected by the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Advection Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (AHATS). AHATS was the fourth in a series of field campaigns aimed at improving large-eddy simulations (LES) of turbulence close to the Earth's surface. The first three Horizontal Array Turbulence Studies (HATS) were, HATS (2002), OHATS (2004) and CHATS (2007). This most recent field campaign, AHATS, took place from May to August 2008 in Kettleman City, CA, the location of the original HATS project.

dataset.title: CAREER/ROCS QC Radiosonde Dataset
dataset.description: The purpose of the Research on Convective Snows (ROCS) project is to determine the characteristics of clouds that produce weather events where snow is accompanied by lightening and thunder. During the project, 47 radiosondes were launched from various locations throughout the Central United States between February 8, 2005 and March 18, 2005. The final radiosonde data set consists of 44 quality controlled ascending soundings and 4 descending soundings. Three soundings were removed from the final archive because the radiosondes never left the ground. Two of the soundings experienced a loss of the radiosonde signal at some point during the flight. For each, the signal was eventually recaptured and the data were stored in new sounding files. During post-processing we identified these “extra files” and merged them with the data collected before the signal loss.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 07:52:00 to 2009-02-01 19:22:00.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ASPIRE project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 14:30:00.

dataset.title: Manus ARM AMF Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This preliminary data set includes 1411 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) C1 Momote, Manus Island site, collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 24 September 2011 through 31 March 2012. There are typically eight soundings per day at 00, 03, 06, 09, 12, 15, 18, and 21 UTC. These data were provided by ARM and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3 version of the data set has a correction by CSU -- see the readme for details. This station used Vaisala RS92-SGP radiosondes with GPS windfinding during the DYNAMO field campaign.

dataset.title: GTS Mandatory/Significant Level Sounding Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Pre-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. This data set includes 1287 GTS mandatory and significant level soundings from 24 stations in the Carribean and Gulf of Mexico region for the period 15 August 2010 to 30 September 2010. Stations typically released soundings at 00 and or 12 UTC. These data are in the EOL sounding composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Convective Initiation Downburst Experiment (CINDE). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V (HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the HIAPER Pole-to-Pole Observations (HIPPO) of Carbon Cycle and Greenhouse Gases Study Phase 2 (HIPPO-2) project.This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 16:52:00 to 2011-07-14 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the GAMETAG-78 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: RICO 5 minute ISFS data, tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute ISFS data, collected during the Rain in Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) field project between 3 December 2004 and 25 January 2005. These data are in NetCDF format, and have been tilt corrected. The data have been quality control processed using the procedures described in the attached document and related webpage "RICO ISFF Data Report." The Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: NEXRAD VNX (Enid/Vance AFB, OK) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Enid/Vance AFB, OK. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Macquarie Island
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Macquarie Island during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-18 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR ISS Surface Meteorological Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL deployed three Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) near Independence in the Owens Valley, California for T-REX (the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment). This dataset contains ISS2 and ISS-MAPR data.

dataset.title: Montana&#39;s RWIS &quot;Specials&quot; Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: Montana's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) "Specials" Surface Data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Net Radiation and PAR Composite
dataset.description: NOAA/ATDD Little Washita Flux data and derived values from ARM SGP SIROS data have been composited together into one data set. This data set is composed of 30-minute observations of Incoming PAR, Outgoing PAR, and Net Radiation from the NOAA/ATDD site, and a Net Radiation value derived from 20-second observations from the SIROS network. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NCAR/ATD Eldorado 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Eldorado, KS during the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study 1999 (CASES-99). This dataset includes consensus winds data in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: SGP99: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Southern Great Plains Experiment (SGP99). This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: WISP91: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file from 39 PAM stations deployed in southeast Wyoming, northeast Colorado and southwest Nebraskaduring the winter of 1991.

dataset.title: MacQuarie Island (94998), AU, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC daily.

dataset.title: MARCUS RSV Aurora Australis Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Department of Energy/Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (DOE/ARM) program operated a radiosonde system on-board the RSV Aurora Australis as part of the Measurements of Aerosols, Radiation, and Clouds over the Southern Ocean (MARCUS) field campaign. The Australis conducted servicing cruises to Davis, Casey, and Mawson Stations on the Antarctica coast from its base at Hobart, Tasmania. Radiosondes were released every six hours (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC) during these cruises. This data set includes only those soundings that were released during the SOCARATES (Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study) field phase (1 January – 28 February 2018). A total of 208 2-second vertical resolution radiosondes are included in this data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Airborne Leonids Meteor Storm Campaign (Leonids-98). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol real-time moments data
dataset.description: S-PolKa radar data taken continuously during the FRONT (Front Range Observational Network Testbed) project. The data is in CfRadial format. See the FRONT S-Pol Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability.

dataset.title: NSF C-130 Meteorology Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: The Aircraft C-130 Meteorology Dropsonde Profiles dataset is one of several archived by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) in support of the Eastern Pacific Investigation of Climate (EPIC) project. The data was collected by NCAR ATD (aka EOL) and RAF. The dataset consists of 0.5 second vertical resolution profiles derived from dropsondes released from the National Science Foundation (NSF)/NCAR C-130 aircraft during EPIC. Dropsondes were released during aircraft flights on the following days: September 2001(3, 5, 7, 14, 16, 19, 23, 25, 28, and 29) and October 2001(2, 6, 9, and 10).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL High-rate Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains high-rate variables from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the Investigation of Sulfur Chemistry in the Antarctic Troposphere (ISCAT) project that ocurred in 2000. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected, but remain in an instrument relative coordinate system.

dataset.title: NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) 915 MHz Profiler Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains the NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) 915 MHz Profiler Imagery [NCAR/EOL] for the NAME time period.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the JASIN project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NCAR SLW-sondes
dataset.description: These data files are IMet Radiosonde data with an attached Anasphere SLW-sonde. Data includes standard meteorological sounding fields plus a wire frequency field from the Supercooled Liquid Water (SLW) sonde. The SLW-content value derived from the wire frequency and the rise rate is appended to the data file as well. Each data file is in CSV format. All SLW-sondes were released from Horseshoe Bend, ID (43.9086, -116.2018) on an "as-available/as-needed" basis. For questions about this dataset, please contact the lead and corresponding author, David J. Serke of NCAR/RAL.

dataset.title: Lear QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde profiles from the Lear aircraft collected during the International H2O Project 2002 (IHOP 2002). The dropsonde data was provided by NCAR/ATD (aka EOL). The Lear made drops on May 14th, 15th, 16th, the 22nd, and 24th and on June 3rd, 8th thru 12th, 15th thru 20th,the 22nd,and 24th thru 25th 2002. An important note to users: ATD reprocessed this data and released a new version of this dataset on May 1st,2003. See ATD Reprocessing. Consult the README for more information. September 2008: The IHOP_2002 Falcon and Lear dropsonde data sets have been updated to include latitude and longitude data that were not in the earlier version. The PTH and wind data are unchanged.

dataset.title: DC-7 Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the DC-7 aircraft during Phases I, II, and III as well as the After Phase. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: NCEP/CPC Daily Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This dataset contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction/Climate Prediction Center (NCEP/CPC) Daily Precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. This dataset was formed by extracting precipitation values with NCEP/CPC element codes of PC and PP that fall on the hour. All raw precipitation data, including data that do not fall on the hour, can be found in the GCIP/EOP Surface: Precipitation NCEP/CPC Gage Only Daily Dataset.

dataset.title: MPD EKO-BRIDGE-2025 data
dataset.description: This dataset contains MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data in NetCDF format which were collected from the MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) for a subset of the BRIDGE project in the summer of 2025. One MPD was deployed to Fukue, Japan for this field project.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Sodankyla Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Sodankyla Observatory B 30 minute Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set. This dataset contains data for the period 1 October 2002 to 31 December 2008. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP)
dataset.description: This dataset contains NGV Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) data measured aboard the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the DEEPWAVE project. The data are in NASA Ames format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR G-V Digital Camera Movie files
dataset.description: During START08, the G-V flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Images were captured once per second during START08 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into movies, one mp4 file per flight.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Flight Level Plots &amp; Tracks
dataset.description: This dataset contains Flight Level Plots & Tracks from the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The missions were completed between 7 Dec 2004 - 20 Dec 2004, and 11 Jan 2005 - 24 Jan 2004.

dataset.title: National Weather Service Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Ice in Clouds Experiment 2007 (ICE-L 2007). This data set includes 487 high vertical resolution (1-second) Radiosonde Replacement System (RRS) soundings from the four National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the PLOWS 2008-2009 region (Grand Junction, CO; Boise, IA; Riverton, WY; and Salt Lake City, UT). Additionally, 245 high vertical resolution (6-second) MicroArt soundings from from Albuquerque, NM and Denver International Airport, CO NWS rawinsonde stations are included. The data cover the period from 1 November to 31 December 2007. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC). The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: GTS Surface Ship Observations
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Surface: GTS Surface Ship Observations are online data. Data is in GEMPAK format.

dataset.title: Counterflow Virtual Impactor (CVI) [Twohy]
dataset.description: The Counterflow Virtual Impactor (CVI) dataset is one of several aircraft data sets collected on the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) as part of the Ice in Clouds Experiment -L (ICE-L). The counterflow virtual impactor (CVI) separates droplets or ice crystals from the ambient aerosol and evaporates the condensed water, producing cloud droplet residual particles and water vapor. Cloud droplet number (as number of residual particles after evaporation) and condensed water content measurements were taken using the CVI onboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 from Nov 7-Dev 16, 2007. Data are in NASA Ames format. UPDATED 2011-02-01

dataset.title: Mexico SMN-CNA Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). It includes 94 high resolution vertical (2 second) rawinsonde data from the Servicio Meteorol&ocaute;gico Nacional (SMN) Comisión Nacional del Agua (CNA), which forms part of the Secretaríade Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT). There are 2 stations (Merida and Vera Cruz) that measure pressure, temperature, humidity and wind that are released twice a day. The SMN home page can be found here: http://smn.cna.gob.mx/SMN.html. The web site is in spanish.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFF 5 minute quality controlled surface data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) collected during the Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (HATS), which was formerly known as the Sub-Gridscale Studies, 2000 (SGS00) field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres have been tilt corrected and rotated to a coordinate system aligned with the mean streamlines.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Summer MONEX project.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar accumulated precipitation, DORADE
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) derived accumulated precipitation data in the Doppler Radar Data Exchange (DORADE) format, from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX). Be aware that some of these files are up to 1 GB in size.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files) - Low Rate
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER G-V flight track in real-time during the NOREASTER project.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the First Aerosol Characterization Experiment (ACE-1). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format. These files are the unabridged data from the C130 datasystem, and include numerous raw or uncalibrated chemistry, CN, and CCN variables. Please look for the standalone final datasets for those variables.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Texas 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Texas 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-03 14:00:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: GOES-East 3-hourly 4km Multi-Spectral Channel NetCDF Data Eastern Pacific
dataset.description: This dataset contains NetCDF-formatted GOES-8 Satellite data at 4 kilometer resolution. The data contain all 4KM channels (Visible, Water Vapor, 3.9, 10, and 12 micron, lat/lon fields). The data cover the period from 1 Sept - 31 Oct 2001 (2001d244-304).

dataset.title: Lake-ICE upper air: NCAR/EOL Greenville 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Greenville, MI (ISS3) during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (LAKE-ICE), which occurred simultaneously with the SNOWBAND project. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Mexican UNAM R/V El Puma Tethersonde Balloon Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME). This data set includes the high vertical resolution (approximately 10 second) tethersonde data from the Research Vessel (R/V) El Puma. During NAME the R/V El Puma conducted the ECAC-5 cruise (6-17 August 2004). The release location was determined from a seperate navigational parameters file containing one minute data. The nearest minute in the navigational parameters file was used from the release time of the sounding. An additional document Reporte-ECAC-5.doc was provided from the ECAC project that describes the methodology used by the Universidad Nacional Autonoma de Mexico (UNAM) in developing the data set. This document is in Spanish. This dataset was not quality controlled by the National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL).

dataset.title: Mexican Daily Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This data set contains daily precipitation data from across Mexico. The data are from 1348 sites within Mexico covering the time period January 1989 to April 1999. In Version 2 of this dataset, the observation hours have all been set to missing or "99". According to the US data provider, Dr. Wayne Higgins, the observation time for the daily Mexican precip data was 8 AM local time for all data. With the complicating factors of a few Mexican states having daylight savings time for some of this period and there are two time zones in Mexico.

dataset.title: Custer, SD High Resolution Rawinsonde Data Set
dataset.description: This is one of the sounding datasets developed for The Upper Missouri River Basin Pilot Project (UMRBPP). The dataset consists of research soundings from Custer, South Dakota and contains vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, dew point, humidity, U and V wind components, total wind speed and direction, and latitude and longitude taken every 10 seconds after the sonde's release time. The soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC, but there were occasional releases at 06 and 18 UTC. Note: since the files are loaded in the database using the actual release times, use the hour just before or the hour a couple hours before UTC release time,when attempting to browse this dataset. UCAR/JOSS performed an automated quality control on this data. See the README for further information.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Cloud Physics of Snow and Urban Plumes (CPSUP) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 12:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-13 1km Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery - Oklahoma
dataset.description: This dataset contans the GOES-13 1km Channel 1 visible satellite imagery for Oklahoma for the DC3 project. The imagery are in the JPEG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: GTS Radiosonde Observations
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Upper Air: GTS Upper Air Rawinsonde Observations are online data. Data is in GEMPAK format.

dataset.title: NCAR/ATD Eldorado ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located in Eldorado, KS during the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study 1999 (CASES-99). These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-7 Visible R/V Discoverer Floater Sector Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 Visible (VIS) imagery collected during the ACE-1 transect period via McIDAS-X, then converted to GIF image format. These images consist of a 2000 x 2000 km sector, 2-km resolution every hour (daylight hours) which followed the transect of the R/V Discoverer from Seattle to Hobart, Tasmania. Digital McIDAS Area format data files were collected hourly at OFPS from which these GIF images were created.

dataset.title: ASCAT Local Near Surface Winds Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains ASCAT Local Near Surface Winds Satellite imagery taken over the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project study area from 18 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: Darwin Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 737 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Australian Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) C3 Darwin, Australia site, collected during the DYNAMO field campaign. The data were provided by ARM. There are typically four soundings per day at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC. The 06 and 18 UTC soundings typically contain only wind data. This L3 version of the data set has had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU. This station used Vaisala RS92-15 radiosondes with radar-tracked winds during the DYNAMO field campaign.

dataset.title: Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) 1-min Data
dataset.description: This data set contains 1 minute resolution surface meteorological data from the Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS). This data set covers the period from 1 May 2002 through 08 July 2002.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/GIST 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the GIST domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: United States National Weather Service High-Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set consists of six second vertical resolution sounding data for all United States sounding locations. These sites were operated by the US National Weather Service. Soundings were taken two times per day at 0000 and 1200 UTC. These data have undergone the JOSS automated quality control procedure. See the README for more information.

dataset.title: FP4 NCAR/EOL 915 MHz Profiler NIMA Consensus Winds and Moments
dataset.description: This data set contains 30 minute NIMA consensus wind and moments data measured by the NCAR/EOL 915 MHz profiler located at the PECAN Fixed PISA 4 site in Minden, Nebraska. These data are in netcdf format and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NCAR Mesoscale Model (MM5)
dataset.description: The NCAR/Penn. State University (PSU) mesoscale model MM5 Version 3 was run by NCAR for the IHOP project. A 15 hour forecast was made using dynamic initialization period of 4 hours. The model was forced with output data from the operational forecasts from AWIP3D Eta 12 km model. Two levels of nesting were used to produce a high resolution (1.333 km) simulation centered on on the Oklahoma panhandle region where the ATD S-Pol and ISS systems are based. The products are usually available about 2230Z. Files with the designations nofdda, fddasol, and fdda2 were not loaded with the data. These files are available by request only. See the contact info below.

dataset.title: Kalamazoo ICICLE Ground Suite
dataset.description: This dataset contains ground-based measurements collected from the Kalamazoo ICICLE Ground Suite during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 27 January - 8 March 2019. Primary information included in the dataset are ground-based measurements of precipitation accumulation and rate, ice accretion, present weather type, atmospheric state parameters, winds, hydrometeor size distributions and velocities, visibility, and cloud base heights and coverage (KZOO only). Data has been reviewed for quality and known data gaps exist due to power outages etc.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S-band, Marshall field site
dataset.description: Selected time periods of radar moments data collected by the S-PolKa radar at the Marshall field site in Colorado. S-PolKa is usually run at the Marshall field site for testing and maintenance purposes so the data in this dataset contains data from various different instrument states. It is not quality controlled. If you would like to use this data set for research purposes, please contact us first at the email address below.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Keyhole Markup Language (KML) files. KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research (NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER) flight track in real-time during the CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics (CONTRAST) project.

dataset.title: GTS Station Plot Imagery - Arizona [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains GTS station plot imagery of Arizona from the CuPIDO Field Catalog.

dataset.title: Japan Naze High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC 2008). The data set includes 156 high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings from Naze, Japan (WMO - 47909). The data cover August and September 2008 and soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC with some special releases during periods of nearby tropical storms. The data are in the EOL Sounding Composite format which is columnar ASCII. The data were provided by JMA.

dataset.title: GOES-8 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1996 (ESOP-96) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL AVAPS Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: Dropsonde profiles onboard from the NPS-CIRPAS Twin Otter were collected by the NCAR/EOL Dropsonde team during the Sundowner Wind Experiment (SWEX) field campaign.

dataset.title: GOES-11 4KM Imager Data (netCDF)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of satellite GOES-11 gzipped netCDF files from the period of the PASE (Pacific Atmospheric Sulfur Experiment) from Christmas Island in the Pacific.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 16:00:00 to 2009-12-21 22:15:00.

dataset.title: DOTSTAR ASTRA NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding profiles released from the DOTSTAR ASTRA aircraft between 16 July to 28 September 2008. See the documentation file for further information.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Data
dataset.description: 5mb vertical resolution radiosonde data from research and operational sources during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) campaign converted into a common format (EOL Sounding Composite format which is a columnar ASCII format). The composite includes radiosondes from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located at the Deer Creek Supersite (near Midway, Utah) as well as radiosondes from the National Weather Service Salt Lake City, Utah; Boise, ID;Elko, NV sites.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Manado Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 361 high vertical resolution soundings from Manado, Indonesia (WMO 97014) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ASPIRE-TEST project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 IR (Channel 8) Data in AREA Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 km resolution Meteosat-7 Infrared (channel 8) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the McIDAS AREA file format.

dataset.title: GOES-12 1km Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-12 1km resolution visible channel satellite imagery over the PLOWS region. The routine 15-minute imagery as well as any rapid scan imagery are included. The images were created by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 13 January to 30 March 2009 and 1 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of VORTEX-SE Meso18-19 operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 2 Imagery
dataset.description: This is the channel 2 imagery collected from the GOES-8 satellite during the EPIC time period.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the ELectra SCAlar Measurement Evaluation (ELSCAM) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Sounding Site at the Upper Orange Grove)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Lufft WS800 that was located at the upper orange grove site in the center of the Vale do Cobrao at the Sounding Site during the Perdigao field project in 2017. This dataset includes 3m temperature, humidity, pressure, winds, and precipitation, collected every minute in NetCDF format. These data have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Aircraft Vertical Separation Standards Project (AVSSP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, Ka-band
dataset.description: Ka-band only cfRadial format, hourly files of S-PolKa radar data taken continuously during the DYNAMO (Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation) project.

dataset.title: CAMP: Mongolia Hourly Surface Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) CEOP related Asian Monsoon Experiment (CAMP) Mongolia Hourly Surface Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains hourly data from four sites for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Sulfur Instrument Test (SIT). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: AVISO Satellite Altimetry Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains AVISO satellite altimetry imagery over the DYNAMO region. Included are dynamic topography, sea level anomaly, and geostrophic velocity errors products. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL using data from AVISO. The images are in png format.

dataset.title: POES Arctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Arctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 12:00:00 to 2011-07-14 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar time series data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) time series data collected during the CSET (Cloud Systems Evolution in the Trades) project from 1 July 2015 through 7 August 2012.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS High Rate Surface Flux Data, Geographic Coordinate Winds
dataset.description: High-rate surface flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the RELAMPAGO field campaign. Data are reported in 1 second intervals, however, samples within one second may vary between 20 Hz and 30 Hz depending on the sensor. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates. These data have not been quality checked and are final.

dataset.title: Lake-ICE: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (Lake-ICE) project. Data is in field dorade format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Multispectral Imagery
dataset.description: The ACE-Asia Satellite: GOES-10 Multispectral Imagery (JOSS) are available online.

dataset.title: POES Antarctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Antarctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 12:00:00 to 2011-07-14 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT (RRUN) Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Convective Initiation Downburst Experiment (CINDE). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Medan Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 364 high vertical resolution soundings from Medan, Indonesia (WMO 96035) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: FABLE 1999 NCAR/ATD Tennessee Site 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Walker Branch Watershead in Oak Ridge, Tennessee during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 1999. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data files have been tarred into montly files for RASS and each of the profiler's operation modes (high and low). These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: University of Leeds Independence Airport Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). It includes 192 high vertical resolution (2 second) rawinsondes released from the Independence Airport (K2O7), CA. Soundings were released from 28 Feb to 30 Apr 2006. The radiosondes used were Vaisala RS-80.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S-band
dataset.description: S-band only cfRadial format, hourly files of S-PolKa radar data taken continuously during the DYNAMO (Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation) project.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
