dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Snow-Shading Boundary-Layer Interaction Measurements (SSBLIM) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:52:00.

dataset.title: HS3 2014 Global Hawk Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NOAA/NASA Global Hawk Dropsonde sounding profiles collected during 11 research flights between August 26 and September 30 2014 during the NASA Hurricane and Severe Storm Sentinel (HS3) campaign. The GH is equipped with an NCAR/NOAA dropsonde system specially designed for remote operation. 656 quality controlled dropsondes in EOL file format are available.

dataset.title: GOES-East Imager Visible CH1 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Imager CH1 Visible Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 14 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: GCIP/LSA-NW 99 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, North Dakota Atmospheric Resource Board (NDARB) daily precipitation data, Natural Resource Conservation Service (NRCS) National Water and Climate Center SNOpack TELemetry (SNOTEL) daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During SOCRATES, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - NASA AMES format
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO. The data are in NASA Ames format and are available for 11 flights.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ADELE/SPRITE/HEFT09, the GV_N677F flew a leftward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Flight RF02, 3, 5, and 9 were night flights, so all images were dark. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Windcube Lidar CF-Radial Products
dataset.description: Leosphere Windcube Lidar products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. Data are provided in CF-Radial lidar parameters. Lidar scans include MAN, PPI, RHI, VAD stored separately in netCDF files. Note: There is pre-project data available on request, although data prior to 4 Jan. should be used with caution as the instrument level may be off.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:30:00.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar time series data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research, HIAPER) (N677F) during SPICULE (Secondary Production of Ice in Cumulus Experiment). The data were collected during 10 research flights which took place between May 29 and June 25, 2021, over the US Great Plains. The dataset contains the raw in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) information archived as time series. Note: Each data file is ~10 G large. Please do not order more than 3 minutes of data at one time.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ADELE/SPRITE/HEFT09, the GV_N677F flew a rightward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Flight RF02, 3, 5, and 9 were night flights, so all images were dark. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During CONTRAST (CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) flew a forward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo (JPEG) images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Note: Downward, Left, and Right-looking images can be found in the companion datasets.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Lidar Cirrus Studies (LCS) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 All Channels 4KM Data (netCDF) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains 4-km resolution GOES-11 data in netCDF format. This data set includes data from all sector scans that cover this region, including any rapid scan or super rapid scan sectors.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies [EOL/RAF]
Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V (HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the HIAPER Pole-to-Pole Observations (HIPPO) of Carbon Cycle and Greenhouse Gases Study Phase 3 (HIPPO-3) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: LDM Surface METAR Special Data
dataset.description: The Surface METAR Data set is one of several surface data sets collected by the National Center for Atmospheric Research/ Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL). Included in the data set are the global special surface meteorological observations in NCAR/EOL columnar ascii surface QC format. These data are contained in daily files which are compressed in gzip format (.gz). The data were aquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: Belize City, Belize Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 140 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from the Belize City site in Belize (WMO 78583). Soundings were typically released once per day (1200 UTC) from 1 June to 13 July 2004 and twice per day from 14 July to 2 September 2004. The sites antenna failed on 3 September 2004 so no soundings are available for the remainder of the NAME period.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Atmospheric Sulfur Gases (ASG) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery [Reeves (NCAR-RAF)]
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 µm. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NCAR GV during the IDEAS-4 GV project. The 2DS puts all flight data into 3 files, and the size of these files depends on the amount of time in clouds.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 08:00:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: CEOP_AP Tsukuba Flux Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) CEOP_AP 30 minute Flux Data Set. This data set contains averaged 30 minute data from three stations in the Tsukuba reference site. The MRI station covers 1 Jan 2007 through 30 Jun 2010, TERC-UT covers 1 Jan 2007 through 31 Dec 2009 and NIAES-MASE covers 1 Jan 2007 through 31 Dec 2008. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: GTS PACS Region Buoy Meteorological Data
dataset.description: This data set contains all drift and moored buoy data available from GTS over the region from 30 N to 60 S latitude and 30 to 150 W longitude as collected by NCAR/SCD. It includes site identifier information, wind speed and direction, surface and sea level pressure, air temperature, and dew point depression. These data have undergone no quality control. See the README for more details.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes at 00 and 12 UTC with occasional special releases at sites throughout the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released at nine sites around Salt Lake City, Utah during the IDEAL (Instabilities, Dynamics and Energetics accompanying Atmospheric Layering) project's field phase (15 October to 15 November 2017). A total of 585 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final IDEAL NWS radiosonde data set.

dataset.title: East-looking Cloud Videos from Mauna Kea
dataset.description: This data set contains mpeg files from VHS tapes of east-looking cloud videos. The videos are from a stationary camera, set up on Mauna Kea, Hawaii to take am and pm videos of the clouds as a part of the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP). The videos have 10:1 compression.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 &amp; 5 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains legs 4 & 5 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 07:52:00 to 2009-02-01 19:22:00.

dataset.title: ISS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: This dataset contains data collected from 43 sondes using the ISS (Integrated Sounding Systems) during the Sierra Rotors Project in Owens Valley of California. The sondes were launched between 12 March and 29 April, 2004. The soundings have been run through ASPEN for quality control processing. Seven of the sondes experienced vertical downdrafts and were manually QC'd to preserve this data. These files are in the NCAR CLASS format. Please see the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Highest Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: High vertical resolution sounding data from research and operational sources during the Cold Air Outbreak Experiment in the Sub-Arctic Region (CAESAR) campaign converted into a common format (EOL Sounding Composite format which is a columnar ASCII format). The composite includes data from 568 radiosondes and 116 dropsondes from locations around the Norwegian Sea. The radiosondes were released by the Norwegian Meteorological Institute from four sites and the dropsondes were released by NCAR/EOL from the NSF NCAR C-130 aircraft in ten research flights.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the North Atlantic Regional Experiment - Aircraft (NARE-AIR). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Skin Temperature Composite
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 Surface: Skin Temperature Composite dataset is composed of 30 minute observations of skin temperaturesderived from 3 sources. These are: Department of Energy (DOE) Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Solar and Infrared Radiation Observing System (SIROS) 10M and 25M, and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration NOAA/Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division (ATDD) long term flux monitoring site located in the Little Washita Watershed. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). Standard deviations are included.

dataset.title: METCRAXII ISS SODAR Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Sonic Detection And Ranging (SODAR) data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II) between 24 September 2013 and 29 October 2013. This dataset contains raw SODAR data files (*.SDR) in ASCII format.

dataset.title: Gan ARM AMF Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 1068 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) M1 Airport (Addu Atoll), Gan Island, Maldives site, collected during the DYNAMO field campaign from 22 September 2011 through 9 February 2012. There are typically eight soundings per day at 00, 03, 06, 09, 12, 15, 18, and 21 UTC. This data set contains data from 22 September 2011 to 9 February 2012. After 9 February 2012 the Maldivian Meteorological Service continued to conduct releases once or twice per day through the end of the DYNAMO field phase. Those data will be part of a separate data set.

dataset.title: GTS Upper Air Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains charts of analysis of the RICO region for upper air products at 200, 300, 500, 700, and 850mb taken daily at 00:00 hours and 12:00 hours..

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R Leg6 AGGH-PHKO Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-11-05 17:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ASTER surface data 1998
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute ASTER surface data collected at the University of Oklahoma Mesonet site in Norman, OK during the Oklahoma Atmospheric Surface-layer Instrumentation System project (OASIS) in 1998. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: NCDC Daily Soil Temperature
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Soil Temperature Dataset is one of several sub-surface datasets provided for the GEWEX Continental Scale International Project (GCIP) Southern Great Plains 1997 (SGP97) project. This dataset was formed by extracting soil temperature data from the NCDC Summary of the Day Co-operative Dataset (TD-3200) for the SGP 1997 area and time of interest.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Lihue
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Lihue, Hawaii during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data (Sadorus)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Sadorus site (ISS2) in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1995. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Trinidad Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). It includes 180 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from Trinidad. (WMO 78970). Soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC) from 6 July to 31 October 2005. This dataset includes sounding during hurricanes: Dennis, Emily, Gert, Katrina, Ophelia, Rita, and Wilma.

dataset.title: GOES-7 2-km Visible Imagery
dataset.description: Digital GOES-7 2-km visible imagery for GCIP/GIST. These data are in GIF format, and are provided for data browse purposes.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE Wind Profiler (ISS and others) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains profiles of winds and temperature from six NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) wind profiler sites. Wind data from three additional sites using other types of wind profilers are also included. The six ISS sites are: R/V Shiyan 3; Kapingamarangi; Kavieng; Manus; Nauru; and R/V Kexue 1. The other research profiler sites are: Biak (50 MHz); Christmas Island (50 MHz); and R/V Moana Wave (915 MHz). The data consist of ASCII data files, 1 profile per file. Postscript files containing daily time-series of the profiles are also included. The ASCII data files include altitude, u wind component, v wind component, w wind component, and several engineering parameters. The ISS sites also have virtual temperature and another series of engineering parameters. Please see the "README" file for more details.

dataset.title: GCIP/EAOP-98 Surface: 15-Minute Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Fifteen Minute Precipitation Composite contains one data source (i.e., National Climatic Data Center Fifteen Minute Precipitation data). Data from this source was quality controlled to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Equatorial Mesoscale EXperiment (EMEX). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: VORTEX-95: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This data set from Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment 95 (VORTEX-95) of Cross Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) is of data in separate files in both ascii and binary sounding tar files. There are sounding data from 3 Oklahoma sites, Lubbock, Texas and one mobile CLASS.

dataset.title: LDM WMO Surface &quot;Specials&quot; Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Unidata Local Data Manager (LDM) World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Surface "Special" observation surface data in Quality Control (QC) format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period (01 April 2000 through 31 March 2001). The GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain is approximately 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: TRANS2AM Chatlogs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the TRANS2AM (Transport and Transformation of Ammonia) field project, collected from 20 July 2021 to 24 August 2021 and from 10 August to 02 September 2022 onboard the University of Wyoming’s Beechcraft King Air 200T (UWKA). These data are available in a txt format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar experimental refractivity
dataset.description: tar files of DORADE format sweep files of refractivity data for the IHOP_2002 project. Data size can be 2.6 GB per day. These data are a product of a scientific investigation. Please contact us prior to using these data.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, DMSP OLS Visible Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of F-12, F-13, F-14 and F-15 DMSP visible channel imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: NOAA/NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains rawinsonde profiles from 63 National Weather Service (NWS) upper-air sites archived during the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME) for the tier-3 area. During NAME, rawinsondes were released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC with more released during the IOPs. The data files consist of vertical profiles of temperature, dew point, relative humidity, u and v wind components, total wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. The vertical resolution is six seconds. This data set has been quality controlled by The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS). Consult the README for more information. NOTE: This data set has been corrected as of 23 March 2010 for a significant dry bias. Only the following 5 stations were corrected: Amarillo, TX (KAMA), El Paso, TX/Santa Teresa, NM (KEPZ), Flagstaff, AZ (KFGZ), Midland, TX (KMAF), and Tucson, AZ (KTUS). See the documentation file for details on the correction(s) applied to this data set. Also see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Winter Icing Storms Project (WISP94). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: INDOEX-98: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - field dorade format (Morely, B. [NCAR/EOL])
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field dorade format files obtained by the ship ORV SAGAR KANYA during the Indian Ocean Experiment First Field Phase (INDOEX-98).

dataset.title: VORTEX-95 10-sec CLASS Soundings
dataset.description: The VORTEX-95 10-second Class Soundings dataset contains the high resolution sounding data collected by NSSL and NCAR Fixed and Mobile CLASS systems in the VORTEX project domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 10 seconds. These data have been extensively quality- controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: ARM Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Department of Energy Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Climate Research Facility Southern Great Plains (SGP) site routinely releases radiosondes four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) from its Central Facility located in north central Oklahoma near Lamont (WMO ID 74646). This data set includes the soundings released during the MPEX field phase (15 May to 15 June 2013). A total of 123 quality controlled, high resolution (2-second) soundings are contained in the final MPEX data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ICEBRIDGE-2015 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Synoptic Maps
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of synoptic maps for A-Scale Ships (Onversaagd, M. Dufresne, Volna, M. Matamoros, Charcot, Sipius, A. Saldanha, Endurer, Kurchatov, Charterer, Passat, Lomonosov, Anton Dohrn, La Perle, Capricorne) for Inter Phases as well as Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: USAF C-130 NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: TPARC C-130 Dropsonde sounding profiles. Dropsondes were launched between August 15 and September 27, 2008 from the USAF C-130. Please see the documentation for more information regarding this data set.

dataset.title: SOAS Quality Controlled ISS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) operated a GPS Advanced Upper-air Sounding System (GAUS) radiosonde system as part of its Integrated Sounding System (ISS) site at the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS) National Weather Service (NWS) site which was located near the Centerville (CTR), Alabama super site. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 15 and 21 UTC from 30 May to 15 July 2013. There were some periods of more intensive sounding operations. This SAS final data set includes a total of 105 quality controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment (IMPROVE) . These data are in dorade format and are available as 4 hourly tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Google Earth KML Files
dataset.description: This data set consists of Google Earth kml files for the period and area of the VOCALS project.

dataset.title: GOES-West Imager Water Vapor CH3 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-15 Imager CH3 Water Vapor Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 16 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: GOES 12 North 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 North 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During NOMADSS, the NSF/NCAR C-130 flew a downward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Note: Forward-looking images can be found in the companion dataset below.

dataset.title: PCAPS NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected at the Integrated Sounding System 2 (ISS2) site during the Persistent Cold-Air Pool Study (PCAPS) from 01 December 2010 to 07 February 2011. The data are available in ASCII text format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During HEFT08, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during HEFT08 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been sharpened, reduced from 1024x768 to 512x384 resolution, and combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: OWLeS Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Ontario Winter Lake-effect Systems (OWLeS) project from 3 May 2013 - 29 January 2014. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the OWLeS project.

dataset.title: KC-135 Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the KC-135 aircraft during Phases II and III. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: METEOSAT7 Ch8 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains Meteosat-7 thermal IR (channel 8) imagery over the DYNAMO region. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL and are in jpg format.

dataset.title: R/V Ron Brown Rawinsonde (hi-res) - Leg 2
dataset.description: This Dataset consists of rawinsonde data collected during the EPIC cruise of the NOAA Ship Ron Brown. Each datafile contains the ships location, the sonde's UTC release time, and a vertical profile of pressure, temperature, humidity, latitude and longitude, total wind speed and direction, and U and V wind components, every one seconds during the sonde's ascent. Consult the README for more information. Note:A new version of this dataset was provided by The University of Washington in September 2003. This version replaces the original dataset. The most significant difference between the new and old versions of the NOAA Ship Ron Brown Rawinsonde data is that the newer version contains corrected lat/lon positions.

dataset.title: NCAR CP4, C-Band Radar data set, cfRadial format
dataset.description: This dataset contains C-band radar data collected by the NCAR CP4 radar during the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP) from 13 July 1990 to 23 August 1990. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment 2 (IMPROVE 2) . These data are in dorade format and are available as tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data (Irish Bend)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Irish Bend, OR (ISS2) site during the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment II (IMPROVE-II). This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Oceanographer Radar
dataset.description: These 16 mm films include footage of radar from the US ship Oceanographer for Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: GCIP/NESOB-97 Surface: Momentum Flux Composite
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of momentum flux data from the NOAA/ATDD Little Washita site and the ECOR sites. It is composed of half hourly observations of average wind vector speed, uv covariance from the mean, kiematic shear stress, vw covariance from the mean, streamwise velocity variance, crosswind velocity variance, and vertical velocity variance. These data were not quality checked by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During DC-3 TEST, the GV_N677F flew a right-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-16 ABI CONUS Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of VORTEX-SE 2018 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the New England Winter Storms (NEWS) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MICROFRONTS GOES-8 WV Images
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (6.7 micron) satellite imagery collected for the 1995 MICROFRONTS experiment via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 8 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Webcam Imagery (Sounding Site at the Upper Orange Grove)
dataset.description: Webcam imagery collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at Sounding Site, which was at the upper orange grove in the center of the Vale do Cobrao during the Perdigao field project in 2017. This dataset includes 5-minute, southwest facing webcam imaged in jpg format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 16:22:00 to 2009-12-19 16:22:00.

dataset.title: VTMX: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - netCDF format (Morley, B. [NCAR/EOL])
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) netCDF format files obtained from a ground based platform during the Vertical Transport and Mixing (VTMX) experiment.

dataset.title: NCAR MGLASS QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Sierra Rotors Mobile GLASS sounding dataset contains 52 quality controlled soundings launched from various locations in and around Fresno, CA between 3 March and 29 April, 2004. These files are in the NCAR CLASS format, and have been processed with the Atmospheric Sounding Processing ENvironment (ASPEN). For more information about the data format and QC process, see the readme.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the First Aerosol Characterization Experiment (ACE-1). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/ATD 5 minute Quality Controlled ASTER surface and chemistry data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute Atmosphere/Surface Turbulent Exchange Research (ASTER) facility surface and chemistry data collected at the Sayreville Generating Station in Sayreville, NJ during the Combustion Turbine Plume Rise and Building Downwash Model Development of 1994 (DOWNWASH94). These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers are not tilt corrected and are in instrument coordinates.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Cabauw Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Cabauw 30 minute Flux Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the Cabauw station in the BALTEX Cabauw reference site. The Cabauw station contains the entire time period 01 October 2002 through 31 December 2009. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Channel 2 (Shortwave IR) Imagery
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Channel 2 (Shortwave) Sectored Imagery (GIF) is one of several satellite products collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase-II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project field catalog operated by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL: http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 4-km imagery from Channel 2 (shortwave; 3.90um) of the GOES-10 satellite. the products cover the period from 1-30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). The products are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). All images are in gif format.

dataset.title: Nicaraguan Daily Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This data set contains daily precipitation data from Nicaragua. Data are from 130 sites within Nicaragua covering the time period January 1990 to December 1994.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Evenness Summary Results
dataset.description: This dataset contains evenness summary results from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: NCEP Eta model 1000 mb Maps
dataset.description: NCEP Eta Model 1000 mb Analysis map images for the SGP97 period.

dataset.title: HS3 2013 Global Hawk Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NOAA/NASA Global Hawk dropsonde data from seven research flights conducted between 20 August and 19 September 2013 for the Hurricane and Severe Storm Sentinel (HS3) project. The GH is equipped with an NCAR/NOAA dropsonde system specially designed for remote operation. A total of 433 quality controlled soundings are available.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 1 Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES-8 imagery from the SALLJEX field project time of interest and area of interest. This dataset includes Channel 1 visual images for Bolivia, Argentina and Paraguay. SALLJEX was funded by NOAA/OGP, NSF(ATM0106776) and funding agencies from Brazil FAPESP Grant 01/13816-1) and Argentina (ANPCYT PICT 07-06671, UBACyT 055).

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During OTREC, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a right looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-11 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 4km Channel 4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2007-10-15 17:15:00 to 2007-12-31 10:45:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: Ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Park Falls, Wisconsin site during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. Raw ceilometer data are provided in both ASCII format and L3 netCDF files that include cloud and boundary layer analysis, as well as plots of the L3 data. These data have been reviewed for completeness and quality. Regarding documentation for the Ceilometer ASCII data: Documentation for the ASCII raw data files can be found in the Vaisala Ceilometer CL51 Users Guide (refer to page 60 CL51 data message section). Link to the document is found in the Documentation section below.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Sodankyla Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Sodankyla Hourly Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains hourly data from the single station in the BALTEX reference, Sodankyla station. This dataset contains the time period 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2008. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer Data (ISS3 York Airport Site)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the York, NE airport during the GRAINEX field campaign. This dataset includes raw ceilometer data in ASCII text format, L3 netCDF files, as well as plots of the data in png format. These data have been reviewed for completeness and quality, but have not been modified since preliminary release (v0.1). Documentation for the ASCII raw data files can be found in the Vaisala Ceilometer CL31 Users Guide (refer to page 63 CL31 data message section). Link to the document is found in the Documentation section below.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 14:52:00 to 2011-07-14 22:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 07:52:00 to 2009-02-01 19:22:00.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Scoresbysund (Greenland)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Scoresbysund in Greenland (WMO 04339) which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of the 5mb vertical resolution upper air sounding data from all sources for the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Thunderstorms Experiment-Southeast 2017 (VORTEX-SE_2017) project. The composite includes 1803 soundings from all VORTEX-SE 2017 sounding systems (Colorado State University, Mississippi State University, NOAA/ATDD, Purdue University, Texas Tech University, University of Louisiana Monroe, and University of Alabama Huntsville) as well as those from the National Weather Service.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Community Aerosol Inlet Evaluation Program - Phase II (CAINE-II) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: CAPE: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set contains 2 tar files each of cmf text files of Portable Automated Mesonet (PAM) station data from the Convection and Precipitation/Electrification Experiment (CaPE). 1 minute and 5 minute data are in separate tar files.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During PREDICT, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. The images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: The 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale domain sectors (MDS) during the period of PERiLS_2022 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The dataset contains all MDS sectors, not just those over the PERiLS region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg8 YPDN-PGSN Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 YPDN-PGSN Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 22:32:00 to 2011-07-14 15:32:00.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 FSSP300 Measurements of Coarse Mode Particle Concentration [Snider/UWyo]
dataset.description: The dataset consists of one readme file and 13 text files (one for each research flight) which contain measurements of the concentration of particles with optical diameter larger than 0.5 µm. Values are written to ASCII files as 1 Hz samples. These data were collected during the time period and area of interest of the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Atmospheric Forcing of Circulation in Gulf Of California (AFCGOC) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Flight Track Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the flight track imagery from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Paraparaumu
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Paraparaumu, New Zealand during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-09 23:00:00 to 2011-07-13 11:00:00.

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Algonquin
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data for Algonquin Park, Ontario Canada. This site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division(ATD). Soundings were typically taken either four times a day or eight times a day during IOPs,i.e. every three or six hours beginning with 00 UTC. This dataset underwent JOSS automatic quality control procedures. Since the soundings are loaded into the database by actual release times and the actual hour of release is typically one hour before the nominal time, when attempting to preview a sounding try the hour right before the nominal time first. For example: for an 18 UTC sounding, try using hour 17. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the SPICULE project.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-98 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, W.K. Kellogg Biological Stations daily precipitation, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the ESOP-98 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV flight track in real-time during the HIPPO-2 project

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, DMSP OLS 0.5KM Visible Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of F-12, F-13, F-14 and F-15 DMSP visible channel imagery. Observations are at a 0.5KM resolution and cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Channel 2 Shortwave Infrared Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-12 Channel 2 shortwave infrared satellite imagery from the time period of the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project. From 13 January to 16 February 2012, the imagery covers Antofagasta, Chile, where the NSF/NCAR GV was forward deployed, and the imagery from 17 February to 1 April 2012 centers on the Galapagos Islands, and the GV was based in San Jose, Costa Rica.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Macquarie Island
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken on Macquarie Island during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-12-21 22:15:00.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking north
dataset.description: North-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) experiment from 26 May 2015 through 20 July 2015. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Downward-Looking Digital Camera Photography [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: During the VOCALS project, the C130 flew a forward looking and a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during VOCALS flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains downward-looking images.

dataset.title: Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (GTCIMS) Trace Gases In Situ Measurements
dataset.description: This data set contains NASA DC-8 In Situ Measurements by the Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (CIMS) of sulfur dioxide (SO2), hydrogen chloride (HCl), and peroxynitric acid (HNO4) collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 18 May 2012 through 22 June 2012. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 ELDORA Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains swp file data from ELDORA on the NRL P-3 aircraft during the BAMEX project. Data are contained in 10 minute tar files.

dataset.title: SAS Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Southeast Atmosphere Study (SAS) project, including NOMADSS (Nitrogen, Oxidants, Mercury and Aerosol Distributions, Sources and Sinks), from May 30 - July 17, 2013. The chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other field project participants regarding data collection within the SAS-NOMADSS project.

dataset.title: ABRFC Stage III Precipitation Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains GIF images of daily precipitation in the Arkansas - Red River Basin. These images were derived from WSR-88D radar data and in situ measurements by the Arkansas - Red River Basin River Forecast Center (RFC) of NOAA's National Weather Service.

dataset.title: C-ToF-AMS (Carbon Time-of-Flight Aerosol Mass Spectrometry) Data
dataset.description: This data set provides chemical composition data for non-refractory, sub-micron (Vacuum aerodynamic diameter) aerosol gathered with the Aerodyne Compact Time of Flight Aerosol Mass Spectrometer. The measurements were made during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Layer Clouds (ICE-L) project.

dataset.title: CAMP: Mongolia Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Mongolia Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set. This data set contains data from sixteen stations in the CAMP reference site for the CEOP EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period. This dataset contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NCAR ISFF High-Rate Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset includes the ISFF High-Rate Data collected during T-REX. The data spans from the 23rd of February, 2006 to the 2nd of May, 2006. The Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) &#39;Specials&#39; Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) Surface "Special" observation surface data. This dataset is one of several surface datasets provided for the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study October 1999 (CASES 1999) project. The ASOS "Nominal" hourly surface data for the CASES 1999 domain and time period are included in the CASES 1999 ASOS hourly surface dataset. This ASOS "specials" dataset contains special or rare-event data from three stations within the CASES 1999 time period (25 September 1999 through 5 November 1999) and in the CASES 1999 domain (approximately 95.7438W to 97.7438W longitude and 36.6501N to 38.6501N latitude). No additional QC was performed by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Ranai Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) project. This data set includes 321 high vertical resolution (1-second) radiosonde soundings from Ranai, Indonesia. The soundings were typically released two times per day at 00, and 12 UTC from 9 September 2011 to 29 February 2012. The station used MODEM M2K2DC radiosondes. The soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. These data were intially processed by NCAR/EOL into the EOL sounding composite format and had a series of automated and visual checks applied. No data values were changed during these procedures. Those files were then processed by CSU where the RH data were corrected using the CDF matching method. See the readme for further information.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Forward-Facing Digital Camera Images (MSS) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains images from a forward facing cockpit camera on the flights of the NSF/NCAR C-130 during MILAGRO. See the companion dataset for movies compiled from the images.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies with data - Final [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During HIPPO-1, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were processed to include production data along the right side of the image and converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps. Note: The camera was not operating during RF09, ceased recording about 20min after takeoff for RF06, and did not start working until RF07 was nearly over.

dataset.title: ISS MAPR Site Surface Met Imagery [EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains surface meteorology imagery from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) sites during T-REX. MAPR is an advanced wind profiler radar developed to make rapid wind measurements of the boundary layer. The radar's antenna is divided into 4 vertically pointing sub-arrays for reception, and uses Spaced Antenna techniques to measure wind. As the atmosphere moves over the radar, the motion of the atmospheric echoes is tracked over the receivers to make a wind measurement. This data set contains real-time imagery files taken from the T-REX Field Catalog.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde 2016 Hurricane Matthew Data Set
dataset.description: The National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes at 00 and 12 UTC with occasional special releases at sites throughout the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled, Tropical Convection Intensification and Structure Experiment (TCI) NWS soundings released at sites that released special radiosondes during the course of Hurricane Matthew. Data are included from 20 NWS stations around the southeastern United States during the entire life cycle of Matthew from 28 September to 9 October 2016. A total of 604 quality- controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final TCI 2016 Hurricane Matthew data set.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Imagery
dataset.description: This data set consists of GOES-10 satellite imagery from the T-REX Field Catalog. The following four image products are included: 1km_ch1_vis, 4km_ch1 vis, 4km_ch3_water_vapor, and 4km_ch4_thermal-IR.

dataset.title: Digital Camera mpeg4 Movies [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During ADELE/SPRITE/HEFT09, the GV_N677F flew three digital cameras for in-flight video capture: forward, left, and right facing. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark were stripped and the remaining images were combined with a select set of data parameters from the flight level data into a video stream running at 15 frames/s, 1500 k bps data rate using the MPEG-4/h.264 (AKA "MPEG-4 Part 10" and "AVC") codec.Flight RF02, 3, 5, and 9 were night flights, so all images were dark

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of radiosondes collected from 7 sounding platforms during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) with data collected from 1 May 2012 through 18 July 2012. This project was conducted in the central United States. This dataset includes a total of 5887 soundings from the following networks: ARM Radiosonde Data (238 2-second soundings), NCAR/EOL MGAUS Colorado Sounding Data (31 1-second soundings), NCAR/EOL MISS Colorado Radiosonde Data (27 1-second soundings), NSSL MGAUS Oklahoma-Texas Sounding Data (39 1-second soundings), National Weather Service (NWS) High Resolution Radiosonde Data (5520 1-second soundings), Redstone Arsenal Radiosonde Data (10 2-second soundings), and University of Alabama Huntsville (UAH) Mobile Alabama Sounding Data (22 1-second soundings). All soundings are provided at the highest possible resolution (i.e., the 'native' resolution).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer data collected during the Deep Propagating Gravity Wave Experiment (DEEPWAVE) from 30 May 2014 through 28 July 2014. This dataset contains both raw ceilometer data (*.DAT) and text files (*.txt).

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, AVHRR Channel 2 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12,14,15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 2 imagery. Observations are from the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .gif format.

dataset.title: Homestead Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the International H20 Project 2002 (IHOP 2002). This data set contains rawinsonde profiles from the Homestead site located in the Oklahoma Panhandle. Rawinsondes were released from May 12th to June 25th ,2002. The Homestead site utilized the National Center for Atmospheric Research Atmospheric Technology Division's (NCAR/ATD) Integrated Sounding System (ISS). This data set has undergone ATD and The University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office of Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) quality control procedures. Consult the README for more information about data format, contacts, and data quality control.

dataset.title: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) [NCAR/EOL/RSF]
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AMIR) measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Marine Stratus Cloud Tops project.

dataset.title: Mexico SMN-CNA Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Cumulus Photogrammetric, In-Situ and Doppler Observations (CuPIDO) project. This data set includes the high resolution vertical (2 second) rawinsonde data from the Servicio Meteorológico Nacional (SMN) Comisión del Agua (CNA), which forms part of the Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT). There are five stations that measure pressure, temperature, humidity and wind. There are a total of 93 soundings from the five sites: Empalme (22), Monterrey (3), Chihuahua (28), Zacatecas (5), and Mazatlan (35).

dataset.title: Invercargill Aero (93844), NZ, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and Rass Data (Sadorus)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Sadorus site in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1996. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-8 4-km WV CONUS Sector Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 4km resolution Water Vapor (6.7 micron) imagery collected for SGP97 in McIDAS AREA file format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the SO2 Oxidant (SO2OX) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Lihue
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Lihue, Hawaii during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR Water Vapor DIAL data
dataset.description: Profiles of absolute humidity and backscatter from the NCAR/EOL Water-Vapor Differential Absorption Lidar (WV-DIAL) during the Land-Atmosphere Feedback Experiment (LAFE). These data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) operated by NCAR from 1973-1977. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the GRAVE-I project.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ProgSci project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the WAVE project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: CAMP: Mongolia Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Mongolia 30 Minute Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the four stations in the CAMP reference site for the CEOP EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period, which are the BTS, DGS, DRS, and MGS stations. This dataset contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Small Cumulus Microphysics Study (SMCS). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 4 Imagery
dataset.description: This is the channel 4 imagery collected from the GOES-8 satellite during the EPIC time period.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Trappes (France)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Trappes in France (WMO 07145) which was operated by Meteo-France. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight times per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) CONUS Sector Data
dataset.description: The 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of TORUS_2022 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL MAPR Wind Profiler and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Inhibition of Snowfall by Pollution Aerosol in 2002. This dataset includes 5 minute consensus winds data (.windsnc_05), 60 minute consensus winds for some days (.windsnc_60), and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (rass_mapr). These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R NZCH Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NZCH Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-23 16:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies with data - final
dataset.description: During TORERO, the GV_N677F flew four digital cameras for in-flight video capture: forward, downward, left, and right-looking. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The image was first cropped to 512x384 pixels. The forward, downward, left, and right-looing images were combined into a single frame and flight-level navigation and state parameter data was added along the right. These 1-second annotated images were compiled into a video stream running at 15 frames/s, 1500 kbps data rate.

dataset.title: Oceanographer All-Sky Camera
dataset.description: These 16 mm films include footage of the sky from the US ship Oceanographer for Phases I, II, and III, as well as the Pre-phase, of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Topeka ASOS 1-minute Data
dataset.description: The ASOS site at Topeka KS provided 1 min resolution measurements of temperature, dewpoint, wind speed/direction,barometric pressure, altimeter, density altitude, visibilitysky conditions and precipitation (5 min). Data has under- gone quality control. This site was co-located with a PAM II Mesonet station that also recorded 1-minute data so that intercomparison studies between the two observing platforms could be performed.

dataset.title: CPPA: Oak Ridge High Resolution Radiosonde Data (NWS Site Nashville, TN)
dataset.description: This data set contains the Climate Prediction Program for the Americas (CPPA) Oak Ridge high resolution radiosondes for the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP). The data was collected from the Nashville,TN National Weather Service (NWS) upper air station and consists of six second vertical resolution profiles of pressure, temperature, wind speed, wind direction, relative humidity,and altitude from 01 October 2002 through 30 April 2007 and two second vertical resolution profiles from 21 May 2007 to 31 December 2009. The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did perform quality control processing on this data set. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS 5-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products - winds in planar geographic and tilt corrected coordinates
dataset.description: 5-minute surface meteorology and flux products collected by the EOL/Integrated Surface Flux System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. These data have been quality controlled and are available in netCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and corrected for the orientation of the instrument. The orientation and tilt corrections applied were determined by the using the planar fit method from Wilczak, Oncley, and Stage (2001). Data were collected from 11 sites (2 towered Supersites + 9 Satellite sites) located around Heber Valley.

dataset.title: GOES-7 IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 IR imagery collected during the GCIP/GIDS-1 period via PC-McIDAS and then converted to GIF image format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 SABL Green Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the SABL green imagery from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC)
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of cloud particle size distributions collected during the ESCAPE project using an airborne holographic instrument. The HOLODEC-II is a second-generation version of a holographic detecter designed to determine the size, two-dimensional shape, and three-dimensional position of hydrometeors via digital in-line holography.
