Advantages vs other hydrometeor detectors are that the sample volume is not size dependent, relative positions of hydrometeors in the sample volume can be determined in three dimensions, and effects produced by shattering from the aperture edges can be identified and eliminated. Automated analysis programs have been developed to process the holograms collected and produce size distributions. HOLODEC-II has sufficient resolution to determine the sizes and locations of cloud droplets as well as ice crystals.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: The DEEPWAVE project was a nighttime project, so imagery were not routinely collected. However, for the test and ferry flights, and the pre-dusk portion of RF15, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number GV_N677F) operated a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the Knorr (NOAA ship)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Knorr, a NOAA ship (ID knr). Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to 16 times per day (90 min intervals). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R AGGH Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains AGGH Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-23 16:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: NCDC Hourly Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This data set contains National Climatic Data Center hourly precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. Data from this source was quality controlled by JOSS.

dataset.title: METCRAX 30 second ISFS data, QC&#39;d, geographic and tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 second ISFS data from the Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX), from 24 September 2006 to 4 November 2006. These data are in NetCDF format, have been tilt corrected, and are in geographic coordinates. More information about the data source and processing can be found at the Project Documentation webpage in the related links. The Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 Carbon Monoxide Concentration (Kok)
dataset.description: This dataset contains carbon monoxide measurements taken aboard the NCAR C-130 aircraft during ACE-1 by Greg Kok (NCAR/RAF). The data consists of time (UTC), location, carbon monoxide (infrared absorption) in ppbv. These data were processed and quality controlled by NCAR/RAF following the field phase of ACE-1.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R NZCH Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NZCH Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-23 16:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL MGAUS QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 22 quality-controlled radiosonde data files in the EOL sounding format. These data were collected by the EOL Mobile GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding system (MGAUS) during the Multi Angle Snowflake Camera-Radar experiment (MASCRAD) between 14 Dec 2014 and 2 Apr 2015.

dataset.title: METEOSAT7 Ch10 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains Meteosat-7 water vapor (channel 10) imagery over the DYNAMO region. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL and are in jpg format.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Macquarie Island
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Macquarie Island during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-22 12:00:00 to 2009-01-22 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR King Air Video Camera Movies
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg movies from VHS tapes of videos taken from the KingAir during the STORMFEST 1992 project. Videos on each flight were shot in the forward and down directions.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the MAIR-E project. Files contain high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Satellite, DMSP OLS Infrared Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of imagery from the infrared channel of the F12, F13, and F14 DMSP satellites. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .gif and .jpg format.

dataset.title: GOES-13 4km Channel 6 12 Micron-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GOES-13 4km channel 6 12 Micron-IR satellite imagery for the DC3 project. The imagery are in JPEG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the MethaneAIR project.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data with Particle ID, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Band Polarmetric (S-Pol) moments data with derived Particle ID data in cfRadial format, from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX) from 15 May 2008 to 30 June 2008. Due to the size of the dataset, it is recommended that the user restrict data orders to one day at a time per order (~10 GB per day of data).

dataset.title: ISS PurpleAir Aerosol Products
dataset.description: PurpleAir aerosol measurements collected during the Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study (M2HATS). Sensors were mounted on the 10m surface meteorology tower and on the ISFS array.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Surabaya Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 365 high vertical resolution soundings from Surabaya, Indonesia (WMO 96935) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: GOES-8 IR Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (11 micron) satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1996 (ESOP-96) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: ISS PurpleAir Aerosol Products
dataset.description: PurpleAir aerosol data collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Sundowner Wind Experiment field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. Data were collected at three sites: (1) Santa Barbara County Fire Department, (2) Rancho Alegre, and (3) Sedgwick Reserve. Final data are reported in ASCII CSV files that are archived here as tar.gz files by site. Refer to the data report for details.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery - Galapagos Zoom
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Channel 1 Visible Satellite zoom imagery of Galapagos taken during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project from 14 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: Iquique GAUS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: During the VAMOS Ocean-Cloud Atmosphere-Land Study (VOCALS) campaign, an NCAR/EOL GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding (GAUS) system was deployed. This dataset is from the system located in Iquique, Chile, and the data collection was done from October 6 to November 15, 2008. A total of 192 high resolution radiosonde soundings were collected from the Iquique site.

dataset.title: GOES-7 WV Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 6.7 Micron Water Vapor (WV) imagery collected during the ACE-1 transect period via McIDAS-X then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of full-disk, 32 km resolution images collected every 6 hours. Digital McIDAS Area format files (8 km resolution) were collected hourly at OFPS from NOAA/NSSFC from which these GIF images were created. These images are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: GOES 12 4KM Multi-channel Imagery, Terrascan format
dataset.description: This dataset contains Terrascan format 4km resolution images from the GOES-12 satellite. Images are for the period and area of the START08 project.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the Aegir (Icelandic Coast Guard Ship)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Aegir, an Icelandic Coast Guard Ship (ID TFTA). Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to 16 times per day (90 min intervals). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: CAMP: Tongyu (Inner Mongolia) Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Periods 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Tongyu (Inner Mongolia) 30 minute Meteorological Tower Data Set for the cropland and grassland sites. This dataset contains the entire EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NOAA Wind Profiler Network Hourly Winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) 405 MHZ Wind Profiler Network (WPN) hourly data from 17 sites within the LSA-NW area of interest. These data consist of a series of hourly observations, each containing approximately 72 levels of wind speed and direction data. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS SODAR-RASS Data
dataset.description: Sodar winds and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperature data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. SODAR winds and RASS virtual temperatures have been quality controlled and are in NetCDF (*.avg.nc) format. Vertical resolution is 20m. Temporal resolution=10 min averages. Click on the 'Related Links' below that accesses the daily curtain plots. These data have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During DC3, the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (GV_N677F) flew a forward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: STORM-FEST 1-minute PAM II Mesonet Data
dataset.description: Nine PAM II stations were located near Senseca KS in the STORM-FEST boundary layer network, additionally another PAM II was collocated with an ASOS site in Topeka KS. Data consists of 1 min averages of temperature, relative humiditybarometric pressure, 10 m wind speed/direction and rainfall. This data was quality controlled by OFPS.

dataset.title: STORM-WAVE Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., Arkansas-Red Basin River Forecast Center, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers Precipitation data, Oklahoma Mesonet Precipitation data, and the precipitation data extracted from the STORM-WAVE Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Male Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 323 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from the Male, Maldives station. The soundings were typically released four times per day at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC from 29 September to 14 December 2011. Eight per day soundings were conducted on 28-29 November and 6 and 13 December 2011. These data were provided by Colorado State University.

dataset.title: Model MRF Surface 24 hour forecast [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains MRF model 24 hour surface forecast from 0000 UTC for the northern hemisphere including the SHEBA domain from IGES. Note: Product times reflect date and time of issuance, not valid time of forecast.

dataset.title: Constant Pressure Analysis Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains constant pressure analysis imagery collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: MTSAT Infrared Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains 30 minute thermal infrared channel imagery over the Western Pacific Ocean from MTSAT-2 up to 7 October and then MTSAT-1R. MTSAT-2 operation was stopped during this time due to image data processing failure at JMA. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL. The files are in jpg format.

dataset.title: FP1 ARM Central Facility Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) program routinely releases radiosondes at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC from its Central Facility located near Lamont, Oklahoma and during PECAN they also did a number of special releases typically at 15 and 21 UTC. This data set includes the quality controlled PECAN Fixed PISA 1 ARM Central Facility soundings released for the PECAN field phase (1 June to 16 July 2015). A total of 221 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (2-second) soundings are contained in the final PECAN data set.

dataset.title: FP3 NCAR/EOL Parsivel Disdrometer Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the precipitation, current weather, and particle observations from the NCAR/EOL Parsivel Disdrometer located at the PECAN Fixed PISA 3 site in Ellis, Kansas. These data are in a comma-delimited ASCII format.

dataset.title: TERRA/AQUA MODIS Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains images from the the TERRA MODIS NASA satellite which are taken from the T-REX Field Catalog. The following 3 image products are included: Vapor, COAMPS, and TrueColor.

dataset.title: Japan Research Vessel Chofu Maru High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC). It includes 75 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from the Japanese R/V Chofu Maru. The soundings were typically released two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) from 16 August to 14 September 2008. Additional radiosondes were released when there were active tropical systems. The soundings from R/V Chofu Maru were released in the area to the south of Kyushu, Japan. The raw sounding data were made available by the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). NCAR/EOL converted these soundings to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) columnar ASCII format and conducted a series of quality control checks.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Barrow
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Barrow, Alaska during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 12:00:00 to 2011-07-13 12:00:00.

dataset.title: ZEBRA GOES-E WSR-88D N42 N43 NRL P-3 Track Composite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains composite images of GOES, WSR-88D, and the flight tracks from NOAA-42, NOAA-43, and the NRL P-3 for storm-specific areas within the RAINEX area of interest. The images were produced during the RAINEX field phase for the flights on September 9, 20, 22, and 23 only.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the STREX project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Winter MONEX project.

dataset.title: SCMS Aircraft: C-130 Photography Video Camera, fwd
dataset.description: This dataset contains mpg movies from a forward camera mounted on the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft during the Small Cumulus Microphysics Study (SCMS).

dataset.title: GOES-East All channels 4km Atlantic Basin Data
dataset.description: This data set consists of 30 minute netcdf satelite data.

dataset.title: NCDC SAO Specials Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/ESOP-95 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Aviation Observation (SAO) "Special" observation surface data for the ESOP-95 domain. These are observations that are reported at off-hour times and report significant changes in conditions from the previous hourly reports. These reports can include all of the information shown in hourly SAOs, but more typically, report only portions of the data. A complete listing of the requirements to issue a "special SAO" are included in the Federal Meteorological Handbook No. 1 (1988).

dataset.title: GOES-8 Visible LSA-NC Sector Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1997 (ESOP-97) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 1 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes, and should not be used for detailed scientific analyses.

dataset.title: ISFF High Rate Tower Data
dataset.description: THIS DATASET HAS BEEN REPLACED WITH VERSION 2.0 ISFS TOWER AND ARRAY HIGH RATE NETCDF DATA. TO DOWNLOAD THE NEW DATASET GO TO: https://data.eol.ucar.edu/dataset/edit/129.005 ----------------------- This data set from the Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) during the Canopy Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (CHATS) contains High-rate tower data in netCDF files. The data of sonics, licors, hygrometer, and pressure sensors are 60 Hz rate data; while soil, rain, barometer, and TRH's data are in 1 Hz rate. Tower data begins March 17, 2007 at 20:00.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar miscellaneous data
dataset.description: 6 S-Pol tar files with scan images in gif format, a tar file with sun scans and a tar file with vertically pointing scans.

dataset.title: GOES-West Imager Thermal IR CH4 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-15 Imager CH4 Thermal IR Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 16 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT (1sps) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains airborne measurements obtained aboard the NRL P-3 during the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign. This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: Other: ARM NSA Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Global Energy and Water Cycle Experiment (GEWEX) North Slope Alaska (NSA) 30 Minute Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the two stations in the NSA reference site: the Barrow and Atqasuk stations. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV during the HCR Test project. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During CONTRAST (CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) flew a left-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo (JPEG) images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Note: Forward, Downward, and Right-looking images can be found in the companion datasets.

dataset.title: Lake Victoria Region METAR Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the METAR surface meteorological observations from stations in the Lake Victoria region of Africa. The data are in the METAR ASCII format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S- and Ka-band, all variables, DORADE
dataset.description: S-PolKa data for the Rain in Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The data set contains both S-only and S-and-K data, repackaged to include separation of un-tarred data into sonly and sandk directories.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Sodankyla Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Sodankyla 30 minute Tower Data Set. This dataset contains the complete EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 to 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: CP3 Doppler Radar DORADE format. Daily tar archives. [NCAR]
dataset.description: This dataset contains CP3 Doppler radar data collected during the STORM Fronts Experiment Systems Test (STORM-FEST) from 2 February 1992 to 12 March 1992. These data are in DORADE format and are available as daily tar archives.

dataset.title: CAMP: Chao Phraya River Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Chao Phraya River hourly Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This dataset contains data from 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment 2 (IMPROVE 2) . These data are in cfRadial format and are available as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 Composite Particle Probe Spectra (Baumgardner)
dataset.description: A composite size distribution synthesized from measurements with the C-130 PCHSP, FSSP-300, FSSP-100 and 260-X. Data collected on flights #4 - #28. This composite size distribution represents a reprocessing of the FSSP-300, FSSP-100 and 260-X measurements.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during the "Eastern Pacific Investigation of Climate" project which took place from 1 September 2001 to 15 October 2001. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV flight track in real-time during the HEFT10 project

dataset.title: Chat Logs [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains Chat Room Log files, hereafter referred to as "Chat," generated during the RAINEX field project. Chat represents the latest in technology for the operations of Field Projects. Project RAINEX Chat is developed and managed by the Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) at the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR), which is managed and operated by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). The Chat Logs are maintained as official, permanent Project records. These Chat Logs were reviewed by EOL and edited, if necessary and at EOL's discretion, to maintain the most accurate record for the Project. EOL and UCAR, however, disclaim all liability for the content or edited content of the Chat Logs.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the Marine Stratus Studies (MSS) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 IR (Channel 8) Raw Uncalibrated Data in NetCDF Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 km resolution Meteosat-7 Infrared (channel 8) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the NetCDF file format. These data are the raw uncalibrated units and are provided if you would like to generate your own calibration versus that in the provided calibrated data set.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Fort Fleur D&#39;Eppe
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the French ASAP ship the Fort Fleur D'Eppe. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Sabreliner Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the Sabreliner aircraft during Phases II and III as well as the Inter and After Phases. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the one minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale over the continental United States during the period of ICICLE operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the ICICLE region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Pre-BOReal Ecosystem Atmosphere Study (pre-BOREAS). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MNBBS ASOS/AWOS Surface
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/ESOP-98 Minnesota Bulletin Board Service (MNBBS) surface data for the GCIP/ESOP-98 domain and time period.

dataset.title: Radar Echo Top Graphics Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of radar echo graphics data for Oceanographer and Researcher for Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Darwin
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Darwin, Australia during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 12:00:00 to 2011-07-13 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Manado Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 361 high vertical resolution soundings from Manado, Indonesia (WMO 97014) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TI3GER, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: DC-6 Radar
dataset.description: This dataset includes 35 mm film of aircraft radar data from DC-6 during Phases I, II, and III. Phase is specified in the "Description" section on the order page. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 16:00:00 to 2009-12-21 22:15:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:00:00 to 2011-07-14 22:00:00.

dataset.title: MOCAWS Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Missouri Automated Agricultural Network (MOCAWS) Hourly Surface data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period (01 April 1999 through 31 March 2000). The GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain is approximately 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Miscellaneous Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes miscellaneous upper air data during Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Title, vessel(s), and phase(s) are noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: PAM/ASTER 30-Minute Surface Flux Data - ASCII format
dataset.description: Surface flux data collected by NCAR/EOL (formerly ATD) during the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study 1997 (CASES-97) project from 22 April to 22 May 1997. These data are in ACSII format at 30 minute resolution.

dataset.title: National Weather Service Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Profiling of Winter Storms (PLOWS) project. This data set includes 829 high vertical resolution (1-second) Radiosonde Replacement System (RRS) soundings from the seven National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the PLOWS 2008-2009 time period (1 February to 31 March 2009) and region (Aberdeen, SD; Davenport, IA; Green Bay, WI; Lincoln, IL; Chanhassen, MN; Omaha, NE; and Springfield, MO). Additionally, 109 high vertical resolution (6-second) MicroArt soundings from the Topeka, KS NWS rawinsonde station are included. For the 2009-2010 time period of 1 November 2009 through 11 March 2010, 2221 high vertical resolution (1-second) RRS soundings were collected. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC). The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: NCAR ISFF Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of 5-minute averaged data collected during the CuPIDO field project. The Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) is designed to study exchange processes between the atmosphere and Earth's surface. This includes the direct measurement of fluxes of momentum, sensible and latent heat, trace gases, and radiation as well as standard atmospheric and surface variables. With multiple sensors and data systems, measurements of horizontal and vertical gradients also can be made.

dataset.title: NOAA/NWS Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Physics of Stratocumulus Top (POST) project. This data set includes 121 high vertical resolution (6-second) soundings from the National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde station at Oakland, California for 01 July to 31 August 2008. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC).

dataset.title: GTS Surface Observation Plots Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes imagery from the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) Surface Observations taken during the BAMEX field project. These hourly National Weather Service (NWS) station plots include images of the entire BAMEX region as well as images of the northern and southern sectors.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During MethaneAIR, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Forward-looking camera images are available for Phase 1 of MethaneAIR (RF01 and RF02).

dataset.title: GOES-7 Infrared Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 IR imagery collected during the STORM-FEST period via PC-McIDAS and then converted to GIF image format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During CONTRAST (CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) flew a downward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo (JPEG) images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Note: Forward, Left, and Right-looking images can be found in the companion datasets.

dataset.title: GTS Regional Surface Observation Plots
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Surface: GTS Surface Observation Plots (JOSS) are available online. All data is in GIF format.

dataset.title: GOES-East Full-Disk Infrared Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES-8 imagery from the SALLJEX field project time of interest and area of interest. Images include channel 4 infrared imaging over the regions of the South Pacific and South America. SALLJEX was funded by NOAA/OGP, NSF(ATM0106776) and funding agencies from Brazil FAPESP Grant 01/13816-1) and Argentina (ANPCYT PICT 07-06671, UBACyT 055).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (King Air) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Remote Sensing of Cloud Water (RMM) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: 1997 Soundings from Cocos Island, Costa Rica
dataset.description:
A temporary GPS rawinsonde station was installed on Cocos Island, Costa Rica for PACS-97 by NOAA National Severe Storms Laboratory and operated by rangers from the CR Park Service.
These data were processed through automated and visual quality control.
The dataset includes pressure, temperature, humidity, winds and altitude taken at 2 seconds vertical resolution.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Egedessminde (Greenland)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Egedessminde in Greenland (WMO 04220) which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 16, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical resolution. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL dropsonde profile sounding from the NRL P-3 aircraft during the Hurricane RAinband and INtensity change EXperiment (RAINEX), which took place from August 27 to November 23, 2005. Profiles have been checked for quality.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4KM Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains Satellite GOES-12 imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: 4km_ch1_vis, 4km_ch3_water_vapor, 4km_ch4_thermal-IR.

dataset.title: CPPA: SGP Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Southern Great Plains (SGP) 30 Minute Flux Data Set. This data set contains data from 23 Extended Facility sites at the SGP reference site. This dataset covers the period 10 October 2002 through 31 December 2009. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 18:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR Micro Rain Radar (MRR) Snowbank Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains NCAR Micro Rain Radar (MRR) data collected at the Snowbank site for the Seeded and Natural Orographic Wintertime clouds—the Idaho Experiment (SNOWIE). The data are in readable ASCII format. Please see the readme for further information.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Channel 1 (Visible) Imagery
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Channel 1 (Visible) Sectored Imagery (GIF) is one of several satellite products collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase-II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project field catalog operated by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL: http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 1-km imagery from Channel 1 (visible; 0.65um) of the GOES-10 satellite. the products cover the period from 1-30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). The products are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). All images are in gif format.

dataset.title: ARM 5-Minute Surface Meteorological Dataset
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-97 ARM 5-Minute Surface Dataset contains data from the Department Of Energy (DOE) Atmospheric Radiation Measurement Surface Network in the NESOB 97 domain and time of interest. These data were not Quality Controlled by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: GOES 13 SouthEast 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 13 Southeast 1 km channel 1 visible imagery from the 2010 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) and does occasional special releases at other times of day (usually 18 UTC) from sites across the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released from 8 stations located within the Ontario Winter Lake-effect Systems (OWLeS) domain for the OWLeS field phase (1 December 2013 to 31 January 2014). The sites included are Albany (NY), Buffalo (NY), Detroit/White Lake (MI), Gaylord (MI), Green Bay (WI), International Falls (MN), Chanhassen (MN), and Pittsburgh (PA). A total of 991 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in this data set.

dataset.title: Central American Station List
dataset.description: This dataset contains a list of stations whose data are included in the PACS Central American data sets. This list includes station name, latitude, longitude, elevation, station type, observing network ID, and station id.

dataset.title: POES Antarctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Antarctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-23 15:00:00 to 2009-12-21 15:00:00.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the UK C-130 dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset consists of dropsonde data from the UK C-130 provided by the UK Meteorological Office. Dropsondes were taken as requested. These data underwent automated and visual quality control. These data include pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at approximately 1.5 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Decorah ICICLE Ground Suite
dataset.description: This dataset contains ground-based measurements collected from the Decorah ICICLE Ground Suite during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 27 January - 8 March 2019. Primary information included in the dataset are ground-based measurements of precipitation accumulation and rate, ice accretion, present weather type, atmospheric state parameters, winds, hydrometeor size distributions and velocities, and visibility. Data has been reviewed for quality and known data gaps exist due to power outages etc.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, AVHRR 1KM Channel 1 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of NOAA-12, 14, 15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 1 Imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are at a 1KM resolution and in .gif format.

dataset.title: Sounding data from TAO Tender Cruises
dataset.description: This dataset contains high resolution upper air soundings derived from rawinsondes released during the Tropical Atmosphere Ocean Project (TAO) and the Pan American Climate Studies Field Campaign (PACS). Consult the readme for more information.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of radiosondes collected from 5 sounding platforms (see Section 2.3) during the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment 2 (VORTEX2) with data collected from 10 May 2009 through 13 June 2009 and from 1 May 2010 through 15 June 2010. This project was conducted in the central United States and contains a total of 4697 soundings. The 2009 data includes 2578 soundings with 241 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Southern Great Plains (SGP) Central Facility (C1) site near Lamont, OK, 106 radiosonde soundings from two mobile GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) systems operated by the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR), 118 radiosonde soundings from two mobile GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) systems operated by the NOAA National Severe Storm Laboratory (NSSL), two high vertical resolution (2 sec) soundings from the West Texas Mesonet Reese Center, TX site, and 2111 soundings from 17 National Weather Service (NWS) sites (all but one have 1 sec vertical resolution, other is 6 sec). The 2010 data includes 2121 soundings with 182 high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Southern Great Plains (SGP) Central Facility (C1) site near Lamont, OK, 174 radiosonde soundings from two mobile GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) systems operated by the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR), 186 radiosonde soundings from two mobile GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) systems operated by the NOAA National Severe Storm Laboratory (NSSL), three high vertical resolution (2 sec) soundings from the West Texas Mesonet Reese Center, TX site, and 1576 soundings from 17 National Weather Service (NWS) sites (all but one have 1 sec vertical resolution, other is 6 sec). All soundings are provided at the highest possible resolution (i.e. the 'native' resolution).

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar and GV-HSRL lidar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) and High Spectral Resolution Lidar (HSRL) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) during the CSET (Cloud Systems Evolution in the Trades) project from 1 July 2015 to 12 August 2015. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar archives.

dataset.title: SOS92: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: The Southern Oxidation Study (SOS92) used a single Cross Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) station near Atlanta, GA. Three data files are written from each sounding with "i" representing a 5mb interpolation, "m" containing 1-second raw data and data flags collected during the sonde ascent, and "x" with 10-second intervals.

dataset.title: GOES-11 1KM Imager Data (TDF)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of satellite GOES-11 30 minute gzipped TDF files from the period of the PASE (Pacific Atmospheric Sulfur Experiment) from Christmas Island.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 14:52:00.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the ACCLIP project.

dataset.title: POES Antarctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Antarctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2010-03-22 12:00:00 to 2010-04-20 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Miscellaneous Analysis
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of miscellaneous analysis from various data during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Title, vessel(s), and phase are noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: MIST: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from 41 PAM stations near the Huntsville, Alabama airport. Data is from the MIST experiment.

dataset.title: SOAS NWS Site NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: This data set contains ceilometer data collected at the Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) NWS site during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS) from 20 May 2013 to 16 July 2013. Both the raw reflectivity data (DAT files) and a derived significant layer product (text files) are provided together in this data set.

dataset.title: CAMP: Northeast Thailand Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Periods 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and 4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Northeast Thailand Hourly Meteorological Tower Data Set. This dataset contains all of the EOP-3 and EOP-4 time periods (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NIDS KUDX Hourly Precipitation (PRE1) Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Nexrad Information Dissemination Service (NIDS) Hourly Precipitation Data Set. This data set is the 1-hour surface rainfall accumulation running total product and is generated when ever precipitation echoes are detected. It covers a range of 230 km with a resolution of 1.1 by 1.1 nmi. It is updated once every volume scan (typically every 5-10 min) and includes 16 data levels. Data are available for most periods during the UMRBPP (5 April to 5 May 1999). Data are available from the Rapid City, SD (KUDX) radar site. These data are in the original NIDS format. These data were not quality quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). This data set is quite large both in terms of size (40 Mb) and in terms of number of files (4500). Please take this into consideration when placing your data order.

dataset.title: Eta MOLTS Derived Soundings
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-95 Eta MOLTS Derived Soundings data set contains NCEP Eta Model Location Time Series (MOLTS) derived soundings from up to 497 locations over North America. These output are only for the initial analysis time (i.e. no forecast derived soundings) and only the state parameters (pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, and wind direction). The complete output (including hourly forecast derived soundings with all surface and upper level parameters) in the original BUFR format are available from NCAR/SCD.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Hilo
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Hilo, Hawaii during HIPPO-2. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: GMS-5 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: GMS-5 Visible (VIS) imagery collected during ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology, then converted to GIF image format. These images consist of the Southern Ocean (image center 49 deg S, 142 deg E), 4 km resolution, collected every hour. Digital McIDAS Area Format data files were collected hourly at OFPS from which these GIF images were created.

dataset.title: WiFE: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) [NCAR/EOL/RSF]
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Wild Fires Experiment. Files are tar files of AIMR fld files.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the second phase of the Fluxes Over Snow Surfaces (FLOSS-II) project that took place near Walden, CO in 2002-03. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have not been tilt corrected and remain in a corrdinate system relative to the sensor.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:52:00.

dataset.title: STAR Surface Meteorological Observation
dataset.description: This dataset contains the surface weather conditions for the stations surrounding the Storm Studies in the Arctic (STAR) project location. There were about 15-17 stations data archived once a day.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Visible, Thermal, Water Vapor Products
dataset.description: This dataset consists of visual and thermal data in jpeg images of GOES products from the PRE-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. This data covers July through October of 2010.

dataset.title: Wyoming&#39;s Remote Weather Information System (RWIS) Hourly Data in QC format
dataset.description: The Wyoming's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) Hourly data in QC format dataset is one of several datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. Data from this source has been converted to Quality Control format, but no Quality Control has been performed by UCAR/JOSS. See the README for additional information.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data with Particle ID, DORADE
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) moments data with derived Particle ID in the Dopplar Radar Data Exchange (DORADE) format, from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX). Due to the size of the dataset, it is recommended that the user restrict data orders to a few hours at a time per order (~.75 GB per hour of data).

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 14:30:00.

dataset.title: Station List
dataset.description: The North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME) 2004 Data sets contain data collected from over 38000 stations in the NAME Tier 3 domain and time period. The station information provided defines each station in the NAME datasets with station location, name, frequency of observation, etc.

dataset.title: HARP: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP).

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During DC3, the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (GV_N677F) flew a right-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the JASIN project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: MP4 NCAR/EOL QC Soundings
dataset.description: This dataset contains 113 quality-controlled radiosonde data files, in the EOL sounding format. These data were collected during the PECAN field campaign by the EOL Mobile GPS Atmospheric Upper-Air Sounding System (MGAUS). The MGAUS was generally collocated with the Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS), and these were collectively know as Mobile PECAN Integrated Sounding Array 4 (MP4) during the project.

dataset.title: Belize City, Belize Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). It includes 17 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from the Belize City site in Belize (WMO 78583). Soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC) from 1 Sept to 9 Sept 2005.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Coastally Trapped Waves (CTW) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: P-3 ELDORA data - DORADE-format sweep (SWP) files [(NCAR/EOL)]
dataset.description: The Electra Doppler Radar (ELDORA) is an airborne, dual beam, meteorological research radar developed jointly by NCAR and France's Centre de Recherches en Physique de L'Environnement Terrestre et Planetaire (CRPE). The ELDORA radar operated on the NRL-P3 aircraft. The data are in DORADE (Doppler Radar Exchange) sweep files tarred into 10 minute chunks.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of the highest vertical resolution (i.e. the "native resolution") upper air sounding data from all sources for the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Thunderstorms Experiment-Southeast 2017 (VORTEX-SE_2017) project. The composite includes 1803 soundings from all VORTEX-SE 2017 sounding systems (Colorado State University, Mississippi State University, NOAA/ATDD, Purdue University, Texas Tech University, University of Louisiana Monroe, and University of Alabama Huntsville) as well as those from the National Weather Service.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the TI3GER project.

dataset.title: USAF C-130 NCAR/EOL Dropsonde High Resolution Data
dataset.description: During ITOP 2010 two USAF C-130 aircraft deployed EOL/AVAPS Dropsondes in 26 flights over the Western Pacific Ocean during the months of August, September, and October 2010. This data set includes the high resolution (0.25 second winds and 0.5 second pressure, temperature and humidity) USAF C-130 dropsonde data set in the EOL columnar ASCII sounding format. This data set has undergone NCAR/EOL quality control. See the readme for details on the QC process and data quality issues.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: Surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Advection Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (AHATS). These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: WSR-88D NIDS Individual Radar Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NEXRAD imagery for cities in the BAMEX region. This dataset contains over 22,000 images. The observing frequency is inconsistent but in some cases there is an image for every minute of the day. Additional information is available at the NEXRAD / Unidata website.

dataset.title: Skin Temperature Composite
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-97 Surface: Skin Temperature Composite dataset is composed of 30 minute observations of skin temperaturesderived from 3 sources. These are: Department of Energy (DOE) Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Solar and Infrared Radiation Observing System (SIROS) 10M and 25M, and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration NOAA/Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division (ATDD) long term flux monitoring site located in the Little Washita Watershed. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). Standard deviations are included.

dataset.title: NCAR GLASS (Loreto) Time Series Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains time series imagery from the NCAR GLASS site in Loreto, Mexico. NOTE: These images were developed based on real-time preliminary data. These soundings contained a daytime dry bias (see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH).

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data in NetCDF format which were collected during the MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidars (MPD) for studying the atmospheric impacts of the total solar eclipse in 2024 (NY-ECLIPSE-2024) projects. Three MPDs were deployed to New York State, USA, for this field project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: Ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Farm Field site (ISS2) during the SAVANT field campaign. These data were collected by a Vaisala CL-51 ceilometer and are available in both raw ASCII format and as level 3 data in NetCDF format generated by Vaisala's BLView software. In addition, both 4-hour and daily plots of these data are available for download within this dataset. When requesting data to download, please select the format you desire from the dropdown menu (data in ASCII or NetCDF, or plots in PNG).

dataset.title: BAQ: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is from 3 PAM stations near Boulder, Colorado during the winter Boulder Air Quality (BAQ) experiment.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Low-rate Quality Controlled ISFF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains low-rate variables from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected during the Investigation of Sulfur Chemistry in the Antarctic Troposphere (ISCAT) project that ocurred in 2000. These data are in NetCDF format and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: CAMP: Korean Peninsula Surface Meteorological and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Korean Peninsula Surface Meteorological and Radiation data set. This dataset contains the first half of the EOP-3 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 March 2003). There is only one station in this dataset. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: NCDC DATSAV Surface &quot;Specials&quot; Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) DATSAV3 Surface "specials" data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: VORTEX-94 GOES-7 1-km VIS Images (GIF)
dataset.description: Digital GOES-7 1-km visible imagery for selected case days during VORTEX-94. Also includes 2-km data for all project days. These data are in GIF format for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa site WebCam images, looking east
dataset.description: Daily tar files of jpg images taken every 6 seconds during a 14 hour period. These images are from the East facing camera of the four cameras mounted at the NCAR S-PolKa Radar When ordering data, please be aware that each daily tar file is approximately 525 MB.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During SOCRATES, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number GV_N677F) flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine (linux), and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: DLR Falcon NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL Dropsondes released from the DLR Falcon aircraft during the T-PARC (THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign 2008) experiment (25 August to 1 October 2008). The DLR Falcon was based out of Atsugi Naval Air Station located near Tokyo, Japan. These data have been quality controlled by NCAR/EOL and are in the EOL Sounding Format (columnar ASCII).

dataset.title: Small Ice Detector Version 2 (SID-2H) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains SID2H data collected during the ICE-L project. The Small Ice Detector, Version 2 (SID2H) is a particle light-scattering instrument for measuring size distributions of particles in the 1 to 70 micrometer size range and for discriminating between ice crystals and supercooled water droplets in mixed phase clouds. SID2H measures the intensity of light scattered by cloud particles in the forward direction. Measurements are recorded for each particle that crosses the instrument's laser beam. The SID2H data files are binary and come in 10-minute blocks; a new file is created every 10 minutes. Data records include timing events, light scattering intensity, and housekeeping (temperatures, laser power, etc.). The file structure has a header, data, and a footer.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Products
dataset.description: Surface meteorology products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. Data are collected from two sites (1) Deer Creek Sounding site and (2) North Pivot.

dataset.title: CP3 Doppler Radar cfRadial format. Daily tar archives. [NCAR]
dataset.description: This dataset contains CP3 Doppler radar data collected during the STORM Fronts Experiment Systems Test (STORM-FEST) from 2 February 1992 to 12 March 1992. These data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar archives.

dataset.title: Millersville University Mobile Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: Millersville University operated a mobile radiosonde system during lake-effect systems on Lake Ontario. Millersville University operations were on the eastern side of Lake Ontario and in the Finger Lakes. This data set includes the quality controlled Millersville University soundings released for the Ontario Winter Lake-effect Systems (OWLeS) field phase (7 December 2013 to 28 January 2014). A total of 65 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final OWLeS data set.

dataset.title: GCIP/NESOB-97 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) Climate Prediction Center (CPC) daily precipitation data, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers Precipitation data, and the precipitation data extracted from the NESOB-97 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Aircraft Vertical Separation Standards Project (AVSSP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Sounder Terrascan Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Sounder Terrascan data from the GOES-12 satellite.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains daily precipitation data extracted from the SGP99 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative data for the SGP99 domain.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Surface Meteorological data at Hokitika
dataset.description: Surface meteorology measurements of the Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) at Hokitika on the New Zealand South Island west coast in support of the DEEPWAVE field campaign, collected between May 24 and July 28, 2014 local time (May 23-July 27 UTC). These data were collected every 30 seconds. No quality control measures have been applied.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset includes high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR Electra during Lake-ICE. The data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Seastar SeaWIFS Imagery
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Satellite: Seastar SeaWIFS ?Imagery? are available online. All data is in JPG format.

dataset.title: R/V Roger Revelle Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 635 high vertical resolution soundings released from the R/V Revelle between 29 August 2011 and 10 February 2012. This data set is the same as R/V Roger Revelle Radiosonde L3 Data (EOL Format) but with the format converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format to match the L2 DYNAMO sounding data sets.

dataset.title: SHEBA: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) [NCAR/EOL/RSF] - raw aimr format
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Surface Heat Budget of the Arctic Ocean Project (SHEBA). The tar files contain raw output files from field tapes.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Richness Summary Results
dataset.description: This dataset contains richness summary results from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of the highest vertical resolution (i.e. the “native resolution”) upper air sounding data from all sources for the Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study (SOCRATES) project in the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) columnar ASCII format. The data set contains 1888 soundings including the dropsonde data (109 soundings) from the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream-V HIAPER aircraft and the radiosonde data from the ships R/V Investigator (234 soundings), RSV Aurora Australis (208 soundings) and from 19 Australia, New Zealand, and Antarctica operational locations (1337 soundings).

dataset.title: GOES-West Imager Near IR CH2 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-15 Imager CH2 Near IR Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 16 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: This data set contains cloud data every 15 seconds from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Ceilometer station that was located on Diego Garcia for the DYNAMO project. These data were collected and processed by NCAR/EOL. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Model MRF 500mb 48 hour forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains MRF model 48 hour 500mb forecast from 0000 UTC for the northern hemisphere including the SHEBA domain from IGES. Note: Product times reflect date and time of issuance, not valid time of forecast.

dataset.title: DC-6 Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the DC-6 aircraft during Phases I, II, and III as well as the Pre Phase. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Low-Rate (1 sps) Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
