dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Texas HIPLEX project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the CO2 Instrumentation Test (CO2). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format. Flight PF00 is a Gust Probe Intercomparison test flight.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) CONUS Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of WINTRE-MIX operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Sodar-RASS Site)
dataset.description: Surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Lufft WS700 that was located at the southeast end of the Vale do Cobrao at the Sodar-RASS Site during the Perdigao field project in 2016-2017. This dataset includes 3m temperature, humidity, pressure, winds, and precipitation, collected every minute in NetCDF format. These data are considered quality controlled, as no changed were deemed necessary during the QC process.

dataset.title: ISS 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains 449 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Persistent Cold-Air Pool Study (PCAPS) field campaign. This dataset includes doppler moments data (.mom.nc) and 5 and 30 minute consensus winds data (.winds.*.nc) bundled into daily tar files. This was the first major deployment of the 449 MHz modular wind profiler, using an early 3 antenna prototype of the system. The data system was originally based on a PIRAQ radar processing card, but was replaced by a PENTEK radar card in December during the campaign. The files from each system are differentiated by piraq and pentek in the tar filenames. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) and does occasional special releases at other times of day (usually 18 UTC) from sites across the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released from 16 stations located within the Southeast Atmosphere Study (SAS) domain for the SAS field phase (1 June to 15 July 2013). A total of 1438 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final SAS data set. These data were converted into the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format (columnar ASCII).

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar time series data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research, HIAPER) (N677F) during Nor'easter project on 2 February 2015. This data set contains time series of the measured I/Q data. If you don't know what time series data is you probably do not want this data set. This data set contains raw measurements that have not and will not been modified. Note: Each data file is ~10 G large. Please do not order more than 3 minutes of data at one time.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV during ARISTO2017. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 micrometers. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NCAR GV during the DC3 project. These data have been converted to a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Forward-Facing Digital Camera Images [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains images from the forward looking camera of the C130 during the RICO project. The C130 flew a forward looking digital camera and a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during RICO flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains the forward-looking camera images.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - ICARTT Format
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the TI3GER project. Files contain low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in ICARTT format.

dataset.title: NOAA/NWS (6-sec vertical levels) Rawinsonde
dataset.description: This data set contains rawinsonde profiles from the National Weather Service (NWS) station in San Juan, Puerto Rico archived during the Rain in Cumulus Over the Ocean (RICO) project. During RICO, rawinsondes were released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC. The data files consist of vertical profiles of temperature, dew point, relative humidity, u and v wind components, total wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. The vertical resolution is six seconds. This data set has been quality contolled by the Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS). Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Sodar-RASS Data (Sodar-RASS Site)
dataset.description: This dataset contains final, non-quality controlled Sodar-RASS data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Sodar-RASS system that was located at the southeast end of the Vale do Cobrao during the Perdigao field project in 2016-2017. This dataset includes Sodar wind data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have NOT been quality controlled. This dataset is identical to the original dataset release that was marked as preliminary.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar time series data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research, HIAPER) (N677F) during OTREC (Organization of Tropical East Pacific Convection). The data were collected during 22 research flights which took place between August 7 and October 2, 2019, over the East Pacific and extreme SW Caribbean Ocean. This data set contains time series of the measured I/Q data. If you don't know what time series data is you probably do not want this data set. This data set contains raw measurements that have not and will not been modified. Note: Each data file is ~10 G large. Please do not order more than 3 minutes of data at one time.

dataset.title: Soundings Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: The upper air highest resolution sounding data for the Rain in Cumulus Over the Ocean (RICO) 2004-2005 domain (15°N to 21°N latitude and 75°W to 72°W longitude) are contained within this dataset. The dataset covers the time period 1 December 2004 through 31 January 2005. This RICO 2004-2005 Sounding Composite Highest Resolution Upper-Air Dataset contains 554 soundings from 4 sites.

dataset.title: VORTEX-94 10-second CLASS Soundings
dataset.description: The Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment (VORTEX) 10-second Class Soundings dataset contains the high resolution sounding data collected by NOAA National Severe Storms Laboratory (NSSL) and National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Fixed and Mobile CLASS systems in the VORTEX project domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 10 seconds. These data have been extensively quality- controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: ISS Radar Wind Profiler and RASS Data Products
dataset.description:
449 MHz, 915 MHz Profiler winds and moments, and RASS virtual temperature collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the M2HATS (Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study) field campaign in Tonopa, Nevada. All data files are in netCDF format. 915 MHz data are availlable through both standard and NIMA (NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm) processing. Moments are separate files provided by NIMA processing. Curtain plots of daily winds from the standard processing have been included. RASS virtual temperature are 5-minute averages run every half hour (in between times the profiler was in winds mode). The moment files are for each spectral averaging period (dwell), and are at about 20 second time steps. 915 MHz profiler datasets (30 min averages):
* m2hats_iss2_prof915Mhz_std_winds_v1.tar.gz
* m2hats_iss_prof915Mhz_std_plots.tar.gz
* m2hats_iss2_prof915_nima_moments_v1.tar.gz
* m2hats_iss2_prof915_nima_winds_v1.tar.gz 449 MHz profiler datasets:
* m2hats_iss2_prof449Mhz_30min_winds_v1.tar.gz
* m2hats_iss2_prof449Mhz_5min_winds_v1.tar.gz
* m2hats_iss2_prof449Mhz_moments_v1.tar.gz RASS datasets:
* m2hats_iss2_rass_5min_virtual-temperature_v1.tar.gz
* m2hats_iss2_rass_moments_virtual-temperature_v1.tar.gz

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR G-V AVAPS Dropsonde High Resolution Data, EOL format
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding data collected using the NCAR Airborne Vertical Atmospheric Profiling System (AVAPS) on board the NSF/NCAR G-V aircraft. These data were collected from 15 May to 15 June 2013 as part of the Mesoscale Predictability Experiment (MPEX). 426 quality controlled soundings are available.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Coastally Trapped Waves (CTW) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MISS 915 MHz Profiler Wind and Moments Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL operated the MISS (Mobile Integrated Sounding System) at various locations in the PLOWS domain for the 2008-2009 and 2009-2010 field seasons. The MISS took part in PLOWS 2008-2009 IOP-3 and IOP-4 and the 2009-2010 IOP-7-10, 14, 15, 17-19, 21, and 24 . Some data are also included from time between IOPs when the system was located near Champaign, IL. Wind and moment data are included in this data set. Profiles were produced every 30 minutes the system was operating. The data are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: POES NOAA AVHRR Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Advanced Very High Resolution Radiometer (AVHRR) imagery collected by National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's (NOAA) Polar Orbiting Environmental Satellite (POES) system for the East Pacific Investigation of Climate Processes in the Coupled Ocean-Atmosphere System (EPIC 2001).

dataset.title: NWS Six Second Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) project. This data set includes 457 high vertical resolution (6-second) soundings from 4 National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the T-REX region (Oakland and San Diego, CA and Desert Rock and Reno, NV) for the period 01 March 2005 to 30 April 2005. The soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC). The Desert Rock, NV station typically did not do releases on Saturdays or Sundays.

dataset.title: NEXRAD GLD (Goodland/Renner, KS) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Goodland/Renner, KS. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: ISS Radiosonde Data - Sedgwick Site
dataset.description: Radiosonde profiles launched by staff from EOL's Integrated Sounding System and the University California, Santa Barbara during the Sundowner Wind Experiment (SWEX) field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. Launches were made at the Sedgwick site.

dataset.title: Automated Weather Observing System (AWOS) 20-min Data
dataset.description: This data set contains 20 minute resolution surface meteorological data from the Automated Weather Observing System (AWOS). This data set covers the period from 1 May 2002 through 8 July 2002.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Black Butte)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Black Butte, OR (ISS3) site during the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment II (IMPROVE-II). These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: FP4 NCAR/EOL Ceilometer Backscatter Profile Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the backscatter profile observations from the NCAR/EOL Ceilometer located on the PECAN Fixed PISA 4 site at Minden, Nebraska. These data are in the Vaisala CL-VIEW format.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ASPIRE-TEST, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. No camera images were collected during RF01.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of TORUS_2019 operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: LIFT96: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format [Morley, B. (NCAR/EOL)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained from a ground based platform during the Lidars in Flat Terrain (LIFT96) project.

dataset.title: NOAA P-3 Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: The EPIC Aircraft:P-3 Meteorology Dropsonde Profiles dataset (NOAA/AOC) is one of several archived by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) in support of the Eastern Pacific Investigation of Climate (EPIC) project. The data were collected and provided by The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration/Aircraft Operations Center (NOAA/AOC). This dataset contains 0.5 second vertical resolution profiles derived from dropsondes released from the NOAA-P3 aircraft during EPIC. Dropsondes were released during aircraft flights on the following days: September 2001(3, 5, 9, 13, 16, 20, 21, and 28) and October 2001(3, 5, 6, and 7).

dataset.title: TI3GER Chatlogs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the TI3GER (Technological Innovation Into Iodine and GV Environmental Research) field project, collected from 01 April to 29 April 2022 onboard the NSF/NCAR GV (Gulfstream V) HIAPER. These data are available in a txt format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Quality-Controlled NIMA 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and Moments Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Dugway Proving Ground in Utah during the Instabilities, Dynamics, and Energetics accompanying Atmospheric Layering (IDEAL) field campaign. This dataset includes Doppler moments and consensus winds data in NetCDF format. These data have been quality-controlled through the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA) and are considered the final data product.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the CAESAR project. Files contain high rate (25 sps) navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV Dropsonde Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: During PREDICT the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream-V aircraft released EOL/AVAPS dropsondes over the Atlantic basin during the months of August and September 2010. This data set has undergone NCAR/EOL quality control, see the readme for details.

dataset.title: NEXRAD PUX (Pueblo/NEXRAD, CO) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Pueblo/NEXRAD, CO. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Tahiti
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Tahiti during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Ambon Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 363 high vertical resolution soundings from Ambon, Indonesia (WMO 97724) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: High vertical resolution radiosonde data from research and operational sources during the Sundowner Winds Experiment (SWEX) campaign converted into a common format (EOL Sounding Composite format which is a columnar ASCII format) are included in this dataset. The composite includes data from radiosondes and dropsondes from locations around the southwestern United States. The radiosondes were released by NCAR/EOL (two sites), University of California, Santa Barbara (2 sites), San Jose State University (1 site), National Weather Service (three sites), and the US Air Force (one site). Additionally, dropsondes released by NCAR/EOL from the NPS CIRPAS Twin Otter are included.

dataset.title: Model MRF 500mb analysis(0000 UTC) Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains MRF model analysis from IGES which are 500mb charts for the northern hemispshere at 0000 UTC daily covering SHEBA domain. Note: Product times reflect date and time of issuance, not valid time of forecast.

dataset.title: GOES-8 4-km VIS CONUS Sector Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible 4-km resolution continental US sector imagery during the SGP99 period in McIDAS AREA file format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Synoptic Observations
dataset.description: The GTS Three-Hourly Synoptic Observation Data is one of several surface data sets collected by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) as part of the IHOP 2002 project. Included in the data set are the global three-hourly synoptic observations. These data are contained in daily files which are in GEMPAK format. The data cover the period from 13 May to 25 June 2002. The data were acquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: NASA DC-8 Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL dropsonde data from the NASA DC-8 aircraft during the NAMMA campaign. 197 QC dropsonde soundings are available from 13 research flights off the west coast of Africa, between 6 August and 12 September 2006.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from theTropical Rainfall Measuring Mission, Large-scale Biosphere-Atmosphere (TRMM-LBA) . These data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar files.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Corozal Panama
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts collected at Corozal Panama during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-01-30 12:00:00.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Funchal (Portugal)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Funchal in Madeira (Portugal) (WMO 08522) which was operated by INMG). Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site camera images
dataset.description: JPEG images from four cameras mounted at the S-Pol radar site during the Prediction of Rainfall Extremes Campaign In the Pacific (PRECIP). The S-Pol cameras were located at the west coast of Taiwan and collected data from May 25 to August 11, 2022. The cameras pointed to the north, east, south, and west. Images were taken every minute.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL BuFEX 2005 QC Radiosonde Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains 167 quality-controlled radiosonde data files, in the EOL sounding format, collected at two locations near Lake King in Australia during the Bunny Fence Experiment in 2005. Eighty-one radiosondes were launched from the west site and eighty-six from the east site.

dataset.title: GOES-12 1km Visible Channel Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the routine and rapid scan 1-km resolution visible (channel 1) data from the GOES-12 satellite over the PLOWS region. The data format is netCDF.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: NWS Constant Pressure Level Plot Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Rawinsonde NWS Constant Pressure Plot imagery. Each day contains images for 300 MB, 500 MB, 700 MB, and 850 MB analysis at 00:00 and 12:00.

dataset.title: NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Surface Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the surface data collected from the three Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME) in Mexico. The three stations are Kino Bay (ISS3), Los Mochis (ISS4), and Puerto Penasco (ISS2).

dataset.title: SHOUT-2015 NASA Global Hawk QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde data from the unmanned NOAA/NASA Global Hawk aircraft during the Sensing Hazards with Operational Unmanned Technology (SHOUT) campaign, using a NCAR/NOAA dropsonde system specially designed for remote operation. These dropsondes were collected in August and September of 2015. A total of 107 quality-controlled soundings in EOL Sounding Format are provided.

dataset.title: NCAR REAL Lidar Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains Raman-shifted Eye-safe Aerosol Lidar (REAL) data collected during the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) from March 3rd, 2006 to April 30th, 2006. The data represent high resolution two-dimensional images of the atmosphere. The REAL lidar is unique because it is safe for use in highly populated areas.The data set includes tar.gz files spanning 30 minutes. Each hour's worth of data in netCDF format are contained in 2 tar.gz files totalling ~1.5GB in size.

dataset.title: Tethered Balloon Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of tethered balloon data from US ships (Researcher, Oceanographer, Dallas) for Phases II and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Vessel, phase, and flights are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Denver
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Denver during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [Beaton, S. (NCAR-EOL-RAF)]
dataset.description: During IDEAS-4 GV, the NSF/NCAR GV flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during IDEAS-4 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 59 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during RICO. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available.

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-97 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the NESOB-97 domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds up to 3000 m above the surface. These data have been quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to computerized consistency checks. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction and altitude.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the GAMETAG-78 project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Owens Sound, Ontario Canada
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data from Owens Sound ,Ontario Canada. This site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). This data set has undergone ATD and UCAR's Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of Owens Sound rawinsonde release times.

dataset.title: ISS Wind Lidar Data Products
dataset.description:
Vaisala/Leosphere Windcube and Halo Lidar products collected by the EOL Integrated Sounding System team during the Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study (M2HATS) field campaign in Tonopah, Nevada, USA. These include Windcube CF-Radial lidar parameters provided in individual netCDF files for each scan, and leased Halo lidar Stare scans in hpl ascii format. All data for a given scan type (i.e. Stare PPI, RHI, VER) are available for order as tarred, compressed files (.tar.gz). Quality controlled, daily netCDF files of Velocity Azimuth Display (VAD) technique derived wind profiles and 30-minute consensus averaged wind profiles are also avaiable for bulk order as tar.gz files. Lidar scans available for download: Halo datasets:
* m2hats_iss_lidar-halo-metek_stare_hpl.tar.gz (8Gb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-halo-uva_stare_hpl_202307.tar.gz (38 Gb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-halo-uva_stare_hpl_202308.tar.gz (129Gb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-halo-uva_stare_hpl_202309.tar.gz (98Gb) Vaisala/Leosphere Windcube datasets:
* m2hats_iss_lidar-windcube_ppi_cfradial.tar.gz (13Gb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-windcube_rhi_cfradial.tar.gz (272Mb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-windcube_ver_cfradial.tar.gz (281Mb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-windcube_vad30min_cfradial.tar.gz (4.4 Mb)
* m2hats_iss_lidar-windcube_vad_cfradial.tar.gz (85 Mb)

dataset.title: NOAA/NCEP WRF NMM Northern Plains Model Forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains the several forecast image products from the NOAA/NCEP WRF NMM model over the northern plains of the US. The products include 250mb heights/wind, 500mb heights/vorticity, 500mb heights/wind, 700 mb heights/humidity/streamlines, 700mb heights/vertical velocity, 850mb heights/temperature/wind, mean sea level pressure/1000-500mb thickness/precipitation, and surface winds/temperature/MSLP. The products are available every 12 hours out to the 84 hour forecast. The images were created by the College of Dupage. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 9 February to 30 March 2009 and 15 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Surface Specials Dataset
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Climatic Database (DATSAV3) Dataset reports for 10 stations in the SGP99 time period (1 July 1999 thru 31 July 1999) and domain (approximately 97W to 99W longitude and 34.5N to 37N latitude). This dataset contains only the "special" records for the DATSAV3 dataset. The nominal records are located in the SGP99 Surface: NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Surface Dataset. This dataset is provided as is and was not quality controlled by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during VOCALS. Summary data have been merged with the "NCAR C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT (1-sps) Data" These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Pangkal Pinang Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 297 high vertical resolution soundings from Pangkal Pinang, Indonesia (WMO 96237) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 5 October 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) 915MHz Wind Profiler NIMA Winds and RASS Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the three NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) during North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME) that occured during the summer of 2004 in Mexico. The three ISS stations are Puerto Penasco (ISS2), Kino Bay (ISS3), and Los Mochis (ISS4). This dataset includes NIMA-processed Doppler moments data (.momnc), 30 minute consensus winds data (.windsnc) and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rassnc) in NetCDF format. These data have been quality controlled by the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA).

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 13:07:00 to 2010-04-20 14:45:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (Marine Stratocumulus) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the FIRE - Marine Stratocumulus project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: US-C130 Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the US-C130 aircraft during Phases I, II, and III, as well as the Pre and After Phases. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Fires in Brazil (FIB) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: FP5 NCAR/EOL ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains webcam imagery from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Web Camera that was located at the Fixed PECAN Integrated Sounding Array 5 (FP5) in Brewster, KS. These data are in daily tar files.

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-96 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the ESOP-96 domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: DMSP Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset is from the Defense Meteorological Satellite Program (DMSP), and contains daily images taken between December 7th, 2004 and January 31st , 2005, in two swaths per day.

dataset.title: NCDC DATSAV Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) DATSAV3 Hourly Surface data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 micrometers. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) during the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades) project. The 2DS puts all flight data into 3 files, and the size of these files depends on the amount of time in clouds.

dataset.title: NCAR EOL ISS All Sky Webcam
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL ISS All Sky Webcam Imagery collected at the Hokitika airport in New Zealand during the DEEPWAVE project. Note: For days with more than one image, the user will receive a tar file of jpeg imagery.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 CORRECTED Pressure Altitude (Baumgardner)
dataset.description: C-130 Aircraft Pressure Altitude CORRECTED (by Baumgardner) The corrected pressure altitude was calculated using estimated values for current surface temperature and pressure rather than reference values from a standard atmosphere (see the readme file).

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Majuro
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Majuro Island in the Marshall Islands (WMO 91376) which was operated by U.S. National Weather Service. Soundings were taken twice per day (00 and 12 UTC) during the IOP. The data were processed through the automated, visual, and spatial quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at six second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: PACS-97 Upper Air Soundings from the R/V Ron Brown
dataset.description:
This dataset consists of sounding data from the PACS-97 (TEPPS; Tropical Eastern Pacific Process Study) cruise of the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Ship Ron Brown. Soundings were released from 2 to 12 times per day at various times of the cruise. The cruise started in Panama, went to 8N 125W, then San Diego, and finally to a subtropical location.
The cruise started 28 July 1997 and ended 6 September 1997.
These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 2 second vertical intervals.
Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data - 1 sps [EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean" project which took place from 7 December 2004 to 24 January 2005. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 Sample Per Second) production data set. The LRT Bitfile log lists times and dates of individual flights.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Cabauw Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Cabauw 30 minute Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from the Cabauw station in the BALTEX Cabauw reference site. The Cabauw station contains the entire time period 06 December 2002 through 31 December 2009. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: PCAPS ISS 915 MHz Wind Profiler NIMA winds, moments, and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Persistent Cold-Air Pool Study (PCAPS) between 01 December 2010 and 10 February 2011. This dataset includes doppler moments data (.mom.nc), consensus winds data (.winds*.nc), Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rass.nc) and RASS moments data (.rass_mom.nc) in NetCDF format. These data are tarred into daily files and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: WISP94: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This sounding data is from the 1994 Winter Icing and Storms Project (WISP94). NCAR's Cross Chain Loran Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) rawinsonde data consist of vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, relative humidity and wind speed/direction from a network of seven stations (6 fixed, 1 mobile). Data from each CLASS station is in raw ascii format in a single tar file. Data is ordered by station plus the mobile CLASS.

dataset.title: NEXRAD Frederick, OK (FDR) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes reflectivity and velocity imagery from the NEXRAD radar at Frederick, OK, from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. Both the 2009 and 2010 field phases cover approximately May through June for those years. The files are gif images. See the catalog link below to access the field catalogs.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Colorado Orographic Seeding Experiment - 1979 (COSE-79) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - NASA AMES format
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO-5. The data are in NASA Ames format.

dataset.title: GOES 12 SouthEast 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 SouthEast 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released at seven sites throughout the northern plains of the United States during the Chequamegon Heterogeneous Ecosystem Energy-balance Study Enabled by a High-density Extensive Array of Detectors (CHEESEHEAD) field phase (23 June to 12 October 2019). The data set includes one second vertical resolution data from six stations (1424 soundings) and mandatory and significant level data from one station (237 soundings).

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: This dataset includes Google Earth .kml files recorded by the NCAR GV during HIPPO-3. The data are available for 13 flights.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Denver
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Denver during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the one minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale over the continental United States during the period of SAVANT operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the ICICLE region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Chat Logs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the ACCLIP (Asian Summer Monsoon Chemical and CLimate Impact Project) field project, collected from 25 July to 01 September 2022 onboard the GV (Gulfstream V). These data are available in a txt format.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Full Disk Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 15 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) full disk sectors during the period of RELAMPAGO operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: ISFS 5-minute Tower and Array Surface Meteorology and Flux Products
dataset.description: This dataset is from the Integrated Surface Flux System (formerly ISFF) during the Canopy Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (CHATS) and contains 5 minute averaged netCDF files. The operations and measurements of the ISFS at CHATS are documented in the CHATS home page, at https://www.eol.ucar.edu/field_projects/chats.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data
dataset.description: S-Pol radar moments data collected during the Prediction of Rainfall Extremes Campaign In the Pacific (PRECIP) from 25 May 2015 to 11 August 2022. The data are available as 3-hourly tar files (~2-6 GB/file) in CfRadial format. The size of the whole dataset is 2T.

dataset.title: Oxford 10-second CLASS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: CLASS radiosonde profiles taken at Oxford, Kansas for the CASES-97 program. The site was operated by NCAR/Earth Observing Laboratory (formerly Atmospheric Technology Division). These soundings have been interpolated to 10 second vertical intervals. The quality control information is that provided by NCAR/EOL. UCAR/JOSS has not altered these soundings in any way. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the readme file for details.

dataset.title: GOES-East Full-Disk Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES-8 imagery from the SALLJEX field project time of interest and area of interest. This dataset includes full disk visual imagery for South America and the South Pacific. SALLJEX was funded by NOAA/OGP, NSF(ATM0106776) and funding agencies from Brazil FAPESP Grant 01/13816-1) and Argentina (ANPCYT PICT 07-06671, UBACyT 055).

dataset.title: GTS Surface Hourly Observations
dataset.description: The GTS Surface Hourly Observation Data is one of several surface data sets collected by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) as part of the IHOP 2002 project. Included in the data set are the global hourly (and special) surface observations. These data are contained in daily files which are in GEMPAK format. It may not contain data which was removed from the US GTS feed. The data cover the period from 13 May to 25 June 2002. The data were acquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Electra) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Experiment on Rapidly-Intensifying Cyclones over the Atlantic (ERICA) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the PHOENIX 84 project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GALE: Electra Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE). Included is rare subcloud layer footage of an extreme cold air outbreak on January 28, 1986. This dataset contains forward and left-looking video. WARNING: This is a big dataset. Each mpg file is about 1.3 GB. Each order can contain a maximum of 16 GB of data. For very large orders, it may be preferable for you to access these data via a loaner external hard drive. Please contact Steve Williams (sfw AT ucar DOT edu) for these very large orders.

dataset.title: ACE-1 Aircraft: C130 Photography video Camera, fwd
dataset.description: This dataset contains mpg movies from a forward camera mounted on the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft during the First Aerosol Characterization Experiment (ACE-1).

dataset.title: NCAR ISS2 915 MHz DBS Wind Profiler Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL operated three 915 MHz boundary layer wind profiler radars at ISS (Integrated Sounding System) sites at T-REX. These radars detect scattering from clear-air refractivity gradients (such as those due to turbulence and inversions) and from precipitation. Two of the three wind profilers were standard DBS (Doppler Beam Swinging) systems, one of which provided the data for the accompanying data set. The DBS profilers at T-REX were designated ISS2 and MISS and produced wind measurements every 30 minutes and also made a 5-minute RASS profile at 30-minute intervals. This dataset includes ISS2 winds, moments, and rass data.

dataset.title: SMILE: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the Shelf Mixed Layer Experiment.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Lihue
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Lihue, Hawaii during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 12:00:00 to 2011-07-13 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR Water Vapor DIAL data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL Water Vapor DIAL system data taken during the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) project from 26 May 2015 to 16 July 2015. The data are available in netCDF format as daily files.

dataset.title: GOES 13 4KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 13 4km Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the 2010 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Lidar Cirrus Studies II (LCS-II) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Imager 4 km All Channel Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 4km resolution all channel data over the southeastern United States from the GOES-13 satellite during the VORTEX-SE_2016 field campaign. The GOES-13 channels are visible (channel 1), near-IR (2), water vapor (3), thermal IR (4), and 13 micron (6). The data are in daily tar files that contain the data files in NetCDF format. This is a large data set, consisting of approximately 2.7 GB daily tar files. Please consider the size of the data set when making your order. You can order 9 days in a single order.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 Navigation and State Parameter Data
dataset.description: The RAINEX NRL P-3 Navigation and State Parameter Data is one of several datasets archived by the National Center for Atmospheric Research / Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) in support of the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX) 2005. These data were collected aboard the NRL P-3 aircraft during approximately 8 hour flights on selected days.

dataset.title: GCIP/EAOP-98 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, W.K. Kellogg Biological Station daily precipitation, USDA Agricultural Research Service NAEW daily precipitation data (Coshocton), Tennessee Valley Authority daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the GCIP LSA-E EAOP-98 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR G-V aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the NOREASTER project. The files contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: FIFE: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description:
This data set contains 3 tar files containing cmf text files from 8 PAM stations from the First ISLSCP (International Satelite Land Surface Climatology Experiment) Field Experiment.
Army Corps FIFE (CFIFE) station data is included though data loss is estimated at over 70% due ot in-field operation problems.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:30:00 to 2011-07-14 22:16:00.

dataset.title: Constant Pressure Level Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains constant pressure level imagery based on the GTS radiosonde data in the western Pacific Ocean region. Images are available at the 300, 500, 700, 850 and 925 mb levels at 0000 and 1200 UTC. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL and and are in gif format.

dataset.title: WSR-88D Base Reflectivity Imagery
dataset.description: his data set contains base reflectivity imagery from the WSR-88D radars located in the PLOWS domain. During the PLOWS 2008-2009 period the radars included are La Crosse WI (ARX), Milwaukee WI (MKX), Davenport IA (DVN), Lincoln IL (ILX), Chicago IL (LOT), Indianapolis IN (IND), Webster IN (IWX), Evansville, IN (VWX), and St. Louis MO (LSX). These images were produced by the College of DuPage. For the PLOWS 2009-2010 period the radars included those above as well as others depending on where operations were occurring. The other radars are available at various times are Birmingham AL (BMX), Columbia SC (CAE), Cleveland OH (CLE), Jackson MS (DGX), Denver CO (FTG), Dallas/Ft. Worth TX (FWS), Goodland KS (GLD), Green Bay WI (GRB), Columbus AFB MS (GWX), Ft. Campbell KY (HPX), Hytop AL (HTX), Wilmington OH (ILN), Jackson KY (JKL), North Platte NE (LNX), Louisville KY (LVX), Marquette MI (MQT), Knoxville TN (MRX), Memphis TN (NQA), Omaha NE (OAX), Nashville TN (OHX), Paducah KY (PAH), Ft Polk LA (POE), Shreveport LA (SHV), Ft Smith AR (SRX), Oklahoma City OK (TLX), Topeka KS (TWX), and Hastings ME (UEX). These imagery were produced by NCAR/EOL. During periods when the NCAR C-130 was flying (and satcom was available) the flight track is included in the imagery. See the PLOWS 2009-2010 Field Catalog to see when imagery for particular sites are available. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 11 February to 30 March 2009 and 20 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During TORERO, the GV_N677F flew a downward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (GTCIMS) PAN and PPN In Situ Measurements
dataset.description: This data set contains NASA DC-8 In Situ Measurements by the Georgia Tech Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (CIMS) of peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) and peroxyl propionyl nitrate (PPN) collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 18 May 2012 through 22 June 2012. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4km Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-12 4km resolution visible channel satellite imagery over the PLOWS region. The routine 15-minute imagery as well as any rapid scan imagery are included. The images were created by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 12 January to 31 March 2009 and 1 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: PACE: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This data set contains a single tar file with all the sounding data from the single Cross Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System station located near Champaign, Illinois taken during the Summer of 1989. Files are in binary format.

dataset.title: Aircraft Flux Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft flux data (UK-C130, Electra, DC-6) for Phases I, II, and III during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase and vessel(s) are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: FASTEX High Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set consists of a composite of all FASTEX sounding data at their "native" resolution, i.e. the highest possible resolution. It includes sounding data from 45 platforms including land and ship based sites as well as dropsondes from aircraft. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the README file for details. Refer to the individual station README files for details on the processing conducted on individual sites.

dataset.title: GOES-13 4km Channel 2 Near-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GOES-13 4km Channel 2 Near-IR satellite imagery for the DC3 project. The imagery are in JPEG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Imager 1km Channel 1 (Visible) Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1km resolution visible channel data over the southeastern United States from the GOES-13 satellite during the VORTEX-SE_2017 field campaign. The data are in gzipped McIDAS AREA format files. This is a large data set, consisting of approximately 6 GB daily. Please consider the size of the data set when making your order. You can order 4 days in a single order.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/EAOP-99 6 second NWS soundings data set contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART sounding systems at fourteen sites over the GCIP LSA-East region. The data set contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality controlled, with every sounding subject to automated consistency checks. No visual examination was conducted on these soundings. Refer to the README file for more details.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Aircraft Vertical Separation Standards Project (AVSSP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Precipitation (Daily) Multi-Network Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., Minnesota Precipitation Network daily precipitation, National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the BAMEX_2003 Mesonet: Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings derived from NOAA P-3 flight level data
dataset.description: This dataset consists of soundings derived from National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) NOAA-42 and NOAA-43 flight level data. Data were taken at events of opportunity. The data were processed through the visual quality control process. No automated or spatial quality control were conducted on this dataset. The dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at one second intervals along the flight path. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: GOES-East 3-hourly 1km Visible Channel Area Files SE Pacific
dataset.description: This dataset contains MCIDAS area files of GOES-8 Satellite data at 1 kilometer resolution. The data are tarred into dayfile. The data cover the period from 1 Sept - 23 Oct 2001 (2001d244-296)

dataset.title: NIWOT07 Hydra data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 minute ISFS data in NetCDF format from the Hydra, a CO2 measurement system, capable of multiplexed sampling of 18 inlets and four calibration gases during the NIWOT07 field campaign. NIWOT07 was an NSF-supported project to investigate the use of sensor networks for biogeoscience research, conducted by NCAR and CU at the Univ. Colo. Flux Facility (CUFF) in the Univ. Colo. Mountain Research Station (MRS). This data has not been QC'd or tilt corrected. For more information please visit the project homepage.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4km Five Channel Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the routine and rapid scan 4-km resolution five channel data from the GOES-12 satellite over the PLOWS region. The channels are: Channel 1 (Visible), Channel 2 (near-IR), Channel 3 (water vapor), channel 4 (thermal IR), and channel 6 (12-micron IR). The data format is netCDF.

dataset.title: Shortwave and Longwave Radiation Composite
dataset.description: ARM SGP SIROS data, ARM SGP SIRS data, ARM SGP BSRN data, ARM SGP 25m MFR data, and HPCN data have been composited together into one data set. This data set is composed of 30-minute averages of observations taken either at 20 seconds (SIROS, SIRS and MFR) or 60 seconds (BSRN); or hourly data (HPCN). The SIROS and SIRS data contains observations of Upwelling and Downwelling Longwave and Shortwave Irradiance. The BSRN data has Downwelling Longwave and Shortwave; the MFR network contains Upwelling Longwave and Shortwave Irradiance; and the HPCN contains solar radiation equivalent to Downwelling Shortwave. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale sectors during the period of WINTRE-MIX operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution.The actual sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the WINTRE-MIX region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Aircraft Vertical Separation Standards Project (AVSSP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: FABLE 2000 NCAR/ATD 915MHz Wind Profiler Moments, Winds, and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the WLEF-TV tower in Park Falls, Wisconsin during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 2000. This dataset includes Doppler moments, 30 minute consensus winds data, and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled. Note: Latitude and longitude locations in data files may be inaccurate.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the ASPIRE project.

dataset.title: GOES-13 1km Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery - Alabama
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 1km Channel 1 Visible satellite imagery for the Alabama area of interest. The imagery are in JPEG format. This imagery was taken during the DC3 Project and covers the time span from 2012-05-01 00:00:00 to 2012-06-30 23:59:59.

dataset.title: NCDC SAO Specials Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the STORM-WAVE National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Aviation Observation (SAO) "Special" observation surface data for the STORM-WAVE domain.

dataset.title: NOAA POES AVHRR 5-channel Imagery
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Satellite: POES (NOAA-12,14,16) AVHRR 5-channel ?Imagery? (JOSS) are online data. All data is in JPG format.

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC)
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of cloud particle size distributions collected during the SPICULE project using an airborne holographic instrument mounted on the GV. The HOLODEC-II is a second-generation version of a holographic detecter designed to determine the size, two-dimensional shape, and three-dimensional position of hydrometeors via digital in-line holography. Advantages vs other hydrometeor detectors are that the sample volume is not size dependent, relative positions of hydrometeors in the sample volume can be determined in three dimensions, and effects produced by shattering from the aperture edges can be identified and eliminated. Automated analysis programs have been developed to process the holograms collected and produce size distributions. HOLODEC-II has sufficient resolution to determine the sizes and locations of cloud droplets as well as ice crystals.

dataset.title: 10m Towers at Sites 1-6, Low Sample-Rate Data
High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Alpine Experiment (ALPEX) project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Flight-Level Data - NASA AMES format
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO-3. The data are in NASA Ames format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 1km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 1km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2007-10-16 13:00:00 to 2007-12-31 00:00:00.

dataset.title: FABLE 1999 NCAR/ATD Wisconsin Site 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the WLEF-TV tower in Park Falls, Wisconsin during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 1999. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data files have been tarred into montly files for RASS and each of the profiler's operation modes (high and low). These data have not been quality controlled. Note: The latitude in the data files is indicated as being negative, while the actual location of the ISS was in Wisconsin. In addition, the latitudes and longitudes may be off slightly in general.

dataset.title: SMEX02: C-130 Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR C-130 aircraft during the Soil Moisture Experiments in 2002 (SMEX02). This dataset contains video of TF01.

dataset.title: NCAR Sodar and RASS Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This is daily SOnic Detection And Ranging (SODAR) data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) data taken in the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) from March 3, 2006 to April 19, 2006. The equipment was located at the Independence Airport Site. The data is in netCDF format.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the MethaneAIR project, including high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: R/V Baruna Jaya Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes 58 high vertical resolution (2 sec) soundings from the R/V Baruna Jaya III collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011. Soundings were typically released at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC from 5-18 December 2011. For most of these soundings R/V Baruna Jaya III was on station at 95E and 7S. These data were converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format. The station used Vaisala RS92-SGPD radiosondes. The ground station software was Digicora III/MW31/ver3.61. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. The L3 version of the data set had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU. This L3.1 version of this data set has had an additional correction applied by JAMSTEC for deck heating effects.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During CAESAR, the NSF/NCAR C-130 flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. The images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds to 59 minutes 59 seconds after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NDARB Daily Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: The North Dakota Atmospheric Resource Board (NDARB) daily precipitation data in QC format is one of several precipitation datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. Data from this source was quality controlled, please see the README for additional information. This dataset contains the available data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period (01 April 1999 through 31 March 2000). The GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain is approximately 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude.

dataset.title: ACME: C130 Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset contains mpg movies from VHS tapes of videos taken from the NCAR C130 during the ACME project. Videos on each flight were shot in the forward, left and downward directions.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT (25 sps) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the VAMOS Ocean Cloud Atmosphere Land Study (VOCALS) which runs 15 Oct - 15 Nov 2008. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps) production data merged with CVI and FO3 data.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the ARISTO2017 project.

dataset.title: GOES-8 IR Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (11 micron) satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1995 (ESOP-95) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes, and should not be used for detailed scientific analyses.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Texas 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Texas 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-03 14:00:00 to 2011-10-12 01:00:00.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Surabaya Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 365 high vertical resolution soundings from Surabaya, Indonesia (WMO 96935) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: DOTSTAR ASTRA NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: During ITOP the National Taiwan University DOTSTAR Astra jet released a total of 94 dropsondes in six flights over the Pacific Ocean near Taiwan during the months of August, September, and October 2010. This data set includes the high resolution (0.25 second winds and 0.5 second pressure, temperature and humidity) DOTSTAR dropsonde data set in the EOL columnar ASCII sounding format. This data set has undergone the NCAR/EOL quality control processing and includes the calculated vertical winds. See the readme for details on the QC process and data quality issues.

dataset.title: SHOUT-ENRR Global Hawk QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde data from the unmanned NOAA/NASA Global Hawk, using a NCAR/NOAA dropsonde system specially designed for remote operation. These dropsondes were collected during the SHOUT-El Nino Rapid Response (ENRR) campaign. A total of 89 quality controlled soundings are provided.

dataset.title: ISS Ceilometer CL31 Data Products
dataset.description: Vaisala C31 ceilometer data products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System group during the Sundowner Wind EXperiment (SWEX) field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. The instrument was mounted on the ISS3 trailer located at the Sedgwick site. Data are in daily raw DAT and netCDf format. DAT files are ordered as a single compressed tar.gz file. Included are text files that contain MLH (Mixed Layer Height) information. These files are ordered as a single compressed tar.fz file. Preview plots are available.

dataset.title: NOAA P-3 Meteorology Navigation and State Parameters - netCDF Format
