dataset.description: This dataset contains the NOAA P-3 State and Navigation parameters from missions flown during EPIC. These are the AOC derived (Type 5) data converted to NetCDF by UCAR/JOSS. The binary form of this data can be ordered here

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Jakarta-Cengkareng Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 356 high vertical resolution soundings from Jakarta-Cengkareng, Indonesia (WMO 96749) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Pohnpei
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Pohnpei Island in the Caroline Islands (WMO 91348) which was operated by the U.S. National Weather Service. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) during the IOP. The data were processed through the automated, visual, and spatial quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at six second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: QC ISFS 5 minute surface data, tilt corrected sonic winds in geographic coordinates
dataset.description: This dataset contains QUALITY CONTROLLED 5 minute surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected by 15 towers during the Vertical Enhanced Mixing Experiment (VERTEX). These data are in NetCDF format. The winds from the sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 08:00:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Eastern Pacific Investigation of Climate" project which took place from 1 September 2001 to 15 October 2001. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 Sample Per Second) production data set. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the CAESAR project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: WE-CAN Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Western Wildfire Experiment for Cloud Chemistry, Aerosol Absorption and Nitrogen (WE-CAN) project from 21 September 2017 - 13 September 2018. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the WE-CAN project.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Lerwick (United Kingdom)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Lerwick in the United Kingdom (WMO 03005) which was operated by the UK Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. However, for most of the 06 and 18 UTC soundings the winds were taken at only 20 or 60 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Corozal Panama
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Panama during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 12:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:00:00 to 2011-07-14 22:16:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the CYCLES-79 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NCAR GV-HSRL lidar data, NetCDF
dataset.description: High Spectral Resolution Lidar (HSRL) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) during the SOCRATES (Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study) project from 15 January 2018 to 24 February 2018. The data are in NetCDF format and are available as hourly files. This data set is intended for the expert user. The data is also available in CfRadial format at the link in the "Related links" section below. The NetCDF data is in a range centered format similar to that of the CfRadial data. However, the NetCDF contains data processing variables that are not necessarily needed by end users and does not have all its variables and metadata in line with the current CfRadial standard and cannot be read by display programs such as HawkEye. In general, data users should use the HSRL-HCR merged data or HSRL only CfRadial data linked below unless there is need for the underlying signals (and in those instances users are still strongly encouraged to contact EOL Data Support to ensure observational data provided is meeting the criteria of the user).

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Ship Track Close-up View (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of .png images plotting a close-up view of the United States Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy ship location and track during the SBI Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01).

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air sounding data sets developed for the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area - North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period 1999 (EAOP-99) conducted from 01 April 1999 to 31 March 2000. The LSA-NW domain extends from 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude. Included in this data set are 17 National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the LSA-NW domain. The soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC, however, several stations had additional releases. The final data set includes pressure, dry bulb temperature, dew point temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and direction, at 6-sec vertical resolution. Consult the readme file for further information.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During SPICULE, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Sensible, Latent and Ground Heat Flux Composite
dataset.description: NOAA/ATDD Little Washita flux data, ARM SGP EBBR data, and ARM SGP ECOR data have been composited together into one dataset. This dataset is composed of half hourly observations of latent heat flux, sensible heat flux, and the corrected soil heat flux from 5 separate sensors. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). However, included for checking the validity of the data are the Bowen ratio, the home_15 (Exchange Mechanism Position Indicator 1 to 15 mins) and the home_30 (Exchange Mechanism Position Indicator 15 to 30 mins). If values for home_15 or home_30 are corrupted, the latent and sensible flux fields should be considered suspect.

dataset.title: AgriMet Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The Great Plains Region AgriMet data Network (AgriMet) Hourly Surface Data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S- and Ka-band, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-PolKa data from the Refractivity Experiment for H2O Research and Collaborative operational Technology Transfer '06 (REFRACTT06) project . This data set contains both S-band and Ka-band data. These data are in cfRadial format and are available as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Composite 5-mb Level Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of data from all Bow Echo and Mesoscale Convective Vortex Experiment (BAMEX)sounding platforms interpolated to a constant vertical resolution of 5 hPa. Consult the Readme for more information about this data set. Some of the release times for the MIPS soundings included in this data set were corrected. See the documentation (bamex_mips_correction_record.doc) for more details.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (Queen Air) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Queen Air aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the Lake Effect Snow Storms - 1984 (LESS84) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R Leg6 NZCH-YMHB Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NZCH-YMHB Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-03 13:30:00 to 2011-08-16 20:32:00.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Kupang Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 349 high vertical resolution soundings from Kupang, Indonesia (WMO 97372) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Observation Plots Korean Area
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Surface: GTS Surface Observation Plots Korean Area (JOSS) are online data. All data is in GIF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL R/V Investigator ISS Raw Ceilometer Data and Plots (ASCII and binary)
dataset.description: This ceilometer data archive includes four tar files that contain: ascii text files, raw binary data files, and plots of density and gradient. These data were collected from the R/V Investigator during the SOCRATES field campaign between 2017-09-21 and 2018-02-21. These data have been reviewed for completeness and quality, but have not been corrected in any way. To obtain more fully quality-controlled data (available only in netcdf format) please see the referenced dataset, NCAR/EOL R/V Investigator Quality-Controlled ISS Ceilometer Data (NetCDF).

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the Lear 36 dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset consists of dropsondes from the Lear 36. Dropsondes were taken as requested. These data were processed through an interpolation that included the removal of bad data from higher resolution data, automated, and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: ISFS 30-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products from AABC site
dataset.description: These data contain surface meteorology measurements of the Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS), at the Alabama Aquatic Biodiversity Center (AABC), from 16 May through 11 July 2013. The ISFS 30 minute dataset contains some of the first and second moments of variables measured by the NCAR ISFS during the SOAS portion of the Southeast Atmosphere Study (SAS), in addition to derived calculations of the fluxes of sensible and latent heat, friction velocity, surface heat flux and net radiation. The data are stored in NetCDF files.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Biak Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 347 high vertical resolution soundings from Biak, Indonesia (WMO 97560) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Corozal Panama
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Corozal, Panama during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: NWS Slidell GTS Mandatory/Significant Level Sounding Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). It includes 56 mandatory / significant level soundings from Slidell, LA site (WMO 72233). Soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC) from 1 Aug to 29 Aug 2005. The high resolution soundings for the Slidell, LA site for the month of August were lost due to Hurricane Katrina. The September high resolution data for Slidell, LA is included in the NOAA/NWS Rawinsonde Data [NCAR/EOL] Data Set.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Ship Underway Data - Atmospheric Pressure (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of Atmospheric Pressure plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar time series data
dataset.description: S-Pol radar time series data collected during the Prediction of Rainfall Extremes Campaign In the Pacific (PRECIP) from 25 May 2015 to 11 August 2022. The dataset contains the raw in-phase (I) and quadrature (Q) information archived as time series. Each file contains 10 minutes of data and is ~4 G large.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data - 25 Hz [EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean" project which took place from 7 December 2004 to 24 January 2005. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps, mixed) production data set. The HRT Bitfile log lists times and dates of individual flights.

dataset.title: FP5 NCAR/EOL 915 MHz Profiler 30 Minute Consensus Winds and Moments Data
dataset.description: This data set contains 30 minute NIMA consensus wind and moments data measured by the NCAR/EOL 915 MHz profiler located at the PECAN Fixed PISA 5 site in Brewster, Kansas. These data are in netcdf format and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains daily precipitation data extracted from the GCIP/EAOP-98 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the EAOP-98 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC, with additional QC performed by JOSS.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia ISS WXT Sensor Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) WXT sensor located on Diego Garcia during the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) field campaign. This dataset contains disdrometer data, in addition to the standard temperature, moisture, winds, and pressure variables. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Lihue
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Lihue, Hawaii during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2007-10-15 17:15:00 to 2007-12-31 10:45:00.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER Raw 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: A 2D-S instrument contains two 2D probes which image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV during the SOCRATES project using the SPEC 2D-S (Stereo) probe. The original files have been processed so that they are compatible with xpms2d software. All files reflect UTC time.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 08:00:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: CP4 Doppler Radar cfRadial format. Daily tar archives. [NCAR]
dataset.description: This dataset contains CP4 Doppler radar data collected during the STORM Fronts Experiment Systems Test (STORM-FEST) from 2 February 1992 to 13 March 1992. These data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar archives.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Padang Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 421 high vertical resolution soundings from Padang, Indonesia (WMO 96163) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC during October and November 2011 and January through March 2012 and four times daily at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC during December 2011. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:52:00.

dataset.title: ISS Surface Met Imagery [EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains surface meteorology imagery from the Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) Integrated Sounding System (ISS) sites during T-REX. The ISS is a self contained meteorological observing system consisting of a wind profiler radar, radiosonde sounding system, a 10m meteorological tower, solar radiation and other sensors. This data set contains real-time imagery files taken from the T-REX Field Catalog.

dataset.title: Meteosat 9 Products
dataset.description: This dataset consists of jpeg images of Meteosat 9 products from the PRE-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project. The data includes Visible SWIR, channel 1, channel 1 visible, Channel 5 water vapor, and Channel 9 Thermal-IR. This data covers from July through October of 2010.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 14:30:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 High Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The INtercontinental chemical Transport EXperiment - Phase B was a two phase experiment that aimed to understand the transport and transformation of gases and aerosols on transcontinental/intercontinental scales and assess their impact on air quality and climate. The primary constituents of interest are ozone and its precursors, aerosols and precursors, and the long-lived greenhouse gases. INTEX-B was conducted during a 10-week period from March 1 to May 15, 2006. The first phase of the study was performed during March and focused on Mexico City pollution outflow, while the second phase was performed during April and May and focused on Asian pollution outflow. This dataset contains High-Rate (HRT) airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the second phase (INTEX-B2). The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NCAR Electra during Lake-ICE.

dataset.title: NEXRAD FDX (Clovis, NM) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes reflectivity and velocity imagery from the NEXRAD radar at Clovis, NM from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. Both the 2009 and 2010 field phases cover approximately May through June for those years. The files are gif images. See the catalog links below to access the field catalogs.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Imager Visible Channel Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Imager Visible Channel data collected from the GOES-10 satellite during the VOCALS project. The files are in netCDF format and cover the time period from September 30, 2008 to December 08, 2008.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Windcube Lidar VAD Winds
dataset.description: Leosphere Windcube Lidar product collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. Wind profiles are calculated using a Velocity-Azimuth Display (VAD) technique described in the data quality report. Thresholds were applied to various lidar parameters as a method of quality control.

dataset.title: Other: ARM TWP Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Global Energy and Water Cycle Experiment (GEWEX) Tropical Western Pacific (TWP) 30 Minute Surface Meteorology and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains 30 minute data from three stations in the TWP reference site for the CEOP 2002-10-01 through 2009-12-31 period, including the Darwin, Nauru and Manus stations. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Central American National Lightning 5 Minute Lightning Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains lightning imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: Vaisala_5min.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm (LCFA) Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm (LFCA) during the period of Organization of Tropical East Pacific Convection (OTREC) field project operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Spontaneous Ice Nucleation (IceNu) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: SAVANT: NCAR/EOL ISS Sodar-RASS Data (ISS2 Farm Field Site)
dataset.description: Sodar and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located at the ISS2 Farm Field Site during the SAVANT field campaign in central Illinois. This dataset contains quality controlled SODAR winds and RASS virtual temperatures in NetCDF (*.avg.nc) format. These data have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: AVAPS Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: Dropsondes released from the University of Wyoming King Air research aircraft stationed at Utqiagvik, Alaska during the Chemistry in the Arctic: Clouds, Halogens, and Aerosols (CHACHA) field campaign aimed to improve the understanding of atmospheric chemistry that impacts ozone, particulate matter, and cloud chemical composition in the context of a rapidly changing Arctic.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg6 NZCH-YMHB Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NZCH-YMHB Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-16 01:32:00 to 2011-09-21 15:32:00.

dataset.title: NIWOT07 Como Creek data
dataset.description: This dataset contains data from three 3-D sonic anemometers, a barometer, a hygrothermometer and a 2-D anemometer deployed at the Como Creek site during the NIWOT07 field campaign. NIWOT07 was an NSF-supported project to investigate the use of sensor networks for biogeoscience research, conducted by NCAR and CU at the Univ. Colo. Flux Facility (CUFF) in the Univ. Colo. Mountain Research Station (MRS). The Como Creek data are from Oct 11, 2006 to Oct 19, 2007 and are 5 minute ISFS data, in NetCDF format. They have not been QC'd or tilt corrected.

dataset.title: GOES-East 4km Multi-Spectral Channel TDF Data
dataset.description: The GOES-8 Satellite data is at 4 kilometers. The data cover the period from 1 September 2001 to 15 October 2001. That data are in tdf format.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Left Side Camera Video [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the final HIAPER left side window video files for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). They are in MPEG4 format. The individual images are also available in the companion dataset NCAR GV (HIAPER) Left Side Camera imagery [NCAR/EOL].

dataset.title: Housekeeping Data Dump
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of the regular data dumps during Phase I, as well as the Pre and Inter Phases, of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-97 Surface: Special Surface Observations Composite
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/ESOP-97 Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) and National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) DATSAV2 "Special" observation surface data for the GCIP/ESOP-97 domain and time period. These are observations that are reported at off-hour times. The ASOS and DATSAV2 "Nominal" hourly surface data for the GCIP/ESOP-97 domain and time period are included in the GCIP/ESOP-97 Hourly Surface Composite.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME). These data are dorade sweep files and are available as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from the Victor Bugaev (Ukranian Ship)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Victor Bugaev, a Ukranian ship (ID EOGW). Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to 16 times per day (90 min intervals). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NOAA AVHRR Satellite Data
dataset.description: Satellite images archived in KuDA are derived from either the NOAA or the Dept of Defense polar orbiting weather satellites. This dataset consists of the NOAA series, which includes images from four satellites which were transmitting data during 1991 (NOAA-9, 10, 11, 12). Each of these satellites carried a sensor called the Advanced Very High Resolution Radiometer (AVHRR), which is one source of images for KuDA (the other source is the Department of Defense's OLS). All data are in TDF format.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 50 Meter Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of interpolated 50m resolution upper air sounding data from all sources for the Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study (SOCRATES) project in the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) columnar ASCII format. The data set currently contains 1888 soundings including the dropsonde data (109 soundings) from the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream-V HIAPER aircraft and the radiosonde data from the ships R/V Investigator (234 soundings), RSV Aurora Australis (208 soundings) and from 19 Australia, New Zealand, and Antarctica operational locations (1337 soundings).

dataset.title: GOES-11 4KM Imager Data (TDF)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of satellite GOES-11 30 minute gzipped TDF files from the period of the PASE (Pacific Atmospheric Sulfur Experiment) from Christmas Island.

dataset.title: RYBICA: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of PAM station data from the RYBICA experiment. One PAM station was deployed in a wheat field approximately fifty miles east of Brighton, Colorado.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 12:00:00 to 2011-06-07 18:00:00.

dataset.title: US DOD Yuma Proving Ground (Arizona) High Resolution Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the high vertical resolution (5 seconds up to 480 seconds after release and 10 seconds after 480 seconds) rawinsonde data from three sites in Yuma, Arizona (3555, Tower 31 and Tower M). This data set has been quality controlled by The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS). Consult the README for more information. Additional information can be found at www.yuma.army.mil NOTE: These data have been corrected as of 16 February 2010 for a significant dry bias. See the documentation file for details on the correction(s) applied to this data set. Also see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH.

dataset.title: Airborne LIDAR Data [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This data set includes flight-level airborne LIDAR measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Kuwait Oil-Fire Smoke Experiment (KOFSE).

dataset.title: DOTSTAR ASTRA NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Constant Level Winds KML Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Google Earth KML files that contain constant level wind observations derived from the dropsondes released from the DOTSTAR Astra jet. These files were produced by NCAR/EOL from the real time GTS TEMPDROP messages and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: CAMP: Korean Peninsula Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Korean Peninsula Meteorological Tower data set. This dataset contains the first half of the EOP-3 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 March 2003). There is only one station in this dataset. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR C-130 during ARISTO2015. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: Flight Logs
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of flight logs for KC-135, UK-C130, and Sabreliner for Phases I and II of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Vessel, phase, and group # are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air sounding data sets developed for the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area - North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period 2000 (EAOP-00) conducted from 01 April 2000 to 31 March 2001. The LSA-NW domain extends from 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude. Included in this data set are 17 National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the LSA-NW domain. The soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC, however, several stations had additional releases. The final data set includes pressure, dry bulb temperature, dew point temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and direction, at 6-sec vertical resolution. Consult the readme file for further information.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS 5-minute Surface Meteorology and Flux Products - winds in theodolite geographic and tilt corrected coordinates
dataset.description: 5-minute surface meteorology and flux products collected by the EOL/Integrated Surface Flux System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. These data have been quality controlled and are available in netCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and corrected for the orientation of the instrument. The orientation and tilt corrections applied were determined by the use of laser multi-station scans. Data were collected from 11 sites (2 towered Supersites + 9 Satellite sites) located around Heber Valley.

dataset.title: CAMP: N. South China Sea - S. Japan Hourly Soil Temperature Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) CEOP Asian-Australia Monsoon Experiment (CAMP) Northern South China Sea - Southern Japan Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture, and Temperature Data Set. This data set contains 7-hour data from 14 stations for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: MP4 NCAR/EOL QC Radiosonde Skew-T Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains skew-T plots of quality-controlled radiosonde data from the PECAN field campaign. These data were collected by the EOL Mobile GPS Atmospheric Upper-Air Sounding System (MGAUS), which was generally collocated with the Mobile Integrated Souning System (MISS). These systems were collectively known as Mobile PECAN Integrated Sounding Array 4 (MP4) during the project. These plots were generated based on a plotting script developed by Russ Schumacher of Colorado State University.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Snowband Dynamics Project (SNOWBAND). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Small Ice Detector Version 2 (SID-2H) Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains SID2H data collected during the ADELE/SPRITE/HEFT09 project. The Small Ice Detector, Version 2 (SID2H) is a particle light-scattering instrument for measuring size distributions of particles in the 1 to 70 micrometer size range and for discriminating between ice crystals and supercooled water droplets in mixed phase clouds. SID2H measures the intensity of light scattered by cloud particles in the forward direction. Measurements are recorded for each particle that crosses the instrument's laser beam. The SID2H data files are binary and come in 10-minute blocks; a new file is created every 10 minutes. Data records include timing events, light scattering intensity, and housekeeping (temperatures, laser power, etc.). The file structure has a header, data, and a footer.

dataset.title: LDM WMO Hourly Surface Data in QC format
dataset.description: The Unidata Local Data Manager (LDM) World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Hourly Surface data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period (01 April 2000 through 31 March 2001). The GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain is approximately 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: ACLAIM: Electra Digitized Cloud Video [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset contains cloud video. The mpeg files were digitized from VHS tapes of forward and left-looking video taken aboard the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Airborne Coherent Lidar for Advanced In-flight Measurements (ACLAIM) project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Sulfur Measurement Studies (SMT) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of the highest vertical resolution (i.e. the “native resolution”) upper air sounding data from all sources for the Remote sensing of Electrification, Lightning, And Meso-scale/micro-scale Processes with Adaptive Ground Observations (RELAMPAGO) project in the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) columnar ASCII format. The data set contains 2714 soundings including the Colorado State University (CSU) mobile radiosondes (105 soundings), the Center for Severe Weather Research (CSWR) mobile radiosondes (266 soundings), the University of Illinois (UIUC) mobile radiosondes (206 soundings), the DOE/ARM CACTI soundings from their two sites (1255 soundings), the INPE radiosondes from Sao Borja, Brazil (58 soundings), as well as the radiosondes from six locations around central Argentina that were operated by Servicio Meteorológico Nacional (SMN; 824 radiosondes).

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TORERO, the GV_N677F flew a left-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES 13 4KM Channel 3 Water Vapor Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 13 4KM 3 channel water vapor imagery from the 2010 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled native vertical resolution radiosonde data from all sources (National Weather Service, Mississippi State University, NOAA/National Severe Storms Laboratory, NOAA/Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Division, Texas A&M University, the University of Alabama Huntsville, the University of Louisiana Monroe, and the University of South Alabama), for the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Thunderstorms Experiment-Southeast (VORTEX-SE) Meso18-19 project period (1 November 2018 to 20 April 2019). A total of 5629 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final data set.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ACCLIP, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: SOCRATES Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Southern Ocean Clouds Radiation Aerosol Transport Experimental Study (SOCRATES) project from 2 January 2018 - 2 March 2018. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the SOCRATES project.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Richness Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains richness data from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: GOES-East Channel 5 Imagery
dataset.description: This is the channel 5 imagery collected from the GOES-8 satellite during the EPIC time period.

dataset.title: GOES-West Imager 13.3 Micron CH6 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-15 Imager CH6 13.3 Micron Channel Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 16 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: Sterling ICICLE Ground Suite
dataset.description: This dataset contains ground-based measurements collected from the Sterling ICICLE Ground Suite during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 27 January - 8 March 2019. Primary information included in the dataset are ground-based measurements of precipitation accumulation and rate, ice accretion, present weather type, atmospheric state parameters, winds, hydrometeor size distributions and velocities, and visibility. Data has been reviewed for quality and known data gaps exist due to power outages etc.

dataset.title: NOAA N43 P-3 Dropsonde Data (.esc format)
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). It includes 406 dropsondes from the NOAA P-3 N43RF aircraft. The data are 0.5 second vertical resolution. It includes dropsondes that occurred during Hurricanes Dennis (2005 Jul 5, 7, 9, and 10), Emily (2005 Jul 18), Gert (2005 Jul 24), Katrina (2005 Aug 25, 27, 28, and 29), Ophelia (2005 Sept 7, 8, 9, and 11) and Rita (2005 Sept 19-23).

dataset.title: SOAS NWS Site NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This data set contains surface meteorology data collected at the Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) NWS site during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS) from 20 May 2013 to 16 July 2013. The data are available in netCDF format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Ship Underway Data - Seabeam Centerbeam Depth (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of Seabeam Centerbeam Depth plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE soundings from Yap
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Yap Island in the Caroline Islands (WMO 91413) which was operated by the U.S. National Weather Service. Soundings were taken twice per day (00 and 12 UTC) during the IOP. The data were processed through the automated, visual, and spatial quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at six second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README file for details.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the OTREC project.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During HIPPO-3, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Cloud Microphysical Measurements and Radar Polarization (CMMRP) project. This dataset contains HRT rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: SHEBA: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) [NCAR/EOL/RSF] - dorade format
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Surface Heat Budget of the Arctic Ocean Project (SHEBA). The tar files contain dorade format data.

dataset.title: TMI 3-Day Average Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: The data set contains TRMM TMI derived 3-day average imagery of water vapor, cloud liquid water, SST and 11 and 37GHz channel surface wind speed. These images were created by NCAR/EOL and are in png format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Channel 3 (Water Vapor) Imagery
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Channel 3 (Water Vapor) Sectored Imagery (GIF) is one of several satellite products collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase-II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project field catalog operated by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL: http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 4-km imagery from Channel 3 (water vapor; 6.75um) of the GOES-10 satellite. the products cover the period from 1-30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). The products are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). All images are in gif format.

dataset.title: NCAR Mobile GAUS (MGAUS) Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: The Terrain Induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX) was conducted during March and April 2006, during which time 87 radiosondes were launched using a mobile sounding system at three locations (Visalia (71), Madera (9) and Delano (7)) in the California Central Valley. TREX is the second phase of a coordinated effort to explore the structure and evolution of atmospheric rotors, which typically occur parallel to, and downstream from, mountain ridge crests. The first phase was a project conducted in 2004 called the Sierra Rotors Project. Both phases included downwind radiosonde launches from the central valley, used to help predict the onset of events likely to produce rotors on the West side of the Sierra Nevada Mountain Range. In order to capture the structure of the rotors, additional instruments were set up in California's Owens Valley.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Aircraft Vertical Separation Standards Project (AVSSP). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg6 NZCH-YMHB Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NZCH-YMHB Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 22:32:00 to 2011-07-14 15:32:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR Electra during Lake-ICE. The data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NOAA P-3 Dropsonde High Resolution L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set contains 469 high vertical resolution dropsondes released from the NOAA P-3 between 9 November and 13 December 2011. This data set is the same as NOAA P-3 Dropsonde High Resolution L3 Data (EOL format) but with the format converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format to match the L2 DYNAMO sounding data sets.

dataset.title: Soundings Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: The upper air highest resolution sounding data for the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME) 2004 Tier 3 domain (5°N to 50°N latitude and 125°W to 75°W longitude) are contained within this dataset. The dataset covers the time period 1 June through 30 September 2004. This NAME 2004 Sounding Composite Highest Resolution Upper-Air Dataset contains 24308 soundings from 112 sites. The PIBALs are not previewable and will generate an error when selected. NOTE: As of 23 March 2010 many of the soundings in this data set have had a correction applied to account for a significant dry bias. See the documentation file for details on the correction(s) applied to this data set. Also see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Hourly Observations
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Surface: GTS Surface Hourly Observations are online data. Data is in GEMPAK format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the NO Lightning (NOLTG) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 micrometers. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the ARISTO2016 project. The 2DS puts all flight data into 3 files, and the size of these files depends on the amount of time in clouds.

dataset.title: Global Hawk NCAR/EOL Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding profiles deployed on the NOAA/NASA Global Hawk using a NCAR/NOAA dropsonde system specially designed for remote operation. Quality-controlled soundings in EOL file format are provided.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Palu Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 365 high vertical resolution soundings from Palu, Indonesia (WMO 97072) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well as a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research, HIAPER) (N677F) during SPICULE (Secondary Production of Ice in Cumulus Experiment). The data were collected during 10 research flights which took place between May 29 and June 25, 2021, over the US Great Plains.

dataset.title: NCAR Research Radar Data
dataset.description: NCAR's CP-2, CP-3, and CP-4 research Doppler radars operated on a coordinated basis during CaPE. Final processed data includes: for all three, reflectivity, velocity, spectral width, normalized coherent power, signal noise ratio and received power (not 2); for CP-2 only, differential reflectivity and linear depolarization ratio.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During PLOWS, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. The images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NEXRAD Radar Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains NEXRAD imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: Albuquerque_NM, El_Paso_TX, Flagstaff_AZ, Las_Vegas_NV, Phoenix_AZ, San_Diego_CA, Tucson_AZ, Yuma_CA. This dataset is VERY large. Please do not order more than 10 days in a single data order.

dataset.title: C-130 Meteorology Dropsonde High Resolution (0.5 s) Data
dataset.description: The DYCOMS-II Aircraft: C-130 Meteorology Dropsonde High Vertical Resolution (0.5 s) Data (NCAR/ATD) is one of several upper air data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. The data were provided by the National Center for Atmospheric Research/Atmospheric Technology Division (NCAR/ATD). Included in the data set are 0.5 second vertical resolution data from dropsondes released from the National Science Foundation (NSF)/NCAR C-130 aircraft as part of the DYCOMS-II project. Dropsondes were released during aircraft flight (10, 11, 13, 17, 18, 24, 25, and 26 July 2001. Most flights were during the night.

dataset.title: NCAR/ATD Smileyberg 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Smileyberg, KS during the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study 1999 (CASES-99). This dataset includes consensus winds data in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: EOL MISS Colorado Sounding Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) 2012 project. This data set includes 27 high vertical resolution (1-sec) soundings from the NCAR Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS). These soundings were released from a location at the Fort Morgan, CO airport. They were released from 17 May to 28 June 2012 as part of the DC3 field campaign. This data set is the same as the EOL MISS Colorado Sounding Data but with the format converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 4km Thermal IR (Ch 4) Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 satellite imagery for the VOCALS study area and time of interest. The images are JPEGS.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV during SPICULE. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Douce France
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the French ASAP ship the Douce France. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: VORTEX-95 NCAR Electra ELDORA Radar Data
dataset.description: This dataset consists of airborne doppler radar measurements of selected tornadic storms made by the ELDORA radar aboard the NCAR Electra aircraft during the VORTEX-95 Field Project. This radar is specifically designed to provide dual doppler measurements of convective storms. VORTEX-95 is the second field deployment of the radar.

dataset.title: ACE-ASIA Aircraft: C-130 High Rate (25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the ACE-Asia project. This dataset contains the High Rate (HRT, 25 sps) Flight Level production data. HRT data is available for only six of the eighteen flights.

dataset.title: Colombo, Sri Lanka Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes 258 high vertical resolution soundings from Colombo, Sri Lanka (WMO 43466) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released four times daily (00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC) from 30 September 2011 to 6 December 2011. From 7-28 December soundings were released at most once per day at 12 UTC. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.0 version of the data set was released 15 October 2013 and changes include the application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: DOE ARM-CART SGP Lamont, OK (C1) Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings from the Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Southern Great Plains (SGP) Central Facility (C1) site near Lamont, OK collected during the VORTEX2 field campaigns for 2009 and 2010. There are 241 soundings for the 2009 season (1 May through 30 June 2009) and 182 soundings for the 2010 season (1 May through 15 June 2010). There are typically four soundings per day at 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC. This station used Vaisala RS92-KL radiosondes with Loran-C windfinding during the VORTEX2 field season.

dataset.title: USDA-ARS Grazinglands Research Laboratory Soil Temperature
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 Sub-Surface USDA-ARS Grazinglands Research Laboratory (GRL) Soil Temperature Dataset contains data from the United States Department of Agriculture-Agricultural Research Service (USDA-ARS) Grazinglands Research Laboratory (GRL). This dataset contains data for two USDA/ARS/GRL networks in the NESOB 1996 domain (100.5 W to 94.5 W longitude and 34 N to 39 N latitude) and time period (01 April 1996 through 30 September 1996). All records from station A182 have been removed from this dataset in Version 2.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ORCAS (The O2/N2 Ratio and CO2 Airborne Southern Ocean Study) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format. Note: Due to a timeserver problem, there is no data available for RF12, and the data for RF13 is only available for the second half of the flight.

dataset.title: GOES-7 IR Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 Infrared (IR) imagery collected during the ACE-1 Transect period via McIDAS-X then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of full disk, 32 km resolution images collected every 6-hr. Digital McIDAS Area format files (8 km resolution) were collected by OFPS from NOAA NSSFC from which these GIF images were created.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Evenness Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains evenness data from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Q80 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During CONTRAST (CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) flew a right-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo (JPEG) images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Note: Forward, Downward, and Left-looking images can be found in the companion datasets below.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia Radiosonde L3 Data (EOL Format)[NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains EOL format (ASCII) files of sounding data from 690 Vaisala RS92 radiosondes launched at Diego Garcia during the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) field campaign. A total of 679 quality controlled soundings are contained in this data set.

dataset.title: CAMP: Mongolia Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture, and Temperature Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) CEOP related Asian Monsoon Experiment (CAMP) Mongolia Hourly Soil Heat Flux, Moisture and Temperature Data Set. This data set contains hourly soil temperatures and soil moisture values at 3cm, 10cm, 40cm, and 100cm depths and hourly soil heat flux values at 5cm depth from the 4 Automated Weather Station (AWS) stations for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). This data set also includes hourly soil temperatures and soil moisture values at 3cm and 10cm depths from 12 Automatic Station for Soil Hydrology (ASSH) stations for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V (HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the HIAPER Pole-to-Pole Observations (HIPPO) of Carbon Cycle and Greenhouse Gases Study Phase 4 (HIPPO-4) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 1km Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 satellite imagery for the VOCALS study area and time of interest. The images are JPG files.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the SOCRATES project. Files contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NOAA R/V Ron Brown Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: During the VAMOS Ocean-Cloud Atmosphere-Land Study (VOCALS) campaign, sounding data were collected onboard the NOAA R/V Ronald H. Brown. Leg 1 was conducted between October 6 and November 3, 2008 (from Charleston, SC to Arica, Chile). Leg 2 was conducted from November 9 to December 2, 2008 (from Arica to the IMET Buoy at 85W and back to Arica). A total of 215 high vertical resolution (1 second) soundings are included in this data set. The data are in the NCAR/EOL Sounding Composite format.

dataset.title: Barbados Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). Ut includes 139 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from Barbados. (WMO 78954). Soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC) from 1 July to 29 October 2005. This dataset contains soundings released during hurricanes: Dennis, Emily, Katrina, Ophelia, and Wilma.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Categorical Summary Results
dataset.description: This dataset contains Categorical summary results from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: NCEP Eta model 1000 mb Maps
dataset.description: NCEP Eta Model 1000 mb Analysis map images for the SGP99 period.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II ISS All Sky Camera Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains all sky imagery every minute from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) All Sky Camera during the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in daily tarred files, including both raw and panoramic images, and were collected and processed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS High Rate Surface Meteorology and Flux Products - winds in theodolite geographic and tilt corrected coordinates
dataset.description: High rate surface meteorology and flux products collected by the EOL/Integrated Surface Flux System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. These data have been quality controlled and are available in netCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and corrected for the orientation of the instrument. The orientation and tilt corrections applied were determined by the use of laser multi-station scans. Data were collected from 11 sites (2 towered Supersites + 9 Satellite sites) located around Heber Valley. That data have been merged in time increments that vary by sensor from 50 ms for 20 Hz sensors to 1 s for 1 Hz sensors.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:00:00 to 2011-07-14 22:00:00.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the Winter Icing Storms Project Instrumentation Test (WISPIT) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Quality Controlled Radiosonde Data: SAVANT 2018
dataset.description: At the Homestead site (ISS1), 41 successful radiosondes were launched during the SAVANT campaign. Soundings were launched on select days for the duration of the campaign, with up to five soundings, which were typically launched in 2-hour intervals.The distance between the radiosonde launch site and the second ISS site (Farm Field site) is approximately 4.5 km.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 15:13:00 to 2010-04-20 06:00:00.

dataset.title: ISFS High Rate Surface Meteorology and Flux Products, tilt-corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains tilt-corrected high-rate ISFS data collected from 20 September to 1 December 2012 as part of the Shallow Cold Pool (SCP) Experiment.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the SPICULE project. Files contain low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data and are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Moments
dataset.description: 449 MHz radar wind profiler moments data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Park Falls site during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. This dataset includes quality controlled data in netCDF format. Winds data from the profiler can be found in the companion dataset, 592.003 NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler, 5 and 30 Minute Winds.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the 3CPO Trace Gas Measurements Program. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: R/V Ron Brown Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This dataset consists of rawinsonde data collected during the INDOEX cruise of the NOAA Ship Ron Brown. Each datafile contains the ships location, the sonde's UTC release time, and a vertical profile of pressure, temperature, humidity, latitude and longitude, total wind speed and direction, and U and V wind components, every 10 seconds during the sonde's ascent.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar time series data
dataset.description: S-Pol Radar full time series data in IWRF format collected continuously during the FRONT (Front Range Observational Network Testbed) project. Each file covers about 15 minutes of S-Pol operation. See the FRONT S-Pol Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability.

dataset.title: Miscellaneous Surface Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes miscellaneous surface data, including boom data winds, during Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Title, vessel(s), and phase(s) are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the OTREC project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the SNOP project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: SCMS95: Mobile CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: These two data files contain soundings from the Small Cumulus Microphysics Study (SCMS95) near Cape Canaveral (Cape Kennedy) from a Mobile Cross-Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) station. Data are in an ascii tar file and in a binary tar file.
