dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Biak Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 347 high vertical resolution soundings from Biak, Indonesia (WMO 97560) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS and University of Utah Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: Radiosonde profiles launched by staff from EOL's Integrated Sounding System and the University of Utah- Department of Atmospheric Sciences during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. Launches were made near the Daniel Creek Supersite.

dataset.title: NWS Mandatory and Significant Level Sounding Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/LSANW 00 Mandatory and Significant Level Sounding data set contains sounding data extracted from the NOAA/FSL radiosonde database for 17 NWS sites over the GCIP LSA-North West region during the period from April 2000 to March 2001. Other sites also occasionally other sites also released radiosonde and are included. These data have not been changed or quality controlled by UCAR/JOSS. Refer to the README file for more details.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Satellite Water Vapor Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains 4km_ch3_water_vapor images taken at 30 minute intervals from October 27, 2004 through February 1, 2005.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Sounder Terrascan Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Sounder Terrascan data from the GOES-12 satellite.

dataset.title: Mobile ISS (MISS) Surface Meteorology Data Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS) from various locations in the Owens Valley of California during the Sierra Rotors Project in 2004 (SRP2004). These data are from two separate surface stations, one of which is available in daily netCDF files, while the other is tarred into daily netCDF files. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 SABL (Lidar) Data (MSS)
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL Lidar data from the NSF/NCAR C-130 flights during MILAGRO. There are no IR data available for RF03 thru RF05 inclusive (2006-03-10 16:21 - 2006-03-17 00:18) due to equipment problems. Data are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the University of Michigan Biological Station (UMBS) in Pellston, MI during the Program for Research on Oxidants: Photochemistry, Emmissions, and Transport (PROPHET) intensive observing period that occurred in the summer of 2000. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: PAM/ASTER 30-Minute Surface Flux Data - netCDF format
dataset.description: Surface flux data collected by NCAR/EOL (formerly ATD) during the Cooperative Atmospheric Surface Exchange Study 1997 (CASES-97) project from 22 April to 22 May 1997. These data are in netCDF format at 30 minute resolution.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) during the MONEX-77 project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NASA ER-2 Quality Controlled Dropsonde Data (NCAR/ATD)
dataset.description: Dropsonde data from the NASA ER-2 research aircraft, collected by the NCAR Airborne Vertical Atmospheric Profiling System (AVAPS) during the Cirrus Regional Study of Tropical Anvils and Cirrus Layers - Florida Area Cirrus Experiment (CRYSTAL-FACE). A total of 47 quality-controlled soundings in the NCAR CLASS format are contained in the final dropsonde data set.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the SOCRATES project.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 IR (Channel 8) Calibrated Data in NetCDF Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 km resolution Meteosat-7 Infrared (channel 8) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the NetCDF file format. These data are the calibrated temperature values.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV during OTREC. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Soundings
dataset.description: This data set consists of soundings taken at ten National Weather Service (NWS) Rawinsonde sites during CASES-99. Quality control on this data set has been performed by UCAR/JOSS. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the README file for details.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 10:57:00 to 2010-04-20 14:52:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 12:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: Meteosat-7 Water Vapor (Channel 10) Calibrated Data in NetCDF Format
dataset.description: This data set contains 5 km resolution Meteosat-7 Water Vapor (channel 10) satellite data over the DYNAMO region. Data are available at 30 minute intervals and are in the NetCDF file format. These data are the calibrated temperature values.

dataset.title: GOES-8 1 and 4km Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES-8 imagery from the IHOP_2002 field project time of interest and area of interest. Images include 1KM resolution from the visible channel, 4KM resolution from the visible channel, the near-IR channel, the water vapor channel, and the two thermal-IR channels.

dataset.title: GAPP: Mount Bigelow High Resolution Radiosonde Data (NWS Site Tucson, AZ)
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 and 4 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) Global Energy and Water Cycle Experiment (GEWEX) Americas Prediction Project (GAPP) Mount Bigelow High Resolution Rawinsonde Dataset. The data was collected from the Tucson,AZ National Weather Service (NWS) upper air station and consists of six second vertical resolution profiles of pressure, temperature, wind speed, wind direction, relative humidity,and altitude from 01 October 2002 thru 31 December 2004. The University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) did perform quality control processing on this data set. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL AVAPS Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding profiles deployed from the NOAA P-3 aircraft. From November 9 through December 13, 2011, thirteen research flights were conducted and 469 dropsonde profiles collected.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data (ESC Format)
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled HIWC Radar 2015 NWS soundings released at 20 sites throughout the southeastern United States and Puerto Rico during the HIWC Radar 2015 field phase (9-25 August 2015). Nine stations in the region were only available at mandatory/significant level resolution and are available in a separate data set. A total of 678 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final HIWC Radar 2015 data set.

dataset.title: SAO Special Observations
dataset.description: Wind direction/speed, ceiling height, visibility. dry bulb temperature, wet bulb temperature, dew point temperature, sea level and station pressure, cloud data, and present weather. Manual and automatic observations for special conditions that arose at about 1200 NWS, FAA, Coast Guard, and DOD sites for STORM-FEST.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Channel 2 Shortwave Infrared Satellite Imagery - Galapagos
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Channel 2 Shortwave Infrared Satellite imagery of Galapagos taken during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project from 14 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: GOES-11 All Channels 1KM Data (netCDF) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains 1-km resolution GOES-11 data in netCDF format. This data set includes data from all sector scans that cover this region, including any rapid scan or super rapid scan sectors.

dataset.title: USDA-ARS Grazinglands Research Laboratory Soil Moisture
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 Sub-Surface USDA-ARS Grazinglands Research Laboratory (GRL) Soil Moisture Dataset contains data from the United States Department of Agriculture-Agricultural Research Service (USDA-ARS) Grazinglands Research Laboratory (GRL). This dataset contains data for two USDA/ARS/GRL networks in the NESOB 1996 domain (100.5 W to 94.5 W longitude and 34 N to 39 N latitude) and time period (01 April 1996 through 30 September 1996).

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ECLIPSE2019 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 915 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Products - ISS3 York Airport Site
dataset.description: 915 MHz wind profiler products operated by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the York, NE airport during the GRAINEX field campaign. This dataset includes consensus winds and moments data in NetCDF format, and has been quality-controlled through the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA).

dataset.title: CAMP: Korean Haenam Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Korean Haenam Hourly Soil Data Set. This data set contains data at a half-hour resolution from one station in the CAMP reference site for the CEOP EOP-3 time period, which is the Korean Haenam station. This dataset only contains the entire EOP-3 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 30 September 2003). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: BEACHON QC Radiosonde Data - Hayman Site
dataset.description: The Bio-hydro-atmosphere interactions of Energy, Aerosols, Carbon, H2O, Organics and Nitrogen (BEACHON) is a project aimed at examining the evolution of thermodynamic structures in the boundary layer above the Manitou Experimental Forest located Colorado. BEACHON included the use of two stationary GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding (GAUS) systems at two separate sites, the Hayman site and the Manitou site. These sounding systems were set up to collect radiosonde data for two intensive operations periods (IOPs). The project targeted one “wet episode”, between Aug 12-14, which followed a major rain event, and one “dry” episode, one week later, from Aug 21-23. A total of 147 quality controlled radiosonde soundings are contained in the final archive.

dataset.title: GOES 12 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery, Terrascan format
dataset.description: This dataset contains Terrascan format 1km resolution images from the GOES-12 satellite. Images are for the period and area of the START08 project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer CL61 Data Products
dataset.description: Vaisala C61 ceilometer products collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System group during Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-12-21 22:15:00.

dataset.title: GOES-East 1KM RICO-Domain HDF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains sectored GOES-East satellite imager data at 1km resolution for the Rain in Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) 2004-2005 domain. The data cover the period from 24 November 2004 - 24 January 2005. The data are in HDF format.

dataset.title: R/V Ron Brown Rawinsonde (hi-res) - Leg 1
dataset.description: This Dataset consists of rawinsonde data collected during the EPIC cruise of the NOAA Ship Ron Brown. Each datafile contains the ships location, the sonde's UTC release time, and a vertical profile of pressure, temperature, humidity, latitude and longitude, total wind speed and direction, and U and V wind components, every two seconds during the sonde's ascent.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 AGGH-PHKO 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 18:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the SGP99 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the SGP99 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, Ka-band, Marshall field site
dataset.description: Selected time periods of radar moments data collected by the S-PolKa radar at the Marshall field site in Colorado. S-PolKa is usually run at the Marshall field site for testing and maintenance purposes so the data in this dataset contains data from various different instrument states. It is not quality controlled. If you would like to use this data set for research purposes, please contact us first at the email address below.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL AVAPS Dropsonde QC Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde profiles collected during the OTREC field campaign. Twenty-two research flights were conducted between 7 Aug and 2 Oct 2019, during which 648 dropsondes were successfully released. Downloadable reference material are included.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled high vertical resolution radiosonde data from all sources (National Weather Service and mobile soundings from the University of Louisiana Monroe and University of Alabama Huntsville), for the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Thunderstorms Experiment-Southeast 2018 (VORTEX-SE_2018) project period (9 March to 16 April 2018). A total of 971 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final data set.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler Moments
dataset.description: 449 MHz modular wind profiler moments data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Park Falls site during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. These data have been quality controlled. Winds data from the profiler can be found in the companion dataset, 560.043 NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Radar Wind Profiler, 5 and 30 Minute Winds.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar time series data
dataset.description: S-Pol Radar full time series data collected during the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) campaign from 9 March 2015 to 16 July 2015. This is a "realtime" PECAN data set. The files are a mix of hourly files ("SPOL_scan") and episodic files (SPOL_vert and SPOL_sunscan). The files are in Integrated Weather Radar Facility (IWRF) format and are available as tar archives.

dataset.title: MAP: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field dorade format files obtained NSF/NCAR aircraft during the Mesoscale Alpine Programme (MAP) experiment.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/EAOP-98 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the EAOP-98 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-95 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., Arkansas-Red Basin River Forecast Center, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers Precipitation data, Oklahoma Mesonet Precipitation data, and the precipitation data extracted from the ESOP-95 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set contains a composite of the of interpolated 5hPa resolution upper air sounding data from all sources for the Remote sensing of Electrification, Lightning, And Meso-scale/micro-scale Processes with Adaptive Ground Observations (RELAMPAGO) project in the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) columnar ASCII format. The data set contains 2714 soundings including the Colorado State University (CSU) mobile radiosondes (105 soundings), the Center for Severe Weather Research (CSWR) mobile radiosondes (266 soundings), the University of Illinois (UIUC) mobile radiosondes (206 soundings), the DOE/ARM CACTI soundings from their two sites (1255 soundings), the INPE radiosondes from Sao Borja, Brazil (58 soundings), as well as the radiosondes from six locations around central Argentina that were operated by Servicio Meteorológico Nacional (SMN; 824 radiosondes).

dataset.title: ZEBRA GOES-E NOAA N42 N43 P-3 Radar Composite Imagery (Lower Fuselage C-band)
dataset.description: This dataset contains ZEBRA generated composites of GOES-E satellite imagery and LF C-band radar imagery from the N42 and N43 aircraft.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Quality Controlled Radiosonde Data - ISS3 York Site
dataset.description: This dataset contains quality controlled radiosonde data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS), using a Vaisala MW41 sounding system at the York, Nebraska site during the Great Plains Irrigation Experiment (GRAINEX). In total, 240 quality controlled radiosonde data files are contained in this archive in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 16:27:00 to 2010-04-20 07:22:00.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Pago Pago
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Pago Pago during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-09 00:00:00 to 2010-01-04 00:00:00.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) and does occasional special releases at other times of day (usually 18 UTC) from sites across the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released from 23 stations located within the Mesoscale Predictability Experiment (MPEX) domain for the MPEX field phase (15 May to 15 June 2013). A total of 1484 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final MPEX data set. These data were converted into the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS Surface Meteorology and Flux Products, 5 minute
dataset.description: Quality-controlled 5 minute averages of surface meteorology and flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) at 12 sites during the Great Plains Irrigation Experiment (GRAINEX) in southeast Nebraska. These data have been quality-controlled and are available in NetCDF format. Winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected and rotated into geographic coordinates.

dataset.title: NEXRAD LNX (Thedford, NE) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Thedford, NE. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During IDEAS-4 C130, the C-130 flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during IDEAS-4 C130 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 59 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains forward-looking images.

dataset.title: Aircraft Spectra Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of spectra data for Phases I, II, and III during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Title, vessel(s), phase, and optional note are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: ABLE-3B: PAM-II Data
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from 4 PAM stations from the Arctic Boundary Layer Expedition (ABLE-3B) above Northeast Canada during the summer months. The data files are in Common Mesonet Format (CMF).

dataset.title: Mobile MGLASS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains rawinsonde profiles collected during the International H20 Project (IHOP 2002) from May 5th to June 25th, 2002 . Rawinsondes were released from two Atmospheric Technology Division Mobile Glass systems. The data set underwent ATD and the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research Joint Office of Science Support (UCAR/JOSS) quality control procedures. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Queen Air aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the cloud Boundary Layer interaction eXperiment (BLX-83) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: FIRE: CLASS Soundings
dataset.description:
This sounding data is from the First ISCCP Regional Experiment (FIRE). NCAR's Cross Chain Loran Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) rawinsonde data consist of vertical profiles of pressure, temperature, relative humidity and wind speed/direction from three stations. Data from each CLASS station is in raw ascii format Data is ordered by station plus the mobile CLASS. Data have three versions of a given sounding: an "x" version that includes 10-second intervals, in"i" version with data interpolated to every 5mb level, and an "m" version with 1-sec raw data with data flags collected during the sonde ascent. Files are named according to the following convention: amddhhmm.sta
where
a refers to the file type (either "i", "x", or "m")
m is the month of the data (values 1-9,a-c; b=Nov)
dd day of month
hh hour of day of sounding start
mm minute of day for sounding start (hhmm is approximate)
sta three-letter station ID

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Monticello)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Monticello site in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1996. These data are in daily netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: MODIS AQUA Satellite Images
dataset.description: This dataset contains images from the Aqua MODIS NASA satellite--650 channel, 850 channel 2, and color channel 143 images--taken between December 9, 2004 and January 17, 2005. Not all days have images.

dataset.title: NAWS China Lake Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). It includes 30 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from China Lake, CA (WMO 74612). Soundings were released from 1 Mar to 27 Apr 2006. Soundings were only released when required for NAWS operations.

dataset.title: WSR-88D Echo Tops Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains echo tops imagery from the WSR-88D radars located in the PLOWS 2009-2010 domain. For the PLOWS 2009-2010 period a set of radars were always collected: La Crosse WI (ARX), Milwaukee WI (MKX), Davenport IA (DVN), Lincoln IL (ILX), Chicago IL (LOT), Indianapolis IN (IND), Webster IN (IWX), Evansville, IN (VWX), and St. Louis MO (LSX) and others were collected depending on where operations were occurring: Birmingham AL (BMX), Columbia SC (CAE), Cleveland OH (CLE), Jackson MS (DGX), Denver CO (FTG), Dallas/Ft. Worth TX (FWS), Goodland KS (GLD), Green Bay WI (GRB), Columbus AFB MS (GWX), Ft. Campbell KY (HPX), Hytop AL (HTX), Wilmington OH (ILN), Jackson KY (JKL), North Platte NE (LNX), Louisville KY (LVX), Marquette MI (MQT), Knoxville TN (MRX), Memphis TN (NQA), Omaha NE (OAX), Nashville TN (OHX), Paducah KY (PAH), Ft Polk LA (POE), Shreveport LA (SHV), Ft Smith AR (SRX), Oklahoma City OK (TLX), Topeka KS (TWX), and Hastings ME (UEX). These imagery were produced by NCAR/EOL. During periods when the NCAR C-130 was flying (and satcom was available) the flight track is included in the imagery. See the PLOWS 2009-2010 Field Catalog to see when imagery for particular sites are available.

dataset.title: Model 72 hour forecast sfc temps,winds, 500mb heights (GIF)
dataset.description: This data set contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) 72 hour forecast of surface winds and temperature and 500mb heights for the SHEBA domain from SSEC at University of Wisconsin.

dataset.title: NEXRAD SGF (Springfield/NWSFO, MO) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Springfield/NWSFO, MO. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg7 SCIP-MROC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-8 IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Infrared (11 micron) imagery collected for the 5-year GCIP Enhanced Observing Period (EOP) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS MISS 915 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Products
dataset.description: NCAR EOL Mobile Integrated Sounding System (MISS) 915 MHz Profiler data taken during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 30 April 2012 through 28 June 2012. Both moment data (*.mom.nc) and winds data (*winds_LO.nc) are included in this data set. The data are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw 2D-S Imagery [Rogers/NCAR-RAF]
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 µm. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NCAR GV during the DC3 project. The 2DS puts all flight data into 3 files, and the size of these files depends on the amount of time in clouds.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During WE-CAN, the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number N130AR) flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Surface Weather Observation PLOWS Sector Map Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains maps of surface weather observations over the PLOWS sector. The latest observation at the time the plot was generated was utilized, so the plots contain a mix of standard hourly and special observations. The maps were generated by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 27 January to 30 March 2009 and 14 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: NWS Constant Pressure Plot Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Rawinsonde NWS Constant Pressure Plot imagery. Each day contains images for 300 MB, 500 MB, 700 MB, and 850 MB analysis at 00:00 and 12:00.

dataset.title: NEXRAD FTG (Denver/Boulder, CO) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes reflectivity and velocity imagery from the NEXRAD radar near Denver and Boulder, CO, taken from the VORTEX2 field catalog for 2009 and 2010. The files are gif images. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files)
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the IDEAS-4_GV project.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR uncorrected radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) Field Moments data collected during the SAANGRIA Test project from 14 February 2013 to 3 March 2013. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as large tar files (one per flight). Note: This dataset is not quality controlled. Please contact us before using this dataset

dataset.title: GTS Skew-T Sounding Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains GTS Skew-T Sounding Plots [man/ sig levels] for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project taken twice daily from 20041104 - 20050201. These are plots for Barbados, Cape Verde, Guadeloupe, San Juan PR, Santa Domingo DR, St. Maarten, and Trinidad each day.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) operated by NCAR from 1973-1977. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the GAMETAG-77 project.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 16:00:00 to 2009-12-21 22:15:00.

dataset.title: USAF C-130 Dropsonde Data (EOL Format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes 86 high resolution dropsonde data files from the USAF C-130 aircraft that flew over the Atlantic basin and Gulf of Mexico during PREDICT. Data are included from thirteen flights that occurred 31 August to 29 September 2010. The data are in the EOL columnar ASCII sounding format. These data have undergone the NCAR/EOL dropsonde quality control processing, see the readme for details.

dataset.title: NCDC 15-Minute Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This data set contains National Climatic Data Center Fifteen Minute Precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. Data from this source was quality controlled to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa site WebCam images, looking south
dataset.description: Daily tar files of jpg images taken every 6 seconds during a 14 hour period. These images are from the South facing camera of the four cameras mounted at the NCAR S-PolKa Radar. When ordering data, please by aware that a daily tar file is just over 500 MG.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TORERO, the GV_N677F flew a right-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5-mb Level Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of radiosondes collected from 5 sounding platforms during the Variability of the American MOnsoonS (VAMOS) Ocean-Cloud-Atmosphere-Land Study (VOCALS) 2008 project with data collected from 30 September 2008 through 1 December 2008. This project was conducted off and along the coast of northern Chile, South America in the eastern Pacific Ocean. This composite contains a total of 678 high resolution soundings. The data includes 678 soundings with 91 soundings from the lower site at Paposo, Chile, 215 soundings from R/V Ron Brown, 47 dropsondes from the United Kingdom Facility for Airborne Atmospheric Measurements (FAAM) BAe-146 aircraft, 192 soundings from the GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) system located at Iquique, Chile, and 133 soundings from the R/V Jose Olaya GAUS system. Users are strongly encouraged to contact FAAM BAe for guidance on using their dropsonde data. Please contact Grant Allen at grant dot allen at manchester.ac.uk. This data set contains upper-air sounding data interpolated to a constant vertical resolution of 5 hPa in the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) Sounding Composite Format.

dataset.title: NCDC SAO Specials Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/ESOP-96 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Aviation Observation (SAO) "Special" observation surface data for the ESOP-96 domain. These are observations that are reported at off-hour times and report significant changes in conditions from the previous hourly reports. These reports can include all of the information shown in hourly SAOs, but more typically, report only portions of the data. A complete listing of the requirements to issue a "special SAO" are included in the Federal Meteorological Handbook No. 1 (1988).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the Mexico City Air Pollution study (MexCAPS) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR Water Vapor DIAL Data
dataset.description: Profiles of absolute humidity and backscatter from the NCAR/EOL Water-Vapor Differential Absorption Lidar (WV-DIAL) during the Perdigao field season. These data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: METAR Surface Observation Plots Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes imagery from the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) Surface Observations taken during the T-REX field project. These hourly National Weather Service (NWS) station plots include images of the entire T-REX region in California, as well as images of the Western United States.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During CAESAR, the NSF/NCAR C-130 flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. The images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds to 59 minutes 59 seconds after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S- and Ka-band
dataset.description: Hourly files of S-band and Ka-band S-PolKa radar data taken continuously during the DYNAMO (Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation) project.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 15:00:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: VORTEX: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This data set taken during the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment 94 [VORTEX) contains sounds from Cross Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) stations. The data set is 4 tar files. There are three ascii tar files, one each from Oklahoma site, Lubbock, Texas and one Mobile CLASS set. One file contains all data in binary format.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Airborne Carbon in the Mountains Experiment" project which took place from 14 May 2004 to 2 August 2004. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 Sample Per Second) production data set. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: USWRP/STORM Fronts Experiment Systems Test (STORM-FEST) sounding data were collected from Cross-chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) instruments at 8 locations: Arkansas City, Burington, Iowa City, Kearney, Kirsksville, St. Louis, Seneca and Storm Lake.

dataset.title: CONTRAST Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics (CONTRAST) project from January 3 - February 24, 2014. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the CONTRAST project.

dataset.title: Montana&#39;s RWIS &quot;Specials&quot; Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: Montana's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) "Specials" Surface Data in QC Format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Twin Otter 1hz Forward and Side-looking camera movies - mp4 format
dataset.description: This dataset contains movies from the forward and side-looking Twin Otter cameras. The movies are in .mov format and are available for each research flight.

dataset.title: GOES-8 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible satellite imagery collected for the STORM-WAVE experiment via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Japan Hachijojima High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC). It includes 146 High Resolution Radiosonde soundings from Hachijojima, Japan released during T-PARC. Hachijojima is located approximately 300 km south of Tokyo. The soundings were typically released twice per day (00 and 12 UTC) from 1 August to 1 October 2008, but additional releases were sometimes made. The soundings are in EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains daily precipitation data extracted from the GCIP/LSA-NW 00 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative data for the EAOP-00 domain.

dataset.title: Water Vapor Sensing System (Winds, Temperatures, and Water Vapor Fields from Commercial Aircraft) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains the JOSS quality controlled WVSS-I data. This data has consistent water vapor information (dewpoint, RH, and mixing ratio are consistent), and has the benefit of time continuity to check for changes in WVSS-I calibration. IMPORTANT NOTE: The sensor technology of the first generation Water Vapor Sensing System (WVSS-I) is Vaisala's thin-film capacitor. Though a better sensor than found on radiosondes, it still loses calibration over time. The data from WVSS-I gathered from July 1, 1999 to December 31, 1999 has been evaluated and a scientific article is being prepared. This data is useful with data from four of the six aircraft considered quite good. One aircraft (#376) appears approximately 5% too wet and one aircraft (#441) appears approximately 5% too dry (very dry in November and December 1999). See the README for further information.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:22:00 to 2011-10-12 07:22:00.

dataset.title: FIFE-II: KingAir Photography Video Camera
dataset.description: This dataset contains hourly mpg movies from videos taken on the KingAir during the FIFE-II project. Each hour of mpg movie file is about 1.3 Gb in size.

dataset.title: MAIR-E Chatlogs
dataset.description: Flight Chat Logs for the MAIR-E (Methane Emissions Quantification at scales from 20 m to 200 km using the MethaneAIR Imaging Spectrometer on the NSF Gulfstream-V) field project, collected from 22 October to 15 November 2022 onboard the NSF/NCAR GV (Gulfstream V) HIAPER. These data are available in a txt format.

dataset.title: Curacao Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). This data set includes 95 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from Curacao. (WMO 78988). Soundings were typically released twice per day (0000 and 1200 UTC) from 1 August to 8 October 2005. This dataset contains soundings released during hurricanes: Katrina and Ophelia.

dataset.title: SOAS AABC Site NCAR EOL ISS SODAR Data
dataset.description: This data set contains SOnic Detection And Ranging (SODAR) data collected at the Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) AABC site during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS) from 20 May 2013 to 16 July 2013. Data orders will include both ASCII and netCDF files.

dataset.title: GTS Mandatory/Significant Level Sounding Data (ESC Format)
dataset.description: This data set contains the quality controlled GTS radiosonde data from sites in the southeastern United States, the Mexican Gulf Coast, and Caribbean for which high vertical resolution data were not available for the period of HAIC-HIWC 2015 Florida operations, 10-24 August 2015. A total of 238 quality-controlled, mandatory and significant level resolution soundings are contained in the final data set.

dataset.title: GCIP/EAOP-99 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, W.K. Kellogg Biological Station daily precipitation, USDA Agricultural Research Service NAEW daily precipitation data (Coshocton), Tennessee Valley Authority daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the GCIP LSA-E EAOP-99 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Pago Pago
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Pago Pago during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 11:07:00 to 2010-04-20 14:45:00.

dataset.title: AESOP/TEXASAQS: NCAR/NSF Electra (N308D) Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF Electra aircraft during the Texas Air Quality Study (AESOP/TEXASAQ) project. This data contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1 sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: CPPA: SGP Meteorological Tower Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Climate Prediction Program for the Americas (CPPA) Southern Great Plains (SGP) 30 Minute Meteorological Tower Data Set. This data set contains data from the Lamont C1 Extended Facility station. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the STORM-FEST project.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files) - from HRT data files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the DEEPWAVE project.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the MITTS project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking west
dataset.description: West-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the FRONT (Front Range Observational Network Testbed) project from 1 January 2014 through 10 April 2015. See the FRONT S-Pol Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During the IDEAS-4 C130 project, the C130 flew a forward looking and a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during IDEAS-4 C130 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains downward-looking images.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 1299 MHz Wind Profiler NIMA Moments Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 1299 MHz wind profiler moments data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Steamboat Springs, CO during the Inhibition of Snowfall by Pollution Aerosol project in 2002 (ISPA-2002). This dataset includes doppler moments data (.momnc) only, as the profiler was operating in the vertically-pointing mode throughout the project, in NetCDF format. These data are have been processes by the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA) and are thus quality controlled.

dataset.title: FP4 NCAR/EOL Ceilometer Mixed Layer Height Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the mixed layer height observations from the NCAR/EOL Ceilometer located on the PECAN Fixed PISA 4 site at Minden, Nebraska. These data show where gradients in reflectivity are detected indicating possible boundary layers. These data are in a columnar ASCII format.

dataset.title: Queen Air Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the Queen Air aircraft during Phase III as well as the After Phase. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) during the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades) project. These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page.

dataset.title: WISP91: CLASS Soundings
dataset.description: Sounding data from he 1991 Winter Icing and Storms Project (WISP91) includes data from 6 fixed Cross-chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) instruments and one mobile CLASS system. Each location includes skew-t gif and postscript images, data in raw class and in raw ascii formats and analysis with images and ascii data. Data is ordered by location plus mobile CLASS data.

dataset.title: DEEPWAVE Chat Logs [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains the scrubbed chat logs from the DEEPWAVE project from May 21 - June 24, 2014. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase the DEEPWAVE project.

dataset.title: WiFE: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) raw output
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Wild Fires Experiment. Files are tar files of all data types from individual flight tapes, includeing "aimrOutput " data files.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-98 6 second NWS soundings data set contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART sounding systems at nine sites over the GCIP LSA-North Central region. The data set contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality controlled, with every sounding subject to automated consistency checks. No visual examination was conducted on these soundings. Refer to the README file for more details.

dataset.title: MDB: Tumbarumba Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-3 and EOP-4) Murray-Darling Basin (MDB) Tumbarumba Flux Data Set. This dataset contains data from Bago State Forest for the complete CEOP EOP-3 period and a portion of the EOP-4 time period (1 October 2002 through 30 September 2004) This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Sudbury, Ontario Canada
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data from Sudbury, Ontario Canada. This site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). This data set has undergone ATD and The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of rawinsonde release times for Sudbury.

dataset.title: PCAPS ISS WXT Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the WXT sensor at the Integrated Sounding System 3 (ISS3) site during the Persistent Cold-Air Pool Study (PCAPS) from 01 December 2010 to 19 February 2011. The data are available in daily, tarred netCDF format and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NEXRAD radar data, from nearby systems, in cfRadial format
dataset.description: This data set consists of cfRadial format, daily files of NEXRAD radar data taken continuously during the FRONT (Front Range Observational Network Testbed) project. See the FRONT Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability.

dataset.title: GOES 13 4KM Channel 4 Thermal IR Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 13 4KM channel 4 thermal IR imagery from the 2010 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Makassar Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 337 high vertical resolution soundings from Makassar, Indonesia (WMO 97180) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: SCP 5 minute ISFS data, not QC&#39;d, sonic winds in instrument coordinates
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NetCDF files containing non-quality-controlled 5 minute means and covariances of surface data from the Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the Shallow Cold Pool Study (SCP) from 20 September to 30 November 2012. Winds from sonic anemometers are in instrument coordinates.

dataset.title: Cloud Slides
dataset.description: This dataset includes color slides of cloud footage during Phases I and II as well as the Inter Phase. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Ambon Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 363 high vertical resolution soundings from Ambon, Indonesia (WMO 97724) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well as a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Pam-II Data CMF format [NCAR]
dataset.description: This data contains two tar files, 1minute and 5 minute, each containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the Storm-Fest experiment.

dataset.title: RELAMPAGO Mobile Ground Asset KML Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the real time geolocation information for the mobile ground assets that provided their location information via Delorme GPS devices for the RELAMPAGO Field Catalog. The frequency of the location data varied depending on the settings used by each vehicle. The assets include the CSWR DOW/COW/probes and the mobile radiosonde units from CSU and UIUC. These data have not been quality checked.

dataset.title: QC ISFS High Rate Surface Data, tilt corrected sonic winds in geographic coordinates
dataset.description: This data set contains high rate ISFS data collected from 2016-08-15 through 2016-11-03 as part of the VERTEX field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format, and have tilt corrected sonic winds in geographic coordinates.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Padang Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 421 high vertical resolution soundings from Padang, Indonesia (WMO 96163) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC during October and November 2011 and January through March 2012 and four times daily at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC during December 2011. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Forward-Facing Digital Cameral Images [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains images from the forward looking camera of the C130 during the INTEX-B2 project. The C130 flew a forward looking digital camera and a downward looking camera for in-flight video capture. Individual jpeg images were captured once per second during project flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. This dataset only contains the forward-looking camera images.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-11 13:30:00 to 2009-02-01 19:30:00.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg6 NZCH-YMHB Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NZCH-YMHB Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-16 01:32:00 to 2011-09-21 15:32:00.

dataset.title: GOES-12 Channel 2 Infrared Satellite Imagery - Chile
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-12 Channel 2 infrared satellite imagery from 13-14 January 2012 for the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project. The imagery covers Antofagasta, Chile, where the NSF/NCAR GV was forward deployed.

dataset.title: AMTS: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains NetCDF data obtained aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft during the Arctic Mesopause Temperature Study (AMTS) project. This dataset contains the Low Rate (LRT, 1sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: Chatham Island (93986), NZ, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 UTC daily.

dataset.title: HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler (AWAS) [Atlas (U.Miami)]
dataset.description: The HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler measured trace gases from whole air samples collected by NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-5. In addition to tracers, the AWAS measured a full suite of halocarbon species. This dataset contains AWAS data in NASA Ames format collected during HIPPO-5.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Hillsborough (United Kingdom)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Hillsborough in the United Kingdom (WMO 03920) which was operated by the UK Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Ice in Clouds Experiment -T" (ICE-T) project. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps, mixed) production data. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled NCAR ASTER and Oklahoma Mesonet surface data 2000
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR ASTER and Oklahoma Mesonet surface data collected during the Oklahoma Atmospheric Surface-layer Instrumentation System project (OASIS) in 2000. These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected, but remain in a corrdinate system relative to the sensor.

dataset.title: NCAR MISS 915 MHz DBS Wind Profiler Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL operated three 915 MHz boundary layer wind profiler radars at ISS (Integrated Sounding System) sites at T-REX. These radars detect scattering from clear-air refractivity gradients (such as those due to turbulence and inversions) and from precipitation. Two of the three wind profilers were standard DBS (Doppler Beam Swinging) systems, one of which provided the data for the accompanying data set. The DBS profilers at T-REX were designated ISS2 and MISS and produced wind measurements every 30 minutes and also made a 5-minute RASS profile at 30-minute intervals. This dataset includes MISS winds, moments, and rass data. The MISS system was a mobile system and moved around 5 sites in the Owens Valley.

dataset.title: Multi-Network 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: 5mb vertical resolution sounding data from research and operational sources during the Cold Air Outbreak Experiment in the Sub-Arctic Region (CAESAR) campaign converted into a common format (EOL Sounding Composite format which is a columnar ASCII format). The composite includes data from 568 radiosondes and 116 dropsondes from locations around the Norwegian Sea. The radiosondes were released by the Norwegian Meteorological Institute from four sites and the dropsondes were released by NCAR/EOL from the NSF NCAR C-130 aircraft in ten research flights.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - ICARTT format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ORCAS (The O2/N2 Ratio and CO2 Airborne Southern Ocean Study) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in ICARTT format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Clouds data subset (ICARTT format)
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the DC3 project. This dataset contains 2DC data (CONC2DC[AR]_LWOI, DBAR2DC[AR]_LWOI, and PLWC2DC[AR]_LWOI) extracted from updated netCDF data files. Files are in ICARTT format. EOL previously released 1D data for DC3 in ICARTT format. This data is slightly different from that data, so users who are focusing on cloud particle research may wish to download this data.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: High vertical resolution radiosonde data from research and operational sources during the Winter Precipitation Type Research Multi-scale Experiment (WINTRE-MIX) campaign converted into a common format (EOL Sounding Composite format which is a columnar ASCII format) are included in this dataset. The composite includes data from radiosondes from locations around Quebec, Canada and the northeastern United States. The radiosondes were released by the University at Albany (three sites), University of Colorado Boulder (four sites), Université du Québec à Montréal (three sites), McGill University (three sites), and the National Weather Service (four sites).

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Bellterre
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data for Bellterre, Quebec Canada. This site was operated by The Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). This data have undergone ATD and The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of available rawinsonde release times.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV (HIAPER) 3V-CPI Raw CPI ROI Imagery [Rogers/NCAR-RAF]
dataset.description: The Three-View Cloud Particle Imager (3V-CPI) is a combination of three imaging instruments. Two of them comprise a 2D-S instrument, in which two 2D probes image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. In that case, the CPI is triggered to take a high-resolution picture, via a briefly illuminated high-resolution imaging array, to provide a third image at high resolution. The probe is particularly suited to imaging ice crystals, but also provide good detection of other hydrometeors including large cloud droplets, drizzle and small rain drops, and precipitation particles. The 3V-CPI measures the size, shape and concentration of water drops and ice particles in clouds in the size range of 15-250 µm. This dataset contains CPI roi images collected by the 3V-CPI aboard the NSF/NCAR GV N677F during the PREDICT project. For all of the flights, the CPI makes as many *.roi files as it needs; each file can be maximum 92Mb size and then a new file is opened.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 915 MHz Radar Wind Profiler Products - ISS2 Rogers Farm Site
dataset.description: 915 MHz wind profiler winds and moments data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Rogers Farm site east of Lincoln, NE during the GRAINEX field campaign. This dataset includes consensus winds and moments data in NetCDF format, and has been quality-controlled through the NCAR Improved Moments Algorithm (NIMA). These data have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: FABLE 1999 NCAR/ATD Wisconsin Site ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the WLEF-TV transmitter near Park Falls, Wisconsin during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 1999. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Lightning Detection Gridded Product Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the lightning detection gridded product data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of RELAMPAGO operations. Included are flash/group extent density, flash/group centroid density, event density, average flash area, and total energy. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) QueenAir B-80 aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the South Central Coast Cooperative Aerometric Monitoring Program (BOLDOS/SCCCAMP). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the MAIR-E project. Files contain low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NOWRAD Radar Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains NOWRAD imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: NAME_Region.

dataset.title: Low Rate (1sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The INtercontinental chemical Transport EXperiment - Phase B was a two phase experiment that aimed to understand the transport and transformation of gases and aerosols on transcontinental/intercontinental scales and assess their impact on air quality and climate. The primary constituents of interest are ozone and its precursors, aerosols and precursors, and the long-lived greenhouse gases. INTEX-B was conducted during a 10-week period from March 1 to May 15, 2006. The first phase of the study was performed during March and focused on Mexico City pollution outflow, while the second phase was performed during April and May and focused on Asian pollution outflow. This dataset contains Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the second phase (INTEX-B2). The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Microwave Temperature Profiler (MTP) Data
dataset.description: The MTP data set consists of two file types. File names of the form MPyyyymmdd.NGV contain vertical temperature profile data. Files named TCyyyymmdd.PNG contain quick-look images showing temperature curtain plots for each flight.

dataset.title: GAUS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: This dataset contains NCAR GPS GAUS radiosonde data collected over the Sierra Madre mountain range in Southern Wyoming between 7 January and 3 March 2012 as part of the AgI Seeding of Clouds Impact Investigation (ASCII) project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the SNOP project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-97 Surface: Hourly Surface Meteorological Composite
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-97 Hourly Surface Composite contains data from several networks (i.e., Automated Surface Observing System, Department of Energy Atmospheric Radiation Measurement Surface, Wind Profiler Network, High Plains Climate Network, Missouri Automated Agricultural Network, Missouri Department of Conservation Fire Network, National Climatic Data Center DATSAV2, National Data Buoy Center, National Soil Tilth Laboratory, University of Minnesota Rosemount Experimental Station, University of Wisconsin Agricultural Weather Observation Network, Illinois Climate Network, Chicago Mesonet, National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration Atmospheric Turbulence and Diffusion Divsision meteorological data, Natural Resource Conservation Service Soil Moisture Soil Temperature, and the Environmental Protection Agency Meteorological data from several states including Michigan and Wisconsin) for the ESOP 97 domain. Data from these sources were merged and quality controlled to form this Surface Composite. These data files are available as ASCII text files and netCDF data files.

dataset.title: CAMP: Korean Haenam Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Korean Haenam Flux Data Set. This data set contains data at a half-hour resolution from one station in the CAMP reference site for the CEOP EOP-3 time period, which is the Korean Haenam station. This dataset only contains the entire EOP-3 time period (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 30 September 2003). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During OTREC, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files.
