The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR C-130 during WiFE-Test. The data are in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL R/V Investigator ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: 5-minute webcam imagery collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) onboard the R/V Investigator during the SOCRATES Field Campaign. These data are JPG images that have been tarred into daily bundles.

dataset.title: USCGC Healy Cruise HLY-02-03 NCAR EOL Service Data [NCAR EOL Service group]
dataset.description: This CD ROM was created 23 August 2002 at the end of the SBI Summer Cruise aboard the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy. It contains data in the state they were in as of the end of the cruise. At that time, the Conductivity Temperature Depth (CTD) and bottle data were thought to be in their final form. The state (preliminary or final) of all other datasets on this CD were unknown at that time. This CD contains the following types of information: Acoustic Depth Current Profiler (ADCP), Expendable Conductivity Temperature Depth ( XCTD), station documentation and CTD / bottle data, preliminary hydrographic plots, digital photos taken by various project participants during the cruise.

dataset.title: Humans and Hydrology at High Latitudes: Water Use Information
dataset.description: This data set contains water use information for Canadian and Alaskan communities as well as general water-use estimates provided by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) for the whole of the United States. These data are utilized in the Arctic Rapid Integrated Monitoring System (ArcticRIMS) project to improve the development of the water stress model. This water stress model shows the effects of water resources, humans and climate change in the Arctic. Recent studies suggest that climate change will have a significant impact on arctic hydrology. However, it is currently unknown which regions of the pan-Arctic are most vulnerable to future changes. In order to begin to address the future change to freshwater availability on a pan-arctic scale, a system of arctic typologies were used to enable the integration of biophysical data with socio-cultural data produced regionally, such as demographics and water values. Those mature data sets were used to study the strategic transformations of the high latitude water cycle. The overall objective of this research is to use a wide array of existing data sets in a synthesis effort to describe the vital role of freshwater in the lives of people in the pan-Arctic, how it has changed in the recent past, and how it is likely to change in the future.

dataset.title: ICE-T Chat Logs [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the ICE-T project from 1-31 July 2011. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the ICE-T project.

dataset.title: MNBBS AWOS/ASOS Surface
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/ESOP-97 Minnesota Bulletin Board Service (MNBBS) surface data for the GCIP/ESOP-97 domain and time period.

dataset.title: GTS West Atlantic Station Plot Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains gif images from the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) West Atlantic station collected during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project time period.

dataset.title: NOAA/NWS Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX) project. This data set includes 4444 high vertical resolution (6-second) soundings from 17 National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the southeast United States and Puerto Rico and 268 high vertical resolution (1.2-second) soundings from 1 NWS rawindonde station in the southeast United States for the period 01 July 2005 to 31 October 2005. There are also 72 high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings from the NWS Corpus Christi, TX site from 3 October to 31 October 2005 when it switched to the Radiosonde Replacement System (RRS) soundings. The soundings were typically released twice a day (0000 and 1200 UTC). This dataset contains soundings released during hurricanes: Dennis, Emily, Gert, Katrina, Ophelia, Rita, and Wilma.

dataset.title: GOES-8 VIS Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible imagery collected for the 5-year GCIP Enhanced Observing Period (EOP) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 4 km resolution. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Mobile GAUS Radiosonde Data - EOL Sounding Composite Format
dataset.description: The Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment (VORTEX) is a project aimed at investigating tornado genesis and examining tornado structure and evolution using a suite of atmostpheric instruments. The VORTEX2 field campaigns included the use of four mobile GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) systems. This dataset contains 105 radiosonde soundings collected during the 2009 field campaign (May 11 - June 14, 2009) and 174 radiosonde soundings collected during the 2010 field campaign (May 6 - June 15, 2010) from two of the systems that were operated by EOL's Atmopsheric Profiling Group.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During ICE-T, the NCAR C-130 flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER Digital Camera Movies with Data - Final
dataset.description: During CONTRAST (CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) withTail Number GV_N677F flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining forward, downward, left- and right-facing images for each second were combined into a single image and processed to include production data along the right side of the image and converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: CV-990 Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the CV-990 aircraft during Phases I, II, and III during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: Beaumont 5-mb CLASS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: CLASS radiosonde profiles taken at Beaumont, Kansas for the CASES-97 program. The site was operated by NCAR/Earth Observing Laboratory (formerly Atmospheric Technology Division). These soundings have been interpolated to 5 mb vertical intervals. The quality control information is that provided by NCAR/EOL. UCAR/JOSS has not altered these soundings in any way. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the readme file for details.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, AVHRR 1KM Channel 5 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12, 14, 15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 5 Imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are at a 1KM resolution and in .gif format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:00:00 to 2011-07-14 22:16:00.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the Improvement of Microphysical Parameterization through Observational Verification Experiment (IMPROVE) . These data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar files.

dataset.title: POES Antarctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains composite Antarctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-17 18:00:00 to 2009-02-01 15:00:00.

dataset.title: NCDC Hourly Precipitation Data in QC format
dataset.description: This data set contains National Climatic Data Center hourly precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period. Data from this source was quality controlled by JOSS.

dataset.title: NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Surface Dataset
dataset.description: The National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Surface Climatic Database (DATSAV3) Dataset reports for 10 stations in the SGP99 time period (1 July 1999 thru 31 July 1999) and domain (approximately 97W to 99W longitude and 34.5N to 37N latitude). This dataset contains only the "nominal" records for the DATSAV3 dataset. The special records are located in the SGP99 Surface: NCDC DATSAV3 Hourly Surface Specials Dataset. This dataset is provided as is and was not quality controlled by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Forward-Facing Digital Camera MPEG Movies (MSS) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains MPEG4 movies from a forward facing cockpit camera on the flights of the NSF/NCAR C-130 during MILAGRO. The movies were compiled from the images in the companion dataset.

dataset.title: NCAR Electra Formaldehyde data
dataset.description: This data set contains the formaldehyde data obtained from the NCAR Electra during the Kuwait Oil-Fire Smoke Experiment (KOFSE). Data were collected in May 1991. Files are in ASCII text format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 2KM/4KM Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains Satellite GOES-10 imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: 2km_ch1_vis, 4km_ch1_vis, 4km_ch3_water_vapor, 4km_ch4_thermal-IR.

dataset.title: Standard Sea Ice Observation Reports Polar Sea Cruise PSEA-10-01
dataset.description: A link to the BEST Field Catalog for the PSEA-10-01 Cruise Ice Observations reports

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (King Air) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King-Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the ELectra RaDOME Tests (ELDOME) Intercomparison project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Hobart
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Hobart, Tasmania during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-09 23:00:00 to 2011-07-13 11:00:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Low Rate (1sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The Gulf Of Tehuantepec Experiment, Coupled Development of Ocean Waves and Boundary Layers (aka OceanWaves) was an experiment that aimed to measure the coupled development of the atmospheric boundary layer and the surface wave field over the Gulf of Tehuantapec, off southern Mexico's Pacific coast. GOTEX was conducted during the period from February 3 to February 29, 2004. This dataset contains Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR). The files are in netCDF format. NOTE: These data were updated May, 2011 to correct a systematic bias in the 3-D winds.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar moments data, S- and Ka-band, 11 variables, DORADE
dataset.description: 11 variables of S- and Ka-band data (DORADE sweepfiles) collected by the S-PolKa radar during the Rain in Cumulus Over the Ocean (RICO) field campaign.

dataset.title: Picarro L2130-i Water Vapor and Ice Crystal Isotope Ratios
dataset.description: Water vapor and ice crystal isotope ratios were measured with two Picarro L2130-i water vapor isotopic analyzers: Desert Research Institute’s (DRI’s) HIDS2034 and NCAR’s HIDS2346. Both analyzers were operated at nominal 0.5 Hz frequency during the SPL deployment. HIDS2346 was operated in 5-Hz flight-ready mode during the instrument characterization, which took place December 20, 2018 – January 7, 2019. The download is organized as a single .tar.gz file that contains contains datafiles, datasets, and numerical processing scripts associated with the January 2019 Mixed Phase (cloud) Isotopes sampling experiment at Storm Peak Laboratory (SPL) in Steamboat Springs, Colorado. Specifically, the directory contains: • All uncorrected, sample rate data • Calibration data points • Models for correcting the data for known biases • Processing scripts for correcting, selecting, and averaging the data • Corrected data for the pre-deployment, main experiment, and post-experiment periods • “Quick look” visualization plots (Please see supporting documents ReadMe.pdf and MetaData_SPL_PreDeployment.pdf for additional dataset information.)

dataset.title: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the Joint Airport Weather Studies (JAWS) experiment.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [Beaton, S. (NCAR-EOL-RAF)]
dataset.description: During IDEAS-4 GV, the NSF/NCAR GV flew a right-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during IDEAS-4 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 59 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER CIMS SO2 and HNO3 In Situ Measurements
dataset.description: This data set contains NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER In Situ Measurements by the Chemical Ionization Mass Spectrometer (CIMS) of sulfur dioxide (SO2) and nitric acid (HNO3) collected during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) from 11 May 2012 through 30 June 2012. This data set contains both second and 20-second data collected by the CIMS. This data set is in ICARTT format. Please see the header portion of the data files for details on instruments, parameters, quality assurance, quality control, contact information, and data set comments.

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Beattyville
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data for Beattyville, Quebec Canada. The site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). These data have undergone ATD and The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of available rawinsonde release times.

dataset.title: MAP: NCAR Electra PMS2D Two-dimensional Cloud Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains binary "filmstrip" imagery files of PMS-2D data obtained aboard the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Mesoscale Alpine Programme (MAP) project.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled GRAINEX NWS soundings released at nine sites throughout the Upper Midwestern United States during the GRAINEX field phase (30 May - 31 July 2018). Two stations in the region were only available at mandatory/significant level resolution (KDVN - Davenport, IA and KTOP - Topeka, KS) and are available in a separate data set. A total of 1173 quality-controlled, high vertical resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final GRAINEX data set.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data - 1 Hz [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the "HEFT Experimental Flight Test 2010" (HEFT10) project. This data set contains the Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) production data. The files are in netCDF format. Flights FF01, FF02, and RF01 also contain AMAX-DOAS data.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Forward-Facing Digital Camera Movies [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: During RICO the C-130 flew a forward looking digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Images were captured once per second during RICO flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into movies in QuickTime multimedia file format, one .mov file per flight.

dataset.title: CPPA: Fort Peck High Resolution Radiosonde Data (NWS Site Glasgow, MT)
dataset.description: This data set contains the Climate Prediction Program for the Americas (CPPA) Fort Peck high resolution radiosondes for the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP). The data was collected from the Glasgow, MT National Weather Service (NWS) upper air station and consists of six second vertical resolution profiles of pressure, temperature, wind speed, wind direction, relative humidity,and altitude from 01 October 2002 through 7 July 2007 and two second vertical resolution profiles from 16 July 2007 to 31 December 2009. The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did perform quality control processing on this data set. Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: GMS-5 WV Imagery
dataset.description: GMS-5 Water Vapor (WV) 6.7 micron imagery collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, from the Australian Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) then converted to GIF image format. These images consist of the Southern Ocean (image center 30 deg S, 140 deg E), 8 km resolution, every hour. Digital McIDAS Area format files (4 km resolution) were collected hourly at OFPS from the BoM from which these GIF images were created.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Raw 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: A 2D-S instrument contains two 2D probes which image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected aboard the NCAR GV during the ARISTO2016 project using the SPEC 2D-S (Stereo) probe. The original files have been processed so that they are compatible with xpms2d software.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During CAESAR, the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number N130AR) flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps. Animated plots are visible on the right side of the frame with the following variables: Plot 1: GGALT timeseries Plot 2: PSX timeseries Plot 3: ATX timeseries Plot 4: DPXC timeseries Plot 5: WIC timeseries Plot 6: PLWCC timeseries Plot 7: CONCS_2DS timeseries Plot 8: CONCD_LWI timeseries Plot 9: FO3C_ACD timeseries Plot 10: (ATX, DPXC), GGALT 1:1 Plot 11: GGLAT, GGLON 1:1

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 4914 quality controlled NWS (National Weather Service) soundings released at thirteen sites throughout the southeastern United States during the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Thunderstorms Experiment-Southeast (VORTEX-SE) Meso18-19 field phase (31 October 2018 to 20 April 2019). Twelve of the stations are available at 1-second vertical resolution (4539 soundings) and one station is available at mandatory and significant level resolution (375 soundings).

dataset.title: CP4 Doppler Radar DORADE format. Daily tar archives. [NCAR]
dataset.description: This dataset contains CP4 Doppler radar data collected during the STORM Fronts Experiment Systems Test (STORM-FEST) from 2 February 1992 to 13 March 1992. These data are in DORADE format and are available as daily tar archives.

dataset.title: SUNY Oswego Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes high vertical resolution (2-sec) soundings taken by the State University of New York - Oswego (SUNY-Oswego) mobile sounding system during the VORTEX2 field campaigns for 2009 and 2010. There are 10 soundings for the 2009 season (25 May through 7 June 2009) and 7 soundings for the 2010 season (24 May through 1 June 2010). These soundings are in the columnar ASCII EOL Sounding Composite format. A list of soundings by date and time is available in the documentation included with the dataset.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Stratospheric Aerosol Validation Experiment (SAVE) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Differential GPS (DGPS) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: Differential GPS (DGPS) data are time series of three-dimensional airplane coordinates that provide increased accuracy and precision compared to a standard GPS measurements. These DGPS measurements were collected as part of the HAIS Experimental Flight Test - 2010 (HEFT10).

dataset.title: CEOP Surface, Tower, Soils, and Flux Data Archive
dataset.description: This data set contains the complete set of surface, tower, soils, and flux data from all reference sites for the complete time period for the CEOP project. These data may be ordered as a single, gzipped TAR file containing either the netCDF or ASCII versions of the data. This data set includes only the data files. If you need the documentation file(s) for any particular data file, please reference that specific CEOP data set.

dataset.title: ISS Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains webcam imagery every 15 minutes during daylight hours from the Integrated Sounding System 2 (ISS2) Web Camera, which was located in the Salt Lake Valley during PCAPS. These data are in daily tarred files and were collected and processed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: IMARPE R/V Jose Olaya GAUS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: During the VAMOS Ocean-Cloud Atmosphere-Land Study (VOCALS) campaign, an NCAR/EOL GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding (GAUS) system was deployed. This dataset is from the system located on board the Instituto del Mar del Peru (IMARPE) ship R/V Olaya, and was conducted from September 30 to October 17, 2008. A total of 133 high quality radiosonde soundings were collected from the R/V Olaya along the coast of Peru. The site used Vaisala RS92 radiosondes with GPS windfinding. These data were processed by NCAR/EOL and converted to the EOL sounding composite format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: Dropsonde sounding profiles collected between June 6 and July 20, 2014 during the Deep Propagating Gravity Wave Experiment (DEEPWAVE) campaign. Data are in EOL file format and checked for quality.

dataset.title: INDOEX: Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) [NCAR/EOL/RSF] - raw AIMR tape data
dataset.description: This data set includes Airborne Imaging Microwave Radiometer (AIMR) measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Indian Ocean Experiment (INDOEX) 1999 experiment. These tar files contain raw aimr Output files.

dataset.title: GOES 12 South 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 South 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies - Final [NCAR/EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During ICE-T, the NCAR C-130 flew forward and downward looking digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies contain both forward and downward images at 512x384 pixels and select parameters for the image time. They are set to play back at 725x800 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: Diego Garcia Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes 679 high vertical resolution soundings from Diego Garcia collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released every three hours 30 September 2011 to 15 January 2012. The station used Vaisala RS92-SGPD radiosondes. This data set is the same as Diego Garcia Radiosonde L3 Data [/NCAR-EOL] but with the format converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format to match the other L2 DYNAMO sounding data sets.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915 MHz Wind Profiler NIMA Consensus Winds, Moments, and RASS Data
dataset.description: 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Advection Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (AHATS). This dataset includes doppler moments data (.mom.nc), consensus winds data (.winds*.nc), Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rass.nc) and RASS moments data (.rass_mom.nc) in NetCDF format. These data are tarred into daily files and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GTS Three-Hourly Synoptic Observation Data (GEMPAK)
dataset.description: The GTS Three-Hourly Synoptic Observation Data is one of several surface data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are the global three-hourly surface synoptic observations. These data are contained in daily files which are in GEMPAK format. The data cover the period from 7 - 28 July 2001. The data were acquired via the UNIDATA Local Data Manager (LDM).

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO. The data are in NetCDF format and are available for 11 flights.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Sadorus)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Sadorus site (ISS2) in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1995. These data are in monthly netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHNL-NSTU 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:30:00.

dataset.title: IFRACS 2014 GAUS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL deployed one GPS Atmospheric Sounding System (GAUS). For more information on this system please visit: https://www.eol.ucar.edu/node/148. The sounding system was located approximately 2.2 miles southeast of downtown Steamboat Springs. Sixty-four radiosonde launches were performed from between January 17 and February 28, 2014.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Channel 4 (Longwave IR) Imagery
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Channel 4 (Longwave IR) Sectored Imagery (GIF) is one of several satellite products collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase-II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project field catalog operated by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL: http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 4-km imagery from Channel 4 (longwave infrared; 10.70um) of the GOES-10 satellite. the products cover the period from 1-30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). The products are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). All images are in gif format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Quality Controlled High-rate ISFS surface flux data, geographic coordinate, tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains quality controlled, high-rate surface flux data collected by the Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the Perdigao field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format and the sonic winds have been corrected for boom orientation and tilt, and are thus rotated into a geographic coordinate system. The quality control proceedures and corrections applied to the data, as well as any uncorrectable issues are described in detail in the accompanying Data QC Report document. These data have been bundled into daily TAR archives and compressed using gzip. Each day of data is approximately 8 GB uncompressed.

dataset.title: HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler (AWAS) [Atlas (U.Miami)]
dataset.description: The HAIS Advanced Whole Air Sampler measured trace gases from whole air samples collected by NSF/NCAR GV during HIPPO-4. In addition to tracers, the AWAS measured a full suite of halocarbon species. This dataset contains AWAS data in NASA Ames format collected during HIPPO-4.

dataset.title: GOES-East Imager Water Vapor CH3 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Imager CH3 Water Vapor Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 15 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: Soundings Multi-Network Composite 5-mb Level Upper Air Data
dataset.description:
This dataset contains upper-air sounding data interpolated to a constant vertical resolution of 5 hPa in the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) Sounding Composite Format from stations in the following networks:
* NCAR GAUS,
* NCAR/NSF C-130 Dropsonde,
* NOAA National Weather Service (NOAA/NWS), and the
* R/V Seward Johnson Data for the Rain in Cumulus Over the Ocean (RICO) 2004-2005 domain (15°N to 21°N latitude and 75°W to 72°W longitude) are contained within this dataset. The dataset covers the time period 1 December 2004 through 31 January 2005. This RICO 2004-2005 Sounding Composite 5-mb Resolution Upper-Air Dataset contains 554 soundings from 4 sites.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-98 Surface: Special Surface Observations Composite
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/ESOP-98 Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) and National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) DATSAV2 "Special" observation surface data for the GCIP/ESOP-98 domain and time period. These are observations that are reported at off-hour times. The ASOS and DATSAV2 "Nominal" hourly surface data for the GCIP/ESOP-98 domain and time period are included in the GCIP/ESOP-98 Hourly Surface Composite.

dataset.title: GOES-16 ABI Meso Sector Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale sectors during the period of VORTEX-SE 2018 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The actual sectors vary in location and not all sectors will cover the VORTEX-SE region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: GALE: PAM Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM station data from the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and Rass Data (Monticello)
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Monticello site in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1996. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the CONTRAST project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Anchorage
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Anchorage, Alaska during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 12:00:00 to 2011-07-13 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the GOTHAAM project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: CAMP: Northeast Thailand Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Periods 3 and 4 (EOP-3and 4) CEOP Asia-Australia Monsoon Project (CAMP) Northeast Thailand Hourly Flux Data Set. This dataset contains the complete EOP-3 and EOP4 time periods (i.e., 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2004). This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Electra) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Remote Sensing of Cloud Water (RMM) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Raw SPEC 2D-S Imagery (RAF OAP .2d format)
dataset.description: A 2D-S instrument contains two 2D probes which image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. This dataset contains 2D-S imagery collected aboard the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the ICE-L project using the SPEC 2D-S (Stereo) probe. The original files have been processed so that they are compatible with xpms2d software. All files reflect UTC time.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 Ozone Concentration (Kok)
dataset.description: This dataset contains ozone measurements taken aboard the C-130 aircraft during ACE-1 by Greg Kok (NCAR/RAF). The data consist of time (UTC), location, "fast" ozone (chemiluminescense), and "standard" ozone (UV absorption). These data were processed and quality controlled by NCAR/RAF following the field phase of ACE-1.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Cirrus - Sabreliner) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the First ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Regional Experiment. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GTS station plot imagery collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: Cedar Rapids ICICLE Ground Suite
dataset.description: This dataset contains ground-based measurements collected from the Cedar Rapids ICICLE Ground Suite during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 27 January - 8 March 2019. Primary information included in the dataset are ground-based measurements of precipitation accumulation and rate, ice accretion, present weather type, atmospheric state parameters, winds, hydrometeor size distributions and velocities, and visibility. Data has been reviewed for quality and known data gaps exist due to power outages etc.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During HEFT08, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during HEFT08 flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been sharpened, reduced from 1024x768 to 512x384 resolution, and combined into movies at 15 frames per second. The movies are H.264 encoded MPEG-4 files and can be played by Quicktime 6.5 or later (Mac and Windows), xine (linux), or RealPlayer 10.5 and later.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS RASS Virtual Temperature
dataset.description: Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperature collected by the EOL/Integrated Sounding System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. The instrument was set-up in tandem with the 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler at the North Pivot.

dataset.title: Raoul Island (93997), NZ, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 UTC daily.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 11:07:00 to 2010-04-20 14:45:00.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R Leg3 PHKO-NCRG Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-11-05 17:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Level 2 Satellite Data
dataset.description: NOAA GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) Level 2 satellite data are included in this Lake Effect Electrification (LEE) Field Project dataset. These data were collected during the LEE project field phase. The Lightning Detection Gridded product generates fields starting from the GLM Lightning Detection Events, Groups, Groups, Flashes product. It consists of flash extent density, event density, average flash area, average group area, total energy, flash centroid density, and group centroid density. Please see the sample netCDF header file in the documentation section of this web page for a list of parameters included in this dataset. The data are stored in gzipped tar files by day. For the complete reference, use the following: Bruning, E., Tillier, C. E., Edgington, S. F., Rudlosky, S. D., Zajic, J., Gravelle, C., et al. (2019). Meteorological imagery for the geostationary lightning mapper. Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres, 124, 14,258–14,309. https://doi.org/10.1029/2019JD030874 This is a large dataset. Please only order the days needed.

dataset.title: GOES-8 4-km WV CONUS Sector Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 4km resolution Water Vapor (6.7 micron) imagery collected for SGP99 in McIDAS AREA file format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Left Side Camera Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the final HIAPER left side window camera image files for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). They are in JPEG format. The individual images have also been assembled into movies in MPEG4 format in the companion dataset NCAR GV (HIAPER) Left Side Camera Video [NCAR/EOL].

dataset.title: METCRAX-II 30 second ISFS data, not tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 second ISFS data collected from 27 September to 2 November 2013 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in NetCDF format. This is the release of the 30 second, not tilt corrected ISFS dataset.

dataset.title: UK-C130 Aircraft Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft data for the UK-C130 aircraft during Phases I, II, and III, as well as the Pre and After Phases during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 07:30:00.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 during ICE-L. Summary data have been merged with the "NCAR C-130 Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT (1-sps) Data" These data are in a format compatible with xpms2d, available from the EOL xpms2d download page. Click on "Order" to see a table listing flight dates and times during which data is available.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) aircraft Electra (Tail Number: N308D) during the DYnamics and Chemistry Of Marine Stratocumulus experiment (DYCOMS) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL R/V Investigator ISS Ceilometer Data (NetCDF)
dataset.description: Quality-controlled ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) onboard the R/V Investigator during the SOCRATES Field Campaign. These data are in NetCDF format and have been processed through the BLView Program provided by Vaisala.

dataset.title: NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) Surface Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface imagery from the NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS).

dataset.title: Model MRF Surface 72 hour forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains MRF model 72 hour surface forecast from 0000 UTC for the northern hemisphere including the SHEBA domain from IGES. Note: Product times reflect date and time of issuance, not valid time of forecast.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Allsky camera Imagery
dataset.description: Allsky camera imagery in jpeg format from the Integrated Sounding System (ISS) camera during the CHEESEHEAD field project. 5 minute snapshots generally over a 24 hour period are organized by month and day. Note that while the time stamps are correct on all images, the time zone is in UTC. Click on the 'Related Links' below that accesses the webcam images.

dataset.title: ACE-1 Aircraft: C-130 Photography Video Camera, left
dataset.description: This dataset contains mpg movies from a left-looking camera mounted on the NCAR Research Aviation Facility NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft during the First Aerosol Characterization Experiment (ACE-1).

dataset.title: GOES-8 4-km IR CONUS Sector Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-8 4-km resolution Infrared (11 micron) imagery collected for the SGP99 in McIDAS AREA file format. These data are available for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (King Air) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Lake Effect Snow Storms - 1984 (LESS84) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking south
dataset.description: South-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) experiment from 26 May 2015 through 20 July 2015. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: GOES-West 4km Multi-Spectral Channel TDF Data
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Satellite data is at 4 kilometers. The data cover the period from 1 September 2001 to 15 October 2001. That data are in tdf format.

dataset.title: Location information and pictures of the OASIS Barrow field intensive Spring 2009
dataset.description: The Ocean Atmosphere Sea Ice Snowpack (OASIS) field campaign was designed to provide a detailed study of atmosphere-cryosphere exchange processes occurring in the Arctic in late winter / early spring and the impact these exchange processes have on the oxidizing capacity of the remote Arctic atmosphere, with an eye toward the understanding of how these processes will evolve in a changing climate. This dataset contains location information in KML and TIFF formats.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) data from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX). These data are in CfRadial format and are available as hourly tar files.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Richness Categorical Results
dataset.description: This dataset contains richness categorical results from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: GOES-8 VIS LSA-NC Sector Images
dataset.description: GOES-8 Visible satellite imagery collected for the GCIP Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1998 (ESOP-98) via McIDAS-X and then converted to GIF image format. These images are at 1 km resolution and are sectors over the LSA-NC region. These data are available for browsing purposes, and should not be used for detailed scientific analyses.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 03:30:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Ship Underway Data - True Wind Speed and Direction (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of true wind speed and wind direction plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei (CCN) Impactor Data
dataset.description: The NCAR/EOL/RAF Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei Impactor (GNI) samples giant aerosol particles. This data set was acquired during the SOCRATES project. Slides were exposed in the free air stream onto uncoated polycarbonate microscope slides. The slides were analyzed in the NCAR/EOL/RAF GNI slide chamber, using a dual-optical microscope. Slides were inserted into the humidified chamber with a relative humidity of 89.8 %. The images were analyzed using an automated edge detection algorithm, and using spherical cap geometry to determine the solution drop volume. Subsequently, the equivalent dry NaCl equivalent radius was determined using the Kohler equation for concentrated solutions, specifically Pruppacher and Klett, 1978, eq. 6.26b, using a full chemical potential calculation.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Godafoss
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Swedish-Icelandic ASAP ship the Godafoss which was operated by the Vedurstofa Islands. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Convection Waves project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NSF NCAR C-130 High-rate (HRT) Data
dataset.description: High-rate data in netCDF format is available here for each flight of the NCAR C-130 that occurred during the SHEBA project (16 flights total) in the spring and summer of 1998. The following is a list of research flight numbers and corresponding dates/times: (rf01a 1846 5/4/98 - 0017 5/5) (rf01b 0036 5/5 - 0350 5/5) (rf02 1849 5/7 - 0220 5/8) (rf03 1808 5/11 - 0312 5/12) (rf04 1824 5/15 - 0256 5/16) (rf05 1652 5/18 - 0330 5/19) (rf06 1655 5/20 - 0300 5/21) (rf07 1653 5/24 - 0327 5/25) (rf08 1652 5/27 - 0312 5/28) (rf09 1630 7/8 - 0318 7/9) (rf10 1658 7/15 - 0250 7/16) (rf11 1635 7/18 - 0335 7/19) (rf12 1608 7/21 - 0254 7/22) (rf13 1627 7/23 - 0332 7/24) (rf14 1547 7/26 - 0004 7/27) (rf15 1556 7/28 - 0003 7/29) (rf16 1658 7/29 - 0004 7/30). The SHEBA C-130 dataset documentation (most of the materials made available in the previously-released data notebooks) have been put on-line via the NCAR RAF Web site. This will enable all users of the data to access the most critical documentation and data quality materials and to assemble their own copies of the documentation package. This documentation web site may be reached by selecting the data set named SHEBA: Aircraft NCAR C-130 Documentation and Data Quality Materials.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the SSN project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: R/V Sagar Kanya Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This preliminary data set includes 71 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from the R/V Sagar Kanya. The soundings were typically released four times per day at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC from 25 September to 10 October 2011 and less frequent releases continuing through 19 October 2011. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. The L3.0 version of the data set had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU. This L3.1 version of the data set had an additional correction applied for deck heating effects by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Pago Pago
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Pago Pago during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-08 12:00:00 to 2011-07-13 12:00:00.

dataset.title: METCRAXII ISS Ceilometer Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains Ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II) between 21 September 2013 and 29 October 2013. These data are in daily tar files containing raw ASCII format ceilometer data and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, 2 variables, NetCDF
dataset.description: S-Pol reflectivity and radial velocity. Sweepfiles for the IHOP_2002 project. Data size can be 3GB for each day of data.

dataset.title: Paraparaumu Aero (93417), NZ, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data(temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 and 12 UTC daily.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm Data
dataset.description: The lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of PERiLS_2022 operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking west
dataset.description: West-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) experiment from 26 May 2015 through 20 July 2015. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Second ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Field Experiment (FIFE-II). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei (CCN) Impactor Raw Data
dataset.description: The NCAR/EOL/RAF Giant Cloud Condensation Nuclei Impactor (GNI) samples giant aerosol particles. Slides were exposed in the free air stream onto uncoated polycarbonate microscope slides. After exposure in the free air stream, the slides were analyzed in the NCAR/EOL/RAF GNI slide chamber, using a dual-optical microscope. Each slide was inserted into the humidified chamber with a relative humidity of 89.8%. Each file (uncompressed) contains 350 images, but one needs to write the data out as a png file (or similar) in order to see the images. Data are archived by date and are stored as .tar.gz files. For a detailed description, see two manuscripts in preparation by Jensen et al., available from the author.

dataset.title: Guam 88-D Radar Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains long-range relfectivity imagery from the WSR-88D radar located on Guam. The imagery was developed by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS Surface Meteorology and Flux Products, 5-minute, geographic coordinate and tilt corrected winds
dataset.description: 5 minute averages of surface meteorology and flux data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) during the SAVANT field campaign. These data have been quality controlled and are available in NetCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and tilt corrected relative to a surface plane using a Leica Multistation (laser theodolite).

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 18:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Montana&#39;s RWIS Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: Montana's Remote Weather Informational System (RWIS) Hourly Surface Data in QC Format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 2000. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-00 domain and time period. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: This dataset includes Google Earth .kml files recorded by the NCAR GV during HIPPO. The data are available for 11 flights.

dataset.title: GOES 12 4KM Channel 4 Thermal IR Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 4km Channel 4 Thermal IR Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: HLY-02-03 Satellite, AVHRR Channel 1 Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of NOAA-12, 14, 15, and 16 AVHRR Channel 1 Imagery. Observations cover the area and time of interest of the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Summer 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-03). Images are in .gif format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-06 10:52:00 to 2011-07-14 21:00:00.

dataset.title: Aircraft C-130 Hydrogen Peroxide Concentration (Kok)
dataset.description: This dataset contains hydrogen peroxides measurements taken aboard the NCAR C-130 aircraft during ACE-1 by Greg Kok (NCAR/RAF). The data consists of time (UTC), location, total soluble peroxide concentration measured as hydrogen, concentration of gas-phase hydrogen peroxide (ppbv), concentration of soluble organic hydroperoxides measured as hydrogen, and equivalent concentration of methylhydroperoxide. These data were processed and quality controlled by NCAR/RAF following the field phase of ACE-1.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies with data - Final (NCAR-RAF)
dataset.description: During DC3, the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (GV_N677F) flew three digital cameras for in-flight video capture: forward, left, and right-looking. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The image was first cropped to 512x384 pixels. The forward, left, and right-looing images were combined into a single frame and flight-level navigation and state parameter data was added along the right. These 1-second annotated images were compiled into a video stream running at 15 frames/s, 1500 kbps data rate.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During PACDEX, the GV flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during PACDEX flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive and the remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: POES Arctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Arctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-03 12:00:00 to 2011-09-21 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the First ISLSCP [International Satellite Land Surface Climatology Project] Regional Experiment (FIRE-II). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the CPSUP project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD San Juan Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains gif imagery from the NEXRAD radar, taken during the Ice in Clouds Experiment - Tropical (ICE-T) project.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Makassar Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 337 high vertical resolution soundings from Makassar, Indonesia (WMO 97180) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Mulitchannel Cloud Radiometer [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The MCR is a seven-channel radiometer that scans between ±45° about the NSF/NCAR C-130 track. This dataset contains MCR data collected during the 2004 Airborne Carbon in the Mountains Experiment (ACME). This data can be viewed using MCRVIEW available for download below.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air sounding data sets developed for the Upper Missouri River Basin Pilot Project (UMRBPP) conducted from 05 April to 05 May 1999. The UMRBPP domain extends from 90W to 115W longitude and 36N to 51N latitude. Included in this data set are 17 National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations in the UMRBPP domain. The soundings were typically released at 00 and 12 UTC, however, several stations had additional releases. The final data set contains pressure, dry bulb temperature, dew point temperature, relative humidity, wind speed and direction, at 6-sec vertical resolution. Consult the readme file for further information.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar time series data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) time series data collected during the SOCRATES (Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study) project from 15 January 2018 to 24 February 2018. This data set contains time series of the measured I/Q data. If you don't know what time series data is you probably do not want this data set. This data set contains raw measurements that have not and will not been modified. Caution: The files are large (~11G each).

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg4 PHKO-NSTU 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 06:00:00.

dataset.title: South Haven ICICLE Ground Suite
dataset.description: This dataset contains ground-based measurements collected from the South Haven ICICLE Ground Suite during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 27 January - 8 March 2019. Primary information included in the dataset are ground-based measurements of precipitation accumulation and rate, ice accretion, present weather type, atmospheric state parameters, winds, hydrometeor size distributions and velocities, and visibility. Data has been reviewed for quality and known data gaps exist due to power outages etc.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: CABL QC Radiosonde Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains 34 quality-controlled radiosonde data files collected by the Mobile GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding System (MGAUS) during the Characterizing the Atmospheric Boundary Layer (CABL) educational deployment. These data are in the EOL sounding format.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During DC3, the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (GV_N677F) flew a left-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Seychelles Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) 2011-2012 project. This data set includes 320 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from the Seychelles. The soundings were typically released four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) from 28 October 2011 to 24 December 2011, then twice per day (00 and 12 UTC) from 25 December 2011 to 15 January 2012, and once per day at 00 UTC from 16 January 2012 through 31 March 2012. These data were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3 version of the data set has had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU.

dataset.title: AWOS Network Data
dataset.description: 48 AWOS sites in the STORM-FEST domain measured 20 min. averages of temperature, dewpoint, altimeter, visibility, wind speed/direction, barometric pressure, sky conditions, density altitude and precipitation. Winds averaged using 2-5 min running mean, cloud heights using a 30 min running mean. This data has undergone quality control at OFPS.

dataset.title: SMILE: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This sounding data was collected during the Shelf MIxed Layer Experiment (SMILE) , from a single NCAR Cross Chain Loran Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) stations. There are two tar files: ascii rawinsonde data in three versions: "i" data interpolated to every 5mb, "m" with 1-second raw dat with data flags collected during the sonde ascent, and "x" 10 second interval data and a tar file with skew-t diagrams

dataset.title: Nairobi Radiosonde L3 Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes 198 high vertical resolution soundings from Nairobi collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released daily at 00 UTC from 31 August to 29 September 2011, then two times per day at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September to 24 November 2011, then daily at 12 UTC from 7-29 January 2012 and finally daily at 00 UTC from 31 January to 6 March 2012. The station used Vaisala RS92-SGPD radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3 version of the data set has had a daytime radiation dry bias correction applied by CSU.

dataset.title: COPS-91: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This dataset is a single tar file of data from 15 widely spaced PAM-II stations, seven of which were clustered near Norman, Oklahoma.

dataset.title: ACE-1: Cape Grim ISS 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at Cape Grim during the Southern Hemisphere Marine Aerosol Characterization Experiment (ACE-1) of 1995. This dataset includes consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: NOAA Wind and RASS Profiler Network Hourly Profiles
dataset.description: The SGP99 National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) and 405 MHZ Wind Profiler Network Dataset consists of merged hourly wind and virtual temperature profiles from ten NOAA Profiler Network (NPN) sites. The profiles contain total wind speed, wind direction, U and V wind components, altitude, and whenever a RASS profile was available, virtual temperature. No additional quality control was performed. When attempting to preview a profile, use altitude and either wind direction or speed since pressure is always missing and virtual temperature is currently not available for browsing. Please see the README for more details.

dataset.title: ROSE-Air II: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This ROSE-AIR II data set is made of two tar files. ASCII "user" tar file contains "x" 10-second data, "i" data interpolated to 5mb, and "m" approximately 1-sec raw data and data flags collected during the sonde ascent. "Data" tar file is in binary format.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Sounder Terrascan Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Sounder Terrascan data from the GOES-10 satellite.

dataset.title: NEXRAD EAX (Kansas City, MO) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Kansas City, MO. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. After 20100601, the images are every 5 minutes, rather than 10 minute frequency. See the catalog links in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) Mesoscale Sector Data
dataset.description: The 1 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) mesoscale domain sectors (MDS) during the period of TORUS_2022 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The dataset contains all MDS sectors, not just those over the TORUS region. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: HaRP: Electra Photography Forward-looking Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP). This dataset contains forward-looking video.

dataset.title: Main Tower Low Sample-Rate Data
Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the UPSLOPE project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Aircraft NCAR C-130 Documentation and Data Quality Materials (Link to NCAR/RAF) [NCAR/RAF]
dataset.description: The SHEBA C-130 dataset documentation (most of the materials made available in the previously-released data notebooks) have been put on-line via the RAF Web site. This will enable all users of the data to access the most critical documentation and data quality materials and to assemble their own copies of the documentation package.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Sounder Terrascan Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Sounder Terrascan data from the GOES-10 satellite.

dataset.title: Surface Weather Observation Large Scale Map Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains maps of surface weather observations over the western two-thirds of the US and southern Canada. The latest observation at the time the plot was generated was utilized, so the plots contain a mix of standard hourly and special observations. The maps were generated by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 27 January to 30 March 2009 and 14 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: NCDC Summary of the Day COOP Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/LSA-NW 00 National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) Summary of the Day Co-operative (COOP) data for the LSA-NW 00 domain. The observations in this dataset are primarily those from the cooperative network, augmented by observations from principal observing stations operated by the NWS and other sites having highly trained observers. Quality Control for this data was provided by NCDC. No additional QC was performed by JOSS on this dataset.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Texas High Plains Experiment (TexasHIPLEX) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: R/V Mirai Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes 518 high vertical resolution (2 sec) soundings from the R/V Mirai collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011. Soundings were typically released every three hours during the two cruises (26 September through 26 October and 29 October through 1 December 2011) and four times daily from 5-10 December 2011. For most of these soundings R/V Mirai was on station near 80.5E and 8.00S Latitude. These data were converted to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format. The station used Vaisala RS92-SGPD radiosondes. The ground station software was Digicora III/MW31/ver3.64.1. This data set is considered preliminary. These data were provided by JAMSTEC and had preliminarly quality control by NCAR/EOL. This L3.1 version of the data set had an additional correction applied for deck heating effects by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During NOMADSS, the NSF/NCAR C-130 flew a forward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file. Note: Downward-looking images can be found in the companion dataset below.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) CONUS Sector Data
