dataset.description: This data set contains the 5 minute resolution data from the GOES-16 satellite Advanced Baseline Imager (ABI) over the continental United States during the period of VORTEX-SE Meso18-19 operations. All 16 channels are included at their full resolution. The data are in NetCDF files packed into hourly tar files.

dataset.title: GOES-East 4KM RICO-Domain HDF data
dataset.description: This dataset contains sectored GOES-East satellite imager data at 4km resolution for the Rain in Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) 2004-2005 domain. The data cover the period from 24 November 2004 - 24 January 2005. The data are in HDF format.

dataset.title: FASTEX 5-millibar Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set consists of a composite of all FASTEX sounding data interpolated to 5-millibar vertical levels collected from the 45 platforms in the experiment domain. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the README file for details. Refer to the individual station README files for details on the processing conducted on individual sites.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Hokitika
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Hokitika, New Zealand during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-09 23:00:00 to 2011-07-13 11:00:00.

dataset.title: SMOG: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing three cmf text files of PAM station data from the SMOG Ozone in the Troposphere Experiment.

dataset.title: Bureau of Meteorology Darwin Australia Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Australian Bureau of Meteorology routinely releases radiosondes from Darwin (WMO 94120) which is on the north-central coast of Australia. During the HAIC-HIWC field phase, soundings were routinely released four times daily (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC; wind only at 06 and 18 UTC). This data set includes the quality controlled Darwin soundings released for the HAIC-HIWC field phase (15 January to 15 March 2014). A total of 254 quality-controlled, high resolution (2-second) soundings are contained in the final HAIC-HIWC data set.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the ACCLIP project. The files contain low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, Evenness Graph
dataset.description: This dataset contains the evenness summary graph from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: NCAR EOL ISS Hokitika Webcam Imagery
dataset.description: NCAR EOL ISS webcam imagery collected at the Hokitika, New Zealand airport. The user will receive a tar file for each day ordered.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the Front Range Air Pollution and Photochemistry Experiment (FRAPPE) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Bermuda
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Bermuda (WMO 78016) which was operated by SERCO. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical resolution. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Anchorage
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Anchorage, Alaska during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: Lake-ICE surface: NCAR/EOL Greenville ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Greenville, MI (ISS3) during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (LAKE-ICE), which occurred simultaneously with the SNOWBAND project. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Angmagssalik (Greenland)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Angmagssalik in Greenland (WMO 04360) which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals for the 00 and 12 UTC soundings and 5 second vertical intervals for most of the 06 and 18 UTC soundings. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NCAR/ATD 5 minute Quality Controlled ASTER surface and chemistry data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute Atmosphere/Surface Turbulent Exchange Research (ASTER) facility surface and chemistry data collected at the Cheeka Peak cloud observatory on the northwest extremity of the Olympic peninsula of Washington during the Cloud and Aerosol Chemistry Experiment of 1994 (CACHE-94). These data are in NetCDF format, have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers are not tilt corrected and are in instrument coordinates.

dataset.title: GOES-11 1km Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES-11 imagery from the IHOP_2002 field project area of interest. All images are at 1KM resolution and are from the GOES-11 visible channel.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains final surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Dugway Proving Ground in Utah during the Instabilities, Dynamics, and Energetics accompanying Atmospheric Layering (IDEAL) field campaign. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have been minimally quality-controlled. We found these data to be complete and have no major issues in quality. We did note that occasionally the wind directions on the Lufft's seem to be reversed. This occurs infrequently and primarily in the 2-m winds data.

dataset.title: NPN Hourly Surface Data in QC Format
dataset.description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) Profiler Network (NPN) Hourly Surface data in QC format is one of several surface datasets provided in the GEWEX Continental-Scale International Project (GCIP) Large Scale Area-North West (LSA-NW) Enhanced Annual Observing Period (EAOP) 1999. This dataset contains data for the GCIP LSA-NW EAOP-99 domain and time period.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Cabauw Hourly Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 1 (EOP-1) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Cabauw Mast Hourly Surface Meteorology, Flux, and Radiation Data Set. This data set contains hourly data from a single station for the CEOP EOP-1 time period (01 July 2001 to 30 September 2001). The National Center for Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) did not perform quality control processing on this data set.

dataset.title: VTMX: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Images (Morley, B. [NCAR/EOL])
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) png images obtained from a ground based platform during the Vertical Transport and Mixing (VTMX) experiment. The images are contained in daily tar files.

dataset.title: METCRAX ISS 915 MHz Wind Profiler and RASS Data
dataset.description: The Meteor Crater Experiment (METCRAX) is a 3-year meteorological research program supported by the Mesoscale Dynamics Division of the U. S. National Science Foundation (NSF). The program is investigating the structure and evolution of temperature inversions or cold-air pools that form on a daily basis in topographic basins and valleys. As part of this research a one-month-long field experiment will be conducted in October 2006 in Arizona's Meteor Crater, a simple near-ideal topographic basin formed by the impact of a meteor. In this basin, the physical processes leading to the buildup and breakdown of temperature inversions and the formation of atmospheric seiches (atmospheric oscillations in the basin caused by wind disturbances at the basin crest) can be studied without the complications introduced by more complex topography. This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during METCRAX between 01 October 2006 and 31 October 2006. This dataset includes doppler moments data (.mom.nc), consensus winds data (.winds*.nc), and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rass.nc) in NetCDF format. These data are tarred into daily files and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) National Weather Service (NWS) routinely releases radiosondes two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) and does occasional special releases at other times of day (usually 18 UTC) from sites across the United States. This data set includes the quality controlled NWS soundings released from 22 stations located within the Wintertime Investigation of Transport, Emission, and Reactivity (WINTER) project domain for the WINTER field phase (1 February 2015 to 15 March 2015). A total of 1934 quality controlled, high resolution (1-second) soundings are contained in the final WINTER data set.

dataset.title: GOES 13 NorthWest 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 13 NorthWest 1 km channel 1 visible imagery from the 2010 field phase of the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the BOReal Ecosystem Atmosphere Study (BOREAS). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Ship Underway Data - Atmospheric Pressure (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of atmospheric pressure plots from the SBI U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01). Files are in .png format.

dataset.title: TOCS: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format [Morley, B. (NCAR/EOL)]
dataset.description: This data set contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field DORADE format files from the ship R/V Kaiyo during the Tropical Ocean Climate/Japan Agency for Marine-Earth Science and Technology, South Pacific (TOCS/JAMTEC) experiment.

dataset.title: GTS (mandatory/significant levels) Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Cumulus Photogrammetric, In-Situ and Doppler Observations (CuPIDO) project. This data set includes 1398 GTS soundings from 17 stations in the southwest United States and Mexico for the period 01 July to 31 August 2007. These data were retrieved from the NOAA/ESRL Radiosonde Database. This data set was not quality controlled by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: Model MRF Surface 48 hour forecast Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains MRF model 48 hour surface forecast from 0000 UTC for the northern hemisphere including the SHEBA domain from IGES. Note: Product times reflect date and time of issuance, not valid time of forecast.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Kupang Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 349 high vertical resolution soundings from Kupang, Indonesia (WMO 97372) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: NCAR MGAUS Skew-T Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains MGAUS Skew-T imagery from the CuPIDO Field Catalog.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT20S Data (Sabreliner) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Experiment on Rapidly-Intensifying Cyclones over the Atlantic (ERICA) project. This dataset contains 20hz state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format. Note that these data files do NOT contain lat/lon information. Please refer to the companion dataset "Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Sabreliner)" for that information.

dataset.title: NCDC 15-Minute Precipitation Data in QC Format
dataset.description: This data set contains National Climatic Data Center Fifteen Minute Precipitation data in QC format for the GCIP LSA-NW domain and time period. Data from this source was quality controlled to form this dataset.

dataset.title: GCIP/EAOP-99 Surface: Special Surface Observations Composite
dataset.description: This dataset contains only the GCIP/EAOP-99 Automated Surface Observing System (ASOS) and National Climatic Data Center (NCDC) DATSAV3 "Special" observation surface data for the GCIP/EAOP-99 domain and time period. These are observations that are reported at off-hour times. The ASOS and DATSAV3 "Nominal" hourly surface data for the GCIP/EAOP-99 domain and time period are included in the GCIP/EAOP-99 Hourly Surface Composite.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHNL 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:45:00.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies - final
dataset.description: During HIPPO-3, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: NCAR EOL ISS Optical Disdrometer Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL ISS Optical Disdrometer data collected during the Deep Propagating Gravity Wave Experiment (DEEPWAVE) from 3 June 2014 through 28 July 2014.

dataset.title: R/V Roger Revelle Radiosonde L3 Data (EOL Format) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains EOL format (ASCII) files of sounding data from 635 Vaisala RS92 radiosondes launched from the R/V Roger Revelle during the Dynamics of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (DYNAMO) field campaign. A total of 635 quality controlled soundings are contained in this data set, collected between 29 August 2011 and 10 February 2012.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISFS High Rate Surface Meteorology and Flux Products - winds in planar geographic and tilt corrected coordinates
dataset.description: High rate surface meteorology and flux products collected by the EOL/Integrated Surface Flux System team during the Cold Fog Amongst Complex Terrain (CFACT) field campaign in Heber Valley, Utah. These data have been quality controlled and are available in netCDF format. The winds reported by the sonic anemometers have been rotated into geographic coordinates and corrected for the orientation of the instrument. The orientation and tilt corrections applied were determined by the using the planar fit method from Wilczak, Oncley, and Stage (2001). Data were collected from 11 sites (2 towered Supersites + 9 Satellite sites) located around Heber Valley. That data have been merged in time increments that vary by sensor from 50 ms for 20 Hz sensors to 1 s for 1 Hz sensors.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the Global Atmospheric Measurements Experiment on Tropospheric Aerosols and Gases (GAMETAG) project.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) moments data collected during the SOCRATES (Southern Ocean Clouds, Radiation, Aerosol Transport Experimental Study) project from 15 January 2018 to 24 February 2018. The data have a 10Hz time resolution and a 19 m range resolution and are available in CfRadial format on a per flight basis. This data set contains all HCR variables at full resolution. A data set which contains only the primary HCR variables at a 2Hz resolution (and also data from the High Spectral Resolution Lidar (HSRL)) is available at the link provided in the "Related links" section below.

dataset.title: METCRAX-II 5 minute ISFS data, not tilt corrected
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute ISFS data collected from 27 September to 2 November 2013 as part of the Meteor Crater Experiment II (METCRAX-II). These data are in NetCDF format and have not been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Lajes (Portugal;Azores)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Lajes in the Azores (Portugal) (WMO 08508) which was operated by INMG). Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) in January and four times per day (also 06 and 18 UTC) in February. These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at variable vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: SAO Special Observations
dataset.description: Wind direction/speed, ceiling height, visibility. dry bulb temperature, wet bulb temperature, dew point temperature, sea level and station pressure, cloud data, and present weather. Manual and automatic observations from sites in the GCIP/GIDS-1 domain.

dataset.title: Raw 2D-S Data
dataset.description: A 2D-S instrument contains two 2D probes which image particles as they pass through beams that are oriented orthogonally to each other and the airflow. If particles also lie in the intersection of the sensitive areas of the two beams, they are seen by both 2D probes. This dataset contains Fast 2D-S imagery collected aboard the NCAR GV during the ACCLIP project.

dataset.title: GTS Surface Observation Plots Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes imagery from the GTS Surface Observations taken during the IHOP_2002 field project. It includes hourly images of both the central US and of just the IHOP_2002 region.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar time series data
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) Radar radar processor time series data from the Terrain-Influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TIMREX). The files for this data set are large (up to 4 GB each) so please note the listed file sizes when ordering. There are four different file types: scanning, vertical, stationary, and solar.

dataset.title: Falcon QC Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the International H2O Project (IHOP 2002). This data set contains high resolution dropsonde data from the Falcon aircraft. The Falcon made drops on May 17th,19th,20th,21st,25th,29th and 31st, and on June 3rd,8th, and 9th 2002. The dropsonde data was provided by the National Center for Atmospheric Research Atmospheric Technology Division (NCAR/ATD). An important note to users: ATD reprocessed this data and released a new version of this dataset May 1st,2003. See ATD Reprocessing. Consult the README for more information. September 2008: The IHOP_2002 Falcon and Lear dropsonde data sets have been updated to include latitude and longitude data that were not in the earlier version. The PTH and wind data are unchanged.

dataset.title: GPS data
dataset.description: Three Global Positioning System (GPS) datasets collected during the MPD-NetDemo field campaign. The data were collected between 16 April 2019 and 22 July 2019. The GFZ German Research Centre for Geosciences in Potsdam, Germany processed the data to provide precipitable water vapor (PWV) fields.

dataset.title: High Resolution Research Soundings from Montague,Michigan
dataset.description: This data set contains ten second vertical resolution sounding data for Montague, Michigan. This site was operated by the Atmospheric Technology Division (ATD) of the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research (UCAR). This data set has undergone ATD and The Joint Office of Science Support (JOSS) quality control procedures. See the README for more information. Note, the README contains a complete list of Montague rawinsonde release times.

dataset.title: NEXRAD DYX (Abilene/Moran, TX) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Abilene/Moran, TX during 2009-04-14 through 2009-06-15, and 2010-04-14 through 2010-06-21 VORTEX 2 periods. Images are only available during these time periods. The files are in .gif format. See the catalog links in the related links section below to access the field catalogs.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - NASA AMES format
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO-2. The data are in NASA Ames format and are available for 13 flights.

dataset.title: COHMEX: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This dataset is a single tar file of data from 50 PAM-II stations as part of the combined Microburst and Severe Thunderstorm (MIST) and Satellite Precipitation and Cloud Experiment (SPACE) projects.

dataset.title: GOES-East Imager Thermal IR CH4 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Imager CH4 Thermal IR Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 15 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: FP3 FP4 FP5 QC 5 min Surface Data, no tilt correction
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute surface data collected from NCAR Integrated Sounding Systems located at FP3, FP4 and FP5 between 23 April to 25 July 2015 as part the Plains Elevated Convection at Night (PECAN) field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format and have been quality controlled, but have not been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: BARUCH: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file of data from one PAM station located at the Hugo Relief Station on the coast of South Carolina.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Marine Stratus Studies (MSS) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/ESOP-95 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 14 sites in the ESOP-95 domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Merauke Radiosonde L3.2 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 364 high vertical resolution soundings from Merauke, Indonesia (WMO 97980) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.2 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level), the L3.1 correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa and the additional L3.2 corrections of setting suspicious zero surface winds to missing and a correction for reducing erroneous heating/cooling data in daytime/nighttime soundings. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg5 NSTU-NZCH 5km Channel 4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:22:00 to 2011-10-12 07:22:00.

dataset.title: GOES-East Visible channel 1km floater data
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-East Visible channel 1km data. Data covers the RAINEX area and period of interest.

dataset.title: GOES-East 3-hourly 4km Visible Imagery Eastern Pacific
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-8 Satellite Imagery at 4 kilometer resolution for the period from 6 Sept - 2 Oct 2001 (2001d249-275).

dataset.title: Dallas All-Sky Camera
dataset.description: These films include footage of the sky from the US ship Dallas for Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 449 MHz Modular Wind Profiler Products, 5 and 30 minute Winds
dataset.description: 449 MHz modular wind profiler radar data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Homestead site during the Stable Air Variability and Transport (SAVANT) field campaign. 5 and 30 minute averaged winds data in netCDF format are provided. These data have been quality controlled. Moments data from the profiler can be found in the companion dataset 560.044.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: NCAR/EOL ISS quality controlled radiosonde soundings collected in the deep Southern Ocean off the coast of Tasmania between Jan 20 and Feb 21, 2018. The soundings were launched from the R/V Investigator, an Australian research vessel operated by CSIRO/MNF, during the SOCRATES field campaign. The data contained in this archive are the complete, quality controlled soundings.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of radiosondes collected from 5 sounding platforms during the Variability of the American MOnsoonS (VAMOS) Ocean-Cloud-Atmosphere-Land Study (VOCALS) 2008 project with data collected from 30 September 2008 through 1 December 2008. This project was conducted off and along the coast of northern Chile, South America in the eastern Pacific Ocean. This composite contains a total of 678 high resolution soundings. The data includes 678 soundings with 91 10-sec resolution soundings from the lower site at Paposo, Chile, 215 1-sec soundings from R/V Ron Brown, 47 0.5 second dropsondes from the United Kingdom Facility for Airborne Atmospheric Measurements (FAAM) BAe-146 aircraft, 192 1-sec soundings from the GPS Advanced Upper_Air Sounding (GAUS) system located at Iquique, Chile, and 133 1-sec soundings from the R/V Jose Olaya GAUS system. Users are strongly encouraged to contact FAAM BAe for guidance on using their dropsonde data. Please contact Grant Allen at grant dot allen at manchester.ac.uk. All soundings are provided at the highest possible resolution (i.e. the 'native' resolution).

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Wallops Island (USA)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Wallops Island, Virginia in the USA (WMO 72402) which was operated by the US National Weather Service. Soundings were taken two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to four times per day (also 06 and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, and altitude taken at 1.2 second vertical intervals and wind speed and wind direction taken at 1 minute vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Lidar SABL Imagery [EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains Lidar SABL Imagery from the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. The missions were completed between 4 Dec 2004 - 20 Dec 2004, and 11 Jan 2005 - 24 Jan 2004.

dataset.title: CABL 30 min ISFS data, QC&#39;d, geographic and tilt corrected sonic winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 minute averaged surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the Characterizing the Atmospheric Boundary Layer (CABL) field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected. For more information on the data quality please see the EOL CABL Field Project webpage: https://www.eol.ucar.edu/field_projects/cabl

dataset.title: GOES-12 Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-12 Channel 1 visible satellite imagery from the time period of the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project. From 13 January to 16 February 2012, the imagery covers Antofagasta, Chile, where the NSF/NCAR GV was forward deployed, and the imagery from 17 February to 1 April 2012 centers on the Galapagos Islands, and the GV was based in San Jose, Costa Rica.

dataset.title: GOES-7 8-km Water Vapor Imagery
dataset.description: GOES-7 8-km water vapor imagery that were collected during VORTEX and GCIP/GIST. One image per day has been converted to GIF format and placed on-line for browsing purposes.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary 'filmstrip' imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the C-130 (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Marine Stratus Cloud Tops project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Inhibition of Snowfall by Pollution Aerosol project in 2002 (ISPA-2002). These data include surface observations from the primary Campbell surface station (surface_met) and snowfall measurements from a second Campbell surface station (surface_two), both available in daily netCDF files and have been subjected to very limited quality control.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Atmospheric Forcing of Circulation in Gulf Of California (AFCGOC-II) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Precipitation (Daily) Multi-Network Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Centers for Environmental Prediction daily precipitation, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers daily precipitation data, and the daily precipitation data extracted from the IHOP_2002 Mesonet: Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite. In July 2005 the Oklahoma Climatological Survey reprocessed and updated the Oklahoma Mesonet surface meteorological data. EOL has not updated the composite files, however the newer OKMESO data is available.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ACCLIP, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a right looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg8 YPDN-PGSN Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 YPDN-PGSN Channel 1 Visible imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 21:32:00 to 2011-07-14 15:32:00.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915 MHz Wind Profiler Consensus Winds, Moments, and RASS Data
dataset.description: 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) aboard the R/V Knorr during the CLIMODE project. This dataset includes doppler moments data (prof915mom*), consensus winds data from both low and high mode profiler operation (prof915l* and prof915h*), and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (rass915*). These data are in daily tarred files containing individual files in netcdf format. The individual data files cover various time periods, but do not overlap or extend beyond the day indicated in the filename. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Hydrological Atmospheric Pilot EXperiment -- MOdelisation du BILan HYdrique (HAPEX-MOBILHY) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Right-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During the CSET (Cloud System Evolution in the Trades), the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) flew a right looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files)
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the ORCAS (The O2/N2 Ratio and CO2 Airborne Southern Ocean Study) project.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks (Google Earth .kml files) [(NCAR-EOL-RAF)]
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV HIAPER flight track in real-time during the DEEPWAVE project.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During HIPPO-2, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Queen Air aircraft (Tail Number: N306D) during the Shelfbreak Front project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-5 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-08-02 20:01:00 to 2011-10-12 05:00:00.

dataset.title: ISFS Supplemental Surface Met Station Data
dataset.description: Supplemental data from the Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) Meteorological Stations. Data includes pressure, temperature, humidity, wind speed, and wind direction for the IHOP time period. Five stations are represented in this dataset. Four of the stations' data are in ASCII comma delimited format with a single file for each station for the entire time period. The fifth station's data is in netCDF format and is broken down into 1006 hourly files for the entire time period.

dataset.title: TOGA COARE Wind Profiler Browse (ISS and other) GIFs
dataset.description: This dataset contains GIF image files containing daily timeseries plots of winds from six NCAR Integrated Sounding System (ISS) sites. Wind data from 3 additional sites using other types of wind profilers are also included. The six ISS sites are: R/V Shiyan 3; Kapingamarangi; Kavieng; Manus; Nauru; and R/V Kexue 1. The other research profiler sites are: Biak (50 MHz); Christmas Island (50 MHz); and R/V Moana Wave (915 MHz). The data consist of GIF files containing 1 daily time series of winds plotted every 30 minutes.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915MHz NIMA Wind Profiler Moments, Winds, and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler NIMA data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the University of Michigan Biological Station (UMBS) in Pellston, MI during the Program for Research on Oxidants: Photochemistry, Emmissions, and Transport (PROPHET) intensive observing period that occurred in the summer of 2001. This dataset includes Doppler moments data (.momnc), 30 minute consensus winds data (.windsnc) and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rassnc) in NetCDF format. These data have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite Highest Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled native vertical resolution radiosonde data from all sources (National Weather Service and NOAA/National Severe Storms Laboratory), for the Targeted Observation by Radars and UAS of Supercells 2019 (TORUS_2019) field season. A total of 1457 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final data set. Additional soundings from Purdue University are expected to be included later.

dataset.title: NASA DC-8 Flight Track Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NASA DC-8 flight track imagery produced during the DC3 project. The imagery are in PNG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-18 00:00:00 to 2012-06-23 23:59:59.

dataset.title: GMS-5 VIS Aircraft Track Imagery
dataset.description: GMS-5 Visible (VIS) imagery (with aircraft track overlaid on plot )collected during ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology, then converted to GIF image format. These images consist of the Southern Ocean (image center 49 deg S, 142 deg E), 4 km resolution, collected every hour. Digital McIDAS Area Format data files were collected hourly at OFPS from which these GIF images were created.

dataset.title: Mobile ISS (MISS) Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains data collected from 19 sondes using the Mobile ISS (MISS) during the Sierra Rotors Project in Owens Valley of California. The sondes were launched between 3 March and 14 April, 2004. The soundings have been run through ASPEN for quality control processing. Three of the sondes experienced vertical downdrafts and were manually QC'd to preserve this data. These files are in the NCAR CLASS format. Please see the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Tahiti
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Tahiti during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-18 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Aerosol Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) Data
dataset.description: The Cloud Particle Imager captures high-resolution images (pixel size 2.3 microns) using a CCD camera. The CPI has two Particle Detector Sensor lasers that instruct the camera to capture an image. This dataset contains binary image files of cloud particles which can be viewed using the IDL software linked to below. The data were collected during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science Phase 2 (IDEAS-2) project which took place from 3 October 2002 to 1 November 2002.

dataset.title: HaRP: Electra Photography Left-looking Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR Electra aircraft during the Hawaiian Rainband Project (HaRP). This dataset contains left-looking video.

dataset.title: High Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Southern Great Plains 1999 Hydrology Experiment (SGP99) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Jakarta-Cengkareng Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 356 high vertical resolution soundings from Jakarta-Cengkareng, Indonesia (WMO 96749) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: FABLE 2000 NCAR/ATD ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/ATD Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the WLEF-TV transmitter near Park Falls, Wisconsin during the Forest Atmosphere Boundary Layer Experiment (FABLE) in 2000. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the DEEPWAVE project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 High Rate (1sps) Navigation, Sate Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: The Gulf Of Tehuantepec Experiment, Coupled Development of Ocean Waves and Boundary Layers (aka OceanWaves) was an experiment that aimed to measure the coupled development of the atmospheric boundary layer and the surface wave field over the Gulf of Tehuantapec, off southern Mexico's Pacific coast. GOTEX was conducted during the period from February 3 to February 29, 2004. This dataset contains High-Rate (HRT, 1 sps) airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR). The files are in netCDF format. Note: These data were updated May 2011 to correct for a systematic bias in the 3D winds.

dataset.title: Regional GTS Station Plot Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes Regional GTS Station Plot Imagery from the VORTEX2 2009 and 2010 Field Catalogs. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. The files are in .gif format. See the catalog links in the related links section below to access the field catalogs.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4km Channel 3 (Water Vapor) Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-12 4km resolution water vapor (Channel 3) satellite imagery over the PLOWS region. The routine 15-minute imagery as well as any rapid scan imagery are included. The images were created by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 12 January to 31 March 2009 and 1 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During TORERO, the GV_N677F flew a forward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa radar time series data, S-band, Marshall field site
dataset.description: Selected time periods of time series data collected by the S-PolKa radar at the Marshall field site in Colorado. S-PolKa is usually run at the Marshall field site for testing and maintenance purposes so the data in this dataset contains data from various different instrument states. If you would like to use this data set for research purposes, please contact us first at the email address below. Time series data is the raw I/Q data collected by the radar. It will never change and is therefore not quality controlled.

dataset.title: TOCS: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Averaged Dorade format
dataset.description: This data set contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) averaged DORADE format files from the ship R/V Kaiyo during the Tropical Ocean Climate/Japan Agency for Marine-Darth Science and Technology, South Pacific (TOCS/JAMTEC) experiment.

dataset.title: NCAR denoised MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data in NetCDF format collected by the MPD 3 during the Multi-point Monin-Obukhov similarity horizontal array turbulence study (M2HATS). The data was simultaneously denoised and processed for temperature, water vapor and aerosol backscatter coefficient using the Poisson Total Variation technique. While two MPDs were deployed to Nevada, USA, for this field project, only data from MPD 3 was processed using this enhanced technique due to hardware issues on MPD 2. Data from both MPDs (processed with the standard technique) is linked as a companion dataset in the "Related links" section below.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Winter Icing Storms Project (WISP94). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: IDEAS-1: C130 Photography Video Camera
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR C130 aircraft during the Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science (IDEAS-1) Project. This dataset contains forward-looking, left-looking, and downward-looking video.

dataset.title: Whitewater 5-mb CLASS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: CLASS radiosonde profiles taken at Whitewater, Kansas for the CASES-97 program. The site was operated by NCAR/Earth Observing Laboratory (formerly Atmospheric Technology Division). These soundings have been interpolated to 5 mb vertical intervals. The quality control information is that provided by NCAR/EOL. UCAR/JOSS has not altered these soundings in any way. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the readme file for details.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Central Pacific Atmospheric Chemistry Experiment (CPACE). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) king air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the TRiple AirCraft Intercomparison (TRACI) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Whitewater 10-second CLASS Radiosonde Profiles
dataset.description: CLASS radiosonde profiles taken at Whitewater, Kansas for the CASES-97 program. The site was operated by NCAR/Earth Observing Laboratory (formerly Atmospheric Technology Division). These soundings have been interpolated to 10 second vertical intervals. The quality control information is that provided by NCAR/EOL. UCAR/JOSS has not altered these soundings in any way. This data set includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. Refer to the readme file for details.

dataset.title: ISS Ceilometer Data Products
dataset.description: Ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Cloud and Precipitation Study (CPS). These data are in daily tar files containing raw ASCII format ceilometer data and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: TORERO Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the TORERO project from January 15, 2012 to February 26, 2012. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the TORERO project.

dataset.title: INDOEX: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format (Morley, B. [NCAR/EOL])
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained by the NSF/NCAR C-130 during the Indian Ocean Experiment (INDOEX).

dataset.title: USGS Stage Only Reservoir Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains United States Geological Survey (USGS) Stage Only Reservoir data from stations reported within the GCIP/EAOP-99 domain. This dataset covers the complete GCIP/EAOP-99 time period. No additional quality control was performed by UCAR/JOSS.

dataset.title: GOES-10 4 km Shortwave IR channel (CH2) Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 satellite imagery for the VOCALS study area and time of interest. The images are JPEGS.

dataset.title: NEXRAD GRK (Fort Hood, TX) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Fort Hood, TX. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: CSAE: Sabreliner Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR Sabreliner aircraft during the Contrail Studies Airborne Exhaust (CSAE) project. This dataset contains forward-looking video for some of the flights.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 GPS Altitude Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GPS altitude imagery from the NSF/NCAR C-130 collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking south
dataset.description: South-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the FRONT (Front Range Observational Network Testbed) project from 1 January 2014 through 10 April 2015. See the FRONT S-Pol Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Hilo
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P charts taken at Hilo, Hawaii during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-17 00:00:00 to 2010-04-19 12:00:00.

dataset.title: GCIP/NESOB-96 Surface: Daily Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Daily Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., Arkansas-Red Basin River Forecast Center, National Weather Service Cooperative Observers Precipitation data, and the precipitation data extracted from the NESOB-96 Hourly Precipitation Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg8 MROC-KBJC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: R/V Seward Johnson Rawinsonde SkewT Plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains R/V Seward Johnson rawinsonde SkewT plots for the Rain In Cumulus over the Ocean (RICO) project. They were taken at random times between December 31st 2004 and January 24th 2005.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Makassar Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 337 high vertical resolution soundings from Makassar, Indonesia (WMO 97180) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: CPPA: SGP Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set
dataset.description: This data set contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Southern Great Plains (SGP) 60 Minute Soil Temperature and Soil Moisture Data Set. This data set contains 60 minute data from 19 stations from the SGP reference site from 1 October 2002 through 31 December 2009. Several stations stopped observations late in 2009, see the documentation file for further information. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Boulmer (United Kingdom)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Boulmer in the United Kingdom (WMO 03240) which was operated by the UK Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except for selected IOPs when it was up to eight times per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NOAA G-IV Dropsonde Skew-T plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains Skew-T plots of dropsondes from the NOAA G-IV. Images exist for hurricanes Dennis on July 6-9, Emily on July 16-18, Katrina on August 24-28, Ophelia on September 8-14, Rita on September 19-23, and Wilma on Oct 18 and Oct 20-24.

dataset.title: NCAR Water Vapor DIAL data
dataset.description: Water Vapor DIAL Quality Controlled (QC) data collected during the Front Range Air Pollution and Photochemistry Experiment (FRAPPÉ) from 1 July 2014 to 19 August 2014. The data are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During HIPPO-5, the GV_N677F flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: DMSP OLS Visible Tropical Cyclone Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains DMSP OLS visible satellite imagery centered over tropical systems in the western Pacific Ocean. All are available during periods of active tropical systems in the western Pacific Ocean. These products were developed by NRL and are in jpg format.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Channel 1 Visible Satellite Imagery - Galapagos
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-13 Channel 1 Visible Satellite imagery of Galapagos taken during the Tropical Ocean tRoposphere Exchange of Reactive halogen species and Oxygenated VOC (TORERO) project from 17 January to 1 April 2012.

dataset.title: GOES-12 4km Channel 4 (Thermal Infrared) Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GOES-12 4km resolution thermal-IR (Channel 4) satellite imagery over the PLOWS region. The routine 15-minute imagery as well as any rapid scan imagery are included. The images were created by NCAR/EOL. This data set contains imagery from the two PLOWS field phases, 12 January to 31 March 2009 and 1 October 2009 to 10 March 2010. No imagery are available for the period between the field phases.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Imager Channels 2-5 data (AREA Files)
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-10 Imager Channels 2-5 AREA files, provided in gzip format. The dataset covers the area and time span of the VOCALS project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Webcam Imagery (West Profiler Site)
dataset.description: Webcam imagery collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located west of the double ridge at the West Wind Profiler Site during the Perdigao field project in 2016-2017. This dataset includes 5-minute, northeast facing webcam images in jpg format.

dataset.title: Aeromet Lear Jet Dropsondes
dataset.description: This dataset contains the 10-sec high resolution Dropsonde data taken from the Aeromet Lear Jet during CEPEX. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg1 KBJC-PANC 4km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 11:07:00 to 2010-04-20 14:45:00.

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data collected during RELAMPAGO (Remote sensing of Electrification, Lightning, And Mesoscale/microscale Processes with Adaptive Ground Observations). The data was collected between October 25 and December 15, 2018, in Argentina.

dataset.title: NCAR GAUS QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Global Atmospheric Upper-Air System radiosonde dataset from the Thunderstorm Electrification and Lightning EXperiment (TELEX) consists of 27 soundings launched from various locations throughout Oklahoma between 24 May 24 and 20 June, 2004. There are three soundings that are included in the final dataset that were test launches: D20040916_130611.1.QC, D20040923120109.1.QC and D20041001_044351.1.QC. Some quality control has been done, but not using EOL ASPEN because TELEX04 was the first project for which GAUS was used and ASPEN was not yet configured for it. Also, there were no surface met sensors available to compare prelaunch data against. For more information please refer to the README file.

dataset.title: GRIP NASA DC-8 Quality Controlled Dropsonde Archive
dataset.description: This data set contains dropsonde data from the NASA DC-8 medium altitude research aircraft. A total of 328 quality-controlled dropsonde soundings were released during 16 research flights, and are contained in the final dropsonde data set.

dataset.title: SOAS AABC Site NCAR EOL ISS LIDAR Data
dataset.description: This data set contains Doppler LIDAR moment data collected by the EOL Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS) from 24 May 2013 to 16 July 2013. The data are gzipped ascii text files and are available as four separate tar files (LOS, DBS, RHI, PPI) for each day.

dataset.title: Downward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: During ICE-L, the C130Q flew a downward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once or twice per second during ICE-L flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into time sequential 600MB tarfiles. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Manus ARM Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Department of Energy Atmospheric Radiation Measurement (ARM) Climate Research Facility Tropical Western Pacific (TWP) site routinely releases radiosondes twice daily (00 and 12 UTC) from its site on Manus Island, Papua New Guinea (WMO ID 92044). This data set includes the soundings released during the CONvective TRansport of Active Species in the Tropics (CONTRAST) field phase (1 to 28 February 2014). A total of 59 quality controlled, high resolution (2-second) soundings are contained in the final CONTRAST data set.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 Temperature, Dew Point, Liquid Water and Cloud Concentration Research Product Imagery
dataset.description: This data set consists of four types of png files: Temperature, Dew Point, Liquid Water and Cloud Concentration plots for the period and area of the VOCALS project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Cloud Droplet Chemistry (CDC) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: DOD Satellite Data
dataset.description: Satellite images archived in KuDA are derived from either the NOAA or the Dept of Defense polar orbiting weather satellites. This dataset contains images that are derived from the Department of Defense's polar orbiting weather satellites. The Department of Defense's DMSP (Defense Meteorological Satellite Program) had three satellites transmitting during 1991 (F8, F9, & F10). These satellites carry a sensor called the Operational Line Scanner (OLS) which is the one source of images for KuDA (the other source of images is NOAA's AVHRR). The OLS is a two-channel sensor with a broadband visible channel and an IR channel. Data are in TDF and .TAR format.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During SPICULE, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 15 fps.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar time series data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) raw I/Q time series data collected during the MEOW (Make Everything Operate Well) project. During MEOW HCR was operated on the ground in the GV pod. It was located in the parking lot of the Foothills Lab 1 building of the NCAR campus in Boulder, Colorado, USA. The testing took place from May 10 to June 27, 2024 and consisted of 11 Intensive Operation Periods (IOPs). Time series data is very large (~11 GB per file). Please request less than 2 minutes of data per order.

dataset.title: Model 48 hour forecast sfc temps,winds, 500mb heights (GIF)
dataset.description: This data set contains National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) 48 hour forecast of surface winds and temperature and 500 mb heights for the SHEBA domain from SSEC at University of Wisconsin.

dataset.title: NEXRAD MPX (Minneapolis, MN) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Minneapolis, MN. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Summary Files From Boulder Workshop, gur-hedge data
dataset.description: This dataset contains hedge data from both terrestrial and marine ecosystems. These are summary data from the Boulder Workshop, 2001.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 5 minute Quality Controlled ISFF surface and chemistry data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 5 minute averaged NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) data collected by 3 ISFF towers during the Carbon in the Mountains Experiment of 2004 (CME04). This dataset contains means and higher moments from all sensors acquired by NCAR during CME04, including fast-response CO2 data, in NetCDF format. These data have been quality controlled, and winds from sonic anemometers have been tilt corrected and rotated to a geographic coordinate system.

dataset.title: BLC/MPL Cloud Composite Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/NESOB-97 ARMCART SGP Belfort Laser Ceiliometer (BLC) and MicroPulse Lidar (MPL) data for the NESOB-97 domain and time period. The 110-meter upward vertical offset present in the NESOB96 BLC data is not present in this dataset. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Tropical Cyclone Initiation Experiment (TEXMEX). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL 915 MHz Wind Profiler NIMA Consensus Winds, Moments, and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the University of Michigan Biological Station (UMBS) in Pellston, MI during the Program for Research on Oxidants: Photochemistry, Emmissions, and Transport (PROPHET) intensive observing period that occurred in the summer of 2000. This dataset includes doppler moments data (.momnc), 30 minute consensus winds data (.windsnc), and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures (.rassnc) in NetCDF format. These data are in daily tar files and have been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the ELectra DOppler RAdar (ELDORA) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the ARISTO2016 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: PMS-2D Two-dimensional Cloud Probe data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains raw (binary "filmstrip" imagery) files of PMS-2D data collected by the NSF/NCAR C-130 (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Beaufort Arctic Storms Experiment (BASE).

dataset.title: NWS Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This data set contains rawinsonde profiles from 34 National Weather Service (NWS) upper-air sites archived during the Bow Echo and Mesoscale Convenctive Experiment (BAMEX). During BAMEX,rawinsondes were released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC. The data files consist of vertical profiles of temperature, dew point, relative humidity, u and v wind components, total wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. The vertical resolution is six seconds. This data set has been quality controlled by The Joint Office for Science Support (JOSS). Consult the README for more information.

dataset.title: METEOSAT7 Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains Meteosat-7 visible (channel 1) imagery over the DYNAMO region. These images were developed by NCAR/EOL and are in jpg format.

dataset.title: NAS Lemoore Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). It includes 28 high vertical resolution (2 second) soundings from Naval Air Station (NAS) LeMoore, CA. Soundings were released from 2 Mar to 27 Apr 2006. Soundings were only released during Intensive Observing Periods (IOP). The site used Vaisala GPS radiosondes.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the Marine Stratus Studies - 1981 (MSS-81) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Bordeaux (France)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Bordeaux in France (WMO 07510) which was operated by Meteo-France. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when soundings were taken up to eight times per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC) IOP1
dataset.description: This dataset contains measurements of cloud particle size distributions collected during the ACE-ENA (IOP1) project using an airborne holographic instrument mounted on the DOE G1. The HOLODEC-II is a second-generation version of a holographic detecter designed to determine the size, two-dimensional shape, and three-dimensional position of hydrometeors via digital in-line holography. Advantages vs other hydrometeor detectors are that the sample volume is not size dependent, relative positions of hydrometeors in the sample volume can be determined in three dimensions, and effects produced by shattering from the aperture edges can be identified and eliminated. Automated analysis programs have been developed to process the holograms collected and produce size distributions. HOLODEC-II has sufficient resolution to determine the sizes and locations of cloud droplets as well as ice crystals. A separate dataset (562.001) has been created for IOP2. Please see the link below to access the ACE-ENA IOP2 dataset page.

dataset.title: Constant Pressure Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 12-hourly constant pressure maps over the United States generated from twice-daily sonde launched from weather stations within the ICE-L region. For each weather station, the maps report temperature (°C) to the upper left, dewpoint depression (°C) below it, altitude of the pressure level (decameters) to the upper right, and a wind barb representing the wind speed and direction. The levels included are 150, 200, 250, 300, 500, 700, 800, and 850 mb (millibars). The imagery was generated in real-time by NCAR/RAL during the ICE-L field project and covers the time span from 2007-10-24 12:00:00 to 2007-12-03 12:00:00. The imagery is in GIF format.

dataset.title: NCAR 100-hz Mixing Ratio Lyman-Alpha (MRLA) in NASA Ames format
dataset.description: This data set includes data obtained from the CIRPAS Twin Otter aircraft during the "Physics of Stratocumulus Tops"(POST) project off the coast of Monterey, CA. This data set contains 100-Hz Mixing Ratio Lyman-Alpha data in Ames format.

dataset.title: MTSAT-1R AGGH Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains AGGH Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-1R satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-23 16:30:00 to 2009-12-21 21:30:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the ICE-L project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2007-10-15 17:15:00 to 2007-12-31 02:00:00.

dataset.title: BLC/MPL Cloud Composite Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains the GCIP/NESOB-96 ARMCART SGP Belfort Laser Ceiliometer (BLC) and MicroPulse Lidar (MPL) data for the NESOB-96 domain and time period. The BLC cloud heights contain a 110-meter upward vertical offset that has not been corrected in the data. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-Pol radar moments data collected during the Mesoscale Alpine Programme (MAP) from September 4 to November 6, 1999. The data are available as tar files in dorade format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the COSE-79 project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, DORADE
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) Doppler Radar Data Exchange (DORADE) data from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX). Due to the size of the dataset, it is recommended that the user restrict data orders to a few hours at a time per order (~1.5 GB per hour of data).

dataset.title: GOES 12 SouthWest 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 SouthWest 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data
