dataset.description: 1-minute surface meteorology data in netCDF format, collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the CHEESEHEAD field campaign. These data have been quality controlled. Click on the 'Related Links' below that accesses the daily time series plots.

dataset.title: DYCOMS-II Aircraft: C-130 Mandatory and Significant Level Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: The C-130 Mandatory and Significant Level Dropsonde Data is one of several aircraft data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are mandatory and significant level dropsonde data released from the National Science Foundation/National Center for Atmospheric Research C-130 aircraft. The data cover the period from 10 - 26 July Several dropsondes were released on each of the flight days (10, 11, 13, 17, 18, 24, 25, and 26 July). NCAR/EOL has performed no quality control on these data.

dataset.title: ISFF High Rate Array Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description:
THIS DATASET HAS BEEN REPLACED WITH VERSION 2.0 ISFS TOWER AND ARRAY HIGH RATE NETCDF DATA. TO DOWNLOAD THE NEW DATASET GO TO: https://data.eol.ucar.edu/dataset/edit/129.005 -----------------------
This data set from the Integrated Surface Flux Facility (ISFF) during the Canopy Horizontal Array Turbulence Study (CHATS) contains High-rate array data in netCDF files. The data of sonics, licors, hygrometer, and pressure sensors are 60 Hz rate data; while soil, rain, barometer, and TRH's data are in 1 Hz rate. Array data begins March 13, 2007 at 16:00.

dataset.title: TDWR: National Weather Service Soundings [NWS]
dataset.description: These data sets are from a National Weather Service (NWS) sounding station near Denver's Stapleton International Airport to support ATD and MMM scientists testing concepts to nowcast thunderstorms and related phenomena. Data were collected during the summer of 1988, 1989 and 1991. It is recommended that data orders be restricted to one year period at a time. Data from 1989 and 1991 are in multiple files and ascii format. Data from 1988 are in a single tar file and are in binary format.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar moments data
dataset.description: 10Hz HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected during the Nor'easter project on 2 February 2015. The data are in cfRadial format and are available in hourly tar files.

dataset.title: GOES-West Imager Visible CH1 Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains GOES-15 Imager CH1 Visible Satellite data (AREA format). The data are provided as TAR/GNU zip files. Each tar file contains all routine GOES sectors scanned for that date. These sectors are the original GOES sectors, including CONUS, Northern Hemisphere, Southern Hemisphere, Full Disk and Rapid Scan (as available). The suggested software for manipulating and displaying these data is McIDAS. The data covers the DC3 project study area from 16 May to 30 June 2012.

dataset.title: GOES-11 4KM Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This data set consists of GOES-11 4 kilometer satellite imagery from the CuPIDO Field Catalog. It contains the 4km_ch1_vis, 4km_ch3_water_vapor, and 4km_ch4_thermal-IR imagery.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During SAANGRIA TEST, the GV_N677F flew a forward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. The data is in JPG format.

dataset.title: Aircraft Tower Fly-by Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft tower fly-by data during Phases I and III. Title, vessel(s), and phase are noted in the "Description" section on the order page. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: Researcher All-Sky Camera
dataset.description: These films include footage of the sky from the US ship Researcher for Phases I, II, and III of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Phase is noted in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: BLX-96: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This data set from the Boundary Layer Experiment 1996 (BLX-96) was collected near Dexter, Kansas from a Cross-Chain LORAN Atmospheric Sounding System station. There are 3 tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR GV-HSRL lidar data
dataset.description: High Spectral Resolution Lidar (HSRL) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research) (N677F) during the CSET (Cloud Systems Evolution in the Trades) project from 1 July 2015 to 12 August 2015. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar archives.

dataset.title: NCAR REAL Lidar Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains png images from the NCAR REAL Lidar Imagery dataset. The dataset is from the TREX period from 20060314 to 20060501 and contains both RHI and PPI images. When ordering or browsing data, be aware of the following data gap. There is no data for the following days: 20060424-28

dataset.title: ISS Wind Lidar Data Products
dataset.description: Leosphere Windcube Lidar products collected by the EOL Integrated Sounding System team during the Sundowner Wind EXperiment (SWEX) field campaign in Santa Barbara, CA. All data for a given scan type (i.e. PPI, RHI, VER, and DBS) are available for order as tarred, compressed files (.tar.gz). These include CF-Radial lidar parameters provided in individual netCDF files for each scan. Also available in this dataset are quality controlled, daily netCDF files of Velocity Azimuth Display (VAD) technique derived wind profiles and 30-minute consensus averaged wind profiles. These are also orderable as individual compressed, tar files (.tar.gz) by product type. Please see included Data Report for detailed description of available products as well as quality control information.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-12-18 21:00:00.

dataset.title: GALE: CLASS Soundings
dataset.description: Sounding data from the Genesis of Atlantic Lows Experiment (GALE) is contained in a tar file for each of the 8 Cross-chain LORAN Sounding System (CLASS) locations. Refer to information within the individual files for the exact time of the beginning of the CLASS ascent.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes EXperiment (VORTEX). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-13 Imager 4 km All Channel Data
dataset.description: This data set contains the 4km resolution all channel data over the southeastern United States from the GOES-13 satellite during the VORTEX-SE_2017 field campaign. The GOES-13 channels are visible (channel 1), near-IR (2), water vapor (3), thermal IR (4), and 13 micron (6). The data are in gzipped McIDAS AREA format files. This is a large data set, consisting of approximately 6 GB daily. Please consider the size of the data set when making your order. You can order 9 days in a single order.

dataset.title: Left-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During OTREC, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a left looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the GV flight track in real-time during thePACDEX project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (Monticello)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Monticello site (ISS3) in central Illinois during the Flatland Observatory Project in 1995. These data are in monthly netCDF files and have not been QC'd.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Padang Radiosonde L3.1 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 421 high vertical resolution soundings from Padang, Indonesia (WMO 96163) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC during October and November 2011 and January through March 2012 and four times daily at 00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC during December 2011. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This L3.1 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014. It includes the L3.0 corrections (application of PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level) as well a correction for reducing the temperature discontinuity at around 300 hPa. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Lake Victoria Region SYNOP Data (SYNOP ASCII Format)
dataset.description: This data set includes the SYNOP surface meteorological observations from stations in the Lake Victoria region of Africa. SYNOP messages are typically sent every six hours. The data are in the SYNOP ASCII format.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Profiler Moments and Wind Profiler Imagery
dataset.description: ISS 915 MHz radar wind profiler moments and wind profiler imagery produced during the DC3 project. The imagery are in PNG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2012-05-03 00:00:00 to 2012-06-29 23:59:59.

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data collected from five MPDs starting in March 2018. The insturments were deployed in several locations. It is an engineering dataset which contains a mix of testing and field campaign data and should only be used in collaboration with the NCAR lidar group for scientific analysis. The data is organized in separate daily tar files for each MPD and can be ordered for all MPDs together or separately for each instrument by setting the "Event" flag during the ordering process.

dataset.title: BALTEX: Sodankyla Flux Data Set
dataset.description: This dataset contains the Coordinated Energy and Water Cycle Observation Project (CEOP) Enhanced Observing Period 3 (EOP-3) and Enhanced Observing Period 4 (EOP-4) Baltic Sea Experiment (BALTEX) Sodankyla 30 minute flux data set. This dataset contains the complete EOP-3 and EOP-4 time period (i.e. 1 October 2002 to 31 December 2004). The flux data are collected 25 and 23.5 m above ground and retrieved with 30 minute averaging. This data set contains both ASCII data and netCDF data. The ASCII data file covers the entire time period for all stations. The netCDF data file covers the entire time period with one netCDF file for each station.

dataset.title: HLY-02-01 Ship Track Regional View (Plot) [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset consists of .png images plotting the ship location and track of the United States Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy during the SBI Spring 2002 Cruise (HLY-02-01).

dataset.title: MTSAT-2 Leg6 NZCH-YMHB Ch2 Thermal IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NZCH-YMHB Channel 2 thermal IR imagery from the MTSAT-2 satellite taken during the HIPPO-4 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2011-06-07 23:32:00 to 2011-07-14 15:32:00.

dataset.title: Grawmet Radiosonde System Northwest Granite Launch site Data (UoU)
dataset.description: This data set contains the University of Utah's Grawmet Radiosonde System data from the Northwest of Granite launch site. Data was collected during intense observation periods between 14 May and 23 May 2013 for the Mountain Terrain Atmospheric Modeling and Observations (MATERHORN-X) field campaign. Files are the original data and have not been quality controlled. The format is ASCII tab separated and consists of separate files for each radiosonde release. The time stamps are based off of UTC time for all the instruments for the MATERHORN-X data, unless it was stated otherwise. Please refer to the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: NCDC Daily Evaporation Dataset
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 Surface NCDC Daily Evaporation Dataset contains data from the National Climatic Data Center (NCDC). This dataset was formed by extracting evaporation data from the GCIP/Enhanced Seasonal Observing Period 1996 (GCIP/ESOP-96) NCDC Summary of the Day Cooperative Dataset for the NESOB 1996 area and time of interest.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Pangkal Pinang Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 297 high vertical resolution soundings from Pangkal Pinang, Indonesia (WMO 96237) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 5 October 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: STERAO-A sounding data
dataset.description: Radiosonde data collected during the first Stratospheric-Tropospheric Experiment: Radiation, Aerosols, and Ozone (STERAO). Files beginning in "i" are class interpolated data; filenames beginning in "m" are class raw thermodynamic data; files beginning in "x" are class 10 second data. Data are in ASCII text format, in a single gzipped file.

dataset.title: Intersection of Climate Change, Water Resources and Humans in the Arctic
dataset.description: This data set contains two spreadsheets. One contains data consisting of conductivity and temperature at sites on the Seward Peninsula. The other contains records of E. coli and coliform in wells in the same area.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130Q Hercules aircraft (Tail Number N130AR) during the "Ice in Clouds Experiment -L" (ICE-L) project. This data set contains the High-Rate (HRT, 25 sps, mixed) production data. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar uncorrected field data, MDV
dataset.description: S-band Polarimetric (S-Pol) uncorrected field data, CIDD Meterological Data Volume (mdv) format, from the Terrain-influenced Monsoon Rainfall Experiment (TiMREX). There are dual sets of mdv files, one for VIRAQ and one for the HAWK spol processor. When ordering, be aware that the size of each file is listed and is about 4 GB.

dataset.title: Surface Time Series
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of time series surface data from B-Scale ships (Oceanographer, Vize, Vanguard, Quadra, Meteor, Researcher, Dallas, Gilliss, Bidassoa) for Phases I, II, and III, as well as Inter Phases, of the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE). Title, vessel, and phase are specified in the "Description" section on the order page.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR uncorrected radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected aboard the HIAPER NSF/NCAR GV aircraft during the 2013 Instrument Development and Education in Airborne Science GV (IDEAS-4 GV) project from 23 September 2013 to 14 November 2013. The data are in cfRadial format and are available as daily tar files.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (Sabreliner) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number N307D) during the Convective Waves over Ocean (Wave) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Flight Tracks - Google Earth .kml files
dataset.description: KML is a file format used to display geographic data in an Earth browser such as Google Earth. This dataset contains KML files used to display the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV flight track in real-time during the ECLIPSE.

dataset.title: Webcam Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set contains webcam imagery from the CuPIDO Field Catalog.

dataset.title: OLYMPICS84: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single ascii text file of data from 10 PAM-II stations deployed near the Los Angeles 1984 Summer Olympics.

dataset.title: SNOWIE Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from SNOWIE (Seeded and Natural Orographic Wintertime Clouds: The Idaho Experiment) from 8 January - 16 March, 2017. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the SNOWIE project.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During MPEX, the GV_N677F flew a forward-looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-14 16:22:00 to 2009-12-19 16:22:00.

dataset.title: GOES-East Sea-Surface Temperature Imagery
dataset.description: This is the Sea-Surface Temprature imagery collected from the GOES-8 satellite during the EPIC time period.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the DYnamics and Chemistry Of Marine Stratocumulus experiment (DYCOMS) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: MAYPOL84: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing cmf text files of PAM-II station data from the May Polarization Experiment 1984.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during ROSE-Air II project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NWS Oakland, CA High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The NWS High Resolution Oakland,CA Sounding Data is one of several upper air data sets collected by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL) as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project. Included in the data set are pressure, temperature, relative humidity, U and V wind components, and altitude measured during rawinsonde flights from the National Weather Service upper air sounding site in Oakland ,California. The data set covers the period from 7 - 28 July 2001. The soundings are typically available twice per day at 00 and 12 UTC. NCAR/EOL has performed automated quality control on this data set. See the README for more details.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL BuFEX 2007 QC Radiosonde Dataset
dataset.description: This dataset contains 214 quality-controlled radiosonde data files, in the EOL sounding format, collected at two locations near Lake King in Australia during the Bunny Fence Experiment in 2007. A total of 108 radiosondes were launched from the west site and 106 from the east site.

dataset.title: ISS MAPR Wind Profiler Data Products
dataset.description: Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) during the Cloud and Precipitation Study (CPS). This dataset includes doppler moments data (*.mom.nc) and 5-minute and 30-minute consensus winds data (*.winds_05.nc and *.winds_30.nc) in daily tar files. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: GOES-11 1KM Satellite Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set consists of GOES-11 1 kilometer satellite imagery from the CuPIDO Field Catalog. It contains the 1km_ch1_vis imagery.

dataset.title: Multi-Network 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled interpolated 5mb vertical resolution radiosonde data from all sources (National Weather Service and NOAA/National Severe Storms Laboratory), for the Targeted Observation by Radars and UAS of Supercells 2019 (TORUS_2019) field season. A total of 1457 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final data set. Additional soundings from Purdue University are expected to be included later.

dataset.title: National Weather Service (NWS) High Resolution Soundings
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Stratosphere-Troposphere Analyses of Regional Transport 2008 (START08). This data set includes a total of 11999 high vertical resolution soundings from the 70 National Weather Service rawinsonde stations in the contiguous United States. This includes 8725 1-second vertical resolution soundings from the 50 stations that utilized the Radiosonde Replacement System (RRS) with GPS windfinding and 3274 6-second vertical resolution soundings from the 20 stations that used the MicroArt sounding system and radiotheolodite windfinding. The data cover the period from 1200 UTC on 1 April 2008 to 30 June 2008. The soundings were typically released twice a day at 0000 and 1200 UTC. Three stations (Albuquerque, NM; Del Rio, TX; Santa Teresa/El Paso, TX) switched from MicroArt to RRS soundings during this time period. The data are in EOL Sounding Composite format (columnar ascii). NOTE: This is a large dataset; please do not order the complete dataset in one order. Limit each order to no more than 30 days.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Gulfstream V (HIAPER) aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the "Stratosphere- Troposphere Analyses of Regional Transport 2008 " (START08) project. This data set contains merged Low-Rate (LRT, 1 sps) production, DGPS, and CO data. This data also contains updates to dewpoint measurement and dependent variables; 2D-C concentrations, histograms and related variables; solar zenith angle variables. The files are in netCDF format. This dataset was updated March 25, 2010.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NCRG-NZCH-AGGH 5km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 10:57:00 to 2010-04-20 14:52:00.

dataset.title: GOES-16 Geostationary Lightning Mapper Lightning Cluster-Filter Algorithm Data
dataset.description: The lightning detection data from the GOES-16 satellite Geostationary Lightning Mapper (GLM) during the period of TORUS_2022 operations. The data are in NetCDF files packed into daily tar files.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Mobile GAUS Radiosonde Profiles - EOL Sounding Format
dataset.description: The Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Tornadoes Experiment (VORTEX2) is a project aimed at investigating tornado genesis and examining tornado structure and evolution using a suite of atmospheric instruments. The VORTEX2 field campaign included the use of four mobile GPS Advanced Upper-Air Sounding (GAUS) systems. This dataset contains 121 radiosonde soundings collected during the 2009 field campaign (May 7 - June 14, 2009) and 174 radiosonde soundings collected during the 2010 field campaign (May 6 - June 15, 2010) from two of the mobile GAUS systems that were deployed by EOL's Atmospheric Profiling Group (APG). These soundings were quality controlled by NCAR/EOL.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR G-V QC Dropsonde Data (EOL)
dataset.description: During the GISMOS project 20 dropsonde soundings were collected between February 14 and February 22, 2008. All 20 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final archive. GISMOS was a project conducted over the Gulf of Mexico on the G-V aircraft. The purpose of the project was to test the GNSS Instrument System for MultiStatic and Occultation Sensing, a HAIS instrument. GISMOS is part of the HEFT-08 project. HEFT-08 is one of a series of airborne projects that are conducted by the Research Aviation Facility, part of the Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL/RAF), to allow instrument developers flight time on the G-V. The goals of the HEFT projects are instrument validation, performance testing and preparation for research field deployments. During the GISMOS project 20 dropsonde soundings were collected between February 14 and February 22, 2008. All 20 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final archive.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Keflavic (Iceland)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Keflavic in Iceland (WMO 04018) which was operated by the Iceland Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 5 second vertical intervals up to 480 seconds, and 10 second vertical intervals after 480 seconds. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: NSF NCAR C-130 Low-rate (LRT) Data
dataset.description: Low-rate data in netCDF format are available here for each flight of the NCAR C-130 that occurred during the SHEBA project (16 flights total) in the spring and summer of 1998. The SHEBA C-130 dataset documentation (most of the materials made available in the previously-released data notebooks) have been put on-line via the RAF web site. This will enable all users of the data to access the most critical documentation and data quality materials and to assemble their own copies of the documentation package. This documentation web site may be reached by selecting the associated dataset SHEBA: Aircraft NCAR C-130 Documentation and Data Quality Materials.

dataset.title: NCAR King Air Video Camera Movies
dataset.description: This dataset contains mpg movies from videos taken on the NCAR King Air during the HAPEX-MOBILHY (Hydrological Atmospheric Pilot Experiment - Modelisation du BiLan Hydrique) project. Each hour of mpg movie file is about 1.3 Gb in size.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar (SABL) - NetCDF format [Morley, B. (NCAR/RSF)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the DYCOMS-II (Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II) project. The data are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the STORM-FEST project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Mexican CICESE R/V Francisco de Ulloa High Resolution Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME). This data set includes the high resolution (2 second) rawinsonde data from the Centro de Investigación Científica y de Educatción Superior de Ensenada (CICESE) Research Vessel (R/V) Francisco de Ulloa. During NAME the R/V Francisco de Ulloa conducted two cruises (5-21 June and 6-16 August 2004) through the Gulf of California. Soundings were typically released four times per day. More information about the R/V Francisco de Ulloa can be found at http://oceanografia.cicese.mx/fcoulloa.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set includes the quality controlled 5mb vertical resolution radiosonde data from all sources (National Weather Service and mobile soundings from the University of Louisiana Monroe and University of Alabama Huntsville), for the Verification of the Origins of Rotation in Thunderstorms Experiment-Southeast 2018 (VORTEX-SE_2018) project period (9 March to 16 April 2018). A total of 971 quality-controlled soundings are contained in the final data set.

dataset.title: Regional Surface Station Plot Imagery
dataset.description: The Regional Surface Station Plot Imagery (GIF) is one of several surface products collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus PhaseII: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project field catalogoperated by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL: http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms). The images are produced by NCAR/EOL every hour and include surface station plots from surface land stations, buoys, and ships of opportunity. The products cover the period from 1-29 July 2001 and cover the region from about 26-40 N and 112-130 W. All images are in GIF format.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol radar moments data, CfRadial
dataset.description: S-Pol data from the PRECIP98 project, in support of NASA's TEFLUN-B study near Melborne, Florida. These data are in cfRadial format and are available in daily tar files. Each daily tar file is between 1 and 8 gigbytes.

dataset.title: WAVE: King Air Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR King Air aircraft during WAVE. This dataset contains left-looking video of research flight rf02.

dataset.title: NCAR S-PolKa site WebCam images, looking north
dataset.description: Daily tar files of jpg images taken every 6 seconds during a 14 hour period. These images are from the North facing camera of the four cameras mounted at the NCAR S-PolKa Radar. When ordering data, please be aware that a daily tar file is just over 500MB.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Hemsby (United Kingdom)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Hemsby in the United Kingdom (WMO 03496) which was operated by the UK Meteorological Office. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) except during selected IOPs when it was up to eight per day (also 03, 09, 15, and 21 UTC). These data were processed through automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at two second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Costa Rican Daily Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This data set contains daily precipitation data from Costa Rica. Data are from 45 sites within Costa Rica covering the time period January 1991 to December 1994, and January to December 1997.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) HRT Differential GPS Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains Differential GPS data collected from the Gulfstream-V aircraft during the T-REX field project. Differential GPS (DGPS) data are time series of three-dimensional airplane coordinates that provide increased accuracy and precision compared to standard GPS measurements. DGPS data were collected using a Sensor Systems model # S67-1575-76 L1/L2 antenna and NovAtel OEM4 dual-frequency (L1/L2) receiver. The files are in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the In-Cloud Temperature (SPICE) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Hanna90: PAM-II Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file from 13 PAM stations deployed along the Wyoming-Colorado border.

dataset.title: Holographic Detector for Clouds (HOLODEC) LRT (1sps) binned particle count and concentration data - CSV format [EOL/RAF]
dataset.description: This dataset contains binned histograms of sample rate counts and concentrations from cloud particles collected during the CSET project using an airborne holographic instrument (HOLODEC) mounted on the NSF/NCAR Gulfstream V (N677F). The data contains 1 second averages of total and binned counts and concentrations. As the HOLODEC collects 3.3 holograms per second, their are either three or four holograms averaged into each second of data.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Ceilometer Data (ISS2 Rogers Farm Site)
dataset.description: This dataset contains Ceilometer data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located at the Rogers Farm site east of Lincoln, NE during the GRAINEX field campaign. This dataset includes raw ceilometer data in ASCII text format, L3 netCDF, as well as plots of the data in png format. These data have been reviewed for completeness and quality. Regarding documentation for the GRAINEX Ceilometer ASCII data. Documentation for the ASCII raw data files can be found in the Vaisala Ceilometer CL51 Users Guide (refer to page 60 CL51 data message section). Link to the document is found in the Documentation section below.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from ASAP ship Nuca Arctica
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from the Danish ASAP ship the Nuca Arctica which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC) while the ship was within the FASTEX domain. These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: FIB-II: King Air Photography Cloud Videos
dataset.description: This dataset consists of mpg files from video tape (VHS) from flights of the NCAR King Air aircraft (N312D) during the Fires in Brazil-II project (FIB-II). This dataset contains forward-looking video from only the RF-04 flight (so far).

dataset.title: NDTP: CLASS Soundings [NCAR]
dataset.description: This sounding data was collected during the North Dakota Thunerstorm Project (NDTP), from two NCAR Cross Chain Loran Atmospheric Sounding System (CLASS) stations. Data is in a single tar file of rawinsonde data in three versions: "i" data interpolated to every 5mb, "m" with 1-second raw dat with data flags collected during the sonde ascent, and "x" 10 second interval data. Data is in raw ascii format.

dataset.title: CABL high-rate ISFS data, QC&#39;d, geographic and tilt corrected sonic winds
dataset.description: This dataset contains high-rate surface meteorology data from the NCAR/EOL Integrated Surface Flux System (ISFS) collected during the Characterizing the Atmospheric Boundary Layer (CABL) field campaign. These data are in NetCDF format, and have been quality controlled. The winds from sonic anemometeres are in geographic coordinates and have been tilt corrected.

dataset.title: NCAR S-Pol site webcam images, looking north
dataset.description: North-looking webcam images of the S-PolKa radar site collected during the FRONT (Front Range Observational Network Testbed) project from 1 January 2014 through 10 April 2015. See the FRONT S-Pol Data Availability 2014-2015 document linked below to check on data availability. These data are available as JPEG images in daily tar archives.

dataset.title: NEXRAD INX (Tulsa, OK) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Tulsa, OK. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the Momentum Flux Intercomparison (MFI) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Hovmoller GOES-13 and Meteosat-9 Products
dataset.description: This dataset consists of Hovmoller GOES-13 and Meteosat-9 jpeg images from the PRE-Depression Investigation of Cloud-systems in the Tropics (PREDICT) project.

dataset.title: HS3 2012 Global Hawk Dropsonde Data
dataset.description: NOAA/NASA Global Hawk Dropsonde data from six research flights conducted between September 7 and 26, 2012 for the Hurricane and Severe Storm Sentinel (HS3) project. The GH is equipped with an NCAR/NOAA dropsonde system specially designed for remote operation. 337 quality controlled soundings in EOL file format are avilable. Version 5 of the dataset was corrected for a dry bias of the RH sensor and dewpoint was recomputed, however in creating these we lost the GPS filtering correction that had been applied to version 3. Version 6 contains both the dry corrections and the GPS filtering of latitude, longitude and altitude.

dataset.title: Japan Research Vessel Seifu Maru High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC). It includes 53 high vertical resolution (2-second) radiosonde soundings from the Japanese R/V Seifu Maru. The soundings were typically released two times per day (00 and 12 UTC) from 30 August to 28 September 2008. The soundings from R/V Seifu Maru were released in the Eastern China Sea to the west of Kyushu, Japan. The raw sounding data were made available by the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). NCAR/EOL converted these soundings to the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) columnar ASCII format and conducted a series of quality control checks.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ACCLIP-TEST, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: NCAR MAPR Wind Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set was collected during the Terrain-induced Rotor Experiment (T-REX). It includes 30 minute and 5 minute MAPR consensus winds taken from February 26,2006 to April 30, 2006. Also included are moment files. The MAPR was located at the gravel pit in the town of Independence, California.

dataset.title: NWS High-Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The GCIP/NESOB-96 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 12 sites in the ESOP-96 domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds up to 3000 m above the surface. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude.

dataset.title: Multi-Network Composite 5mb Vertical Resolution Sounding Composite
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of radiosondes collected from 7 sounding platforms during the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Experiment (DC3) with data collected from 1 May 2012 through 18 July 2012. This project was conducted in the central United States. This dataset includes a total of 5887 soundings from the following networks: ARM Radiosonde Data (238 2-second soundings), NCAR/EOL MGAUS Colorado Sounding Data (31 1-second soundings), NCAR/EOL MISS Colorado Radiosonde Data (27 1-second soundings), NSSL MGAUS Oklahoma-Texas Sounding Data (39 1-second soundings), National Weather Service (NWS) High Resolution Radiosonde Data (5520 1-second soundings), Redstone Arsenal Radiosonde Data (10 2-second soundings), and University of Alabama Huntsville (UAH) Mobile Alabama Sounding Data (22 1-second soundings). This data set contains upper-air sounding data interpolated to a constant vertical resolution of 5 hPa in the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR) Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) Sounding Composite Format.

dataset.title: Grawmet Radiosonde System Southwest Granite Launch site Data (UoUtah)
dataset.description: This data set contains the University of Utah's Grawmet Radiosonde System data from the Southwest of Granite launch site. Data was collected during intense observation periods on 7 May 2013 for the Mountain Terrain Atmospheric Modeling and Observations (MATERHORN-X) field campaign. Files are the original data and have not been quality controlled. The format is ASCII tab separated and consists of separate files for each radiosonde release. The time stamps are based off of UTC time for all the instruments for the MATERHORN-X data, unless it was stated otherwise. Please refer to the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: GMS 4-channel Imagery
dataset.description: The ACE-ASIA Satellite: GMS 4-channel Imagery (JOSS) are online data. All data is in JPG format.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - NASA AMES format
dataset.description: This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO-4. The data are in NASA Ames format.

dataset.title: NIMROD: PAM-I Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This dataset is a single tar file containing data from 27 PAM-I stations.

dataset.title: GOES-11 16km Ch3 Water Vapor Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 16km Channel 3 water vapor imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2008-12-12 09:00:00 to 2009-02-01 18:00:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the MethaneAIR project, including low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Convective Waves project. This dataset contains HRT rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg6 NTAA-SCIP 4km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2008-12-12 11:22:00 to 2009-02-01 19:22:00.

dataset.title: High Rate (HRT - 25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the JASIN project.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Driftsonde Data
dataset.description: Driftsonde sounding data for the THORPEX Pacific Asian Regional Campaign (T-PARC) project. The files are in EOL format, an ascii text format including a header and typically seventeen columns of high resolution data. See the Documentation for a more complete descrition of this data set.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Aerosol Cloud Particle Imager (CPI) Data
dataset.description: The Cloud Particle Imager captures high-resolution images (pixel size 2.3 microns) using a CCD camera. The CPI has two Particle Detector Sensor lasers that instruct the camera to capture an image. This dataset contains region of interest (roi) binary image files of cloud particles which can be viewed using the IDL software linked to below For all of the flights, the CPI makes as many *.roi files as it needs; each file can be maximum 92Mb size and then a new file is opened.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number: N312D) during the Particulate Airborne Inlet Research (PAIR) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: NEXRAD UDX (Rapid City, SD) Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes NEXRAD Reflectivity and Velocity Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalogs for 2009 and 2010. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Rapid City, SD. The files are in .gif format. Imagery files are only available for the VORTEX2 field phases for approximately May-June 2009 and April-June 2010. See the related links below to access the field catalogs for the exact time periods covered by this data set.

dataset.title: FASTEX soundings from Thorshavn (Denmark)
dataset.description: This dataset consists of sounding data from Thorshavn on Faroe Island (WMO 06011) which was operated by the Danish Meteorological Institute. Soundings were taken four times per day (00, 06, 12, and 18 UTC). These data were processed through the automated and visual quality control processes. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dewpoint, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude taken at 10 second vertical intervals. Refer to the station README for details.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the TI3GER project. Files contain low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GCIP/ESOP-97 Surface: Hourly Precipitation Composite
dataset.description: The Hourly Precipitation Composite was formed from several data sources (i.e., National Climatic Data Center hourly precipitation data, National Centers for Environmental Prediction hourly precipitation, National Soil Tilth Laboratory hourly precipitation, and the precipitation data extracted from the ESOP-97 Hourly Surface Composite). Data from these sources were quality controlled and merged to form this precipitation composite.

dataset.title: NOAA Wind Profiler Network Hourly Surface
dataset.description: This dataset contains the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) 405 MHZ Wind Profiler Network (NPN) hourly surface data in JOSS Quality Control format from 2 sites within the SGP 1999 area of interest. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS).

dataset.title: LESS: PAM Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set is a single tar file containing three cmf text files of PAM station data from the Lake Effect Snow Storms experiment.

dataset.title: POES Arctic Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains Arctic CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the POES satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The data is in JPG format. The data covers the time span from 2010-03-22 12:00:00 to 2010-04-20 12:00:00.

dataset.title: NSF/NCAR C-130 Temperatures and Dew Point Imagery [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains temperature and dew point imagery from the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft collected during the MILAGRO field project.

dataset.title: NEXRAD CYS (Cheyenne, WY) Reflectivity Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains NEXRAD Reflectivity Imagery from the ICE-L Field Catalog. These imagery products are taken from the NEXRAD station located in Cheyenne, WY. The files are in .GIF format and cover the time span from 2007-11-13 18:28:00 to 2008-01-03 15:57:59

dataset.title: FIFE: ARMY CORP PAM Data [CMF]
dataset.description: This data set contains a single tar file of data from seven Army Corp PAM stations. The quality of the CMF files here are severly limited by problems associated with in-field operation of Army Corps DCP stations. Total data loss is estimated at greater than 70%.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Imagery
dataset.description: During ICE-L, the C130Q flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during ICE-L flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. The remaining images have been combined into hour long tarfiles running from zero minutes zero seconds (or the start time of the first file) to 23 minutes 59 seconds (or the end time of the last file) after each hour. Note that the first and last tarfile for each flight will contain less than a full hour of imagery. Directory files returned with each order give the contents of each corresponding tar file.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) during the Atlantic & Stratocumulus Transition EXperiment (ASTEX). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: NCAR GV (HIAPER) Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data - NASA AMES format
dataset.description:
This dataset includes low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data collected by the NCAR GV during HIPPO-2. The data are in NASA Ames format.
The up to date entry for the HIPPO-2 Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data in NASA AMES format is accessible via dataset 117.008.

dataset.title: University of Utah Halo Photonics Streamline Scanning Doppler LiDAR Data Captured During Fall Campaign (LID-UOU-FALL)
dataset.description: This data set contains the University of Utah's Halo Photonics Streamline Scanning Doppler LiDAR data. Data was collected during intense observation periods between 25 September and 13 October 2012 during the Mountain Terrain Atmospheric Modeling and Observations (MATERHORN-X) Fall field campaign. Files are the original data and have not been quality controlled. The format is ASCII tab separated and different scanning strategies have different file naming conventions. The time stamps are based off of UTC time for all the instruments for the MATERHORN-X data, unless it was stated otherwise. Please refer to the readme file for more information.

dataset.title: NCAR MPD data
dataset.description: MicroPulse Differential Absorption Lidar (MPD) data in NetCDF format collected during the Preparatory Rockies Experiment for the Campaign In the Pacific 2021 (Pre-CIP_2021), a preparatory project for the Prediction of Rainfall Extremes Campaign In the Pacific (PRECIP). The data was collected by three MPD units between June 17 and August 20, 2021, in Ft. Collins, Colorado (MPD 5), at the NCAR Foothills campus in Boulder, Colorado (MPD 2) and the NCAR Marshall Field site near Boulder, Colorado, USA (MPD 3).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Surface Meteorology Data (West Profiler Site)
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) WXT-520 that was located west of the double ridge at the West Wind Profiler Site during the Perdigao field project in 2016-2017. This dataset includes 3m temperature, humidity, pressure, winds, and precipitation, collected every minute in NetCDF format. These data are now considered quality controlled, as no changes were required during the QC process.

dataset.title: GOES-10 Channel 1 (Visible) 1KM Sectored Data in Hierarchical Data Format
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Channel 1 (Visible) 1KM Sectored Data in Hierarchical Data Format (HDF) is one of several satellite data sets collected as part of the Dynamics and Chemistry of Marine Stratocumulus Phase II: Entrainment Studies (DYCOMS-II) project by the National Center For Atmospheric Research/Earth Observing Laboratory (NCAR/EOL). NCAR/EOL utilized its SeaSpace system to retrieve data from the Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite 10 (GOES-10) and developed sectors over the DYCOMS-II region. This data set consists of the sectored 1-km data from Channel 1 (visible; 0.65um) of the GOES-10 satellite. The products cover the period from 1 - 30 July 2001 and cover the DYCOMS-II sector (27-37N and 114-126W). During the times the NSF/NCAR C-130 aircraft was in flight (see the web page http://catalog.eol.ucar.edu/dycoms/missions/ for flight times) the data are typically available every 15 minutes, but rapid scan imagery are also often available (most often during the afternoon and evening hours). For the times that the NSF/NCAR C-130 was not in flight data are available every three hours (00, 03, 06, ... UTC). All images are in HDF format. A brief description of HDF is given in Section 3.1 of the readme.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During MethaneAIR, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 15 fps. Digital camera movies are available only for Phase 1 of MethaneAIR (RF01 and RF02).

dataset.title: GOES-East 7 KM Atlantic Basin Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains 30 minute satellite imagery from the GOES-12 satellite over the RAINEX area of interest.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) during the GAMETAG-76 project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: NRL P-3 Dropsonde Skew-T plots
dataset.description: This dataset contains Skew-T plots of dropsondes from the NRL P-3. Note that dropsondes only exist for 10 days during the time period Aug 17- Sept 23.

dataset.title: NCAR HCR radar moments data
dataset.description: HIAPER Cloud Radar (HCR) data collected aboard the NSF/NCAR GV HIAPER (Gulfstream-V High-performance Instrumented Airborne Platform for Environmental Research, HIAPER) (N677F) during OTREC (Organization of Tropical East Pacific Convection). The data were collected during 22 research flights which took place between August 7 and October 2, 2019, over the East Pacific and extreme SW Caribbean Ocean.

dataset.title: NCAR/NSF C-130 High Rate (25 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight Level Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains netCDF data obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Passing Efficiency of the Low-Turbulence Inlet (PELTI) project. This data contains the High Rate (HRT, 25 sps) Flight Level production data.

dataset.title: Sensible, Latent and Ground Heat Flux Composite
dataset.description: NOAA/ATDD Little Washita flux data and ARM SGP EBBR data have been composited together into one dataset. This dataset is composed of half hourly observations of latent heat flux, sensible heat flux, and the corrected soil heat flux from 5 separate sensors. These data were not quality controlled by the University Corporation for Atmospheric Research/Joint Office for Science Support (UCAR/JOSS). However, included for checking the validity of the data are the Bowen ratio, the home_15 (Exchange Mechanism Position Indicator 1 to 15 mins) and the home_30 (Exchange Mechanism Position Indicator 15 to 30 mins). If values for home_15 or home_30 are corrupted, the latent and sensible flux fields should be considered suspect.

dataset.title: QuickSCAT WINDS Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains files from the QuickSCAT Winds Imagery for the area and the period of the VOCALS project.

dataset.title: Skew-T Plots: Anchorage
dataset.description: This dataset contains upper air Skew-T Log-P data collected at Anchorage, Alaska during the HIPPO project. The imagery are in GIF format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-01-06 00:00:00 to 2009-02-01 12:00:00.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg45 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg45 NSTU-NZCH-NTAA 4km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-2 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2009-10-06 00:00:00 to 2009-10-06 23:52:00.

dataset.title: Composite 5-mb Level Upper Air Data
dataset.description: This data set is a composite of data from all IHOP_2002 sounding platforms excluding the reference sonde interpolated to a constant vertical resolution of 5 hPa. Consult the Readme for more information about this data set. As of May 12th,2003, this dataset contains reprocessed dropsonde profiles from the Lear and Falcon. ATD provided new dropsonde data May 1st,2003. See ATD Dropsonde Reprocessing. As of 10/15/2008 this dataset contains reprocessed dropsonde profiles from the Lear and Falcon aircraft.

dataset.title: Aircraft Intercomparisons
dataset.description: This dataset includes microfilm of aircraft intercomparisons during Phases I, II, and III. Title, aircraft vessel(s), phase(s), and optional note are specified in the "Description" section on the order page. Data were collected during the Global Atmospheric Research Program's (GARP) Atlantic Tropical Experiment (GATE).

dataset.title: National Weather Service High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Deep Convective Clouds and Chemistry Project (DC3) 2012 project. This data set includes 5520 high vertical resolution soundings from 53 1-second National Weather Service (NWS) rawinsonde stations located throughout the United States for the period covering 10 May 2012 through 30 June 2012. Soundings were typically released twice daily during this period. These data were converted into the EOL Sounding Composite (ESC) format (columnar ascii).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS Radiosonde Data - ISS2 Rogers Farm Site
dataset.description: Quality controlled radiosonde data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS), using a Vaisala MW41 sounding system at the Rogers Farm site, East of Lincoln, Nebraska during the Great Plains Irrigation Experiment (GRAINEX). In total, 243 quality controlled radiosonde data files are contained in this archive in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N308D) operated by NCAR from 1978-2000. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format collected during the CYCLES-79 project.

dataset.title: Forward-Looking Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During IDEAS-4 C130, the NCAR C-130 flew a forward looking digital camera for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 512x384 pixels and 15 fps.

dataset.title: MPEX Chat Logs
dataset.description: This dataset contains the scrubbed chat logs from the Mesoscale Predictability Experiment (MPEX) project from 1 May 2013 - 14 June 2013. These chat logs contain conversations between scientists and other project participants collected during the field phase of the MPEX project.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the QueenAir, B-80 aircraft (Tail Number N306D) during the EAE project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: GTS Station Plot Imagery
dataset.description: This data set contains GTS_Station_Plot imagery from the NAME Field Catalog. The following imagery products are included: Tier1_region, Tier2_region.

dataset.title: GOES 12 NorthEast 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset includes GOES 12 NorthEast 1KM Channel 1 Visible Imagery from the VORTEX2 field catalog. The files are jpg images. See the catalog link in the related links section below to access the field catalog.

dataset.title: NWS High Resolution Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The USWRP STORM-WAVE 6-second NWS Soundings dataset contains high resolution sounding data extracted from NWS MicroART Sounding systems at 34 sites in the STORM-WAVE domain. The dataset contains one sounding level every 6 seconds. This dataset includes pressure, temperature, dew point, relative humidity, wind speed, wind direction, and altitude. These data have been extensively quality-controlled, with every sounding subjected to both computerized consistency checks and human visual review.

dataset.title: Mount Gambier Aero (94821), Australia, SkewT Imagery
dataset.description: SkewT/logP plot of the Global Telecommunications System (GTS) upper air data collected during the ACE-1 Intensive Operations in Hobart, Tasmania, via the Australian Bureau of Meteorology(BoM) McIDAS-X system, then converted to GIF image format. These data consist of real-time GTS mandatory and significant level data (temperature, dew point temperature, pressure, and winds). These soundings were typically taken at 00 UTC daily.

dataset.title: ISPA-2007 QC Radiosonde Data
dataset.description: The Inhibition of Snowfall by Pollution Aerosols (ISPA) was the second phase of a field campaign with the primary objective to better quantify the amount of water in snow pack lost due to pollution aerosols. The first phase of ISPA took place in 2002. The second phase was conducted during January and February 2007. Both phases took place near Steamboat Springs, Colorado. ISPA was organized by the Desert Research Institute (DRI), and the primary site was located on Mount Werner at the Storm Peaks Laboratory (SPL), with an EOL Integrated Sounding System located in town, near the base of the Steamboat Ski Resort. The ISS was equipped with a UHF boundary layer wind profiler, Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS), radiosonde sounding system, a surface meteorology tower, and a ceilometer for measuring cloud base heights. A total of 71 radiosonde launches were made from the ISS site, 70 of which are included in the final archive.

dataset.title: T-REX Chat Logs [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This dataset contains Chat Room log files generated during the T-REX field project. The T-REX Chat Room logs are managed by the Earth Observing Laboratory (EOL) at the National Center for Atmospheric Research (NCAR). The Chat logs are maintained as official, permanent project records. These Chat logs were reviewed by EOL and edited, if necessary and at EOL's discretion, to maintain the most accurate record for the project. EOL and UCAR disclaim all liability for the content or edited content of the Chat logs.

dataset.title: INDOEX-98: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Averaged Dorade format (Morely, B. [NCAR/EOL])
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) averaged dorade format files obtained by the ship ORV SAGAR KANYA during the Indian Ocean Experiment First Field Phase (INDOEX-98).

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL ISS 915 MHz Wind Profiler Data
dataset.description: This data set contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the Integrated Sounding Systems (ISS) during the Southern Oxidant and Aerosol Study (SOAS) from 20 May 2013 to 16 July 2013. The data are available in netCDF format and are of three types: doppler moments data (*.mom.nc), winds data (*.winds_LO.nc) and RASS virtual temperatures (*.rass.nc).

dataset.title: Panamanian Daily Precipitation Data
dataset.description: This data set contains daily precipitation data from Panama.Data are from sixteen sites within Panama covering the time period January 1990 to December 1994, and January to December 1997.

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km Ch4 Thermal-IR Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg3 PHKO-NCRG 5km CH4 thermal-IR imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 12:13:00 to 2010-04-20 14:52:00.

dataset.title: Low Rate (LRT - 1 sps) Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV aircraft (Tail Number N677F) during the CGWAVES project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) King Air aircraft (Tail Number N312D) during the Convection and Precipitation/Electrification Experiment (CaPE) project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in netCDF format.

dataset.title: GOES-West 1km Visible Channel TDF Data
dataset.description: The GOES-10 Satellite data is at 1 kilometer. The data cover the period from 1 September 2001 to 15 October 2001. That data are in tdf format.

dataset.title: NOAA N42 P-3 Dropsonde Data (.esc format)
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the Hurricane Rainband and Intensity Change Experiment (RAINEX). It includes 201 dropsondes from the NOAA P-3 N42RF aircraft. The data are 0.5 second vertical resolution. It includes dropsondes that occurred during Hurricanes Dennis (2005 Jul 8-11), Ophelia (2005 Sept 7, 9, 11, 12, 16, and 17), Rita (2005 Sept 22 and 23), and Wilma (2005 Oct 22 and 23).

dataset.title: GOES-11 Leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Ch1 Visible Satellite Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains leg2 PANC-PHKO 5km Channel 1 Visible imagery from the GOES-11 satellite taken during the HIPPO-3 project. The imagery are in JPG format. The imagery cover the time span from 2010-03-09 14:20:00 to 2010-04-20 14:45:00.

dataset.title: Lake-ICE surface: NCAR/EOL Montague ISS Surface Meteorology Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains surface meteorology data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Montague, MI (ISS1) during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (LAKE-ICE), which occurred simultaneously with the SNOWBAND project. These data are available in daily netCDF files and have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Mexico SMN-CNA Rawinsonde Data
dataset.description: This is one of the upper air data sets developed for the North American Monsoon Experiment (NAME). This data set includes the high resolution vertical (2 second) rawinsonde data from the Servicio Meteorol&ocaute;gico Nacional (SMN) Comisión Nacional del Agua (CNA), which forms part of the Secretaríade Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales (SEMARNAT). There are 15 stations that measure pressure, temperature, humidity and wind that are released twice a day. The SMN home page can be found here: http://smn.cna.gob.mx/SMN.html. The web site is in Spanish. NOTE: This data set has been corrected as of 18 March 2010 for a significant dry bias. The 9 stations that were corrected are: La Paz (MLAP), Mazatlan (MMZT), Chihuahua (MMCU), Torreon (MMTC), Monterrey (MMAN), Zacatacas (MMZC), Guadalajara (MGDL), Manzanillo (MZLO), and Empalme (MGYM). See the documentation file for details on the correction(s) applied to this data set. Also see Ciesielski et al 2009 in JTECH.

dataset.title: ISS MAPR Wind Profiler and RASS Data Products
dataset.description: This dataset contains Multiple Antenna Profiler Radar (MAPR) wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located in the Owens Valley, 5 miles south of Independence, CA during the Sierra Rotors Project in 2004 (SRP2004). This dataset includes doppler moments data, 5, 10, and 30 minute consensus winds data (.windsnc_05, .windsnc_10, and .windsnc_30), and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar - Field Dorade format [Morley, B. (NCAR/EOL)]
dataset.description: This dataset contains SABL (Scanning Aerosol Backscatter Lidar) field format files obtained aboard the NCAR/NSF C-130 aircraft during the Alliance Icing Research Study II (AIRS-II) project. The data are in DORADE format.

dataset.title: Lake-ICE upper air: NCAR/EOL Sheboygen 915MHz Wind Profiler Winds and RASS Data
dataset.description: This dataset contains 915 MHz wind profiler data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) located near Sheboygen, WI (ISS2) during the Lake-Induced Convection Experiment (LAKE-ICE), which occurred simultaneously with the SNOWBAND project. This dataset includes 30 minute consensus winds data and Radio Acoustic Sounding System (RASS) virtual temperatures in NetCDF format. These data have not been quality controlled.

dataset.title: University of Missouri 10-second Vertical Resolution Radiosonde Data Set
dataset.description: This data set includes high vertical resolution (10-second) soundings from the University of Missouri mobile sounding site from the Profiling of Winter Storms (PLOWS) 2008-2009 and PLOWS 2009-2010 field seasons. During PLOWS 2008-2009 a total of 27 soundings are included from IOP-1 (11-12 February 2009), IOP-2 (18 February 2009), and IOP-5 (28-29 March 2009). During PLOWS 2009-2010 a total of 65 soundings are included from IOP-7 (15-17 November 2009), IOP-8 (23-25 November 2009), IOP-9 (2-3 December 2009), IOP-10 (8-9 December 2009), IOP-13 (16-17 January 2010), IOP-14 (24 January 2010), and IOP-21 (22 February 2010). These soundings were provided by the University of Missouri and converted and quality controlled by NCAR/EOL. This station used IMET1 AB GPS radiosondes during PLOWS.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL Quality Controlled Radiosonde Data (Upper Orange Grove)
dataset.description: This dataset contains the quality controlled radiosonde data collected by the NCAR/EOL Integrated Sounding System (ISS) that was located at the upper orange grove site in the center of the Vale do Cobrao during the Perdigao field project in 2017. This dataset includes sounding data from daily launches occurring at 00, 06, 12, and 18 local time, as well as select periods with 3-hourly launches, in EOL format. These data have been quality controlled and include a data quality report that include information on the project, the quality control techniques applied, and subsequent corrections.

dataset.title: HLY-04-02 NCAR EOL Service Group Cruise CD [NCAR EOL Service Group]
dataset.description: This CD ROM was created 22 June 2004 at the end of the SBI Spring Cruise aboard the U.S. Coast Guard Cutter (USCGC) Healy. It is a subset of the NCAR EOL HLY-04-02 field catalog and contains the data in the state they were in as of the end of the cruise. At that time, the Conductivity Temperature Depth (CTD) and bottle data were in their final form. The state (preliminary or final) of all other datasets on this CD was unknown at that time.

dataset.title: NCAR/EOL AVAPS Electra Dropsonde Profiles
dataset.description: Dropsonde profile data collected by the NSF/NCAR L188 Electra aircraft during the Snowband Dynamics (SNOWBAND) project that took place concurrently with the Lake-ICE project. A total of 62 dropsondes were launched, of which 55 profiles are quality controlled and publicly available.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data (Electra) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Electra aircraft (Tail Number: N308D) during the ELectra raDOME tests (ELDOME). This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: VALPO Supplemental Sounding Data and Imagery
dataset.description: This dataset contains sounding data and images collected by Valporaiso University during the ICICLE (In-Cloud ICing and Large-drop Experiment) field campaign from 26 January - 8 March 2019. Data were collected with the Intermet iMet-4 Radiosonde. See the iMet-4 data sheet for instrument accuracies / uncertainties. Also contains skewT/LogP images for quick reference.

dataset.title: Indonesia Site - Manado Radiosonde L3.0 Data
dataset.description: This data set includes 361 high vertical resolution soundings from Manado, Indonesia (WMO 97014) collected during the DYNAMO field campaign for 2011-12. Soundings were typically released twice daily at 00 and 12 UTC from 30 September 2011 to 31 March 2012. The station utilized Meisei RS-06G radiosondes. These soundings were provided by JAMSTEC. This revised L3.0 version of the data set was released 20 May 2014 and adjustments were made to the PDF matching and correction for the relative humidity discontinuity at the 0C level. These adjustments were applied by JAMSTEC.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics HRT Data in GENPROI format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the L-188 Electra aircraft (Tail Number N595KR) during the GAMETAG-77 project. This dataset contains high rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in GENPRO-I format.

dataset.title: Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics LRT Data (Sabreliner) in NetCDF format
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) Sabreliner aircraft (Tail Number: N307D) during the Experiment on Rapidly-Intensifying Cyclones over the Atlantic (ERICA) project. This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Low Rate Navigation, State Parameter, and Microphysics Flight-Level Data [NCAR/EOL]
dataset.description: This data set includes airborne measurements obtained from the NCAR Research Aviation Facility (RAF) C-130 aircraft (Tail Number: N130AR) during the Small Cumulus Microphysics Study (SCMS). This dataset contains low rate navigation, state parameter, and microphysics flight-level data in NetCDF format.

dataset.title: Digital Camera Movies
dataset.description: During TI3GER, the NSF/NCAR HIAPER GV (Tail Number N677F) flew digital cameras for in-flight video capture. Individual photo jpeg images were captured once per second during flights. Images taken after dark have been stripped from this archive. Remaining images were converted to Quicktime movie files. The movies are h.264 codec playable with Quicktime (Mac and Windows), xine, (linux) and mplayer (many platforms). The original images are 1024x768 pixels and were recorded at 1 frame/second. The movies are set to play back at 15 fps. Animated plots are visible on the right side of the frame, with the following variables: Plot 1: GGALT timeseries Plot 2: DPXC timeseries Plot 3: PSX timeseries Plot 4: WIC timeseries Plot 5: ATX timeseries Plot 6: CONCD_LWOO timeseries Plot 7: ATX, GGALT 1:1 Plot 8: GGLAT, GGLON 1:1
